Episodes.Title: The Desert Gang: The Hover Cargo's in Danger
Episodes.Description: When the Blitz team and Fluggel teams get ambushed in the desert, it's up to Lenna and her new Gunsniper to save the day. Will they succeed?

Episodes.Title: Invasion of the Fierce Tigers: Transform to Zero Schneider
Episodes.Description: An unknown man named Dr. Layon decides to help the Tigers team get on the winning track again, but at what costs, and why does he want to destroy Lenna's dad?

Episodes.Title: The Princess Arrives: Mary Champ
Episodes.Description: Harry's sister Mary decides to come and make him grow up until she sees the Liger Zero. Now she wants to win the Liger Zero for herself, but can she actually defeat the Blitz team when no one else has?

Episodes.Title: Desert Tusk: Assault of the War Sharks
Episodes.Description: Altail decides to have the Back Draft group try one final test on Liger Zero to prove its the Ultimate X. Can Bit and Liger survive?

Episodes.Title: The Sensational Three: Rematch with Jack Cisco
Episodes.Description: Jack Cisco forms a team composed of nothing but Lightning Siax to do battle with the Blitz Team. Can Bit and company have any hope of winning when they only have one fast Zoid?

Episodes.Title: Zero Is Stolen: The Fiery Battle
Episodes.Description: Liger Zero is stolen by Altail and the Back Draft group to do a one-on-one battle with the Elephandor. Can Bit and Liger survive when all their safeties have been removed?

Episodes.Title: The Brave Wild Eagle: The Raynos vs. the Zabats
Episodes.Description: The Zoid battle comission allows the Blitz Team to do battle with the Back Draft Group in an approved match up, but will the Blitz Team stand a chance when Jamie is their only air pilot, and he can't even control the Raynos he now has?

Episodes.Title: Fright Day The 13th
Episodes.Description: Lenna gets challenged by the "Chainsaw" man in this classic Halloween spoof. Does she stand any chance against the mysterious Zoid that cuts everything up, or will her teammates even stand by her?

Episodes.Title: Layon Returns: Anti-Gravity Catastrophe!
Episodes.Description: Dr. Layon decides to get revenge on Dr. Toros by kidnapping Lenna and forcing the Blitz Team into a gravity free battle. Can Liger Zero and the Command Wolf defeat Layon when they can't get a firm grip on the ground?

Episodes.Title: Red Rival: Leon Toros Returns!
Episodes.Description: When the Back Draft group overwhelms Naomi, she gets help from an unlikely source. The two form a team together and challenge the Blitz Team. Can Bit and company have any chance against this new "unknown" rival?

Episodes.Title: Warriors On Vacation: The Storm Sworders
Episodes.Description: Dr. Layon joins the Back draft group to strengthen his abilities to get revenge on Toros. Can he actually finally win an illegal battle against the Blitz Team?

Episodes.Title: Love on the Battlefield: My Love, the Judge
Episodes.Description: Benjamin has fallen in love with a judge that has the same operating frequency as him. And with Harry & Bit's help he might see her again.

Episodes.Title: The Third Conversion: Zero Panzer's Debut!
Episodes.Description: Stoller has left the Back Draft group and become a legintimate Zi fighter, but will he stand a chance when the Back Draft Group decides to retaliate? Perhaps, with a little help from Bit.

Episodes.Title: The Shadow Fox: Brad's Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Brad goes looking for a mysterious new Zoid, but will his temptation to gain the Zoid cause him to leave and attack the Blitz Team?

Episodes.Title: Harry's Disaster: Dr. Laon Traps Toros!
Episodes.Description: When Lenna finally accepts a date from Harry, Dr. Layon decides they must be lovers and kidnaps Harry. Will Lenna be able to go at full strength during the next battle knowing that Layon has Harry?

Episodes.Title: The Dragon Under the Sea: In Search of the Ultimate X
Episodes.Description: The Back Draft group decides to search for another Ultimate X. Can Bit and Harry stop them from succeeding?

Episodes.Title: The Dragon Awakens: The Berserk Fury Enters the Fray
Episodes.Description: On a day of recreation, Blitz and Jack are humiliated by a kid named Vega. The next day, they are attacked by a new Zoid piloted by the same kid. Why is he attacking them?

Episodes.Title: Tournament of Heroes: The Royal Cup
Episodes.Description: All Class A teams are put into the Royal Cup competition. The winner gets admitted into Class S, but the only Zoids that can be used are what you carry on hand. There can be no repairs once a Zoid is defeated. Can the Blitz Team find a way to win with only 4 Zoids, 3 transformations, and at least 5 battle wins needed?

Episodes.Title: Survival: The Mystery of the Ultimate X
Episodes.Description: It all comes down to this. The Blitz team wins all 5 of their matches to advance to the final, but Team Vega also gets 5 wins. Which one will end up being the Ultimate champion?

Episodes.Title: The Miracle of Zero - The Wind, the Cloud and Adventure
Episodes.Description: Everyone except for the Blitz Team and the Vega team have suffered losses, so it comesdown to the two of them. Which Ultimate X will end up being the victor?

Episodes.Description: The Hills try out different churches after becoming dissatisfied with theirs.

Episodes.Title: 24 Hour Propane People
Episodes.Description: Hank and his coworkers work around the clock to keep Strickland Propane afloat.

Episodes.Title: The Texas Panhandler
Episodes.Description: Peggy tries to help a homeless woman she believes is a con artist.

Episodes.Title: Hank's Bully
Episodes.Description: Hank is bullied at work by a new employee, and struggles to handle it.

Episodes.Title: Edu-macating Lucky
Episodes.Description: Lucky decides to get his GED to prove himself to Luanne and the Hills.

Entries.Title: Star Blazers: Space Battleship Yamato 2199
Entries.Description: In 2199, Earth's fleet battles Gamilon at Pluto. Cadets Derek Wildstar and Mark Venture retrieve a message capsule from Mars containing hope for humanity—and tragic news about Wildstar's brother.

Episodes.Title: Messenger of Iscandar
Episodes.Description: In 2199, Earth's fleet battles Gamilon at Pluto. Cadets Derek Wildstar and Mark Venture retrieve a message capsule from Mars containing hope for humanity—and tragic news about Wildstar's brother.

Episodes.Title: Toward a Sea of Stars
Episodes.Description: Earth completes the interstellar warship Yamato, hidden under the ruins of its WWII namesake. Gamilon attacks during its maiden launch, forcing Captain Avatar to activate defenses prematurely.

Episodes.Title: Escape from the Jupiter Sphere
Episodes.Description: A warp malfunction strands the Yamato on a floating continent in Jupiter's atmosphere. The crew repairs the ship while fending off Gamilon forces.

Episodes.Title: Gravestone on a Frozen Field
Episodes.Description: The Yamato lands on Saturn's moon Titan for repairs. Wildstar discovers his brother's crashed ship, the Paladin, and accepts his death.

Episodes.Title: The Trap on All Sides
Episodes.Description: Colonel Ganz lures the Yamato to Pluto using planet bombs. The Reflex Gun cripples the ship, forcing Wildstar to lead a strike team to destroy it.

Episodes.Title: The Sun Sets on Pluto
Episodes.Description: Wildstar's team locates the Reflex Gun. The Yamato destroys Pluto's Gamilon base, ending the bombardment of Earth.

Episodes.Title: Farewell to the Solar System
Episodes.Description: As the Yamato exits the solar system, crew members send final messages to loved ones on Earth. Wildstar and Avatar confront personal losses.

Episodes.Title: Wish Upon a Star
Episodes.Description: Pursued by Gamilons, the Yamato navigates solar flares near a star. Desslok deploys energy-draining gas to trap the ship.

Episodes.Title: Clockwork Prisoner
Episodes.Description: The crew rebuilds a Gamilon android found on Saturn's moon. IQ-9 befriends it, revealing shared AI sentience.

Episodes.Title: Graveyard of the Universe
Episodes.Description: Trapped in a dimensional rift with a Gamilon ship, the Yamato brokers a ceasefire to escape. Mutual distrust threatens the truce.

Episodes.Title: A World I Once Saw
Episodes.Description: A captured Gamilon pilot reveals the truth behind Earth's first contact. Wildstar recalls his parents' deaths in a Gamilon attack.

Episodes.Title: What Lies Beyond
Episodes.Description: An extradimensional vessel attacks near the Milky Way's edge. Sandor discovers a link between the entity and Wave Motion energy.

Episodes.Title: The Wolf from Another Dimension
Episodes.Description: The Yamato shelters in an asteroid cluster, uncovering Gamilon tactics. General Domel plots an ambush using spatial anomalies.

Episodes.Title: The Whisper of the Witch
Episodes.Description: Kodai and Yuki return to an eerily empty Yamato. A memory-manipulating foe obstructs efforts to locate the crew.

Episodes.Title: Point of No Return
Episodes.Description: General Domel prepares a massive ambush. Unbeknownst to him, political turmoil brews on Gamilon.

Episodes.Title: A Choice for the Future
Episodes.Description: Discovery of a habitable planet sparks a mutiny. Some crew members advocate abandoning Earth to colonize the new world.

Episodes.Title: Out of the Forest of Memory
Episodes.Description: An ancient warp gate offers a shortcut. Engineer Sanada reveals secrets about the Yamato's navigation system.

Episodes.Title: Over the Black Light
Episodes.Description: The Yamato warps past planet Balun, facing a massive Gamilon fleet. A high-stakes battle ensues in the Large Magellanic Cloud.

Episodes.Title: They're Coming!
Episodes.Description: Okita navigates a lethal nebula to outmaneuver Gamilons. General Domel reinstated, pursues relentlessly.

Episodes.Title: Under a Rainbow Sun
Episodes.Description: Domel's ambush unfolds at the Rainbow Galaxy. A drill missile disables the Wave Motion Gun, forcing Sandor and IQ-9 into a race against time.

Episodes.Title: Prison Planet 17
Episodes.Description: Yuki is captured and taken to Gamilon's prison planet Leptapoda. Kodai scouts the same planet for supplies, sparking a rescue mission.

Episodes.Title: The Planet That We Head For
Episodes.Description: Iscandar and Gamilas are revealed as twin planets. The Yamato warps into enemy territory for a final approach.

Episodes.Title: One Man's War
Episodes.Description: With Gamilon possessing a Wave Motion Gun, the Yamato assaults their capital. Kodai rescues Yuki amidst chaos.

Episodes.Title: The Distant Promised Land
Episodes.Description: After defeating Desslok, the Yamato lands on Iscandar. Starsha grants the Cosmo Reverser, and Kodai learns his brother's fate.

Episodes.Title: The Forever War
Episodes.Description: En route to Earth, Desslok ambushes the Yamato for a final battle. The crew must deliver the Cosmo DNA or humanity perishes.

Episodes.Title: Earth, We're Home
Episodes.Description: The Yamato returns with seconds to spare. The Cosmo DNA restores Earth, but Captain Avatar sacrifices himself to ensure victory.

Episodes.Title: The Comet Empire
Episodes.Description: One year after saving Earth, a new threat emerges: Prince Zordar's Comet Empire. Derek Wildstar commands the Argo against Desslok's vengeful alliance with Zordar.

Entries.Title: Naruto Shippuden
Entries.Description: Two and a half years have passed since the end of the original series. Naruto returns to the Hidden Leaf Village and reunites with his friends.

Episodes.Title: Homecoming
Episodes.Description: Two and a half years have passed since the end of the original series. Naruto returns to the Hidden Leaf Village and reunites with his friends.

Episodes.Title: The Akatsuki Makes Its Move
Episodes.Description: The Akatsuki, a mysterious organization of elite rogue ninja, begins to make its move. Their goal is to capture all of the tailed beasts.

Episodes.Title: The Results of Training
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Sakura are tested by Kakashi to see how much they have grown. They must take two bells from him, just like they did when they were genin.

Episodes.Title: The Jinchuriki of the Sand
Episodes.Description: Gaara, the Kazekage of the Hidden Sand Village, is targeted by the Akatsuki. Deidara, a member of the Akatsuki, is sent to capture him.

Episodes.Title: The Kazekage Stands Tall
Episodes.Description: Gaara fights Deidara to protect his village. He is a powerful ninja, but Deidara has a few tricks up his sleeve.

Episodes.Title: Mission Cleared
Episodes.Description: Deidara captures Gaara and takes him to the Akatsuki hideout. The Hidden Sand Village is in turmoil.

Episodes.Title: Run, Kankuro
Episodes.Description: Kankuro goes after Deidara to rescue Gaara. He is a skilled puppet master, but he is no match for Sasori, another member of the Akatsuki.

Episodes.Title: Team Kakashi, Deployed
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi is sent to the Hidden Sand Village to help. They are the only ones who can save Gaara.

Episodes.Title: The Jinchuriki's Tears
Episodes.Description: Sakura heals Kankuro, who was poisoned by Sasori. She is a skilled medical ninja.

Episodes.Title: Sealing Jutsu: Nine Phantom Dragons
Episodes.Description: The Akatsuki begin the process of extracting the One-Tailed Shukaku from Gaara. The process will kill him.

Episodes.Title: The Medical Ninja's Student
Episodes.Description: Team Guy arrives to help Team Kakashi. They are a powerful team of taijutsu specialists.

Episodes.Title: The Retired Granny's Determination
Episodes.Description: Chiyo, a retired ninja from the Hidden Sand Village, decides to help Team Kakashi. She is a skilled puppet master and Sasori's grandmother.

Episodes.Title: A Fateful Encounter
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi and Team Guy arrive at the Akatsuki hideout. They are confronted by Itachi Uchiha and Kisame Hoshigaki.

Episodes.Title: Naruto's Growth
Episodes.Description: Kakashi faces off against Itachi. He is a powerful ninja, but Itachi's Mangekyo Sharingan is too much for him.

Episodes.Title: The Secret Weapon is Called...
Episodes.Description: Naruto uses his new jutsu, the Giant Rasengan, to defeat Itachi's clone.

Episodes.Title: The Secret of the Jinchuriki
Episodes.Description: Team Guy faces off against Kisame. They are powerful taijutsu specialists, but Kisame's Samehada is a dangerous weapon.

Episodes.Title: The Death of Gaara!
Episodes.Description: The Akatsuki successfully extract the One-Tailed Shukaku from Gaara. Gaara dies.

Episodes.Title: Charge Tactic! Button Hook Entry!!
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi and Team Guy break into the Akatsuki hideout. They are confronted by Sasori and Deidara.

Episodes.Title: Traps Activate! Team Guy's Enemies
Episodes.Description: Team Guy is separated from Team Kakashi and forced to fight clones of themselves.

Episodes.Title: Hiruko vs. Two Kunoichi!
Episodes.Description: Sakura and Chiyo face off against Sasori in his Hiruko puppet.

Episodes.Title: The True Face of Sasori
Episodes.Description: Sakura destroys the Hiruko puppet, revealing Sasori's true form. He is a young man who has turned himself into a human puppet.

Episodes.Title: Chiyo's Secret Skills
Episodes.Description: Chiyo reveals her own puppets, the Mother and Father puppets. They were created to look like Sasori's parents.

Episodes.Title: Father and Mother
Episodes.Description: Sasori reveals his most powerful puppet, the Third Kazekage. The Third Kazekage was a powerful ninja who could control iron sand.

Episodes.Title: The Third Kazekage
Episodes.Description: Sakura and Chiyo struggle to fight the Third Kazekage puppet. Sakura comes up with a plan to defeat it.

Episodes.Title: Three Minutes Between Life and Death
Episodes.Description: Sakura is poisoned by Sasori's puppet. Chiyo must use a forbidden jutsu to save her.

Episodes.Title: Puppet Fight: 10 vs. 100!
Episodes.Description: Chiyo summons ten of her own puppets to fight Sasori's one hundred puppets.

Episodes.Title: Impossible Dream
Episodes.Description: Sasori is defeated by Sakura and Chiyo. He dies in the arms of his Mother and Father puppets.

Episodes.Title: Beasts: Alive Again!
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Kakashi chase after Deidara, who has Gaara's body. Deidara uses his explosive clay to create a diversion.

Episodes.Title: Kakashi Enlightened!
Episodes.Description: Kakashi awakens his Mangekyo Sharingan. He uses it to send Deidara's arm to another dimension.

Episodes.Title: Aesthetics of an Instant
Episodes.Description: Naruto uses the power of the Nine-Tailed Fox to defeat Deidara. Deidara escapes, but he leaves Gaara's body behind.

Episodes.Title: The Legacy
Episodes.Description: Chiyo uses a forbidden jutsu to bring Gaara back to life. She sacrifices her own life in the process.

Episodes.Title: Return of the Kazekage
Episodes.Description: Gaara returns to the Hidden Sand Village as a hero. He has finally been accepted by his people.

Episodes.Title: The New Target
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. Team Kakashi gets a new member, Sai. They are sent on a mission to find Sasuke.

Episodes.Title: Formation! New Team Kakashi
Episodes.Description: Sai is a mysterious ninja who has no emotions. He is a member of Root, a secret organization within the Hidden Leaf Village.

Episodes.Title: An Unnecessary Addition
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Sai do not get along. They are constantly fighting.

Episodes.Title: The Fake Smile
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi sets out on their mission. They are led by Yamato, a ninja who can control wood.

Episodes.Title: Untitled
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi arrives at the Tenchi Bridge, where they are supposed to meet one of Sasori's spies.

Episodes.Title: The Fruits of Training
Episodes.Description: The spy turns out to be Kabuto, Orochimaru's right-hand man. Orochimaru appears and a battle ensues.

Episodes.Title: The Nine-Tails Unleashed
Episodes.Description: Naruto loses control and unleashes the power of the Nine-Tailed Fox. He grows four tails and becomes a miniature version of the beast.

Episodes.Title: The Top-Secret Mission Begins
Episodes.Description: Yamato uses his wood style to suppress the Nine-Tailed Fox's chakra. Naruto returns to normal, but he is badly injured.

Episodes.Title: Orochimaru's Hideout
Episodes.Description: Sai reveals that he has been working for Danzo, a rogue elder of the Hidden Leaf Village. He has been ordered to kill Sasuke.

Episodes.Title: The Jinchuriki's Bond
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi infiltrates Orochimaru's hideout. They are determined to find Sasuke.

Episodes.Title: Sakura's Tears
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi finds Sasuke, but he is not the same person they once knew. He is cold and distant.

Episodes.Title: The Secret of the Battle
Episodes.Description: Sasuke attacks Team Kakashi. He is more powerful than ever before.

Episodes.Title: The Consequences of Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Sasuke face off. Their battle is interrupted by Orochimaru and Kabuto.

Episodes.Title: The Unfinished Page
Episodes.Description: Sai has a change of heart and decides to help Team Kakashi. He wants to understand the meaning of friendship.

Episodes.Title: Infiltration! The Den of the Snake!
Episodes.Description: Team Kakashi returns to the Hidden Leaf Village. Their mission was a failure, but they have not given up on Sasuke.

Episodes.Title: Bonds
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. Naruto begins his training to create a new jutsu. He must learn to combine his wind chakra with the Rasengan.

Episodes.Title: Something Important...
Episodes.Description: Asuma Sarutobi, the leader of Team 10, is killed by Hidan, a member of the Akatsuki.

Episodes.Title: The Picture Book's Story
Episodes.Description: Shikamaru is devastated by Asuma's death. He vows to get revenge.

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: Team 10, led by Kakashi, goes after Hidan and Kakuzu, another member of the Akatsuki.

Episodes.Title: The Power of the Uchiha
Episodes.Description: Shikamaru uses his intelligence to defeat Hidan. He traps him in a pit and buries him alive.

Episodes.Title: Title
Episodes.Description: Naruto arrives to help Kakashi fight Kakuzu. He has perfected his new jutsu, the Rasenshuriken.

Episodes.Title: Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Naruto defeats Kakuzu with his Rasenshuriken. The jutsu is powerful, but it also damages Naruto's arm.

Episodes.Title: Wind
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. The Akatsuki's leader, Pain, begins his plan to capture the Nine-Tailed Fox.

Episodes.Title: Writhe
Episodes.Description: Jiraiya infiltrates the Hidden Rain Village to gather information on Pain. He is confronted by Konan, a former student.

Episodes.Title: Deprived of Sleep
Episodes.Description: Jiraiya faces off against Pain. Pain has the Rinnegan, a powerful dojutsu that was once possessed by the Sage of Six Paths.

Episodes.Title: Loneliness
Episodes.Description: Jiraiya is killed by Pain. He dies with a smile on his face, knowing that he has found the child of prophecy.

Episodes.Title: A New Enemy
Episodes.Description: Pain attacks the Hidden Leaf Village. He is looking for Naruto.

Episodes.Title: The Wheel of Fortune
Episodes.Description: The ninja of the Hidden Leaf Village fight back against Pain. They are no match for his power.

Episodes.Title: The Forbidden Jutsu
Episodes.Description: Kakashi is killed by Pain. He dies protecting the village.

Episodes.Title: The Master's Legacy
Episodes.Description: Naruto returns to the village and finds it in ruins. He is devastated by the destruction.

Episodes.Title: The Triumphant Return
Episodes.Description: Naruto faces off against Pain. He has mastered Sage Mode, a powerful technique that allows him to use natural energy.

Episodes.Title: The Sixth Hokage
Episodes.Description: Naruto defeats Pain and saves the village. He is hailed as a hero.

Episodes.Title: The Five Kage Summit
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. The leaders of the five great ninja villages meet to discuss the threat of the Akatsuki.

Episodes.Title: The Man Named Kisame
Episodes.Description: Sasuke attacks the Five Kage Summit. He is looking for Danzo, the man who ordered the Uchiha clan massacre.

Episodes.Title: The Fourth Hokage's Legacy
Episodes.Description: Sasuke faces off against the Raikage, the leader of the Hidden Cloud Village. The Raikage is a powerful ninja who can use lightning chakra.

Episodes.Title: The Key to the Future
Episodes.Description: Sasuke is defeated by the Raikage, but he is saved by Tobi, the true leader of the Akatsuki.

Episodes.Title: The Truth
Episodes.Description: Tobi reveals his true identity. He is Obito Uchiha, Kakashi's former teammate.

Episodes.Title: The Fourth Great Ninja War
Episodes.Description: Tobi declares war on the five great ninja villages. He plans to use the ten-tailed beast to create a new world.

Episodes.Title: The Five Kage's Decision
Episodes.Description: The five great ninja villages form an alliance to fight the Akatsuki. The Fourth Great Ninja War begins.

Episodes.Title: The Jinchuriki of the Mist
Episodes.Description: Naruto begins his training to control the Nine-Tailed Fox's chakra. He is helped by Killer Bee, the jinchuriki of the Eight-Tails.

Episodes.Title: The Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist
Episodes.Description: The Fourth Great Ninja War begins. The allied shinobi forces face off against the Akatsuki's army of reanimated ninja.

Episodes.Title: The User of the Scorch Style
Episodes.Description: The allied shinobi forces are struggling to fight the reanimated ninja. They are outnumbered and outmatched.

Episodes.Title: The Curse of the Puppet Master
Episodes.Description: Kankuro faces off against Sasori, who has been reanimated by Kabuto. Kankuro must use his skills as a puppet master to defeat him.

Episodes.Title: The Two Suns
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Killer Bee join the battle. They are the allied shinobi forces' secret weapon.

Episodes.Title: The Unsetting Sun
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Killer Bee face off against the reanimated jinchuriki. They must work together to defeat them.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Became a God
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Killer Bee defeat the reanimated jinchuriki. They now have to face Tobi and the reanimated Madara Uchiha.

Episodes.Title: The Ten-Tails' Revival
Episodes.Description: Tobi and Madara revive the Ten-Tailed Beast. The allied shinobi forces are in for the fight of their lives.

Episodes.Title: The Infinite Tsukuyomi
Episodes.Description: Madara activates the Infinite Tsukuyomi. The entire world is trapped in a dream.

Episodes.Title: The Final Battle
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Sasuke are the only ones who can stop Madara. They must work together to save the world.

Episodes.Title: The New Hokage
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Sasuke defeat Madara. Naruto becomes the Seventh Hokage.

Episodes.Title: A New Threat
Episodes.Description: A new enemy appears, threatening the peace that Naruto has worked so hard to achieve.

Episodes.Title: The Next Generation
Episodes.Description: Naruto's son, Boruto, begins his own journey as a ninja. He is determined to surpass his father.

Episodes.Title: A New Mission
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his team are sent on their first mission. They must protect a village from a group of bandits.

Episodes.Title: The Chunin Exams
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends participate in the Chunin Exams. They must prove their strength and skill to become chunin.

Episodes.Title: The Otsutsuki Invasion
Episodes.Description: The Chunin Exams are interrupted by Momoshiki and Kinshiki Otsutsuki, two powerful beings from another dimension.

Episodes.Title: The Five Kage vs. Momoshiki
Episodes.Description: Naruto and the other Kage fight Momoshiki and Kinshiki. They are no match for their power.

Episodes.Title: Boruto and Sasuke
Episodes.Description: Boruto and Sasuke team up to fight Momoshiki. They must work together to save Naruto.

Episodes.Title: The Final Battle
Episodes.Description: Boruto defeats Momoshiki with a giant Rasengan. He is hailed as a hero.

Episodes.Title: The Path to the Future
Episodes.Description: The series ends with Boruto and his friends looking forward to the future. They are the next generation of ninja, and they will protect the peace that Naruto created.

Episodes.Title: A New Beginning
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. Boruto and his friends are now genin and they are sent on their first official mission.

Episodes.Title: The Byakuya Gang
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends must stop a group of thieves who are stealing from the rich and giving to the poor.

Episodes.Title: The Ghost Incident
Episodes.Description: A mysterious ghost is causing trouble in the Hidden Leaf Village. Boruto and his friends must find a way to stop it.

Episodes.Title: The Cursed Forest
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends are sent on a mission to a cursed forest. They must find a way to break the curse.

Episodes.Title: The Genin Exchange Program
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends travel to the Hidden Mist Village as part of a genin exchange program.

Episodes.Title: The Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist, Again!
Episodes.Description: The new Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist appear and they are not friendly.

Episodes.Title: The Jougan
Episodes.Description: Boruto awakens a mysterious power in his right eye. It is called the Jougan.

Episodes.Title: The Kara
Episodes.Description: A new organization called Kara appears. They are a mysterious group with a dark agenda.

Episodes.Title: The Vessel
Episodes.Description: Kara is looking for a vessel to house their leader, Jigen. They believe that Boruto is the perfect candidate.

Episodes.Title: The Karma
Episodes.Description: Boruto is marked with a mysterious seal called Karma. It gives him immense power, but it also has a dark side.

Episodes.Title: The Mujina Bandits
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his team are sent on a mission to the Land of Silence. They must protect a feudal lord from a group of bandits.

Episodes.Title: The Hidden Cloud, The Hidden Stone, The Hidden Mist
Episodes.Description: The other great ninja villages send their own teams to help Boruto. They must work together to defeat the Mujina Bandits.

Episodes.Title: The Ao Arc
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. Boruto and his friends are sent on a mission to the Land of Water. They must investigate a mysterious airship.

Episodes.Title: The Scientific Ninja Tool
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends discover that the airship is a scientific ninja tool created by Kara.

Episodes.Title: The Value of a Shinobi
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends must decide whether to use scientific ninja tools. They are powerful, but they go against the traditions of the shinobi.

Episodes.Title: The Time for a Decision
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends decide to use scientific ninja tools to fight Kara. They are determined to protect the world from their evil plans.

Episodes.Title: The Kawaki Arc
Episodes.Description: A new arc begins. A mysterious boy named Kawaki appears. He has a Karma seal, just like Boruto.

Episodes.Title: The Past
Episodes.Description: Kawaki was raised by Jigen, the leader of Kara. He was abused and experimented on.

Episodes.Title: The Escape
Episodes.Description: Kawaki escapes from Kara and is found by Boruto and his friends. They take him to the Hidden Leaf Village.

Episodes.Title: The New Life
Episodes.Description: Kawaki begins his new life in the Hidden Leaf Village. He is taken in by Naruto and his family.

Episodes.Title: The Brother
Episodes.Description: Boruto and Kawaki do not get along at first, but they eventually become like brothers.

Episodes.Title: The Training
Episodes.Description: Naruto begins to train Kawaki. He teaches him how to control his Karma.

Episodes.Title: The Attack
Episodes.Description: Kara attacks the Hidden Leaf Village to retrieve Kawaki. Naruto must protect him.

Episodes.Title: The Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Naruto sacrifices himself to save Kawaki. He is sealed away by Jigen.

Episodes.Title: The Rescue
Episodes.Description: Boruto, Kawaki, and their friends go to rescue Naruto. They must face Jigen and the other members of Kara.

Episodes.Title: The Final Battle
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends defeat Jigen and rescue Naruto. They have saved the world once again.

Episodes.Title: The Future
Episodes.Description: The series ends with Boruto and Kawaki looking forward to the future. They are the new generation of ninja, and they will protect the peace that Naruto created.

Episodes.Title: Kakashi's Story: A Life on the Battlefield
Episodes.Description: A special episode that tells the story of Kakashi's life.

Episodes.Title: Itachi's Story: Light and Darkness
Episodes.Description: A special episode that tells the story of Itachi's life.

Episodes.Title: Sasuke's Story: Sunrise
Episodes.Description: A special episode that tells the story of Sasuke's life.

Episodes.Title: Shikamaru's Story: A Cloud Drifting in the Silent Dark
Episodes.Description: A special episode that tells the story of Shikamaru's life.

Episodes.Title: Konoha's Story: A Perfect Day for a Wedding
Episodes.Description: A special episode that tells the story of Naruto and Hinata's wedding.

Episodes.Title: The Last: Naruto the Movie
Episodes.Description: The final movie in the Naruto series. Naruto must save Hinata from a new enemy who wants to destroy the world.

Episodes.Title: Boruto: Naruto the Movie
Episodes.Description: The first movie in the Boruto series. Boruto must prove his strength to his father, Naruto.

Episodes.Title: The Day Naruto Became Hokage

Entries.Description: Tim the Witch-Smeller captures Harvey, mistaking him for a witch. Sabrina must rescue him before he becomes a permanent trophy.

Episodes.Title: Most Dangerous Witch
Episodes.Description: Tim the Witch-Smeller captures Harvey, mistaking him for a witch. Sabrina must rescue him before he becomes a permanent trophy.

Episodes.Title: You Said a Mouse-Ful
Episodes.Description: Salem replaces Sabrina's science fair mouse but gets traded to NASA. Sabrina must save him before he becomes an astromouse.

Episodes.Title: Boogie Shoes
Episodes.Description: Harvey gets magical shoes that make him dance uncontrollably. Sabrina must remove them before he dances himself to exhaustion.

Episodes.Title: Tail of Two Kitties
Episodes.Description: Salem falls for a kitty-witch and must choose between staying a cat or becoming human again.

Episodes.Title: The Senses-Shattering Adventures of Captain Harvtastic
Episodes.Description: Harvey's wish transports him into his comic book world. Sabrina must help defeat the villain Dysphillia before they're erased from existence.

Episodes.Title: Witch Switch
Episodes.Description: Sabrina swaps lives with Gem, but Gem refuses to return her witch powers. Sabrina must trick her to switch back.

Episodes.Title: Picture Perfect
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and Gem compete for Student of the Year. Sabrina uses magic to win but confesses her dishonesty during the award ceremony.

Episodes.Title: Field Trippin'
Episodes.Description: Sabrina babysits terror twins at a museum. When magic backfires, Harvey and the twins end up trapped in artwork.

Episodes.Title: No Time to Be a Hero
Episodes.Description: Sabrina time-travels to correct undeserved praise for saving Harvey, but her actions worsen the situation.

Episodes.Title: Extreme Harvey
Episodes.Description: Sabrina magically enhances Harvey's skateboarding skills, but the spell wears off during a championship contest.

Episodes.Title: Shrink to Fit
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and Chloe shrink to fit fad jeans but continue shrinking. They must reverse the spell before disappearing.

Episodes.Title: Has Anybody Seen My Quigley?
Episodes.Description: Uncle Quigley runs away, leaving a strict nanny. The Spellmans turn her into a hippie but regret it and seek Quigley's return.

Episodes.Title: Wag the Witch
Episodes.Description: Sabrina runs for class president against Gem, using magic to appear 'normal' and hide her witch identity.

Episodes.Title: Witchy Grrrls
Episodes.Description: Sabrina's band uses magic for fame, but egos cause a split. They reunite after realizing they miss each other.

Episodes.Title: Paranormal Pi
Episodes.Description: Pi investigates paranormal activity after seeing Uncle Zamboni fly. Sabrina must prevent him from discovering her family's secrets.

Episodes.Title: Anywhere But Here
Episodes.Description: Sabrina magically becomes an adult but learns adulthood comes with burdensome responsibilities.

Episodes.Title: Nothin' Says Lovin' Like Something From a Coven
Episodes.Description: Sabrina throws a Halloween party and competes with Gem to host the best event.

Episodes.Title: Once Upon a Whine
Episodes.Description: Sabrina accidentally summons Cinderella to Greendale. When she tries to send her back, Harvey ends up in fairy-tale land.

Episodes.Title: Documagicary
Episodes.Description: A documentary crew invades Sabrina's life, but she quits after realizing fame isn't enjoyable. Tim the Witch-Smeller is released from prison.

Episodes.Title: The Grandparent Trap
Episodes.Description: Sabrina fears her grandparents are divorcing and schemes to reunite them, only to learn they plan to renew their vows.

Episodes.Title: I Got Glue Babe
Episodes.Description: Sabrina casts a spell to end her rivalry with Gem, but they become magically glued together.

Episodes.Title: Boy Meets Bike
Episodes.Description: Sabrina conjures a sentient bike for Harvey to beat a bully, but it becomes dangerously competitive.

Episodes.Title: Upside Down Town
Episodes.Description: Sabrina's magical upside-down cake reverses personalities. She must find an antidote before chaos spreads.

Episodes.Title: The Importance of Being Norma
Episodes.Description: Sabrina tries to impress cheerleaders while guiding her geeky friend Norma. A spell to make Norma 'cool' backfires.

Episodes.Title: Stage Fright
Episodes.Description: Sabrina conjures Romeo for a play, but he falls for Enchantra. Sabrina learns about true love.

Episodes.Title: Witchitis
Episodes.Description: Sabrina avoids a witchitis shot, but her germs grow into human-sized threats. She seeks help to save her friends.

Episodes.Title: My Stepmother the Babe
Episodes.Description: Sabrina turns her father's fiancée into a 12-year-old to relate to her, but her father disapproves.

Episodes.Title: Absence of Malissa
Episodes.Description: Sabrina attends Witches Boot Camp to gain full powers but struggles with the challenges.

Episodes.Title: This Is Your Nine Lives
Episodes.Description: Sabrina time-travels to find Salem a unique birthday gift and encounters a pirate.

Episodes.Title: Planet of the Dogs
Episodes.Description: A stray dog Alvin becomes a canine vigilante, kidnapping Sabrina's family.

Episodes.Title: Hex-Change Students
Episodes.Description: Two fairy exchange students visit Greendale, causing magical chaos.

Episodes.Title: Saturday Night Furor
Episodes.Description: Sabrina tries to have fun without Uncle Quigley's supervision but faces magical mishaps.

Episodes.Title: Scare Apparent
Episodes.Description: Sabrina helps Boogey Jr. overcome his fear of shadows, learning about facing fears.

Episodes.Title: The Hex Files
Episodes.Description: Sabrina visits Uncle Quigley's lab, uncovering mysterious experiments.

Episodes.Title: Stone Broke
Episodes.Description: Gem moves in with Sabrina after her parents lose their fortune, leading to comedic clashes.

Episodes.Title: Salem's Plot
Episodes.Description: Salem tries to disguise himself when a friend visits, embarrassed by his appearance.

Episodes.Title: Molar Molar
Episodes.Description: Sabrina uses magic to avoid wisdom teeth pain, but the spell backfires.

Episodes.Title: Harvzilla
Episodes.Description: Sabrina helps Harvey bulk up magically, but the transformation goes awry.

Episodes.Description: Sabrina clones herself for an Extracurricular Activities Fair, but the clones cause chaos.

Episodes.Title: Feats of Clay

Episodes.Description: Sabrina and Enchantra switch bodies, experiencing each other's lives for a day.

Episodes.Title: Board & Sorcery

Episodes.Description: Sabrina shows Gem the value of generosity during Christmas using magical interventions.

Episodes.Title: Boruto: Jump Festa 2016 Special (Special)
Episodes.Description: The special anime adaptation of Boruto screened at Shueisha’s by-invitation anime event Jump Special Anime Festa 2016. It was also included with the Naruto Ultimate Ninja Storm Legacy video game (Released July 27 Japan, Aug 25 Overseas).

Episodes.Title: The Day Naruto Became Hokage (Special)
Episodes.Description: Depicts the day that Naruto Uzumaki became the 7th Hokage. Packaged with Boruto the Movie.

Episodes.Title: Boruto Uzumaki!
Episodes.Description: The Hidden Leaf Village is located within the Land of Fire, one of the Five Great Shinobi Nations. Boruto Uzumaki lives here and he's the son of the village leader, Naruto Uzumaki, the Seventh Hokage. One day, Boruto saves a boy named Denki Kaminarimon, who's being picked on. Denki is physically weak, so he is unable to stand up to the bullies. On his way to the entrance ceremony at the Ninja Academy, Boruto sees Denki again. He notices that his chakra is warped and that he is acting strangely.

Episodes.Title: The Hokage's Son!
Episodes.Description: After being suspended for the uproar he caused at the entrance ceremony, Boruto makes his way to the academy for the first time. His classmates ostracize him for being the son of the Seventh Hokage and for being suspended. Iwabe Yuino, one of Boruto's classmates, picks a fight with him. Iwabe is an older student who has a keen sense for battle, but was held back a year for his bad behavior. At first, Boruto ignores him no matter what he says. But when he sees Iwabe punch Denki for telling him to stop, Boruto can't ignore him any longer.

Episodes.Title: Metal Lee Goes Wild!
Episodes.Description: Boruto's classmate, Metal Lee, is very dilligent and is skilled at taijutsu. Unfortunately, he gets nervous easily and is unable to do his best when people are watching him. One day one of his classmates, Shikadai Nara, says something that enrages Metal, who attacks Shikadai the next day. Caught in the middle, Boruto notices that Metal's chakra is warped, just like Denki's.

Episodes.Title: A Ninjutsu Battle of the Sexes!
Episodes.Description: At the suggestion of Shino Aburame, their homeroom teacher, Boruto and his classmates split off into gendered teams to capture flags placed on the roof. Boruto and the rest of the boys' team quickly head for the roof, but they struggle with traps and the girls' team, led by Sarada Uchiha and Chocho Akimichi. Desperate to capture a flag before the girls' team, Boruto tries out a Summoning Jutsu, but he ends up summoning something unexpected!

Episodes.Title: The Mysterious Transfer Student!
Episodes.Description: A new student named Mitsuki from the Hidden Sound joins Boruto's class.  A student named Mitsuki has transferred into Boruto's class from Hidden Sound Village. He overwhelms Iwabe in sparring and shows his genius by solving difficult problems. However, Boruto and the others are unable to tell what he is thinking. Meanwhile, someone who has been doing repair work on the school, suddenly goes berserk. Boruto and the others rush over. Another side of Mitsuki emerges as he starts muttering strange words.

Episodes.Title: The Final Lesson!
Episodes.Description: Boruto, Shikadai and Mitsuki arrive at the location they are told to go to by Shino. They notice their teacher is acting different than he usually does— and Shino suddenly attacks them! Shino belongs to the Aburame clan, a clan of Insect Users. He unleashes a swarm of Parasitic Insects. Boruto and the others can't match the skill of someone who's a jonin. But even in this situation, Mitsuki remains calm and coldly stares at Shino.

Episodes.Title: Love and Potato Chips!
Episodes.Description: Cho-Cho's scared because she thinks she's being watched by someone, so she decides to catch them in the act. She succeeds in snagging Magire Kakuremino, and it turns out he wasn't watching Cho-Cho, but Sumire, the class rep, whom he secretly likes. Cho-Cho urges him to declare his love, and at first Magire hesitates. But he takes the leap and tells Sumire how he feels!

Episodes.Title: The Dream’s Revelation
Episodes.Description: The shadowy, warped chakra that only Boruto can see takes over more people, causing them to rampage. It only affected people within the Academy at first, but now it’s extending its reach into the village. Can it be stopped? And later, a Visual Jutsu places Boruto within a dream—and afterward, Boruto declares the dream has awakened his Byakugan, the Kekkei Genkai unique to his mother’s Hyuga Clan. Naruto does not believe him, so Boruto seeks advice from his grandfather, Hiashi Hyuga.

Episodes.Title: Proof of Oneself
Episodes.Description: Under his father and grandfather’s guidance, Boruto spars with his aunt Hanabi. Boruto has sought this match in order to win acceptance from his father, but no matter how hard he tries, he can’t activate his Byakugan in any form. He begins to doubt that he even saw the shadowy warped chakra at all, and feels even worse when people begin to think he lied. But then Boruto sees another person being manipulated by the mysterious shadow.

Episodes.Title: The Ghost Incident: The Investigation Begins!
Episodes.Description: Boruto nicknames the mysterious shadow “The Ghost” and is excited when he and his friends Shikadai and Mitsuki decide to solve the recent “Ghost Incidents.” Shino secretly lends Boruto a helping hand by giving their class an assignment to research different workplaces. Meanwhile, Sai, who once served in The Foundation of the ANBU Black Ops, makes a big discovery while investigating the same incident under orders from the Hokate.

Episodes.Title: The Shadow of the Mastermind
Episodes.Description: During a tour of workplaces for their school assignment, Sumire, Wasabi Izuno and Namida Suzumeno get wrapped up in the Ghost Incident and are hurt. Boruto feels bad that he wasn't there to prevent their harm, and becomes more determined to solve the case. With the help of Tayori Kuroyagi the postal worker, along with Shikadai and Mitsuki, the team scans the village more closely. Then Shikadai and Mitsuki realize one possibility from something Boruto says casually.

Episodes.Title: Boruto and Mitsuki
Episodes.Description: The Ghost incidents suddenly come to an end and Boruto and his classmates are puzzled, but Mitsuki seems to know something they don't. Mitsuki himself realizes he's been undergoing some puzzling changes and questions his classmates in order to figure out his predicament. Soon after, a mysterious chakra begins to spread throughout the village.

Episodes.Title: The Demon Beast Appears!
Episodes.Description: After Mitsuki reveals more information about the Ghost incidents, Boruto is determined to find and stop the culprit! Meanwhile, Seventh Hokage Naruto and his top advisors are shocked to learn who the perpetrator is from the results of Sai's investigation. Just then, Nue—an enormous otherworldly beast—appears! The imminent danger to the village forces the Sixth Hokage, Kakashi, out of retirement!

Episodes.Title: The Path That Boruto Can See
Episodes.Description: The late Danzo Shimura was the founder and leader of the Foundation, an elite branch of the ANBU Black Ops. The recent incidents have been masterminded by someone who had sworn to carry on Danzo's wishes. Boruto is able to enter another world with his strange "eye." The perpetrator wields the Gozu Tennou, a weapon that relies on the power of the beast Nue, and is set on destroying the village. Boruto desperately tries to dissuade them, but can Boruto's thoughts unleash a curse from the past?!

Episodes.Title: A New Path
Episodes.Description: The ghost incident that threatened the Hidden Leaf Village is over, and now Boruto is unable to awaken the mysterious power he used. Things return to normal in the village and the Academy, but one thing still troubles Boruto and his classmates...

Episodes.Title: Crisis: The Threat of Failing!
Episodes.Description: Exam day is fast approaching, and everyone at the Academy begins preparing for them. Repeating a grade is a possibility if you fail a test. Denki, who lacks skills in ninjutsu, is having a hard time using chakra to climb walls. And as usual, Iwabe can't wrap his head around what he's studying. Boruto and the others try to help them train and study, but end up making things more confusing for the two. Will Denki and Iwabe avoid being held back?

Episodes.Title: Run, Sarada!
Episodes.Description: Sarada agrees to return a teddy bear to a young patient at the hospital, but she forgets it on the train and goes into a panic. Despite having dismissed Boruto and the boys for sitting on the roof of the train, Sarada does exactly that in her desperate search for the toy. Cho-Cho happens to see Sarada and takes her to the station’s lost and found. Sarada retrieves her package and all is well, until…

Episodes.Title: A Day in The Life of the Uzumaki Family
Episodes.Description: The Uzumaki household is thrown into chaos when Himawari, Boruto's younger sister, catches a cold. Naruto rarely comes home since he became Hokage, and Boruto's anger toward him grows especially because his sister is so sick.

Episodes.Title: Sarada Uchiha
Episodes.Description: Boruto pulls a prank and is pursued around the village by Naruto. Seeing this, Sarada can't help but be exasperated, but a part of her grows wistful as she thinks of her father, Sasuke, whom she hasn't seen since she was a baby. She begins to feel doubt after she sees a photo of Sasuke with a young woman wearing glasses. Sarada becomes determined to learn the truth. Will the secret of Sarada Uchiha's birth be revealed?!

Episodes.Title: The Boy With The Sharingan
Episodes.Description: Sasuke sends a message to Naruto about a man possessing the Sharingan. Upon receiving the intel, Naruto rushes to meet with Sasuke. Meanwhile, Sarada, who has doubts about who her real mother is, joins Cho-Cho, who is about to set out on a journey to find her “real parents.” Upon learning that Naruto is on his way to meet Sasuke, they go after him. But danger looms when they come under attack.

Episodes.Title: Sasuke and Sarada
Episodes.Description: Sarada arrives at the tower where her father is, only to be hurt by Sasuke's surprising words and actions. Naruto and Cho-Cho can hardly bear to watch the awkward exchange between father and daughter, and try to think of something to help. But the party is attacked by a father-son duo who call themselves "Shin Uchiha," and who possess the Sharingan! Meanwhile, Sakura learns that Sarada has gone to meet her father.

Episodes.Title: Connected Feelings
Episodes.Description: Sarada is in shock after Sakura is captured by Shin's jutsu. Even Naruto, with his exceptional tracking skills, is unable to locate her. Then Sasuke discovers countless Sharingan embedded in Shin's arm. Following clues gleaned from Shin's arm, they come upon the laboratory of the heinous Hidden Leaf criminal, Orochimaru, who has been conducting research on Forbidden Jutsu. There, Sarada meets her father's former partners Suigetsu Hozuki and Jugo. She then asks Suigetsu to look into who her real mother is.

Episodes.Title: Bonds Come In All Shapes
Episodes.Description: Determined to rescue Sakura, Sarada pursues Shin with Sasuke, Naruto, and Cho-Cho. After brutal battles with Shin's clones along the way, Sarada is surprised to see the bond of trust between Sasuke and Sakura, who haven’t seen each other in years. But suddenly, Shin orders his children to kill the intruders. Since her parents share a bond of trust and love, will Sarada's journey to learn the secret of her birth reach a conclusion?

Episodes.Title: Boruto and Sarada
Episodes.Description: The Hidden Leaf Village is filled with excitement upon the arrival of the Kage for the Five Kage Summit. Boruto knows that security is tighter than usual, but he still plans on pulling a big prank. Meanwhile, Sarada has found a new goal, to become the Hokage, and trains hard. Behind closed doors, the Five Kage discuss highly classified intel that Sasuke has obtained involving Kaguya Otsutsuki.

Episodes.Title: The Turbulent Field Trip
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his classmates head to the Village Hidden in the Mist in the Land of Water for a field trip. Kagura Karatachi is chosen as the village guide. About the same age as Boruto, Kagura is already an accomplished shinobi and serves as an aide to the Mizukage, Chojuro. Once known as the Blood Mist Village, it's now more modern and bustling than anyone could have imagined. However, dissatisfaction exists among some Hidden Mist Shinobi.

Episodes.Title: The Mizukage’s Successor
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his classmates are invited to tour the Hidden Mist Academy under Kagura and Chojuro's escort. The Hidden Mist emphasizes swordsmanship, and Boruto is awed by their intense training sessions. Chojuro sees Boruto's interest and arranges a sparring match with Kagura, who seems hesitant. Kagura is extremely skilled and has been asked by Chojuro to become the successor to his Great Twin Sword, Hiramekarei, but he has declined.

Episodes.Title: A Shinobi Bout of Friendship
Episodes.Description: Tsurushi Hachiya, Kagura's former classmate at the Academy, finds Boruto and his friends from the Leaf irritating, so he kidnaps Denki. Kagura and Boruto set out to rescue him, and they find themselves in a battle against Hachiya and his crew. During the fight, the truth that Kagura has been hiding is revealed!

Episodes.Title: Declaration of War
Episodes.Description: Kagura makes up his mind to accept the famed sword Hiramekarei from Chojuro, but unwittingly becomes part of a plot set up by Kagura’s old acquaintance, Shizuma Hoshigaki, a man who opposes the new, peaceful shinobi order.

Episodes.Title: The New Seven Ninja Swordsmen!
Episodes.Description: Kagura unlocks the storeroom to let Shizuma take the Mist Blades. The New Seven Ninja Swordsmen begin an insurrection, the end goal being to turn their village back into the Blood Mist Village! News of the rebellion reaches Chojuro and Mei, the current and previous Mizukage. They are determined to execute the perpetrators, along with Kagura, who aided them. In order to change Chojuro's mind, Boruto makes an astonishing announcement.

Episodes.Title: The Sharingan vs. The Lightning Blade, Kiba the Fang!
Episodes.Description: Chojuro leads Boruto and Sarada to the location where Shizuma and his "New Seven Shinobi Swordsmen" are based. Shizuma uses his jutsu to create a fog that clouds the trio's vision, and they end up getting separated. Sarada is forced into one-on-one combat with a kunoichi, Buntan Kurosuki, who wields the Lightning Blade, Kiba the Fang! In the thick fog, Sarada uses her Sharingan, but her enemy is stronger than expected. Driven into a corner, she comes up with a counterattack. Meanwhile, Boruto goes up against none other than Kagura.

Episodes.Title: Boruto and Kagura
Episodes.Description: Boruto urges his friend Kagura to return with him, but Kagura rejects him and begins to attack. Although Boruto is desperate to save him, Kagura once again falls under a spell and is unable to defy Shizuma. Then someone steps in between the two as they battle. It's Mitsuki, and he has obtained intel about the rebellion. Just what is the intel, and can Boruto save his friend?

Episodes.Title: The Quest for Souvenirs
Episodes.Description: The field trip comes to an end, and Boruto and his friends prepare to return to Hidden Leaf. Chojuro, the Mizukage, sees them off, but Kagura is nowhere to be seen. The class makes it back to the Leaf Village safely and Boruto is relieved to be home. But Himawari isn't her usual cheerful self. She's been looking forward to the souvenir that Boruto promised her, which he completely forgot to get! Boruto decides to tell the truth and beg for Himawari's forgiveness, but he misses his chance, and things gets worse!

Episodes.Title: The Super Beast Scroll Slump!
Episodes.Description: Inojin has loved to draw since he was small, and his ninjutsu speciality is the Super Beast Scroll. But one day, he suddenly loses his ability to use his jutsu! Puzzled, he talks to his father, Sai, who uses the same jutsu. Even though Sai is sympathetic, he doesn't give Inojin a way to overcome his slump. Instead he suggests that his son enter into a children's art contest, which Inojin halfheartedly does.

Episodes.Title: The Night of the Shooting Stars
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his classmates decide to go camping to try to catch the mysterious fish, the Eternal Carp, said to be unforgettably delicious. With graduation coming up this could be the last time the class does something together, so Boruto figures this is the perfect opportunity to catch one, but the fish proves to be very elusive.

Episodes.Title: The Parent Teacher Conference!
Episodes.Description: Prior to the graduation exams, it's decided that the students will take part in a three-person interview to discuss their future plans. Boruto, who has passed his ninjutsu courses with flying colors, realizes his path toward becoming a "ninja" has been trouble-free and easy. As the students prepare for their finals, Boruto meets a journalist named Sukea who is doing a story on them. Something about Boruto's indifferent attitude about his future as a ninja raises a red flag in Sukea, and he gives Boruto a warning.

Episodes.Title: The Graduation Exam Begins!
Episodes.Description: It is time for the graduation exams. Boruto and the others complete the first-round written exam and move on to the next. The second round has the students facing off against Kakashi—the previous Sixth Hokage—and the academy instructors in actual combat situations. With the goal to "steal the bell" from Kakashi, every student rushes into action. However, the going is rough against Kakashi and the teachers who guard him. Somehow, Boruto reaches Kakashi first, but the Sixth Hokage shows no mercy. After a tough fight, he coldly tells Boruto that he's not suited to become a ninja!

Episodes.Title: A Shinobi's Resolve
Episodes.Description: Boruto's the first to confront Kakashi in the exam. Despite a determined effort, he is immobilized and angered by Kakashi's severe criticism of his class. Shortly after, Boruto's classmates come by to assist and Boruto makes his escape. Although depressed by his own shortcomings, Boruto is able to overcome them and formulate a strategy, thanks to the encouragement of his friends.

Episodes.Title: Formation of the Three-Man Squad?
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his classmates take their first step as genin and start forming their basic shinobi three-man squads. The members are matched according to their ability and compatibility. Boruto was counting on teaming up with Shikadai, but is disappointed when he opts to be part of the "Ino-Shika-Cho" trio, like his dad. Boruto finds himself teamed up with Sarada and Mitsuki. Since he and Sarada have issues with this matchup, they file a direct appeal to the Hokage to overturn this decision.

Episodes.Title: The Path Lit by the Full Moon
Episodes.Description: Originally from the Village Hidden in the Sound, Mitsuki has made up his mind to become a Hidden Leaf Shinobi. In the past, having lost his memory, Mitsuki finds himself in unfamiliar surroundings, unsure of his identity and motive. Mitsuki faces a difficult decision, but his thoughts and feelings that had once been shrouded in mystery, now come to light

Episodes.Title: Team 7: The First Mission!
Episodes.Description: Team 7 sets out on their first mission. Their client is a village who has been plagued by bandits, and their mission is to eradicate them. They meet Kiri, a young girl who has just been installed as the village head after her father's sudden death. The team soon realizes that this mission is far more dangerous and complicated than first expected.

Episodes.Title: Strength in Unity
Episodes.Description: Team 7's original mission evolves into a rescue operation after Kiri is kidnapped. The team must face a formidable genjutsu user as well as a skilled sword user. Following Konohamaru's orders, the team successfully rescues Kiri. But Konohamaru is captured and the trio must battle the enemy alone while protecting Kiri.

Episodes.Title: A Ninja's Job
Episodes.Description: Boruto is dissatisfied with the team's easy and lackluster missions since its first one. Team 7 is assigned to capture a suspect who has barricaded himself inside a bank. Excited to show off his skills again, Boruto and the team rush to the site. But the suspect turns out to be a timid individual who was recently fired. A possibility soon arises that a certain organization could be involved!

Episodes.Title: The Byakuya Gang Surfaces!
Episodes.Description: An incident occurs in Hidden Leaf Village and the Byakuya Gang is suspected. The gang steals from the rich to give to the poor, and they've been active recently in several villages. Boruto disapproves of them, because he believes stealing is stealing no matter how noble the reason.

Episodes.Title: Shikadai's Doubts
Episodes.Description: The Byakuya Gang's activities become more brazen in the Hidden Leaf. While some people view them as heroic, noble thieves, Boruto can't get himself to approve of their actions. The genin are told to work together to capture the gang, and security in the village is increased. During this time, Shikadai meets a youth named Ryugi. Despite their age difference, a bond grows between them.

Episodes.Title: Memories from the Day of Snow
Episodes.Description: Shikadai and Ryogi became friends playing shogi, but lately Ryogi hasn't been coming to their usual meeting place. Shikadai's became worried about his friend's behavior the last time they met, but he's kept his concerns to himself. Ryogi is also worried about Shikadai, but is tormented by memories he can't forget.

Episodes.Title: Go! The Crest of Night Strategy
Episodes.Description: The protest instigated by the Byakuya Gang against the Kaminarimon Company increases in intensity. The Leaf Shinobi, including the genin, are mobilized into action. The teams are assigned sections to keep watch over the protesters, and Team 10, made up of Shikadai, Inojin and Cho-Cho, takes up its position. But Shikadai notices something as he studies the position chart and rushes out on his own!

Episodes.Title: The Figure I Want to Be
Episodes.Description: During the protests, the Byakuya Gang attacks Katasuke's research center, which has been developing new technology for Scientific Ninja Tools. Shikadai figures out what the Byakuya Gang's goal is and rushes after them in pursuit with Boruto close by. Even a weak "pawn" can become strong in one move—what are the two friends who bonded through shogi seeking?

Episodes.Title: The Genin Documentary
Episodes.Description: Udon Ise the jonin captain of Team 5, issues a direct order from the Hokage to Iwabe, Denki and Metal, which states: "In order to attract more students to the Ninjutsu Department of the Academy, you will appear in a PR video documentary." During the Byakuya Gang incident, the three were under suspension, and could only watch as their genin classmates leapt into action. The trio decide to do their best in the documentary in order to prove their prowess, but Udon seems skeptical...

Episodes.Title: Wasabi and Namida
Episodes.Description: Boruto's aunt, Hanabi Hyuga, leads an all-girl team made up of Sumire, Wasabi and Namida. They are given a mission to recover animals that someone has released from their cages at the zoo. The team sets out, but Wasabi and Namida start arguing en route, and Sumire is unable to stop them.

Episodes.Title: The Chunin Exams: The Recommendation Meeting
Episodes.Description: The Chunin Exam assembles exceptional genin from each village and pits them against each other in order to assess their abilities. Childhood friends and teammates Konohamaru, Udon and Moegi contemplate whether the genin under their guidance will be able to handle the severity of the Chunin Exam.

Episodes.Title: Boruto's Birthday
Episodes.Description: Boruto overhears remarks being made about his father and him, adding to the hurt because Naruto has broken his promise to be home for Boruto's birthday. Shortly after, Team 7 is given a mission to capture a gang of thieves targeting the Thunder Train, who are hiding out in a town near the Land of Fire's border. But when Team 7 arrives at the town, they find something is not quite right with one of the captured thieves.

Episodes.Title: Sasuke's Shadow
Episodes.Description: Team 7 enters the mine where the thieves had been hiding out, only to be attacked by a powerful, strange-looking White Zetsu. They find out the mine connects to a ruin belonging to Kaguya Otsutsuki. Team 7 decides to investigate and engage the White Zetsu. As they proceed deeper and deeper into the mine, they make a shocking discovery!

Episodes.Title: Himawari's Birthday
Episodes.Description: The Chunin Exams are fast approaching and everyone’s excited—except for Boruto, which causes everyone grief. During this time, Boruto and his family have a rare chance to be together to celebrate Himawari's birthday, and for once it seems his father has kept his promise...

Episodes.Title: Sasuke and Boruto
Episodes.Description: Unable to contain his anger towards his father for ruining Himawari’s birthday as well as his own, Boruto rushes out to confront Naruto. He runs into Sasuke and unknowingly attacks him but is instantly subdued. Amazed at Sasuke’s strength, Boruto asks him to be his teacher. Sasuke agrees to the request but only after Boruto is able to use the Rasengan. In order to win Sasuke's approval, Boruto trains unusually hard.

Episodes.Title: The Scientific Ninja Tool
Episodes.Description: Boruto manages to perfect his Rasengan and begins training under Sasuke. He’s an extremely strict teacher because Boruto’s unfocused and only thinks about surpassing his father, and keeps looking for the easy way out when training gets tough. Iwabe, Sumire and the others also decide to take the Chunin Exam and turn in their applications. Hoping to show off his skills to Naruto, Boruto decides to apply as well. Meanwhile, the Otsutsuki Clan set their sights on Killer Bee!

Episodes.Title: Rivals, Gather!
Episodes.Description: The Chunin Exams are about to begin and genin from the other villages arrive in droves. The Hidden Sand's hopefuls include the Kazekage's adopted son Shinki, and his team mates Yodo and Araya. The Hidden Mists send the Senka triplets, the Hidden Cloud sends Yurui, Iroi, and Tarui. And finally, the Hidden Rock send the Genbu Three. As formidable rivals arrive on the scene, tensions run high as every participant sizes each other up, and prepare for the first round of the Chunin Exams!

Episodes.Title: The Reason I Can't Lose
Episodes.Description: Round two of the Chunin Exams begins. For the second test, three-man teams must try to capture their rival team’s flags. Sarada and Mitsuki set out for enemy territory while Boruto stays behind to guard their flag. The Senka Triplets from the Hidden Mist attack, and Boruto finds himself in trouble. Boruto considers using the Scientific Ninja Tool that Katasuke gave him, but it's prohibited to do so during the exam

Episodes.Title: The Tournament Begins
Episodes.Description: The third round of the exams begins, consisting of individual battles held tournament style. Boruto’s first match is against Yurui of the Hidden Cloud, and Shikadai is matched up against Yodo of the Hidden Sand. Sarada and Mitsuki are up against Tarui and Toroi of the Hidden Cloud, while Inojin and Cho-Cho pull Araya and Shinki of the Hidden Sand, respectively. After honing their skills in jutsu and strategy, the intense battles between the young shinobi begin!

Episodes.Title: Boruto vs. Shikadai
Episodes.Description: The match between Cho-Cho and Shinki of the Hidden Sand begins. Confronted by a foe who is unbelievably calm and menacing, Cho-Cho assumes a seriousness that she rarely reveals as her teammates watch and cheer her on. Boruto and Shikadai's match is next, and the moment nears when the two friends will face off against each other for the first time!

Episodes.Title: The Hidden Leaf vs. The Hidden Sand
Episodes.Description: The tournament nears its finale, as the matches of Sarada vs. Araya of the Hidden Sand and Mitsuki vs. Shinki of the Hidden San begin! Sarada uses her shuriken and Sharingan skills to attack Araya relentlessly, but he counters her with total ease. Her genjutsu has no effect and she is backed into a corner. In Mitsuki and Shinki's match, the evenly matched duo puts on a show of skills.

Episodes.Title: The Iron Sand User: Shinki
Episodes.Description: The final battle of the tournament begins with Boruto, Sarada and Shinki participating in a battle royale. As the lone representative remaining from the Hidden Sand, Shinki is determined to preserve the pride of the Sand, and goes on the offensive against Boruto and Sarada. Boruto and Sarada team up to fight Shinki, but he puts up an impenetrable defense. Sarada falls, and Boruto's chakra is nearly exhausted, but he refuses to give up!

Episodes.Title: The Otsutsuki Invasion
Episodes.Description: Momoshiki, Kinshiki and Urashiki of the Otsutsuki Clan suddenly appear in the arena filled with spectators. Using his Scientific Ninja Tool, Boruto hurls jutsu after jutsu to no avail against Momoshiki, who is targeting Naruto. Meanwhile, Urashiki is curious about Mitsuki's strange power and goes after him, but he is confronted by Gaara along with the Mizukage Chojuro. Naruto and the other ninja do all they can to protect the citizens, and for the first time, Boruto witnesses the magnitude of his father's power in real combat.

Episodes.Title: Sasuke’s Secret Weapon
Episodes.Description: Naruto uses all his power to protect everyone from the Otsutsuki Clan. Boruto realizes the magnitude of his father's love for the village and its people and, at the same time, his own weakness. Watching his friends working on repairs and aiding the wounded in the aftermath of the attack, Boruto realizes the meaning of his father's words. Knowing that this experience has matured his student a little, Sasuke brings up a certain mission.

Episodes.Title: Rescuing Naruto
Episodes.Description: Sasuke and the Kage wage an intense battle against the ridiculously powerful Momoshiki and Kinshiki of the Otsutsuki Clan. During that time, Boruto and Naruto, who have always been at odds, face each other and connect for the first time. But Momoshiki interrupts their reunion.

Episodes.Title: Father and Child
Episodes.Description: Naruto and Sasuke fight against Momoshiki Otsutsuki. Momoshiki gets defeated, but he's helped by Katasuke and his Scientific Ninja Tool. In the end, Boruto puts an end to Momoshiki's life. While dying, Momoshiki talks to Boruto and gives him the Karma Seal.

Episodes.Title: My Story!
Episodes.Description: Boruto has made his rounds apologizing to everyone for his transgressions during the exam, but Momoshiki's prophecy continues to bother him.

Episodes.Title: Super Cho-Cho Butterfly Mode!
Episodes.Description: Popular actors Tomaru and Ashina receive death threats from an unknown person, so Team 10 is assigned to a joint mission with Team 7 to guard them. The two teams assemble to get the details of their mission, but Boruto sees a beautiful girl he doesn't remember seeing before…

Episodes.Title: Super Cho-Cho Kiss Mode!
Episodes.Description: The movie studio where Team 7 and Team 10 have been assigned to is attacked by a mysterious ninja. The lead actress is wounded and Tomaru, the lead actor, picks Cho-Cho to be the stand-in! Tomaru's flirting has Cho-Cho on Cloud 9, but Sarada and the others worry that the lovestruck Cho-Cho has lost her focus on the mission!

Episodes.Title: Super Cho-Cho Love Upheaval!
Episodes.Description: The ninja in the gas mask appears again during filming and kidnaps Tomaru. Despite everything that happened, Cho-Cho continues to worry about Tomaru and berates Konohamaru and Moeri for failing to stop the abductor. Meanwhile, Ashina agrees to deliver the money as instructed in the ransom note.

Episodes.Title: The Other Side of Anxiety
Episodes.Description: Metal's father, Rock Lee, announces that he will train Metal to master the ultimate taijutsu technique, the Eight Inner Gates. The thought that he cannot fail this training fills Metal with anxiety, and he ends up buying an item that's supposed to calm his nerves. But it doesn't work, and his father ends up postponing the training. He then runs into Might Guy, his father's mentor and a hero of the Fourth Great Ninja War.

Episodes.Title: The Hardest Rock in the World
Episodes.Description: The first Five Kage Summit since the attack by the Otsutsuki Clan is held in Hidden Leaf. The current Kage as well as their predecessors assemble, except the Third Tsuchikage, Ohnoki. Boruto and Team 7 have been assigned security duty, but Boruto gets bored and lets his guard down. Then by chance, they encounter Ohnoki.

Episodes.Title: Mitsuki's Will
Episodes.Description: The ninja assigned to the Hidden Leaf Gate are attacked, and Mitsuki disappears. Boruto and Sarada are unaware of this when their scheduled mission is suddenly canceled. Worried, the two start searching for their teammate. When they learn that all the jonin have been summoned by the Hokage, they set out to find out what's going on.

Episodes.Title: The Other Side of the Moon
Episodes.Description: Boruto and Sarada sneak out of the village and head to Orochimaru's research lab to find clues about Mitsuki. After evading the ninja guarding the entrance, they get in. But what they observe at the facility and hear from Orochimaru makes Boruto realize that he never truly knew Mitsuki. Meanwhile, the village finds out that Boruto and Sarada have gone in search of Mitsuki, and Shikadai and his Team 10 are assigned a tracking mission to bring back them back.

Episodes.Title: The Enemy, Ino-Shika-Cho!
Episodes.Description: Orochimaru tells Boruto and Sakura about the White Snake Sage who lives in Ryuchi Cave. On their way there, the two are confronted by Team 10, which is determined to take the two back to the village so that they are not labeled as "rogue" ninja. But there's no way Boruto or Sarada will oblige until they find out the truth from Mitsuki, so they are forced into confrontation using everything they've got!

Episodes.Title: The Trials of Ryuchi Cave
Episodes.Description: Boruto and friends head for Ryuchi Cave in order to see the White Snake Sage. But it's not a simple task, since they have no clue where it is. They search for miles, becoming hungry and tired. They are near their limit when Ryuchi Cave suddenly appears before them along with mysterious women to guide them. They are told they must pass a series of tests in order to meet the White Snake Sage!

Episodes.Title: Incurring Wrath
Episodes.Description: The White Snake Sage tells Boruto to bring back the "Reverse Scale" from Garaga, a troublesome snake. Boruto and his friends head deeper into Ryuchi Cave and are confronted by a giant serpent. It is Garaga, the very one they seek, but its sheer power has the gang backed into a corner. Meanwhile, Moegi reports that Mitsuki's disappearance might involve someone who has access to crucial village secrets.

Episodes.Title: A Fierce Enemy: Garaga’s Ferocious Attack!
Episodes.Description: Boruto and the others work together to obtain the Reverse Scale from Garaga. But the battle proves difficult, as Garaga has the power to sense the location of its enemies and turn them into stone. In the midst of battle, the team notices inconsistencies in Garaga's moves and comes up with a successful strategy to subdue him. Boruto is seized with a strange feeling and makes Garaga a proposition.

Episodes.Title: Everyone’s Motives
Episodes.Description: Mitsuki heads toward Kokuyou and Sekiei's homeland, the Land of Earth. Meanwhile, thanks to the power of the White Snake Sage, Boruto and the others learn that Mitsuki is with Hidden Stone Ninja, and they also head for the Land of Earth. Each side has their own agenda, but will they be able to meet up successfully?

Episodes.Title: Reunion with Mitsuki
Episodes.Description: Kokuyou confronts Boruto and the others. Kokuyou, whose only goal is to become strong, is so powerful that he's taken down the Leaf ninja pursuing Mitsuki. He easily drives Boruto and his team into a corner. Just then, backup appears. Boruto and his friends manage to overcome Kokuyou, and finally catch with up Mitsuki.

Episodes.Title: Mitsuki's Friend
Episodes.Description: Instead of returning home with Boruto, Mitsuki stays with Kokuyou. During this time, Sekiei becomes sick and declines. To recover, Kokuyou returns to his comrades. During his absence, Sekiei asks Mitsuki to teach him what it means to be human. Meanwhile, the Fourth Tsuchikage Kurotsuchi, who had been visiting Ohnoki, her ailing grandfather, is attacked by mysterious assailants.

Episodes.Title: Boruto's Wish
Episodes.Description: Boruto is injured, unconscious and unable to continue. Everyone thinks about returning to the Hidden Leaf. However, being close to the Land of Earth, a surprise attack is highly possible. As a precaution, Inojin and Cho-Cho set out on recon of the surrounding area.

Episodes.Title: Infiltrating the Hidden Stone Village
Episodes.Description: Boruto and his friends decide to go the Hidden Stone Village to see the former Tsuchikage, Ohnoki. In case of an emergency, Inojin stays back with the young Akuta, who is attached to him. The team secretly enters the village determined to find Ohnoki, but they are unaware that they are being watched.

Episodes.Title: Ohnoki's Justice
Episodes.Description: The team finds Ohnoki, but he flatly refuses to help. On top of which, they are attacked and separated. This leaves it up to each member to make it to the rendezvous point on their own. Meanwhile, Mitsuki is being shown around Kokuyou’s hideout.

Episodes.Title: Ohnoki's Thoughts, Ku's Thoughts
Episodes.Description: Boruto and Ohnoki head to the rendezvous point, but they stumble into the Hidden Stone Shinobi Training Grounds, which are protected by a barrier. Ohnoki tells Boruto that the only way out of the Training Grounds is to find his heart of stone, something that can only be found once in a lifetime when a person comes to terms with their will.

Episodes.Title: The Heart Stone
Episodes.Description: In order to get out of the barrier, Boruto desperately searches for his heart of stone, but he has little success. Then he encounters Sekki, one of the Genbu Three that participated in the recent Chunin Exams. Sekki has also come to the training ground in order to find his heart of stone. Seeing their predicament, Ohnoki tries to help them.

Episodes.Title: Kozuchi's Will
Episodes.Description: Ohnoki takes Boruto to a special location to explain his vision of the future, formed after losing his grandchild, Kozuchi. Meanwhile, time is running out for Ku and his supporters. They rush to set their plan in motion—using force to subdue any who dissent, they attempt to take over the Hidden Stone Village.

Episodes.Title: The Sensation of Living
Episodes.Description: Kakou appears to take the former Tsuchikage back to the village, but Boruto confronts him and they fight. Kakou uses a rare and powerful Particle Style and pushes Boruto to the edge. Meanwhile, Shikadai manages to slip through the Akuta guards and heads for the Hidden Leaf to report on the situation in the Hidden Stone.

Episodes.Title: Clash: Kokuyou!
Episodes.Description: Boruto and Sarada are caught and taken back to the Hidden Stone headquarters along with Ohnoki. There, they find that Ku and his supporters have taken the village, and that things have changed drastically. Kokuyou and Kirara swoop down on Boruto and Sarada, but Shikadai comes to the rescue!

Episodes.Title: A Piercing Heart
Episodes.Description: After Boruto and Sarada part ways with Shikadai and the others, Kirara appears and turns them into “dolls” that must obey her, ordering the two to kill each other. Meanwhile, thinking about Boruto’s words and how his village is becoming something different than what he envisioned, Ohnoki realizes that he’s made a mistake.

Episodes.Title: Mitsuki and Sekiei
Episodes.Description: Sustaining great damage from Mitsuki’s attack, Ku flees the scene. Boruto and Sarada attempt to chase after him, but Kirara blocks their path! Meanwhile, Sekiei watches everything unfold. Shocked and confused by the actions of Mitsuki, Sekiei recklessly attacks him. Not wanting to fight, Mitsuki tries to stop him.

Episodes.Title: Ohnoki's Will
Episodes.Description: Ku appears once again to provoke and attack Boruto. Meanwhile, reevaluating his true will and intent, Ohnoki prepares for a fight to the death in order to stop Ku from doing any more harm.

Episodes.Title: A New Ordinary
Episodes.Description: Boruto and the other Leaf Genin return to the Hidden Leaf with Mitsuki. However, Mitsuki is detained and subjected to hours of interrogation. And since Boruto and the others have taken actions that would normally banish them from the village, it is decided that they will lose their genin qualification as punishment.

Episodes.Title: Parent and Child Day
