Episodes.Title: Van Rook's Apprentice
Episodes.Description: When Drew spots Van Rook's new apprentice Doyle without his mask on, she wonders if he is really her long-lost brother.

Episodes.Title: Twelve Hundred Degrees Fahrenheit
Episodes.Description: When a volcano erupts, a lizard-man known as the Cherufe is released.

Episodes.Title: The Owlman Feeds at Midnight
Episodes.Description: When the Saturdays travel to Southern England for information on the Kur Stone, they end up getting involved with a string of disappearances caused by the Owlman.

Episodes.Title: The Swarm at the Edge of Space
Episodes.Description: After the Saturdays rescue Agents Epsilon and Francis, space jellyfish attack.

Episodes.Title: Black Monday
Episodes.Description: When water supplies in the Middle East are inexplicably turning into salt, the Secret Scientists send Drew and Zak to investigate.

Episodes.Title: Eterno
Episodes.Description: When Zak touches the mystic Smoke Mirror of Tezcatlipoca, it unleashes the Monday family, evil doppelgangers of his family with their own unique powers

Episodes.Title: Cryptid vs. Cryptid
Episodes.Description: The Saturdays discover the existence of underground cryptid fights run by Leonidas Van Rook. They soon discover that Van Rook isn't in on this on his own.

Episodes.Title: The Underworld Bride
Episodes.Description: As part of Zak's training in his cryptid-influencing power, the Saturdays travel to New Guinea with Ulraj (the young king of Kumari Kandam) to investigate a dinosaur/bat creature called the Duah.

Episodes.Title: Ghost in the Machine
Episodes.Description: When Doc receives a troubling "visit" from what appears to be the ghost of his old mentor, the Saturdays travel to Louisiana's Honey Island Swamp to let Doc finish the work he and his mentor started over 25 years ago.

Episodes.Title: Something in the Water
Episodes.Description: The Saturdays stumble across a hidden city built in the middle of an African lake, but this paradise in being threatened by repeated attacks from the giant, catfish-like Lau.

Episodes.Title: Target: Fiskerton
Episodes.Description: Argost recruits Van Rook and Piecemeal to kidnap Fiskerton, whom Argost suspects may be Kur.

Episodes.Title: Once More the Nightmare Factory
Episodes.Description: To rescue their kidnapped family member, the Saturdays and Doyle are forced to assault Weirdworld itself.

Episodes.Title: The Underworld Bride
Episodes.Description: The Saturday family and King Ulraj travel to New Guinea to investigate the Dua'a, a prehistoric flying cryptid.

Episodes.Title: Once More the Nightmare Factory
Episodes.Description: When the Saturdays invade Weirdworld to rescue Fiskerton, Doyle shows up to lend a hand.  Argost reveals Fiskerton's Lemurian heritage to Fisk and Doyle, but the family doesn't yet know.

Episodes.Title: Paris is Melting
Episodes.Description: A series of attacks on the Secret Scientists prompt Zak and the family must go on a quest to clear Fiskerton's name.

Episodes.Title: Where Lies the Engulfer
Episodes.Description: When Zak and Doyle go on a training mission in an abandoned town, they make a surprising discovery.

Episodes.Title: Shadows of Lemuria
Episodes.Description: The Saturday family call on the para-neurologist Dr. David Bara to find the motivation behind Fiskerton's strange instinctual behavior, while V.V. Argost sends a Neural Parasite to the Saturdays' home to extract Kur's location from the creature's brain by force.

Episodes.Title: Kur Rising
Episodes.Description: Upon arriving in Antarctica, V.V. Argost releases Kur from beneath the ice. The Saturdays battle against Kur, giving Argost the opportunity to sneak inside its body and control it from within. Zak follows Argost inside, pitting his powers against Kur's might. After a long struggle, Zak manages to overcome Kur, knocking it unconscious. The cryptids formerly under Argost's control turn on him, forcing Munya to carry him out to safety. Outside of Kur, Doyle uses the Kur-sensing relic to solidify the point that they are near Kur. However, once Zak is expelled from Kur's body,the glow began to fade. Doyle approaches Zak, and the artifact glows strongly once more—showing that the Antarctic Cryptid wasn't Kur, but that Zak is actually Kur.

Episodes.Title: Kur (1)
Episodes.Description: Six months after the Kur crisis, the other Secret Scientists have discovered that Zak is Kur, and are tracking him to take him into custody, forcing the Saturdays into a life as fugitives. To make matters worse, the Nagas are also after Zak, in hopes of making him their new leader. Meanwhile, Doyle and Zon go to England and have a run-in with Leonidas Van Rook (who had just had his buisness overtaken by Abbey) when looking for V.V. Argost, who has mysteriously disappeared.

Episodes.Title: Kur (2)
Episodes.Description: The Saturdays fight to keep the Nagas and the other cryptids from invading the world. Meanwhile, Doyle, Zon and Leonidas Van Rook are still looking for V.V. Argost. Doyle and Van Rook seem to find evidence that Argost is dead. The Saturdays go to Hong Kong expecting the Nagi invasion to start there but turn out to be wrong. The Nagas are invading New York. After some encouragement, Zak stops the invasion and is saved by a mysterious black shadow. It turns out to be V.V. Argost who offers to (cryptically) teach Zak to better control his powers through Argost's show, Weird World. Zak accepts the deal, despite knowing that Argost is trying to somehow trick him. Zak also asked Doyle to find out as much about Argost's past as he can.

Episodes.Title: The Thousand Eyes of Ahuizotl
Episodes.Description: Upon learning that a cryptid has awakened after centuries of hibernating in the jungle, the Saturdays head to Mexico.

Episodes.Title: Into The Mouth of Darkness
Episodes.Description: The Saturdays set a course for Greenland so they can search for an ancient Sumerian tablet, but the family is forced to take a detour to Australia when the airship gets infested by Bunyips by V.V. Argost.

Episodes.Title: The Legion of Garuda
Episodes.Description: he Saturdays learn about a sect of Indian sorcerers who were able to drive out the spirit of Kur in the past, and they attempt to find them, in hope that group can do it again.  They learned that in order to drive out the spirit of Kur a ritual, using an artifact known as the "Flute of Gilgamesh", must be performed

Episodes.Title: The Return of Tsul 'Kalu
Episodes.Description: The Saturdays return to their headquarters to retrieve tomes from Drew's library and are ambushed by Tsul 'Kalu, a cryptid whose hand now resides at the end of Zak's Claw.

Episodes.Title: The Unblinking Eye
Episodes.Description: Doyle and Zak help Fiskerton come to terms with his Lemurian heritage.

Episodes.Title: Life in the Underground
Episodes.Description: The Saturdays and Abbey go to the Allegheny Mountains to help with a problem caused by the cryptid Allegewi, but Van Rook's new apprentice shows up to cause trouble for the family.

Episodes.Title: And Your Enemies Closer
Episodes.Description: Drew reunites with Doyle, Zon, and Van Rook in the Himalayas, where they hope to learn about the orange cryptid that was stolen by Argost.  Meanwhile, Doc, Zak, and Fiskterton attempt to make a deal with the rest of the Secret Scientists.

Entries.Title: Magic Kaito 1412
Entries.Description: It seems the notorious Kid the Phantom Thief has returned after eight years. At first, high school student and master illusionist Kaito seeks to challenge the magic trick-wielding outlaw out of pride, but then he learns that his deceased father was actually Kid the Phantom Thief, so who is the newcomer? Kaito puts on his dad's old cape, hat, and monocle and takes to the air to get answers.

Episodes.Title: Kid the Phantom Thief Returns
Episodes.Description: It seems the notorious Kid the Phantom Thief has returned after eight years. At first, high school student and master illusionist Kaito seeks to challenge the magic trick-wielding outlaw out of pride, but then he learns that his deceased father was actually Kid the Phantom Thief, so who is the newcomer? Kaito puts on his dad's old cape, hat, and monocle and takes to the air to get answers.

Episodes.Title: Blue Birthday
Episodes.Description: Kaito finds himself double-booked when a theft he announced beforehand is on the same night as Aoko's birthday party. Complicating matters is the appearance of a group of jewel-collecting thugs who may have had something to do with the murder of Kaito's father.

Episodes.Title: Hustler vs. Magician
Episodes.Description: Kaito goes up against a Syndicate-owned pool hall hustler to win back the Legendary Cue, a treasure once owned by Jii before he was cheated it out of it by the Syndicate boss many years ago. However, things look dire when Jii's pool hall is put on the line and Kaito apparently has no skill with the game.

Episodes.Title: A Great Detective Comes to Light
Episodes.Description: A brilliant if arrogant teen detective comes to town, determined to capture Kid the Phantom Thief. This turns the heat up for Kaito, especially since they're classmates. In fact, Kaito becomes Suguru's rival even out of uniform, leading to a "gentlemen's bet" over which of them will go on a date with Aoko.

Episodes.Title: Scarlet Seduction
Episodes.Description: Kaito has a new classmate, Akako, who appears to possess genuine magic abilities, the kind that bend everyone to her will... except for Kaito and his alter ego, Kid the Phantom Thief! Who will come out on top in the inevitable showdown, sorceress or illusionist?

Episodes.Title: Black Star
Episodes.Description: Kid the Phantom Thief attempts a bold clock tower robbery in a building swarming with the police, but his real rival takes the stage here for the first time, turning the endeavor into a fierce battle of wits!

Episodes.Title: Kaito Kuroba's Busy Day Off
Episodes.Description: When Inspector Nakamori catches a glimpse of Kaito's face during an attempted robbery, the young magician has to "prove" he's not Kid the Phantom Thief by going on a date with Aoko at the same time Kid is supposed to make his next appearance!

Episodes.Title: Adult's Charm
Episodes.Description: Real magic comes back to haunt Kaito in the form of Akako. This time, the sorceress is so annoyed with her classmate that she plots to wipe him out when he's in his Phantom Thief identity. And to stack the deck, Akako turns Inspector Nakamori into a murderous thug!

Episodes.Title: Enter: The Phantom Lady
Episodes.Description: In the present, Kaito and Aoko are lured into a trap at the top of the Toto Tower, while in the past, the first Kid the Phantom Thief and the mysterious Phantom Lady have an exciting first encounter at the top of the Eiffel Tower!

Episodes.Title: Phantom Lady and the Ryoma Treasure
Episodes.Description: Kid's first order of business is saving himself and an unconscious, handcuffed Aoko as they plummet from the top of Toto Tower in an antique car. Assuming he succeeds, the next challenge is finishing his mother's last job, bringing a crooked antiques dealer to justice. But his mother never had to deal with the brilliant diminutive detective, Edogawa Conan!

Episodes.Title: Kid, Conan, and the Ryoma Treasure Illusion
Episodes.Description: The Detective Conan crossover concludes with a night at the museum, in which Kid goes out of his way to return stolen items amid a crowd of adoring fans, the police who want to take him down, and a couple of real criminals!

Episodes.Title: Holy Night: Two Kid the Phantom Thieves!
Episodes.Description: When the greedy owner of a department store has an employee impersonate Kid the Phantom Thief to steal the Star of the Giants, he doesn't count on the real Kid showing up on Christmas Eve to foil his plan!

Episodes.Title: Get Away From Him
Episodes.Description: Kaito takes a break from thieving to go on his class ski trip, but when his teacher holds a couples-only masquerade ski tournament, he finds himself in a tug-of-war between the witchy Akako and childhood friend Aoko!

Episodes.Title: Crystal Mother
Episodes.Description: Kaito and Aoko are on a luxury train with the Queen of Ingram, her son, and the Principality of Ingram's Crystal Mother, a huge topaz that may contain the Pandora jewel. The queen has the real jewel cleverly hidden, though, making it a challenge for Kaito/Kid to find it before the train reaches Osaka. On top of that, he's got competition, as there's a Snake on the train!

Episodes.Title: The Princess and the Thief's Improv
Episodes.Description: When a princess with a priceless jewel comes to town, Inspector Nakamori is sidelined by a detective from her country who shoots first and... shoots again later, until his quarry is killed. Naturally, his target is Kid the Phantom Thief!

Episodes.Title: Kid vs Conan: Miraculous Airwalking
Episodes.Description: Kid the Phantom Thief literally rises to the occasion when old man Jirokichi of the Suzuki conglomerate throws down the gauntlet. But with Detective Conan as part of the security team guarding the Blue Wonder jewel, will Kaito finally get his wings clipped?

Episodes.Title: Green Dream
Episodes.Description: Kid's next target is Green Dream, the world's largest emerald and a one-time-only stage prop for a local play. Though the venue is crawling with cops under Nakamori's command, will Kid be able to make off with Green Dream as well as make a young actress's dream come true?

Episodes.Title: Golden Eye (Part One): Chat Noir's Challenge
Episodes.Description: Kid has a new phantom thief rival in town, who flew all the way from France: Chat Noir! The felonious feline challenges Kid to steal a cat's-eye ring which may have belonged to Marie Antoinette, but this time, tough security measures have also been imported from France.

Episodes.Title: Golden Eye (Part Two): Kid Versus Chat Noir: Endgame
Episodes.Description: Right on schedule, Kid the Phantom Thief makes his move to steal Marie Antoinette's cat's-eye ring off the hand of Inspector Nakamori... but has the French cat burglar Chat Noir already made the first move? And will either one of them be able to escape the "inescapable cage"?

Episodes.Title: Dark Knight
Episodes.Description: Kid is pressured into teaming up with Nightmare, a masked criminal mastermind with a penchant for losing partners to police custody and sometimes death itself! Will Kid make a successful steal and survive the night?

Episodes.Title: Teleportation Under the Moonlight
Episodes.Description: Kid the Phantom Thief accepts another challenge from old man Suzuki, which means Conan will be on the scene, too. Although given short notice, Kaito tries to think of a show-stopper of a trick to impress his rival and get away with the jewels.

Episodes.Title: Red Tear
Episodes.Description: Kid's next target is Red Tear, a gem that belongs to the leader of a magic troupe. But just as he changes his mind after realizing something important, Kaito notices that Snake and his henchmen are also after Red Tear. What's a phantom thief to do?

Episodes.Title: Midnight Crow (Part One): The Name is Corbeau the Phantom Thief!
Episodes.Description: Corbeau the Phantom Thief, a black-clad, dead-ringer for Kid's father, appears and challenges him. Kaito agrees, but if he fails, he'll have to retire as a phantom thief!

Episodes.Title: Midnight Crow (Part Two): Clash! White or Black?!
Episodes.Description: In this final episode, Kid goes up against the enigmatic Corbeau one more time as they vie for the jewel that may contain Pandora, which means Snake can't be far behind!

Episodes.Title: The Hanged Man
Episodes.Description: Rising artisan Leonardo da Vinci is commissioned by the powerful Medici to create an Easter spectacle in Florence. After some maneuvering, da Vinci is hired to engineer war machines. A mysterious Turk intrigues Leonardo.

Episodes.Title: The Serpent
Episodes.Description: Leonardo continues his quest for the Book of Leaves. The Pope’s nephew arrives and meets his spy. Leonardo’s war designs fail, causing a rift with the Medicis. The Pope learns of Leonardo’s prowess.

Episodes.Title: The Prisoner
Episodes.Description: Riario engages the Pope and a mysterious prisoner in a discussion concerning the count's defeat, while Leonardo searches for a rational explanation when an outbreak of demonic possession occurs at a convent, and the blame is placed on the Medicis.

Episodes.Title: The Magician
Episodes.Description: Bechhi is accused of being a spy for Rome. The armies of Rome and Florence face off, and Leonardo reveals his latest weapon.

Episodes.Title: The Tower
Episodes.Description: Lorenzo orders Piero da Vinci to defend his estranged son in court. During a performance for visiting royalty, Leonardo surprises the corrupt judge. Back at his workshop, Leonardo is surprised by the Turk.

Episodes.Title: The Devil
Episodes.Description: A clue from the Turk about the Book of Leaves sends Leonardo to Wallachia, where he encounters Vlad Dracula. Lorenzo and Piero meet the Duke of Urbino. The search for the true spy continues.

Episodes.Title: The Hierophant
Episodes.Description: Leonardo builds an underwater suit and uses the sewers to enter the Vatican, where he meets the Pope and the mysterious prisoner. Giuliano reveals the true identity of Rome's spy.

Episodes.Title: The Lovers
Episodes.Description: The Pazzis prepare a murderous plot for Easter Sunday. The Turk tells Leonardo where to find the Book of Leaves. Lucrezia makes a confession as Leonardo attempts to save the Medicis.

Episodes.Title: The Blood of Man
Episodes.Description: The Pazzis make their move; Leonardo gambles for the future of Florence; Riario makes progress in his quest for the Book of Leaves.

Episodes.Title: The Blood of Brothers
Episodes.Description: Leonardo uses his intellect to save Florence as Pope Sixtus brings powers together; Nico tries to resist Riario's temptations.

Episodes.Title: The Voyage of the Damned
Episodes.Description: Leonardo continues his search for the Book of Leaves; Lorenzo is forced to make sacrifices when Pope Sixtus takes aggressive measures against Florence; Lucrezia looks for new alliances in Rome.

Episodes.Title: The Ends of the Earth
Episodes.Description: Leonardo attempts to navigate the Atlantic without maps; Lucrezia is smuggled into the Vatican for an important meeting; Lorenzo's identity is discovered during his trip to Naples.

Episodes.Title: The Sun and the Moon
Episodes.Description: Leonardo makes an unexpected discovery in the New World. Lorenzo attempts to save Florence with the help of an old flame. Clarice struggles to retain control of the Medici Bank.

Episodes.Title: The Rope of the Dead
Episodes.Description: Entering the Vault of Heaven presents challenges for Leonardo and Riario; Lorenzo becomes a part of King Ferrante's bloody games; Lucrezia meets the Turk in Constantinople.

Episodes.Title: The Vault of Heaven
Episodes.Description: Leonardo and his allies face deadly threats as they search for the Book of Leaves; Carlo helps Clarice; the Sultan's son is intrigued by Lucrezia.

Episodes.Title: The Fall from Heaven
Episodes.Description: Leonardo and Riario face death; Zoroaster and Nico plan an escape; Lorenzo waits to meet with the king of Naples; Bayezid seeks diplomacy in Rome.

Episodes.Title: The Enemies of Man
Episodes.Description: Leonardo returns to learn that Duke Federico has been ruling Florence with an iron fist; a sinful Riario seeks redemption; King Ferrante negotiates with Lorenzo.

Episodes.Title: The Sins of Daedalus
Episodes.Description: An unlikely alliance is needed to save Italy from an Ottoman attack; Riario faces danger; Nico takes control of Vanessa's destiny.

Episodes.Title: Semper Infidelis
Episodes.Description: Leonardo and his allies are forced to retreat when the Ottoman Empire storms the city of Otranto.

Episodes.Title: Abbadon
Episodes.Description: Leo devises an escape from Otranto but may not be able to save those closest to him.

Episodes.Title: Modus Operandi
Episodes.Description: Leonardo investigates a horrific murder that may result in the Labyrinth being exposed.

Episodes.Title: The Labrys
Episodes.Description: Carlo's attempt to program Leonardo into becoming "one" with the Labyrinth leads him to slip into an alternate reality that could prove life-threatening.

Episodes.Title: Anima Venator
Episodes.Description: A paranoid Leonardo becomes shut off from his friends, while an endangered Lucrezia searches for a way to make amends for past sins.

Episodes.Title: Liberum Arbitrium
Episodes.Description: The Monster of Italy is captured but not all is safe as danger still lurks and poses a threat to the upcoming Crusade Festival.

Episodes.Title: Alis Volat Propiis
Episodes.Description: A former nemesis returns to Florence and stands in opposition to Crusade efforts. Vanessa and Nico ponder their futures; Leo attempts to decipher the Turkish armor.

Episodes.Title: La Confessione Della Macchina
Episodes.Description: Nico and Zoroastre turn to an old enemy to gain support for the Crusade. Leo is ambushed by the Labyrinth.

Episodes.Title: Angelus Iratissimus
Episodes.Description: Leo and Sophia struggle to control the mysterious device they've built. Back in Florence, Riario awaits judgment while Lorenzo and Vanessa take their partnership to the next level.

Episodes.Title: Ira Deorum
Episodes.Description: Leo must put his faith in his friends and in himself to have a chance to defeat the Turks.

Episodes.Title: The Legendary Hit Man
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto enjoys a quiet life in retirement with his family. But one day, an old colleague demands he return to the assassin world — or face consequences.

Episodes.Title: Vs. Son Hee and Bacho
Episodes.Description: While out on an errand, Sakamoto and Shin encounter Lu Shaotang, the daughter of a mafia boss, who's on the run and targeted by twin assassins.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Sugar Park
Episodes.Description: After learning of the huge bounty on Sakamoto's head, the crew tries to enjoy a family outing at the amusement park while fending off assassins.

Episodes.Title: Hard-Boiled
Episodes.Description: With the poison-wielding hitman taken out, the Sakamotos head to their next attraction, where they're ambushed by Dondenkai Ltd's ultimate assassin duo.

Episodes.Title: Source of Strength
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto goes all out in a fierce one-on-one duel with Boiled. Meanwhile, ORDER members handle a serial case targeting assassins.

Episodes.Title: Heisuke Mashimo
Episodes.Description: Hoping to win the million-yen prize, Team Sakamoto enters the shopping district's survival tournament and teams up with a completely clueless sniper.

Episodes.Title: Jurassic Bastard
Episodes.Description: While manning the store alone, Lu gets kidnapped by a mysterious group. Sakamoto and Shin pursue her but are halted by an invisible assassin.

Episodes.Title: Sakamoto's vs. the Lab
Episodes.Description: To rescue Lu, Sakamoto and Shin infiltrate a top-secret lab seized by assassins. Meanwhile, Lu meets someone from Shin's childhood in a prison cell.

Episodes.Title: All Aboard
Episodes.Description: In the depths of the Lab, Shin and Heisuke join forces to take down the invisible assailant, while Sakamoto battles Kashima intensely.

Episodes.Title: Bathhouse Roughhouse
Episodes.Description: Exhausted from their battle, the crew heads to a local bathhouse but finds it too dangerous to relax. Later, a mysterious man arrives in search of Lu.

Episodes.Title: Unlisted Episode
Episodes.Description: Description not available from sources.

Episodes.Title: For the Eternal Pulse of Mine Bloodline, I Would Offer This Blood in Totality

Entries.Title: Initial D
Entries.Description: As usual Mako and Sayuki are racing on Mt. Usui. But Mako is battling emotional wounds from what she thinks was a rejection by Iketani, while Sayuki's childhood friend Shingo (of the Myogi Night Kids) and his teammate Nakazato arrive to warn them that a team made of Lancer Evolutions called Emperor is targeting Usui now, to conquer the Gunma area.

Episodes.Title: Extra Stage 1 Part 1 - Beyond Impact Blue... (Special)
Episodes.Description: As usual Mako and Sayuki are racing on Mt. Usui. But Mako is battling emotional wounds from what she thinks was a rejection by Iketani, while Sayuki's childhood friend Shingo (of the Myogi Night Kids) and his teammate Nakazato arrive to warn them that a team made of Lancer Evolutions called Emperor is targeting Usui now, to conquer the Gunma area.

Episodes.Title: Extra Stage 1 Part 2 - Sentimental White (Special)
Episodes.Description: To make Mako’s world better, Sayuki sets up a perfect match for her best friend. At first this seems alright, but is it worth it if it means giving up her dreams in street racing for a relationship?

Episodes.Title: Battle Stage (Special)
Episodes.Description: Initial D Battle Stage (special) will summarize the major street races from the two TV series. Rather than simply using clips from the TV series, the new special will entirely re-animate all of the original CG car and background footage with new state-of-the-art computer graphics rendering. The special will also feature entirely new Super Eurobeat music and guest commentary from legendary "drift racer" Keiichi Tsuchiya.

Episodes.Title: Project D to the Next Stage (Special)
Episodes.Description: A special that comes with the Fourth Stage DVD-BOX. It is comprised of a recap from First Stage to Third Stage, along with staff commentary and sneak preview of the making of the Fourth Stage.

Episodes.Title: Fourth Stage Battle Digest (Special)
Episodes.Description: An 8 minute trailer for Initial D Battle Stage 2 that came with Super Eurobeat Presents Initial D Fourth Stage Non-Stop Mega Mix With Battle Digest, the thirty-fourth Initial D album. It was released February 28th 2007 and published by Avex Trax.

Episodes.Title: Battle Stage 2 (Special)
Episodes.Description: Initial D Battle Stage 2 summarizes the major street races from the recent Fourth Stage TV series. While the first Battle Stage had every battle re-animated from scratch, the only episodes altered in the second version were the early races in stage 4, to match with the visual style of the latter portion of Stage 4. Additionally, two races that were previously seen only in the manga were animated specially for the feature. The first race is Takahashi Keisuke vs. Smiley Sakai, and the other is Keisuke vs. Kawai Atsuro. Both races are noticeably shorter than the other races in the feature.

Episodes.Title: Extra Stage 2 - Tabidachi No Green (Special)
Episodes.Description: Itekani missed an oppertunity to see Mako-chan and hates himself for never calling to say he was sorry. By chance he runs into her 6 months later, and the situation is akward. Itekani does not have time to talk at the chance, but both want to talk, so they arrange a 2. meeting. Itekani goes to the meeting place early, but an old man was left behind from an tourist bus, and asks Itekani to catch the bus for him. Itekani being a nice guy, cant say no.

Episodes.Title: Battle Stage 3 (Special)
Episodes.Description: Initial D: Battle Stage 3 is the eleventh and final installment of the Initial D series. It features every race from Fifth Stage and Final Stage. Unlike the previous two battle stages, it does not feature any new battles, and doesn't feature any character dialogue.

Episodes.Title: The Ultimate Tofu Store Drift
Episodes.Description: High school kid Takumi works at a gas station with his buddy Itsuki. When the guys join their co-worker Iketani for a night of street racing action on Mt. Akina, Takumi’s life will never be the same.

Episodes.Title: Revenge! The Rumbling Turbo
Episodes.Description: When his boss reveals that the Eight-Six driver from Mt. Akina owns a tofu shop, Iketani begins to wonder if the legendary racer might have an intimate connection to Takumi.

Episodes.Title: Downhill Specialist Arrives
Episodes.Description: Iketani’s out of commission for the race against the RedSuns, so he tries to convince Bunta to take his place. Takumi’s working on a deal of his own - he need’s his dad’s car for a date with Natsuki.

Episodes.Title: The Battle Begins
Episodes.Description: The match between the SpeedStars and the RedSuns is set to begin. Just as Iketani makes the desperate decision to put Kenji up against Keisuke, the Eight-Six appears - with Takumi behind the wheel.

Episodes.Title: Dogfight!
Episodes.Description: When Takumi stuns everyone with his skills in the Eight-Six, Iketani and Itsuki start plotting a way to get the new hotshot to join the SpeedStars.

Episodes.Title: A New Challenger
Episodes.Description: Driving his new Three-Two, Takeshi goes head-to-head against Ryosuke on Mt. Akina. Meanwhile, Takumi offers Iketani a first-hand look at the thrill of riding in the Eight-Six.

Episodes.Title: Pride of a Racer
Episodes.Description: Takeshi is ready to take on the Eight-Six and he has every reason to believe that the car’s driver is game. When Takumi catches wind of the situation, he’s got to decide if the challenge is worth accepting.

Episodes.Title: Time's Almost Up!
Episodes.Description: There’s a crowd waiting for a race to start on Mt. Akina, but the Eight-Six is nowhere to be seen. Itsuki’s in a tough spot - and Takumi’s the only one who can get him out of it.

Episodes.Title: Battle To the Limit
Episodes.Description: The race is underway with Takumi behind the wheel of the Eight-Six. His competition, Takeshi, drives the Three-Two with undeniable skill - but he can’t seem to pull away from Takumi!

Episodes.Title: The Five Consecutive Hairpins
Episodes.Description: Takeshi and Takumi speed toward the finish line! Victory is at hand for the driver who can conquer the final challenges of the course - five treacherous hairpin curves.

Episodes.Title: Shingo Arrives
Episodes.Description: Iketani’s putting his S-13 to the test now that it’s out of the shop, but a simple practice session turns into a dangerous situation when a reckless member of the NightKids - Shingo - arrives in a red EG-6.

Episodes.Title: The FR Killer
Episodes.Description: Shingo arrives with the NightKids and he’s calling Takumi and the gang out. His demands: A Duct Tape Death Match against the Eight-Six.

Episodes.Title: First Date
Episodes.Description: Shingo’s itching to take on the Eight-Six in a dangerous race, but with nobody stepping up to accept the challenge, he takes drastic measures to get his way.

Episodes.Title: Evolving Drift
Episodes.Description: Takumi’s had enough of Shingo’s intimidation tactics. He agrees to take on the pushy NightKid in the most treacherous of races: A Duct Tape Death Match.

Episodes.Title: Takumi's Fury
Episodes.Description: Takumi and Iketani are having very different days: Takumi’s hand is taped to the Eight-Six’s steering wheel as Shingo bumps into him at high speeds. Iketani’s hanging out with a pretty girl.

Episodes.Title: The Angel of Usui
Episodes.Description: When Iketani takes Mako out for a good time, his friends decide to tail the duo and figure out what she’s all about. They soon discover her greatest talent: outdriving them all on Mt. Usui!

Episodes.Title: Sudden-Death Death Match
Episodes.Description: Takumi’s upcoming race at Usui is creating friction among his friends. One reason for the tension: he’s never driven the course. A bigger reason: his opponent is Mako.

Episodes.Title: Hot Winds and Furious Driving
Episodes.Description: Mako and Sayuki are having their way with Takumi and the Eight-Six on Mt. Usui. As Takumi himself questions his ability to pull out a win, the racers approach the course’s toughest curve.

Episodes.Title: Super Drift!
Episodes.Description: The finish line is in sight on Mt. Usui! Mako and Sayuki know the course like the back of their hands; Takumi might need a miracle if he is to claim victory against the girls.

Episodes.Title: The End of Summer
Episodes.Description: When the gang heads out to a water park, Iketani sees signs that it could actually work out with Mako - until he finds photographic proof that her heart might belong to another guy.

Episodes.Title: Challenge From the Superstar
Episodes.Description: Takumi’s growing rep has attracted the attention of Ryosuke, who’s ready to face the Eight-Six on Mt. Akina. Takumi better get his head on straight - this will be his greatest challenge yet.

Episodes.Title: Fierce Uphill Battle!
Episodes.Description: At Itsuki’s behest, Takumi heads out to watch an uphill race between two of his former foes - Takeshi of the NightKids and the RedSuns’ Keisuke.

Episodes.Title: The Rainy Downhill
Episodes.Description: Kenta, a member of the RedSuns, challenges Takumi to a downhill race in the pouring rain. With the increasingly wet course conditions, neither driver is guaranteed victory.

Episodes.Title: Akagi's White Comet
Episodes.Description: Ryosuke may already be a local legend, but he still drives like a man with something to prove. He’s determined to beat the very best racers Mt. Akina has to offer - and Takumi’s next on his list.

Episodes.Title: Last Great Battle
Episodes.Description: Veteran racer Ryosuke’s a mastermind behind the wheel, and he’ll be pulling no punches in the match against rising rookie Takumi. The drivers are ready and only one can be the best.

Episodes.Title: The New Downhill Legend
Episodes.Description: The drivers fly toward the finish line, with only one curve to go. Ryosuke and Takumi have earned their reputations - but the winner of this race will go down in history.

Episodes.Title: A New Threat
Episodes.Description: Emperor, a team of Lan Evos from the Tochigi prefecture has arrived with the goal to crush every team in Gunma. Soon they realize the fastest car in Gunma isn’t just Akagi’s White Comet, but also a new downhill legend known as Akina’s Eight-Six.

Episodes.Title: Team Emperor on Akina
Episodes.Description: What would happen if the Eight-Six gets a new upgrade? That’s exactly what Iketani and Itsuki has been thinking about to increase the performance of Takumi’s vehicle. But would Bunta allow it? Elsewhere, team Emperor’s winning streak isn’t slowing down as they continue to sweep across Gunma, defeating every race team with ease. Their next target, Akina’s Eight-Six.

Episodes.Title: The Feeling of Defeat
Episodes.Description: Kyoiichi senses an uncanny fighting spirit within the Eight-Six’s driver, as he gives Seiji strict rules against the race. Seiji however decides to ignore these rules and launches his Evo IV into full power. Takumi is outclassed in almost every category as the Evo IV’s power is truly amazing. The battle risk escalates when the race reaches it’s second half point of the coarse.

Episodes.Title: Hollow Victory
Episodes.Description: In his heart, Takumi couldn’t accept his victory over the Evo IV and decides to make a vow. To add to his already uneasy thoughts … anonymous messages are being sent to Takumi concerning his relationship with Natsuki.

Episodes.Title: Countdown to Destruction
Episodes.Description: Takumi soon discovers Natsuki’s secret that leads him to vent his anger in an egotistic battle against Kyoiichi at Akagi, thinking little of the huge disadvantage he has.

Episodes.Title: Goodbye Eight-Six
Episodes.Description: Kyoiichi is realizing just how incredible Akina’s downhill is, yet he has full confidence in his rally tuned Evo III. Takumi soon realizes the difference between the Eight-Six and the loud banging horsepower of the Evo III. It seems that Bunta instinctively knows of the race taking place as a major turning point is about to happen in the series.

Episodes.Title: Battle at Akagi
Episodes.Description: With the Eight-Six out of the picture, the RedSuns has become the main representatives of Gunma, as every local racer within the prefecture are in favor of Emperor’s defeat. Ryosuke has returned on the street to defeat the revenge-seeking Kyoiichi, who plans to use his theories of motorsports against the White Comet. Also, Iketani and Kenji spot another racer from a neighbouring prefecture.

Episodes.Title: Dangerous Car
Episodes.Description: Mt. Akagi’s battle continues, as Ryosuke has his own theories about streetracing…and he plans to demonstrate it’s difference on Kyoiichi’s Evo III. Back in Akina, Takumi’s routine way of life is gone with the absence of the Eight-Six and the discovery of Natsuki’s secret.

Episodes.Title: The New Eight-Six
Episodes.Description: The Eight-Six has returned undergoing a major change. Takumi soon test-drives the new performance much to his mixed satisfactions and disappointments, but what he doesn’t understand is what Bunta knows what’s within that car. Also, the relationship between Takumi and Natsuki is falling apart, but Itsuki’s heart is shaken with the appearance of Kazumi.

Episodes.Title: The Eight-Six Turbo!
Episodes.Description: After Wataru issues a short-lived battle against Keisuke, his sister Kazumi introduces him to Itsuki leading to a chance meeting with another Eight-Six driver. At first everything seems right with the meeting, but because of Takumi’s naïve reaction to his car’s new downhill weapon, Wataru rubs it the wrong way as his bad side emerges.

Episodes.Title: The Seal Has Been Broken
Episodes.Description: Fujiwara takes up the challenge and decides where the battle would take place. But before he can accept Wataru’s challenge, he’ll have to learn the most basic essentials of what it means to be a streetracer. Also, Itsuki’s relationship with Kazumi is teaching him the value of having a girlfriend.

Episodes.Title: Eight-Six vs. Eight-Six
Episodes.Description: Fujiwara is about to experience a completely different type of racer within Wataru’s own Eight-Six, in a treacherous mountain pass consisted of mixed elevations, rusting guardrails, unexpected traps and aging rough pavements. As Takumi presses down the accelerator, the true nature of the Eight-Six’s new hidden weapon emerges in it’s monstrous raw performance.

Episodes.Title: Changing Seasons
Episodes.Description: The battle between the two Eight-Sixes have met Wataru’s satisfaction much higher than he expected, but he plans to decide the outcome of this battle with the judgement of the human body’s limitations. Takumi soon realizes he is losing grip of his pace. After the battle, a series of revelations take place among all the characters in preparation to what’s coming next.

Episodes.Title: Project D
Episodes.Description: Project D's reputation is growing with every race. The team's next match pits Takumi against a downhill racer with technique very similar to his own.

Episodes.Title: Full Speed! Downhill Battle
Episodes.Description: Tohru's promised to quit racing forever if he loses his next match. The course is dangerous, and with Project D's downhill specialist on his tail, one wrong move could spell disaster.

Episodes.Title: The Most Powerful Man of the Toudou School
Episodes.Description: The guys of Project D are great at keeping their cool, but the pressure can't be denied as they prepare to face their next opponents - the students of the Toudou Racing School.

Episodes.Title: Two Pieces of Advice
Episodes.Description: The Toudou School's driver could be the toughest Takumi's ever faced. If Project D is to claim victory, Takumi would be wise to listen to Ryosuke's advice.

Episodes.Title: The Starting Line to Victory
Episodes.Description: The Toudou School brings in a professional driver to face Project D in a rematch. With reputations on the line, Ryosuke must decide who will represent the team.

Episodes.Title: Blind Attack
Episodes.Description: The Toudou School's driver knows all about exploiting a challenger's blind spot. If Takumi hopes to win, he'll have to find a way to leave his opponent in the dark.

Episodes.Title: The 85's Raging Turbo
Episodes.Description: A New nightmarish opponent arrives on Mt. Akina challenging Takumi in a downhill battle. Also, Itsuki gets a new upgrade for his Eight-Five as it is demonstrated on the downhill.

Episodes.Title: Fateful Battle of FDs
Episodes.Description: Keisuke meets a girl named Kyoko, who happens to be a fellow FD driver. Their first encounter is pleasant and leaves her weak in the knees. Their second encounter is a race on her turf.

Episodes.Title: Kyoko's Confession
Episodes.Description: Hoping to keep up with Takumi's growth as a racer, Keisuke's spending most of his spare time driving. He's not interested in distractions - and that could spell heartbreak for Kyoko.

Episodes.Title: The Saitama Area's Ultimate Weapon
Episodes.Description: Project D might be in trouble. The leader of the Northern Saitama Alliance has recruited a bold new driver to face Takumi. Ryosuke knows victory isn't a sure thing, and as the race begins, so does a heavy rain.

Episodes.Title: Rainy Downhill Battle
Episodes.Description: Takumi struggles to keep up with the Northern Saitama Alliance's Cappuccino. As the rain soaks the course, both teams find their confidence wavering - it seems the race could go either way.

Episodes.Title: Straightaway of Struggles
Episodes.Description: Takumi is locked in the toughest race of his career! With Ryosuke's odd advice echoing in his mind, and the Cappuccino still leading, his decision in the last straightaway will be the difference in victory or defeat.

Episodes.Title: Motivation
Episodes.Description: Keisuke and Wataru's grueling race continues in the pouring rain. Meanwhile, the Cappuccino driver picks Takumi's brain, trying to better understand his amazing abilities behind the wheel.

Episodes.Title: Sad Lonely Driver
Episodes.Description: After driving the Impreza, Takumi begins to question his abilities behind the wheel of the Eight-Six. Itsuki's got his own emotional turmoil after a date with Kasumi takes an unexpected turn.

Episodes.Title: 4WD Complex
Episodes.Description: Takumi continues wrestling with the differences in his Eight-Six and the Impreza. Later, when Keisuke falls prey to a trap set by Project D's next opponents, the upcoming race could be over before it begins.

Episodes.Title: Hillclimb of Fury
Episodes.Description: The damage to Keisuke's car might prevent him from driving in the uphill race. Just as it looks like he's out of options, Kyoko arrives on the scene in her FD.

Episodes.Title: The Saitama Area's Final Battle
Episodes.Description: The Lan EVO drivers have proven to be Project D's shadiest opponents yet. They've already shown their willingness to cheat - and now they've threatened Takumi's team with physical violence.

Episodes.Title: Last Drive
Episodes.Description: Kyoko is delighted to spend a day with Keisuke while his car's in the shop. She likes him more than ever, but with his skills growing, Keisuke's never been more focused on driving.

Episodes.Title: God Foot and God Arm
Episodes.Description: Project D's next match is against a pair of legendary racers. The veteran drivers of Purple Shadow may be a lot older than Takumi's crew, but they aren't rusty. In fact, their skills are as sharp as polished blades.

Episodes.Title: The Unmatched GT-R!
Episodes.Description: Keisuke climbs behind the wheel of his newly modified FD to take on the legendary God Foot's GT-R! The race will be tougher - and longer - than normal. Luckily, Ryosuke's got a plan.

Episodes.Title: Dogfight
Episodes.Description: The battle between the FD and GT-R continues, however the real battle has just begun. Now, Hoshino demonstrates his unique driving skills that people call the impossible earning him the name Godfoot. This makes Keisuke’s true racing abilities appear when it’s pushed beyond his limits as both drivers begin to drive recklessly forcing the battle to be settled in more than just one battle.

Episodes.Title: The Sorcerer of the Single-Handed Steer
Episodes.Description: God Arm's unexpected moves and legendary steering skills have Project D's downhill ace feeling the pressure - and it doesn't help that Takumi's mind keeps drifting back to the Impreza.

Episodes.Title: Endless Battle
Episodes.Description: Takumi's greatest strength is his greatest weakness in the match with God Arm. The race has become an endurance test, and both drivers are wearing thin. Something's got to give - and soon.

Episodes.Title: The Never-Ending Challenge
Episodes.Description: Takumi and God Arm speed toward the finish line. After the race ends, the rising star looks to the legend for a lesson in technique - and Project D looks into the future where new challengers wait for their shot.

Episodes.Title: Encounter of Destiny
Episodes.Description: Following their narrow victory against Purple Shadow, Project D's reputation is at stake after a pair of imposters parade around Saitama. Initially Takumi seems oblivious to the incident, but takes notice after he is mistakenly blamed for taking advantage of a girl. Meanwhile, the final stage of Project D's expeditions is upon them, and is to be the hardest yet.

Episodes.Title: A New Battlefield
Episodes.Description: The first stage of Project D's Kanagawa expeditions is against Team 246: Satoshi Omiya and Kobayakawa. Although racing for their own pride, 246 are actually part of a grand plan initiated by Team Sidewinder's Go Hojo and Eiji Kubo. As the uphill race begins, Kobayakawa is about to be shown the true ability of Keisuke Takahashi.

Episodes.Title: Dead Line
Episodes.Description: As the first battle winds down, the downhill between Takumi’s Eight-Six and Omiya’s NB8C Roadster begins. As both cars reach their limits, the control of the drivers will determine the outcome. Against Omiya’s miraculous car control, will Takumi be able to win? Another factor will come into play.

Episodes.Title: Revenge Battle of Fate
Episodes.Description: Kanagawa's Second Line will be against RT Katagiri, where Takumi encounters Kai Kogashiwa: a former rival from Irohazaka; graduated from street racing and now a professional racer with his MR-S. However, Takumi is starting to show a "Zone" that had evolved from the Purple Shadow races, a zone that even Ryosuke cannot explain. The winner of this race is up in the air.

Episodes.Title: Fujiwara Zone
Episodes.Description: As the battle heats up, both Takumi and Kai both use all of their ability, and then some, to battle for the win. In the next battle, Keisuke puts his new accelerator techniques to the test against Minagawa's Supra. But as Ryosuke explains, there is another purpose of this training that would allow him to beat the "super-orthodox" pro racer.

Episodes.Title: Keisuke's Determination
Episodes.Description: As it appears that the FD vs. Supra battle is giving no quarter, the question is, is it possible for Keisuke to hold off Minagawa's professional pressure? Meanwhile a new racer appears on the slopes of Hakone, and its evident he wants to kill himself, and take anybody with him!

Episodes.Title: Zero Hearts
Episodes.Description: Keisuke's next opponent in Kanagawa's Four Lines of Defense is the leader of Team Spiral, Ryuji "Zero" Ikeda. Ikeda believes in his "Zero Theory", where the driver thinks of nothing except being one with the car to create the ultimate racer. Quite similar to Ryosuke's Fastest Racer Theory, Ryosuke also notices a few flaws in Ikeda's theory. A flaw that would arise as the wet conditions create a fog battle.

Episodes.Title: White Devil
Episodes.Description: The downhill battle between Takumi and Hiroya "Zero 1" Okuyama's S15 starts, with Okuyama waiting to attack until the later section because of the fog. However, he hasn't considered the ability of Takumi's adaptibility skills. Whilst this is on, another battle is in the midst: Ryosuke's inevitable battle with the driver known as 'Shinigami', Rin Hojo.

Episodes.Title: Grim Reaper
Episodes.Description: The destined battle between Ryosuke and Rin 'Shinigami' Hojo has begun, over a girl named Kaori. As the race progresses on, the story of Ryosuke, Hojo and Kaori is revealed. And as Ikeda of Spiral Zero spectates the race from behind, it's obvious that this race of fate has quickly risen well beyond dangerous.

Episodes.Title: Full Stop
Episodes.Description: As the battle get more dangerous, several confessions come into play that create the full picture behind the feud between Ryosuke and Rin, and how Rin's actions played a huge part in Kaori's suicide. But as they approach the end of the track, Rin's tires and brakes are completely shot, turning his R32 into an unstoppable weapon.

Episodes.Title: Full Stop, Continued...
Episodes.Description: As the out-of-control FC and R32 hurtles down the mountain, only a miracle can stop these two missiles from spectacularly crashing! Meanwhile, Project D prepares for their last battle of Kanagawa against the secretive Team Sidewinder. That is, until the SpeedStars find out that Takumi’s opponent will be an Eight-Six.

Episodes.Title: Brothers
Episodes.Description: The final battles for Project D are here, and it all starts with the uphill battle between Keisuke's FD and Go Hojo's NSX. But as Rin understands, there is a fundamental difference between his younger brother and Keisuke, one that might determine this race.

Episodes.Title: Unexpected Battle
Episodes.Description: The battle between Keisuke and Go Hojo continues. Keisuke's good run behind Go Hojo led to many feeling unbelievable, including Go Hojo himself. Then entering the second round, the match gets more intense. Who will take this uphill climb battle?

Episodes.Title: Conclusion! Extreme Hill Climb
Episodes.Description: The intense hill climb battle between Keisuke and Go Hojo is coming to the end of second round. Keisuke engages in attack mode and Go Hojo starts to get tense. Meanwhile, Shinji Inui has revealed to especially Mako and Sayuki, who has been with him, that he would be the racer of the downhill battle against Takumi.

Episodes.Title: The Sorcerer Of The Single-Handed Steer
Natural
Episodes.Description: Takumi and Shinji's match thus kicks off on an instant. Shinji is given the lead. Bunta steps out of the tofu shop and breaks his key pouch after accidentally dropping it. Bunta speculates an unfortunate event that will happen. Shinji starts to show his dormant power, leaving Takumi to be shocked himself.

Episodes.Title: The Strongest Enemy
Episodes.Description: Takumi and Shinji continue with their match with Takumi, still bewildered by Shinji, starts to focus. But suddenly, Shinji allows Takumi to pass, which disturbs Takumi even more. Even Kubo is utterly disheartened by the turn of events, but both Go and Ryosuke believe this was inevitable, creating a suitable conclusion to Project D's expeditions.

Episodes.Title: Dangerous Scent
Episodes.Description: Both drivers are equally strong, towards the middle of the race. They face a battle of gaining the lead.

Episodes.Title: Dream
Episodes.Description: The intense downhill battle between the two drivers are reaching an end, as Takumi and Shinji race to their absolute limits. As this battle comes to a close, and the reign of Project D finally ends, the true meaning behind the "D" will be revealed. As the characters go on different paths, Takumi's passion to be "the fastest one out there" will never end.

Episodes.Title: The Taste of Curry
Episodes.Description: Tucked away in a corner of Hongdae, Seoul, South Korea is the curry restaurant "Cat's Restaurant" run by Yu-Mi. She doesn't have very many customers, but Yu-Mi tries to stay the course. One day, Yu-Mi's restaurant is vandalized and she notices a guy standing behind her. Yu-Mi ends up knocking him out with her groceries. When he wakes up, the guy is unable to remember his own name. Until he regains his memory, the man helps out at Yu-Mi's restaurant.

Episodes.Title: First Birthday
Episodes.Description: Jeong-Suk holds a one year birthday party for her daughter. She invites her old college friends to her apartment for the party. Tension from their past soon simmers during the birthday celebration.

Episodes.Title: Playing Games
Episodes.Description: Nearing the age of 40, Nam Gung-Sang (Kim C) is content with his bachelor life and working at his mid-level office job. He is particular about certain things and somewhat condescending towards those around him. Lee Eun-Hong (Woo Hee-Jin) works at the same comapny as Nam Gung-Sang and similar in age. After attending a funeral for a co-worker, they wake up in the same bed. Meanwhile, Nam Gung-Sang becomes interested in younger co-worker Yu Ji-A (Shin So-Yul).

Episodes.Title: You're Pretty, Oh Manbok
Episodes.Description:
Oh Man-Bok (Kim Hyang-Gi) lives with her family which includes her father (Park Chul-Min), mother (Ra Mi-Ran), older sister (Na Hae-Ryung) and older brother (Shin Dong-Woo). Her family loves her and treats her with kindness, but Oh Man-Bok still yearns to meet her birth father. After her birth parents separated, her mother passed away from cancer and her adoptive parents have taken care of her since then.

One day, Oh Man-Bok watches a music competition TV program and realizes the song that is being performed is the same song her mother sang to her. During the show, the singer mentions that 10 years ago he met a guy in Chuncheon who wrote and performed the original song. After the original singer broke up with his love, he could no longer sing the song anymore and gave the song to him. Oh Man-Bok is convinced the original singer is her father.

Episodes.Title: The Dirge Singer
Episodes.Description:
The dirge singer is paid to attend funerals and mourn for the dead. They are viewed as belonging to the lowest class. Yeon-Sim (Kim You-Jung) is brought up by her mother (Hwang Mi-Seon) to become a dirge singer like herself. Yeon-Sim refuses to follow in her mother's footsteps and cry for others. She flees to a home to become a gisaeng.

Yun-Su (Seo Jun-Young) was born out of wedlock and is only half a noble person. Because of his birth status, he can't attain the stature that his brother (Kim Dong-Yun) has. Yun-Su and Yeon-Sim meet at a delicate moment in their lives.

Episodes.Title: I'm Dying Soon
Episodes.Description: After experiencing pain near his stomach area, Choi U-Jin (Oh Jung-Se) goes to see a doctor. He learns that he has pancreatic cancer and only 3 months to live. While stunned by the news, Choi U-Jin eventually decides to live the last 3 months of his life fully. He quits his job as an office worker, closes out his savings account and books a hotel suite for the next 3 months. Meanwhile, Sa-Rang (Kim Seul-Gi) worked with Choi U-Jin at his former office job and likes him a lot. In fact, she was the only woman who liked him there.

Episodes.Title: The Reason I'm Getting Married
Episodes.Description:
Kim Ji-Won (Park Hee-Von) and Han Seung-Uk (Song Jong-Ho) have dated for about 6 years and they will get married in 3 months. Yet, their seems to be little excitement in their relationship Kim Ji-Won even asks Han Seung-Uk "Why are we getting married?"

One day, while Kim Ji-Won is getting fitted for a wedding dress, she meets Lee Jun-Gi (Hong Jong-Hyun). He had a huge crush on her in the past.

Episodes.Description: Auto-generated episode

Episodes.Title: Middle School Student A
Episodes.Description:
Lee Hae-Jun (Kwak Dong-Yeon) transfers to a new middle school in an affluent area of Seoul. At his previous school, Lee Hae-Jun was the top ranked student in his grade. While going to his first day of class at his new school, he sees a girl leaning over a bridge. Thinking she may jump, he pulls her to the ground which she does not appreciate. Later that day, Lae Hae-Jun learns the girl he saw earlier is Jo Eun-Seo (Lee Yul-Eum). She's currently the top ranked student at his new school.

3 months later, with new test scores released, Lee Hae-Jun takes the top spot and bumps Jo Eun-Seo down to #2. Meanwhile, Jo Eun-Seo vows that Lee Hae-Jun won't beat her again. She recruits her classmate Jeong Na-Yeon (Lee Han-Na) to help her retake the top spot. Lee Hae-Jun finds himself falling for Jo Eun-Seo.

Episodes.Title: That Kind of Love
Episodes.Description: Heo Jin-Uk (Bae Soo-Bin) is serving a life in prison term. After years in prison, he is informed that he is terminally ill and he will be released from prison. For the past two years, he has been visited in prison by Ji Yeon-Su (Lee Yoon-Ji). She is part of a volunteer group that tries to help reform prisoners. Without having anywhere to go, Heo Jin-Uk visits Ji Yeon-Su. Her personal life is far different than what he envisioned.

Episodes.Title: Youth
Episodes.Description: Seok-Ju (Seo Young-Joo) lives with his older brother Seok-Hyeon (Kim Heung-Soo). Seok-Hyeon was once a promising boxer, but he nows works at a market selling fish. Seok-Ju feels nothing but hopelessness with his situation. He sees an out when his older brother's former friend Jong-Beom (Um Tae-Goo) offers him a job to work with his gang. His older brother warns him to stay away from Jong-Beom.

Episodes.Title: Illegal Parking
Episodes.Description: Noh Jung-Do (On Joo-Wan) is an office worker at a law firm. He buys a new car, to impress Lee Ji-Hyun (Jang Joon-Yoo). He carpools with her to work everyday. Anxiety soon sets in for Noh Jung-Do when a taxi company CEO (Kim Sang-Ho) parks in his spot everyday.

Episodes.Title: The Dreamer
Episodes.Description: Joo Joon-Kil (Yang Jin-Woo) dreams about the deaths of others before it even happens. He drives out to see a client (Yoon Se-Ah) and meets the woman from his last dream. He can't help falling in love with her even though he keeps seeing her death in his dream.

Episodes.Title: Pitch-black Darkness
Episodes.Description: Park Hyun-Tae (Danny Ahn) drives his bus through a tunnel like every other night, but this evening high school student Jung Woo-Min (Kang Chan) is standing outside of the tunnel. Park Hyun-Tae is unable to avoid the student and he is killed. When he goes back to work, he has to drive through the same tunnel every evening. Meanwhile, he overhears high school students mention Han Jung-Wook's (Kwak Jung-Wook) bullying as a reason for Jung Woo-Min committing suicide.

Episodes.Title: Bomi's Room
Episodes.Description: Kong Bo-Mi (Ahn Seo-Hyun) ia miserable that she has to share a room with her older sister Kong Eun-Joo (Lee Young-Ah). Even though her mom (Park Hae-Mi) promised to renovate the storage room into a bedroom for Kong Bo-Mi, she realizes she will be stuck with her older sister forever. Kong Bo-Mi then gets the idea that if she can get her older sister married, the bedroom will be all hers.

Episodes.Title: The End of that Summer
Episodes.Description: Han Soo-Kyung (Cho Eun-Sook) receives a phone call that her husband (Lee Kwang-Ki) was involved in a car accident and is now in coma.While filing insurance papers, Han Soo-Kyung learns that her husband registered a young boy Kim Cho-Rok (Jeon Jin-Seo) on their family register. Han Soo-Kyung goes through her husband's phone and contacts a woman from his recent caller list. They make plans to meet at a cafe in Chuncheon. There, Han Soo-Kyung meets the woman and young Kim Cho-Rok.

Episodes.Title: The Three Female Runaways
Episodes.Description: Su-Ji, Kim Yeo-Jin and Hyung-Ja all converge at the park, while they are all being chased by men who want to take them back. They decide to escape together.
