Episodes.Description: A poor 26-year-old rider has great dreams, but reality is harsh. He ends up with special powers strong enough to kill someone and punishes the bad. A story about the birth of a young dark hero.

Episodes.Title: Prism
Episodes.Description: A beautiful and lonely story of growth about high school students who dreamed of being ballet dancers at a young age, finding the meaning of life through each other, suffering and badly hurting each other.

Episodes.Title: Nineteen Otters
Episodes.Description: The story of the precarious and affectionate first love of a 19-year-old who carries around a letter of resignation.

Episodes.Title: Let's Meet in an Unfamiliar Season
Episodes.Description: A drama that tells the story of COVID-19-confirmed patients in 2020 who enter a residential treatment center, communicating through windows and comforting each other during unfamiliar and fearful quarantine times.

Episodes.Title: Underwear Season
Episodes.Description: A story about a young man who doesn't believe in sincerity meets Don Quixote, the president of an underwear company, and his right-hand man, Sancho, and becomes sincere both in underwear and in life.

Episodes.Title: Do You Know Ashtanga?
Episodes.Description: A yoga instructor with a twisted mind meets a sugar daddy in this bumpy human romantic comedy.

Episodes.Title: Silence of the Lambs
Episodes.Description: A drama about the conflict between Captain Choi Hyeong Won, who has to silence a case to seize the last chance of promotion.

Episodes.Title: Devil in the Lake
Episodes.Description: A horror movie that takes place against the background of a reservoir where people are dying.

Episodes.Title: The Distributors
Episodes.Description: Yoo-bin, a man who dreams of a happy married life, is led by his old friend, Sang-bum, and spends an unforgettable day at the club. And then, the memories from before that night disappeared, and a phone call was received from someone. The criminal said that if he didn't get 33 million won, he would release the video to the world... Tonight, everything he wanted to hide is unlocked.

Episodes.Title: No Path Back
Episodes.Description: A story about a salesman in beverage distribution who makes the wrong decision to better his life.

Episodes.Title: Half Lies
Episodes.Description: The story of 10-year-old Du-ri, who lied to hide her parents' divorce, and the growth of people around her trying to protect Du-ri.

Episodes.Title: Shoot For Love
Episodes.Description: Do-hyun was a promising youth soccer player in the national team but retired due to injury. Growing up in an orphanage, she leaves the facility, turning 20. While bending over backward to stand on her own, Do-hyun meets an amateur female futsal team and becomes a proper adult. Now, Do-hyun wants to confess her feelings to her first love, Moo-won.

Episodes.Title: Anyone Anywhere
Episodes.Description: Eun-ho goes to school early in the morning as usual and senses something is odd. To school where it should still be silent, the police and ambulance have come. While things are hectic, a lonely little hand drops lethargically from the stretcher. The estimated time of death was 11:13 p.m. last night. It was 45 minutes before the victim's birthday, and on that day, we were there.

Episodes.Title: Dog Days of Summer
Episodes.Description: Puberty causes emotional turmoil and secondary sex characteristics to appear. During this stage, teenagers go through their own pain, which leads some to fully transform while some don't. In this process of becoming another version of themselves, puberty hits like a midsummer heatwave that burns the teenagers swept in chaos. This is a story about teenagers who accept the changes puberty causes and grow one step at a time.

Episodes.Title: The True Love of Madam
Episodes.Description: Seol-ae is known for her humble life style as the wife of Jung-yeol, the man of integrity. However, her beauty and elegance can't be unnoticed. Also, as she grew up as the dotted youngest daughter, she still has a child in her. After Jung-yeol was dismissed, they moved to a small town, but as Jung-yeol stops being intimate with her, Seol-ae spends a lonely and agonizing nights. Meanwhile, after seeing a servant boy taking a bath at the valley, half-naked, Seol-ae opens up to a new possibility.

Episodes.Title: Behind the Shadows
Episodes.Description: It features a gay storyline set in the Joseon Dynasty and explores the complexities of love, friendship, and social conventions. Yoon Ho, Jae Woon, and Seol were childhood friends who hung out together before their coming-of-age ceremony. However, their friendship intertwines through love, as one day, Yoon Ho realizes that his heart is pounding for someone, leading him to develop his first love that he can't tell anyone about. The youthful romance set in Joseon begins.

Episodes.Title: Love Attack
Episodes.Description: A campus drama about what happens when Cha Seok-jin, second-rank in the school, attacks with confession to blur the concentration of Kang Kyeong-joo, an ace.

Episodes.Title: Overlap Knife, Knife
Episodes.Description: A story about two people trying to protect their loved ones by turning back time and confronting fate.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Auto-generated episode

Episodes.Title: The History of Us
Episodes.Description: The story of a young officer who tries to stop the crown prince from erasing history in order to become king.

Episodes.Title: Find Handsome!
Episodes.Description: A story about Cutie, an unknown idol who dreams of making a comeback, and his journey to find Handsome, a missing former member of the disbanded group.

Episodes.Title: The Two Women
Episodes.Description: A story of a husband battle that unfolds in a village near the 38th parallel a year before the outbreak of the Korean War.

Episodes.Title: The Road in Between
Episodes.Description: The story of Seo Hu, a member of the Road View filming team who went through a painful breakup, and Eun Ha, who searches for her father who was caught on Road View, stumbles her way through the path of separation and entering the alley of love.

Episodes.Title: To My Lonely Sister
Episodes.Description: Unfolds as Ha Neul, a high school girl with a reclusive, lonely older sister, begins a plan to help her sister escape from her room. With the theme of love and recovery between families, it depicts the process in which the Ha Neul overcomes her family's pain together.

Entries.Title: SPY×FAMILY
Entries.Description: A short animated collaboration promoting Spy x Family Movie: Code: White and the video game Street Fighter 6.

Episodes.Title: Street Fighter 6 x Spy x Family Movie: Code: White (Movie)
Episodes.Description: A short animated collaboration promoting Spy x Family Movie: Code: White and the video game Street Fighter 6.

Episodes.Title: Ayataka Spy x Family Movie Campaign Ayataka de Hotto Hitoiki (Movie)
Episodes.Description: A commercial between Spy x Family Movie: Code: White and Ayataka featuring the Forger family having a picnic under the cherry blossoms while drinking Ayataka tea.

Episodes.Title: Spy x Family Movie: Code: White Manner Movie (Movie)
Episodes.Description: Wit Studio and Cloverworks released a new short film using Spy x Family to remind the general public of basic movie theater etiquette. You’ll be able to watch it from all Toho cinemas in Japan. All members of the immediate Forger family are present. It focuses on Loid and Yor teaching Anya how to behave when in a movie theater.

Episodes.Title: OPERATION STRIX
Episodes.Description: Twilight is an agent that works for WISE, Westalis's intelligence agency, and he is tasked with investigating Desmond, who is in Ostania and planning to start a war. Twilight disguises himself as the psychiatrist Loid Forger and adopts a girl named Anya so that he can enroll her into the prestigious Eden College to get closer to his target. Unbeknownst to him, Anya is actually a telepath who can read people's minds. One day, members of a mafia group that is after Twilight kidnaps Anya. Loid realizes that he needs to reconsider his priorities and...

Episodes.Title: SECURE A WIFE
Episodes.Description: Civil servant Yor Briar has a secret identity: an assassin named the Thorn Princess. Lately, single women had been suspected of being spies, which was making Yor nervous. Meanwhile, Loid was searching for someone to play Anya's mother so they could attend the interview at Eden College. He just happens to run into Yor at a boutique. Anya reads Yor's mind and finds out that she's an assassin and tries to get Loid to ask Yor to play her mother.

Episodes.Title: PREPARE FOR THE INTERVIEW
Episodes.Description: Yor moves in with Loid and Anya. Now that they are a family, they need to prepare for the interview. But Loid realizes with how Anya and Yor currently are, the interview probably won't go well. In order to make sure they all understand how an upper-class family should be, Loid decides that they should all go out as a family. They go to the theatre and a museum, but it's just not clicking with Anya and Yor. Twilight begins to lose hope, but...

Episodes.Title: THE PRESTIGIOUS SCHOOL'S INTERVIEW
Episodes.Description: The day they had been preparing for has finally arrived! The Forgers are fully prepared and head to the interview. As soon as they enter the school grounds, Loid feels someone watching them. All of the applicants were being observed from the shadows by the instructors of the academy. The exam had already begun. Housemaster Henderson, who would be grading their performance, kept a keen eye on how the Forgers were acting and seeing if they were truly worthy of the prestigious Eden College.

Episodes.Title: WILL THEY PASS OR FAIL?
Episodes.Description: The day that Eden College would announce the applicants that successfully got into the school had finally arrived, but Anya's number is not listed. The Forgers fall into the depths of despair but are greeted by Henderson. He praises them for their interview and tells them that Anya is at the top of the waiting list. Three days later, they find out that Anya got into the school! Franky comes over to celebrate with the Forgers and they all agree to reward Anya for working so hard. What Anya asks for...

Episodes.Title: THE FRIENDSHIP SCHEME
Episodes.Description: Anya's uniform is finished. Loid has to go to a WISE strategy meeting, so he has Yor pick up the uniform as he heads to the safehouse. At the meeting, he finds out that Anya will have to receive 8 Stellar Stars and become an Imperial Scholar at Eden College in order for him to successfully complete Operation Strix. Meanwhile, Anya is very excited about getting her new uniform. But there are always criminals on the lookout for wealthy students from Eden College and Anya gets targeted by a group of hoodlums.

Episodes.Title: THE TARGET'S SECOND SON
Episodes.Description: Anya ends up with a Tonitrus Bolt after she hit Damian Desmond. Sadly, this causes her to stand out for the wrong reasons in class which depresses her, but she ends up friends with Becky, and school becomes a little more fun. She also tries to apologize to Damian for hitting him, but just can't seem to get the words out. For the sake of Operation Strix, Loid disguises himself as someone who works at the school and tries to help Anya reconcile from the shadows, but...

Episodes.Title: THE COUNTER-SECRET POLICE COVER OPERATION
Episodes.Description: Ostania's counterintelligence agency and national security bureau conducts spy hunts and keeps surveillance on its citizens to maintain peace within the country. They are also called the Secret Police and are feared. Yor's younger brother Yuri actually belongs to the Secret Police and is hunting down spies while keeping this a secret from Yor and others around him. One day, he suddenly shows up at the Forger residence. The Forgers, who are full of secrets, and Yuri, who has a secret identity, come face to face!

Episodes.Title: SHOW OFF HOW IN LOVE YOU ARE
Episodes.Description: In order to prove to Yuri that they are actually a married couple, Loid and Yor are supposed to kiss. Loid is willing to get this done immediately for the sake of Operation Strix, but Yor can't do this sober, so she ends up downing a bunch of wine and gets drunk. Yuri sees his sister this way, also gets drunk, and is unable to make rational decisions anymore...

Episodes.Title: THE GREAT DODGEBALL PLAN
Episodes.Description: A rumor spreads amongst the first graders at Eden College saying that if they do well in their next PE class, they will get rewarded with Stella Stars. Anya is determined to get a Stella Star, so she trains with Yor. Thus begins the dodgeball match between Cecile Hall and Wald Hall! Anya and her classmates are determined to win, but they are faced with the giant, Bill Watkins.

Episodes.Title: STELLA
Episodes.Description: In order for parents to attend one of the social gatherings at Eden College, their children need to be Imperial Scholars, but Anya hating to study makes this rather difficult. Loid then comes up with a plan to get Anya to get Stella Stars by doing community service rather than with her academics. But when she ends up volunteering at a hospital, she continuously messes up. Later, she hears a child drowning in a pool with her telepathy and...

Episodes.Title: PENGUIN PARK
Episodes.Description: Loid is burdened with one mission after another from WISE and comes home exhausted. He then hears neighbors gossiping that he's neglecting his family. Because he can't let anyone doubt them as a family for the sake of Operation Strix, he decides to take his family to the aquarium the next day they have off to show everyone that they get along. However, he is assigned another mission from WISE while he's there, and...

Episodes.Title: PROJECT APPLE
Episodes.Description: The Forgers go look for a dog for Anya's reward for getting a Stella. In the middle of their outing, Loid ends up having to work a mission to stop a terrorist bombing attack planned against Westalis's foreign minister. Meanwhile, Anya is trying to pick out a dog, but then sees a vision of her family when she randomly reads the mind of a giant, mysterious, white dog. Anya becomes curious and chases after the dog, but she ends up accidentally wandering into the hideout of the terrorists!

Episodes.Title: DISARM THE TIME BOMB
Episodes.Description: Anya meets a mysterious dog who can see into the future. They were able to escape from the terrorists with the dog's help, but eventually, they fall back into the hands of the terrorists again. And then Yor shows up and attacks the enemy! Soon after, the dog sees into the future again. The vision Anya saw through the dog's mind was Loid unconscious and buried under the remains of a building that had been bombed. In order to stop this future from happening, Anya and the dog head to the place where the incident happens!

Episodes.Title: A NEW FAMILY MEMBER
Episodes.Description: Loid faces off with one of the enemy's bomb dogs, Anya secretly saves Loid, and Yor finds the leader of the terrorists who had been on the run. The whole family ends up involved in this terrorist bombing incident, but what will be its conclusion?! Also, they were supposed to go get a dog for Anya as a reward for her getting a Stella, but now, she says she wants to keep the mysterious, giant dog that she encounters in this incident. Loid knows the truth about this dog as well as the other dogs involved in the bombing incident and tells her no, but then Anya says she'll quit going to school if she can't have the dog and...

Episodes.Title: YOR'S KITCHEN / THE INFORMANT'S GREAT ROMANCE PLAN
Episodes.Description: Why has Yor been coming home late every night, her hands covered in cuts? Why has Franky asked Loid to meet him under mysterious and urgent circumstances? These are two tales of misadventure while seeking happiness in Berlint.

Episodes.Title: CARRY OUT THE GRIFFIN PLAN / FULLMETAL LADY / OMELET RICE♥
Episodes.Description: Anya and the rest of her class have an arts and crafts lesson where Anya is put in the same group as Damian. Sylvia goes about an ordinary work day. We learn the secret source of Yuri's strength.

Episodes.Title: UNCLE THE PRIVATE TUTOR / DAYBREAK
Episodes.Description:
Next week is Eden College's midterms. That week happens to include the new moon, the one day of the month Anya can't use her powers to cheat. But then, Yor suggests that Yuri should be her tutor...

The midterms are over. Loid is nervous about Anya's test scores and heads to Eden College to alter the answers. However, there already seems to be another guy there with the same motive that's making himself insanely suspicious and obvious?!

Episodes.Title: A REVENGE PLOT AGAINST DESMOND / MAMA BECOMES THE WIND
Episodes.Description:
Damian does well on his midterms, so he earns a Stella. Everyone around him is now praising him, but for some reason, his classmate George seems to be looking at him begrudgingly. The reason being...

After seeing Anya off to school, Yor finds Anya's gym clothes on top of her desk. At this rate, Anya will surely have trouble in her gym class. Yor runs to deliver the forgotten clothes!

Episodes.Title: INVESTIGATE THE GENERAL HOSPITAL / DECIPHER THE PERPLEXING CODE
Episodes.Description:
Anya has to write a report about an occupation she's interested in, so she ends up going to Loid's place of work, Berlint General Hospital. As soon as Loid was out of sight, Anya starts to explore!

Anya becomes very interested in deciphering codes after seeing it done in her spy cartoon, so she makes her own code and sends Loid and the others secret messages. Will they be able to crack the codes?!

Episodes.Title: NIGHTFALL / FIRST FIT OF JEALOUSY
Episodes.Description:
Fiona, who works at Loid's hospital, happens to actually be the female WISE agent Nightfall. She is irritated that Operation Strix is facing delays, so she suggests that she becomes Mrs. Forger instead. She also decides to show up at the Forger household unannounced and comes face to face with Yor!

Anya loves the penguin plushie that Loid got for her, and even sleeps with it. However, a pale shadow shoots jealous glares in the penguin's general direction...

Episodes.Title: THE UNDERGROUND TENNIS TOURNAMENT: THE CAMPBELLDON
Episodes.Description: The secret files called the Zacharis Dossier may cause a war between the East and the West. In order to obtain a painting that is supposed to be the hiding spot for these files, Loid and Fiona enter an underground tennis tournament run by the owner of the painting, Campbell. If they win, the art piece they're after will be presented. Loid and Fiona enter as a married couple and play various skilled players including pro players!

Episodes.Title: THE UNWAVERING PATH
Episodes.Description: The underground tennis tournament is finally heading to the final match. The Campbell siblings that Loid and Fiona are up against are playing dirty, as they have altered tennis rackets as well as the staff helping them out. But the spy pair from WISE overcome one obstacle after another and Loid deals the final blow! But right after the match, the State Security Service finds out about the dossier and infiltrates the tournament...

Episodes.Title: THE ROLE OF A MOTHER AND WIFE / SHOPPING WITH FRIENDS
Episodes.Description:
Yor becomes anxious about their pretend marriage after Fiona shows up. Loid notices this and thinks that Yor had started to develop romantic feelings towards him. For the sake of the mission, he flips on his Twilight mode.

Becky takes Anya to the department store so they can buy Anya some cute clothes. She uses her rich girl powers and rents out a whole shop where they start their own little fashion show.

Episodes.Title: FIRST CONTACT
Episodes.Description: A social gathering happens at Eden College once every half term. It is a strictly guarded event where only Imperial Scholars and their parents, the VIPs of Ostania, are allowed to go. Damian tells his brother that he'd like to see their father when he attends the event. Loid finds out about that and uses Damian to get close to his target.

Episodes.Title: FOLLOW MAMA AND PAPA
Episodes.Description: Yor is shot in the butt while on a mission and looks miserable when she gets home. Loid mistakes her very apparent miserable mood as her being unhappy with their marriage of convenience and offers to take her out on a date.

Episodes.Title: BOND'S STRATEGY TO STAY ALIVE / DAMIAN'S FIELD RESEARCH TRIP
Episodes.Description: Bond sees an ominous future and believes that it's Yor's food that's going to cause it. In order to change this fate, Bond leaves the house to search for Loid! Henderson orders Damian, Emil, and Ewen to go on a field research trip with Mr. Green.

Episodes.Title: MISSION AND FAMILY / THE ELEGANT BONDMAN / THE HEART OF A CHILD / WAKING UP
Episodes.Description: Yuri is doing great at his job with the Secret Police. His assignment today is to investigate a former newspaper reporter suspected of selling articles slandering Ostania to Westalis. Anya's favorite cartoon hero Bondman shows off his elegant spy moves!!

Episodes.Title: THE PASTRY OF KNOWLEDGE / THE INFORMANT'S GREAT ROMANCE PLAN II
Episodes.Description: Eden's legendary dessert finally appears! In order to obtain the macaroons that supposedly can make you into an Imperial Scholar if eaten, Anya and her friends race to get to them first.

Episodes.Title: PLAN TO CROSS THE BORDER
Episodes.Description: On a mission as Thorn Princess and using her job as city hall as a cover, Yor is tasked with protecting the only survivors of the Gretcher family, Olka and her son, and helping them escape to a different country by traveling on a cruise ship.

Episodes.Title: THE FEARSOME LUXURY CRUISE SHIP
Episodes.Description: After boarding the cruise ship, Yor began her duty as bodyguard to Olka and her son. Meanwhile, Yor's superior, Matthew, finds an assassin who is after Olka and her son.

Episodes.Title: WHO IS THIS MISSION FOR?
Episodes.Description: Loid tries to pick out souvenirs that will make him look like a fun and happy dad so he can cheer Anya up. Meanwhile, Yor was facing off with Sickle-and-Chain Barnaby.

Episodes.Title: THE SYMPHONY UPON THE SHIP
Episodes.Description: The deck is filled with passengers enjoying the fireworks show. Anya and Loid were also enjoying the fireworks. Meanwhile, Yor's mission finally reaches its climax. She tries to help Olka and the others escape, but they are surrounded by assassins!

Episodes.Title: THE HAND THAT CONNECTS TO THE FUTURE
Episodes.Description: Due to the movements the State Security Service members were making, Loid finds out that there was a bomb on the ship. Loid leaves Anya at the daycare in a hurry then disguises himself as a State Security Service member to take care of the bomb.

Episodes.Title: ENJOY THE RESORT TO THE FULLEST / BRAGGING ABOUT VACATION
Episodes.Description: The morning after the attack from the assassins and the bomb scare, the cruise ship arrives at the resort island. Loid and Anya meet up with Yor and the three enjoy a family vacation!

Episodes.Title: BERLINT IN LOVE / NIGHTFALL'S DAILY LIFE
Episodes.Description: Becky is very excited about a romantic drama on TV, so she heads over to the Forgers' place to see Loid, who she fell in love with instantly after seeing his picture. Becky aggressively pursues Loid.

Episodes.Title: PART OF THE FAMILY
Episodes.Description: As Bond is on a walk with Loid, he has a premonition of an accident, so he tries to stop it, but is scolded by Loid. He then sees a vision of a building going up in flames and a sobbing girl standing in front of it.

Episodes.Title: The Curse of the Pharoah (Poot-Ta-Foot's Curse)
Bad Dreams are Made of This
GoGoFive: Sudden Shock! A New Warrior
The Five Stars of Heaven and Earth

Entries.Title: Angel's Last Mission: Love
Entries.Description: Yeon Seo receives an invitation letter to the 20th anniversary party of Fantasia Cultural Foundation. On her way to take a walk, she hears Seung Hwan talking to the doctor on the phone. She asks the doctor if she can receive the cornea donation. Dan accidentally encounters Yeon Seo and observes her.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Fails to Receive the Cornea Donation
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo receives an invitation letter to the 20th anniversary party of Fantasia Cultural Foundation. On her way to take a walk, she hears Seung Hwan talking to the doctor on the phone. She asks the doctor if she can receive the cornea donation. Dan accidentally encounters Yeon Seo and observes her.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Goes to the Party
Episodes.Description: Dan goes to Yeon Seo’s place to find his handkerchief. Yeon Seo decides to go to the Fantasia’s party. At the party, Yeon Seo realizes that everyone is looking at her with pity. On the way back home, Yeon Seo and Seung Hwan get in a car accident, and Dan witnesses it.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Receives Cornea Donation
Episodes.Description: Dan saves Yeon Seo, but this insubordinate act angers his deity. Dan is in danger of being dissipated, but he gets one last chance. Meanwhile, Seung Hwan dies because of the car accident, and Yeon Seo gets to receive his cornea transplant since Seung Hwan had arranged it with Yeon Seo in advance.

Episodes.Title: Dan Becomes Yeon Seo's Secretary
Episodes.Description: Kang Woo joins the Fantasia Ballet Company as an artistic director, and he criticizes Ni Na harshly. Kang Woo announces to the ballet company that he will appoint Yeon Seo as the lead ballerina. Dan gets hired as Yeon Seo’s secretary and has a hard time working under ill-natured Yeon Seo.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Gets to See Dan's Wings
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo sees Dan’s wings, but she thinks that Dan is just a pervert. Kang Woo comes into Yeon Seo’s house, and Dan thinks Kang Woo is the culprit. Kang Woo meets Ni Na on his way home, and they have dinner together. During the meal, Ni Na goes to the restroom, and Kang Woo notices that she went to the restroom to throw up her dinner.

Episodes.Title: Kang Woo's Suggestion
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo and Dan go to the columbarium together, and it suddenly rains again. Kang Woo suggests that Yeon Seo should dance again, but she refuses. Yeon Seo gets to know that Kang Woo was the one who saved her on the day of the accident. Ni Na’s family goes to Yeon Seo’s house to celebrate her recovery, but Yeon Seo gets furious.

Episodes.Title: Dan Gets Arrested for Housebreaking
Episodes.Description: Dan gets arrested because Yeon Seo reports him for housebreaking. The video of Yeon Seo that Ni Na posted on her SNS becomes the talk of the town. Kang Woo announces to the Fantasia’s board of directors that Yeon Seo will hold the press conference to announce her comeback.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Practices to Walk on Her Own
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo encounters Dan at the place where they met for the first time, and she asks him to help her to walk on her own. Yeon Seo misunderstands that Dan is in love with her. Meanwhile, Dan tries to help Yeon Seo and Kang Woo spend time together. Yeon Seo successfully walks into the place of the press conference on her own, and Yeong Ja surprises.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Starts to Prepare for Her Comeback
Episodes.Description: After Dan kisses Yeon Seo, it suddenly rains. So Dan leaves Yeon Seo alone and runs away. Yeon Seo promises Kang Woo she will get back in shape within a week. Ni Na confesses her feelings to Kang Woo, but he rejects her. Meanwhile, Dan tells Yeon Seo to forget about what happened between two.

Episodes.Title: Hu Tells Dan a Story of the Angel Who Loved Human
Episodes.Description: Kang Woo asks Dan if he likes Yeon Seo as a woman. Dan asks Hu if it’s possible for an angel to love someone other than the deity. And Hu tells Dan a story about the angel who loved human 15 years ago. Meanwhile, Yeon Seo keeps practicing even though she hurts her foot, and Dan tries to stop her. At that moment, Yeon Seo asks Dan if he ever liked her.

Episodes.Title: The Day of the Fantasia's Night
Episodes.Description: Kang Woo tells Yeon Seo to go to the Fantasia’s Night to show the sponsors that she is the prima ballerina. Dan obtains a driver’s license to serve as Yeon Seo’s secretary, but his driving skill is poor. Yeon Seo attends the event, and Dan keeps an eye on her to prevent anything bad happens to her.

Episodes.Title: The Sponsors Oppose Yeon Seo's Comeback to Fantasia
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo makes a disturbance during the Fantasia’s Night. Because of her behavior, the sponsors oppose Yeon Seo’s return to Fantasia. Dan thinks that this is a setup. Meanwhile, Yeong Ja tells Yeon Seo to hand over the entire foundation to her. Dan tells Yeon Seo to give up on everything because he doesn’t want her to be in trouble.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Apologizes to the Sponsors
Episodes.Description: Dan tells Kang Woo that he can’t disappear yet. Yeong Ja gathers the sponsors for a meeting. Yeon Seo attends the meeting and apologizes to the sponsors. Meanwhile, Kang Woo tells the members of the ballet theatre that they will be fired if they don’t show up for tomorrow’s practice.

Episodes.Title: Kang Woo Gets to Know Dan's Identity
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo helps the corps to do volunteer work at the sanatorium. She tries to show her sincerity to them, so she tries her best. She suggests Kang Woo that he should hold an audition for "Giselle". Ni Na goes to Elena to ask her for help. Meanwhile, Kang Woo gets to know that Dan is an angel.

Episodes.Title: Dan Quits His Job
Episodes.Description: Dan quits his job as a secretary and leaves Yeon Seo’s house. Hu notices that Kang Woo is not an ordinary human. Yeong Ja tells Kang Woo that he should step down as a panel of the audition, and Kang Woo accepts her suggestion under the condition that the dancers will judge each other at the audition.

Episodes.Title: Dan's Old Memory Came Back
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo is having a hard time because she keeps thinking about Dan. She can’t even focus on the ballet practice, and Kang Woo worries about her. She gets drunk and goes to the place where she met Dan for the first time. Meanwhile, Dan tries to find the place that he keeps seeing in his dream, and he gets his old memory back.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo & Seong Woo's Old Memories
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo has a dream about her childhood friend named Seong Woo, and she goes to the island where she met him for the first time. She asks the villagers if they remember the boy, and she gets to know that the boy died a long time ago. Meanwhile, Yeon Seo and Dan get to meet each other on the island.

Episodes.Title: Dan's Promise to Yeon Seo
Episodes.Description: Dan promises Yeon Seo that he will come back to her soon. Kang Woo tells Yeon Seo that she can lean on him, but Yeon Seo tells Kang Woo not to cross the line again. Meanwhile, Yeong Ja and Ru Na are trying to win over the dancers to their side. Dan is suspicious of Kang Woo and he trespasses on Kang Woo’s house.

Episodes.Title: The Day Before the Audition
Episodes.Description: Hu gets to know that Kang Woo is the angel who loved a human. Yeon Seo asks Dan what is the story that he is hiding from her. Kang Woo gets to hear that Ru Na and Yeong Ja bought votes from the corps. Meanwhile, Yeon Seo keeps practicing her dance with Dan the day before her audition.

Episodes.Title: The Result of the Audition
Episodes.Description: Dan thinks that there must be a way for an angel to become a human. Ni Na and Yeon Seo both do a great job on the audition. After the audition, Kang Woo tells Yeon Seo that he will wait for her at the restaurant to say something. Meanwhile, Dan tries to talk about his identity to Yeon Seo, and it starts to rain at that moment.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo's Distorted Memory
Episodes.Description: After what happened to Yeon Seo at the rooftop of the ballet theatre, she can’t remember what happened to her that day. Kang Woo is suspicious of Yeong Ja and Ru Na for the kidnapping, but they deny it. Meanwhile, Dan worries about Yeon Seo, so he tells Yu Mi to strengthen the security of the Ivy Mansion.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Search for Dan's Secret
Episodes.Description: Yeong Ja gets to know that Ru Na schemed to kill Yeon Seo. Ni Na tells Kang Woo that she will be Yeon Seo’s understudy. Yeon Seo thinks Dan is hiding something from her, so she sneaks into his room. Meanwhile, Dan gets to know that Kang Woo was the angel who fell in love with a human.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Regains Her Memory
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo remembers everything, including the fact that she was kidnapped. Yeon Seo asks Dan if he really is an angel, and he admits to it. Meanwhile, Yeong Ja tells Ru Na that she shouldn’t plot anything without telling her first. Yu Mi and Yeon Seo notice that Gwang Il’s phone has been bugged.

Episodes.Title: Gwang Il's Statement
Episodes.Description: Dan asks Kang Woo how he could become a human, and Kang Woo tells Dan that Yeon Seo needs to die in order for him to become a human. Yeon Seo receives Gwang Il’s statement that confesses his wrongdoings by the instigation of Yeong Ja. Meanwhile, Kang Woo tells Yeon Seo that Dan will dissipate like dust because of her love.

Episodes.Title: Ki Chun's Confession
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo holds an emergency board meeting and tells the supporters that Yeong Ja, Ru Na, and Ki Chun will leave Fantasia. Ru Na begs for Yeon Seo’s mercy, but Yeon Seo tells her that she has no intention of forgiving them. Meanwhile, Dan wants to hear the answer from the deity, but the deity doesn’t respond.

Episodes.Title: Does Dan Finally Become a Human?
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo and Dan go on a picnic to the park where they first met. Yeon Seo wants to marry Dan because she thinks it is the only way for them to be together. Meanwhile, Dan falls down and gets hurt in the park, but his wound doesn’t heal itself as usual. They think this is a symptom of becoming a human and they wait for a rainy day to check if it’s real.

Episodes.Title: Dan's Proposal to Yeon Seo
Episodes.Description: Dan decides to disobey the deity’s will, and he proposes to Yeon Seo. Elena suggests Ni Na that she should hurt Yeon Seo in order to be Giselle. Hu warns Dan and Yeon Seo for the last time, but they won’t listen to him. Meanwhile, Dan goes to see Ru Na and gives her a warning not to hurt Yeon Seo once again.

Episodes.Title: Dan's & Yeon Seo's Wedding Day
Episodes.Description: Kang Woo tells Yeon Seo that it will be meaningless to Dan if she doesn’t exist in this world, and she notices that she should die in order to save Dan. Ni Na announces to her family that she will live by herself from now on, and Ru Na gets furious. Meanwhile, Dan and Yeon Seo’s wedding day comes, and they make a vow of their eternal love.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Refuses to Perform
Episodes.Description: Ki Joon Soo tries to kill Dan, and Hu saves Dan at that time. Yeon Seo tells Kang Woo that she won’t perform on stage because there is no time left for Dan and Yeon Seo. Dan gets to hear that conversation and tells her that she needs to dance for his sake. Meanwhile, Dan and Yeon Seo get to find Hu’s report at the church and they realize Hu’s innermost feelings.

Episodes.Title: Ru Na’s Other Plot
Episodes.Description: Ru Na tries to hang herself in prison, so she is taken to the hospital. On the day of Fantasia’s show, Yeon Seo decides to show the most beautiful Giselle in the world to impress the deity. Meanwhile, Ru Na escapes from the hospital and sneaks into the theater. Ni Na tries to stop her, but Ru Na doesn’t care about her.

Episodes.Title: Dan's Disappearance
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo loses consciousness after her performance. Yeong Ja and Ki Chun go to the police station to see Ru Na, but Ru Na only concerns about whether Ni Na plays Giselle or not even in this situation. Dan wants to be by Yeon Seo's side, but there is no more time left for Dan. Meanwhile, Yeong Ja and Ki Chun come to Yeon Seo’s hospital to apologize to her.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo's Life without Dan
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo comes back to home with Dan, and they spend time together happily. However, Yeon Seo realizes that it is her dream. Dan tells Yeon Seo to live happily without him and bids farewell to her. After her dream, Yeon Seo finally wakes up from a coma. After Dan’s disappearance, Yeon Seo tries to live bravely, but she keeps seeing a hallucination of Dan.

Entries.Title: Brain Works
Entries.Description: Dr. Shin Ha-ru is fired after illegally acquiring a criminal’s brain. He volunteers to help Detective Geum Myeong-se's bureau — and to make him pay.

Episodes.Title: Cooperation As Yet Unheard Of
Episodes.Description: Dr. Shin Ha-ru is fired after illegally acquiring a criminal’s brain. He volunteers to help Detective Geum Myeong-se's bureau — and to make him pay.

Episodes.Title: The Most Brilliant Moment
Episodes.Description: Ha-ru and Myeong-se's first case involves a famous guitarist and his wife, who turned herself in for his murder. But Ha-ru turns the case on its head.

Episodes.Title: I Don't Know My Wife's Face
Episodes.Description: A Vietnamese woman is found dead with her face and hands burnt. Her husband suffers prosopagnosia; her best friend has disappeared. Both are suspects.

Episodes.Title: Things That Are Visible When You Close Your Eyes
Episodes.Description: New evidence and test results drastically change the face of the case. A killer approaches Ha-ru, saying he wants to donate his brain to neuroscience.

Episodes.Title: The Girl With The Wicked Spirit
Episodes.Description: A 6-year-old with aphasia gets turned in by her mother. She believes a demon has possessed her daughter to kill — and her husband has paid the price.

Episodes.Title: How To Be Saved Forever
Episodes.Description: Ha-ru exposes the truth before the child’s exorcism can take place. And a tablet reveals some dirt on the detective, much to the doctor's delight.

Episodes.Title: A Man Cheating With His Wife
Episodes.Description: Ha-ru’s attempt to sully Myeong-se embarrassingly backfires. A man reports his wife missing to the police, claiming a "virtual human" attacked her.

Episodes.Title: Love, The Basic Instinct
Episodes.Description: After a husband's confession, his wife shows symptoms of conversion disorder. Who killed who? Ha-ru gives up his revenge and leaves the department.

Episodes.Title: Reset Man
Episodes.Description: A suspect whose memory resets every 30 minutes claims he has killed his mother. Ha-ru returns, intrigued by a patient with anterograde amnesia.

Episodes.Title: Though Memories Fade, feat. How to Forget Bad Memories
Episodes.Description: The stepbrother becomes a prime suspect as the siblings’ harrowing tale comes to light. On his date with So-jeong, Myeong-se gets a call about a body.

Episodes.Title: A Brain on Trial
Episodes.Description: The perpetrator who left a mysterious note at the murder scene demands a reduced sentence. Unaware of Dong-u’s plan, Ha-ru appears as a witness.

Episodes.Title: The Effects Love and Breakups Have on the Brain
Episodes.Description: Ha-ru's statement in court stirs up the media. When he unravels the cause of Kim Mo-ran’s hypersexuality, Myeong-se and So-jeong get tangled up in it.

Episodes.Title: A Teenage Brain Versus A Psychopath Brain
Episodes.Description: A bleeding boy is found unconscious in I-na's bedroom. All of her friends claim she's the one responsible, and unfortunately, the evidence agrees.

Episodes.Title: The Best Revenge
Episodes.Description: Ha-ru helps prove I-na's innocence. As he and Myeong-se's family bond, Ha-ru finally discovers Myeong-se’s flaw, leading to his untimely resignation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Ha-ru learns that his parents weren't killed in a car accident but murdered. To find their killer, Ha-ru must accept a psychopath's dangerous offer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Myeong-se and Ha-ru must play the sympathy game, or else. The hostages will be released if their brain waves sync. Can two heads work better than one?

Episodes.Description: Crown Prince Lee Chang investigates the King's mysterious illness while a strange plague begins turning people into monsters.

Episodes.Description: The prince flees the capital with his guard as the zombie plague spreads through the palace and surrounding villages.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Chang and his group discover the plague's connection to a rare plant while fighting infected villagers.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The group takes refuge in a military camp as the undead horde grows, revealing new behaviors of the infected.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6

Episodes.Title: Episode 2

Episodes.Title: Episode 3

Episodes.Title: Episode 4

Episodes.Title: Episode 5

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
