Entries.Title: Prison School
Entries.Description:
Hachimitsu Private Academy's five male students have been released from their oppressive prison captors, allowing them to return to their ideal school lives surrounded by short-skirted girls.

With their freedom restored, things could not be going better for the gang. Kiyoshi Fujino and Shingo Wakamoto have formed close bonds with their female classmates; Reiji Andou is the center of attention due to his masochistic quirks; and even Takehito "Gakuto" Morokuzu—notorious for defecating himself during class—befriends the klutzy yet like-minded Mitsuko Yokoyama.

However, in contrast to his fellow ex-convicts, Jouji "Joe" Nezu struggles to readjust to student life, and the unlikely romantic success of his friend Gakuto pushes him to his wit's end. Feeling ostracized, he begins to wonder if life was better behind bars.

Episodes.Title: Mad Wax (Special)
Episodes.Description:
Hachimitsu Private Academy's five male students have been released from their oppressive prison captors, allowing them to return to their ideal school lives surrounded by short-skirted girls.

With their freedom restored, things could not be going better for the gang. Kiyoshi Fujino and Shingo Wakamoto have formed close bonds with their female classmates; Reiji Andou is the center of attention due to his masochistic quirks; and even Takehito "Gakuto" Morokuzu—notorious for defecating himself during class—befriends the klutzy yet like-minded Mitsuko Yokoyama.

However, in contrast to his fellow ex-convicts, Jouji "Joe" Nezu struggles to readjust to student life, and the unlikely romantic success of his friend Gakuto pushes him to his wit's end. Feeling ostracized, he begins to wonder if life was better behind bars.

Episodes.Title: The Peep Job
Episodes.Description: Five boys newly enrolled in a formerly all-girls school, already having difficulty connecting with the girl students, run afoul of the school’s "Underground Student Council" and face strict disciplinary measures.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Viewed Too Much
Episodes.Description: Hana is embarrassed when Kiyoshi sees her in a compromising position. Kiyoshi becomes desperate to keep his date with Chiyo, and searches for a way to get out of prison in time to meet her. Gakuto has plans of his own.

Episodes.Title: A Mighty Spurt
Episodes.Description: With Meiko’s attention divided between two groups, Kiyoshi is able to widen the escape hole enough to let him through in time for his date. An already-suspicious Shingo gets an eyeful of more than he bargained for.

Episodes.Title: Take Me Out to the Sumoland
Episodes.Description: After committing a heinous offense against Mari, Gakuto receives a drastic punishment from Meiko. Kiyoshi and Gakuto work desperately to break Kiyoshi out of the prison by having him impersonate a girl.

Episodes.Title: The School’s Number One Most Treacherous Man
Episodes.Description: Kiyoshi returns from his breakout, but must face the music with Gakuto and the others when the truth comes to light. Chiyo reconsiders her reaction to Kiyoshi, and decides to give him a second chance.

Episodes.Title: Vengeance is Hana’s
Episodes.Description: Mari introduces the DTO plan to Hana, and they begin plotting ways to drive the boys out of school. Shingo leads the others boys in shunning Kiyoshi, but Meiko has plans to drive an even deeper wedge between them.

Episodes.Title: Meiko’s Delicious Restaurant
Episodes.Description: Shingo, on furlough from the prison, meets a girl named Anzu at the arcade in town. When Gakuto turns to his Guan Yu figurine for guidance, the tip of his sword falls off, starting a chain of events with momentous consequences.

Episodes.Title: The Diary of Andre
Episodes.Description: Andre suffers a mental collapse when he goes for a week without receiving any discipline. Shingo takes Anzu to the movies, but finds his expectations betrayed. The Underground Student Council moves forward with their DTO project.

Episodes.Title: Full of Bodily Fluids
Episodes.Description: Shingo realizes that he saw emails regarding DTO on the computer in the corrections office, which if recovered by the boys, would prove that they were set up. The boys plot to break into the corrections office.

Episodes.Title: It’s a Bum-derful Life
Episodes.Description: The boys are resigned to their upcoming expulsions, and spirits are low, until Gakuto, suffering a bout of temporary insanity, devises one last strategy to get them out of their predicament, if they can just buy enough time to pull it off.

Episodes.Title: Eryngii Brockovich
Episodes.Description: Given a one-day reprieve, the boys must again execute a plan to get inside the corrections office, but the Underground Student Council won’t make it easy for them. Hana has a personal score that she wishes to settle with Kiyoshi.

Episodes.Title: Good Morning, Prison!
Episodes.Description: Hana continues pressing Kiyoshi in order to exact her revenge, but Kiyoshi employs an adaptation of a classical military strategy to counter her. Once all the boys are locked into their cells for the night, will they be able to complete their plan?

Entries.Title: Doctor Prisoner
Entries.Description: Dr. Na Yi Je is a kind person with excellent skills. He works at the emergency medical station of Taegang Hospital. He always goes by the rules, and it makes him a bane for his seniors. Lee Jae Hwan, the second son of Taegang Group, causes a traffic accident by reckless driving.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Closed His Eyes
Episodes.Description: Dr. Na Yi Je is a kind person with excellent skills. He works at the emergency medical station of Taegang Hospital. He always goes by the rules, and it makes him a bane for his seniors. Lee Jae Hwan, the second son of Taegang Group, causes a traffic accident by reckless driving.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: A Traffic accident is caused by Jae Hwan, and many emergency patients are transferred to Taegang Hospital. Yi Je goes into surgery of a pregnant woman. However, Jae Hwan makes a scene, and it leads to the death of the patient. Yi Je is accused of malpractice and loses his position.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: A car crash occurs, and Jae Hwan is secretly moved to a hospital with a serious injury. Min Sik comes to know that Yi Je is the only person who can save Jae Hwan, but he still disapproves the surgery. Meanwhile, Yi Je threatens Jae Hwan saying that he only has a few more minutes to live since he did the least job to keep him alive from the injury.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Yi Je performs the surgery on Jae Hwan. Min Sik tries to stop him, but Jae Jun appears and tells him that he approved the surgery. Yi Je asks Jae Jun to let him be the successor of Min Sik. Two weeks later, Yi Je gets appointed as the next medical director of the penitentiary.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Min Sik visits the prison to see Sang Chun. Min Sik forces Sang Chun to tell the truth, but he refuses. Min Sik poses a threat to Sang Chun, and Sang Chun gets into an urgent situation. Meanwhile, So Geum thinks Min Sik is suspicious, and she calls Yi Je for help.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Min Sik and Yi Je talk about negotiation for mutual cooperation, but Min Sik gets Yi Ra’s urgent call. Min Sik chooses to go to see Yi Ra, and he makes a deal with her. After seeing her, Min Sik encounters Jae Jun. Jae Jun notices that Min Sik is on Yi Ra’s side, and he plans to dig his back.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Getting betrayed by Yi Ra, Min Sik is being driven into a corner getting his family in a risk. Yi Je tells So Geum that he knows about Bit. Yi Ra and Jae In find out that Yi Je is after Min Sik. Yi Je asks Sang Chun about the list, and Min Sik searches the penitentiary.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Yi Je suggests Min Sik to retire without making problems. But Min Sik is certain that the document is not a real one and provokes Yi Je. Hyun Sang tells Min Sik where the list was sent by Sang Chun. Yi Ra calls Yi Je and tells him to bring Jae Hwan. Min Sik finds out that Yi Je is after him because of the false diagnosis three years ago.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Yi Je falls into Min Sik’s trap and faces danger. To get away from the situation, Yi Je makes a suggestion to Sang Chun. Meanwhile, Min Sik is watching them through the camera. So Geum visits Yi Je and asks him about Han Bit. Meanwhile, Seok Woo is being transferred to Western Seoul Penitentiary.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Yi Je promises Seok Woo to get a suspension of execution of detention. Sang Chun sends an email to Yi Je, and Yi Je sends the file related to So Geum. Jae Jun and So Geum meet to have a psychological consultation. Meanwhile, Jae In visits Jae Hwan, and she gets to know that Yi Je is trying to make Seok Woo have a suspension of execution of detention.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Seok Woo goes to Taekang Hospital to examine his disease. So Geum gets shocked that an arrogant psychopath Seok Woo’s body was deteriorated in a short time. Eui Sik visits Jung Hee to find out the link between Jung Hee and Yi Je. Meanwhile, Min Sik is confident that Yi Je’s plan will be failed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: So Geum thinks Yi Je is using her to make Seok Woo have a suspension of execution of detention. So Geum goes to Yi Je and asks him the reason he helps Seok Woo. Min Jung hears that So Geum is helping to let Seok Woo go. Meanwhile, Seok Woo thinks that he couldn’t get a stay of execution because of So Geum.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Yi Je tells So Geum that they shouldn’t cooperate anymore. Yi Ra says to Chairman Kim that the reason Seok Woo’s detention couldn’t get suspended is Min Sik. Meanwhile, Min Sik meets Jae Jun to persuade him to discard Yi Je. Yi Je and Sang Chun go to see Jung Hee and ask her to be on the same boat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Eui Sik takes away Yi Je and Jung Hee to his office, and he asks Yi Je the reason he visited Jung Hee. Jae In comes to Eui Sik’s office to defend Yi Je, but Eui Sik says that he has a witness to testimony Yi Je’s guilt. Meanwhile, Yi Je tries to track down Min Sik’s illegal transfer of medicine.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Min Sik gets investigated on suspicion of breaking the Pharmacy Law. So Geum goes to Yi Je and tells him she wants to join hands with him again. Yi Je gets appointed as the new medical director of Western Seoul Penitentiary, and Min Sik asks Jin Chul to stall Yi Je.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Yi Je goes to the Special Sector to see people who are on the VIP list. Jin Chul stalls Yi Je, and Yi Je takes a measure to make Jin Chul stay out of it. Eui Sik goes to Jung Hee to find out some information regarding Yi Je. Meanwhile, So Geum watches the video files that Yi Je gave to her and finds out the secret of Han Bit.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: While So Geum is watching the Bit’s video, Jae Jun visits her. So Geum tells Yi Je that she will dig into Jae Jun. Min Sik tells Eui Sik about what Yi Je did to his patients to practice to fabricate Jung Hee's Fanconi anemia. Meanwhile, someone steals So Geum's laptop which has Jae Jun's patient records.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: An Jin Chul tells Yi Je that he will be on Yi Je’s side, and help him to destroy Min Sik. Eui Sik finally decides to join hands with Yi Je. They go to Haeun Hospital to look through their medical records and find out fake patients in the hospital. The family members of Min Sik are all arrested by the prosecution.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Yi Je asks Min Sik to hand over Haeun Hospital to Yi Je as a way to get out of prison, and Min Sik agrees with him. So Geum gets a call from Bit and finally gets to see him. Meanwhile, Yi Ra and Jae Jun also chase after Bit, but Bit disappears again. So Geum goes to Yi Ra and asks her about Yi Ra and Bit’s relationship.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Min Sik and Min Je get to meet each other on the way to the Western Seoul Penitentiary. Min Je suddenly suffers from the pain, and Min Sik injects medicine into him, but Min Je falls into an emergency situation due to the injection. Meanwhile, Jae Jun tracks Yi Je’s moving path the day when Bit appeared.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Congressman Jung dies all of a sudden. Yi Je gets a call from Yi Hyun saying that there are weird guys outside the house. After hearing Yi Je’s conversation with Yi Hyun, So Geum goes to Yi Hyun’s house to find Bit. Meanwhile, Jae Jun becomes Min Je’s chief mourner.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Min Sik calls Yi Je and leaves a message that he heard Congressman Jung’s last word. Jae In tries to catch Nam Pyo, but she fails to find him. Jung Hee and So Geum trace Nam Pyo’s whereabouts. Yi Je takes Nam Pyo to the Penitentiary to make him confess.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Jae Jun suggests to Eui Sik to cover up his case, and in return, offers to make him a district attorney. Jae Jun wants Yi Je to give him Congressman Jung’s belongings to him. But Yi Je only agrees to do it under one condition. Meanwhile, So Geum tries to figure out Jae Jun’s psychological state.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Chairman Lee Deok Seong’s stocks are donated to Congressman Jung, and Han Bit gets to manage the stocks. Yi Je suggests to Yi Ra to recommend Min Sik as a candidate for the head of the VIP center. Yi Je and Yi Ra layout a plan to make Min Sik the head of the VIP center.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Hye Soo and Young Chul have a drink after work, and Hye Soo asks Young Chul to tell about his past. Young Chul gets arrested for Congressman Jung’s murder. Meanwhile, Yi Je tries to destroy Min Seok to make Min Sik the head of the VIP center.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Min Seok’s condition gets worse and has no choice but to get surgery from Yi Je. Chairman Lee dies, and Jae Hwan begs Yi Je to get him a stay of execution no matter what it takes. Yi Je plans how to get Jae Hwan a stay of execution. Meanwhile, Do Hoon comes to the penitentiary on Young Chul’s behalf.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Young Chul tells Hye Soo that he will never tell anyone who abetted the murder of Congressman Jung even if he knows. Yi Je tries to get Jae Hwan’s stay of execution, and Do Hoon tries to stop him. Jung Hee and Eui Sik spend time together at the amusement park.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: So Geum goes to find Young Chul’s ex-wife. Eui Sik gets in trouble that might get him demoted to the Suncheon Prosecutor’s Office. Min Sik and Jae Jun make a deal with the Congressman Jung’s file. So Geum tries to find out what other illness Chairman Lee had.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Jae In gives Yi Je the medical records of Deok Seong and Jae Jun. Eui Sik tries to find out the truth between Congressman Jung and Young Chul. He also investigates the relationship between Taekang and Jung Hee’s ex-husband. Yi Je and Min Sik plan a scheme to trick Jae Jun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: Eui Sik asks Jung Hee to serve her term of imprisonment and wait out for a few months. Yi Je and Min Sik make a plan to catch Jae Jun, but they get cheated by Jae Jun. Jae Hwan falls into a coma, and Yi Ra gets furious at Yi Je because she thinks Yi Je could predict this coming.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Eui Sik goes to Taekang Group to arrest Jae Jun without a warrant. Yi Je injects a drug to Jae Jun, and Jae Jun stabs Yi Je with a knife. Jae Jun gets arrested for the attempted murder of Yi Je. So Geum tries to make Young Chul confess that he murdered Congressman Jung because of Jae Jun’s order.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: Min Sik gets An Jin Chul’s help and releases the tabloid about Jae Jun being investigated for charges of attempted murder and for abetting a felony. Jae Jun’s habeas corpus gets acknowledged, and he gets released. At the regular board meeting, Yi Je gives the board members evidence of Jae Jun’s attempted murder.

Entries.Title: Vagabond
Entries.Description: Shinmen Takezo lie down on the battlefield as the battle of Sekigahara has just ended, calling himself a failure as other men pass by.

Episodes.Title: Shinmen Takezo
Episodes.Description: Shinmen Takezo lie down on the battlefield as the battle of Sekigahara has just ended, calling himself a failure as other men pass by.

Episodes.Title: The Cover-Up Begins
Episodes.Description: Dal-geon reveals his suspicions to bereaved families and begs Hae-ri for help, but she hides critical evidence about the crash.

Episodes.Title: Ambushed
Episodes.Description: Hae-ri doubts the flight-recording evidence. Dal-geon is attacked after discovering the crash was orchestrated.

Episodes.Title: The Journalist
Episodes.Description: A mysterious caller contacts Dal-geon. A journalist approaches him claiming to investigate the crash.

Episodes.Title: Silenced
Episodes.Description: Dal-geon tries to expose the truth to the media, but saboteurs intervene. Hae-ri confronts Gi Tae-ung about a flash drive.

Episodes.Title: Safe House
Episodes.Description: The NIS hides Dal-geon in a secure location. Tae-ung interrogates Oh Sang-mi about her husband's role in the crash.

Episodes.Title: Ghosts
Episodes.Description: Dal-geon spots a man presumed dead in the crash. Hae-ri and Tae-ung return to Morocco to capture a suspect.

Episodes.Title: Rogue Investigation
Episodes.Description: Dal-geon faces obstacles in his solo search. Tae-ung fumes over a failed mission in Morocco.

Episodes.Title: Target: Kim Woo-gi
Episodes.Description: Dal-geon and NIS agents protect co-pilot Kim Woo-gi. Jessica Lee frames an innocent party for the crash.

Episodes.Title: Escape Route
Episodes.Description: Dal-geon flees the embassy with Hae-ri. Min Jae-sik confronts NIS Director Kang Joo-chul over corruption.

Episodes.Title: Unmasking the Shadow
Episodes.Description: Dal-geon infiltrates a weapons lobby. Hae-ri discovers a traitor within the NIS.

Episodes.Title: Blue House Infiltration
Episodes.Description: Evidence implicates South Korea's Prime Minister. Dal-geon confronts Edward Park at a weapons exhibition.

Episodes.Title: The President's Order
Episodes.Description: The President authorizes Dal-geon's arrest. Jessica Lee activates sleeper agents to eliminate witnesses.

Episodes.Title: Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Hae-ri is framed for treason. Dal-geon races to recover a key witness held by North Korean defectors.

Episodes.Title: Countdown
Episodes.Description: Dal-geon exposes arms lobbyists live on television. The conspirators activate a bomb plot to silence him.

Episodes.Title: Cliffhanger
Episodes.Description: Dal-geon and Hae-ri corner the masterminds in Portugal, but a shocking twist leaves their fates unresolved.

Entries.Title: Witch at Court
Entries.Description: Ma Yi-Deum joins the sex crimes unit and clashes with principled colleague Yeo Jin-Wook during their first case involving a serial rapist.

Episodes.Title: The Witch Rises
Episodes.Description: Ma Yi-Deum joins the sex crimes unit and clashes with principled colleague Yeo Jin-Wook during their first case involving a serial rapist.

Episodes.Title: Fabricated Truth
Episodes.Description: Yi-Deum's ruthless tactics backfire as she fabricates evidence. The team investigates a hospital assault case with political connections.

Episodes.Title: Past Shadows
Episodes.Description: A celebrity sexual assault case reveals ties to Mayor Jo Gap-soo. Yi-Deum confronts trauma from her mother's disappearance.

Episodes.Title: Web of Power
Episodes.Description: The team uncovers a human trafficking ring protected by high-ranking officials. Jin-Wook's psychiatric skills prove critical.

Episodes.Title: Beneath the Mask
Episodes.Description: Yi-Deum goes undercover at a charity gala to expose a predator. Flashbacks reveal Mayor Jo's history of sexual torture.

Episodes.Title: Daughter's Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: A victim's suicide forces Yi-Deum to reconsider her methods. The team discovers evidence linking Jo to 20-year-old crimes.

Episodes.Title: Betrayal of Trust
Episodes.Description: A prosecutor within their unit is accused of assault. Yi-Deum and Jin-Wook race to prevent evidence tampering by Jo's network.

Episodes.Title: Witness Hunt
Episodes.Description: The team protects a key witness against Jo's forces. Yi-Deum's childhood friend emerges with crucial information about her mother.

Episodes.Title: Unholy Alliance
Episodes.Description: Jo manipulates the media to discredit the task force. Yi-Deum forms a risky partnership with a corrupt lawyer to infiltrate his circle.

Episodes.Title: Judgment Day
Episodes.Description: Yi-Deum takes the stand in a high-stakes trial against Jo's protégé. Secret documents surface exposing systemic cover-ups.

Episodes.Title: Echoes of Torture
Episodes.Description: A survivor from Min Ji-sook's past case provides new testimony. Yi-Deum discovers her mother was Jo's original accuser.

Episodes.Title: Sacrificial Pawn
Episodes.Description: Jo frames Jin-Wook for evidence tampering. The team must clear his name while preventing the destruction of critical documents.

Episodes.Title: Burn the Witch
Episodes.Description: Public backlash threatens the unit's dissolution. Yi-Deum confronts Jo in a televised debate revealing his psychological profile.

Episodes.Title: Graveyard Secrets
Episodes.Description: The team excavates a burial site containing evidence of Jo's past crimes. A key witness disappears under mysterious circumstances.

Episodes.Title: Final Gambit
Episodes.Description: Yi-Deum risks disbarment by leaking classified documents. Jin-Wook discovers medical proof linking Jo to the torture victims.

Episodes.Title: The Court of Redemption
Episodes.Description: In the climactic trial, Yi-Deum faces Jo's empire of corruption. The team presents a decade-spanning case to deliver justice for all victims.

Entries.Title: Agila ng Maynila
Entries.Description: The beginning of the urban hero's journey as he takes on the criminal underworld of Manila.

Episodes.Title: Disc 1
Episodes.Description: The beginning of the urban hero's journey as he takes on the criminal underworld of Manila.

Entries.Title: School 2017
Entries.Description: Introduction to Seoran High students and teachers, as mysterious notes from 'Student X' begin appearing, challenging the school's hierarchy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Introduction to Seoran High students and teachers, as mysterious notes from 'Student X' begin appearing, challenging the school's hierarchy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16 (Final)
Episodes.Description: The dramatic conclusion reveals Student X's identity as the students face their futures and say goodbye to Seoran High.

Entries.Title: Serial Experiments Lain
Entries.Description: Lain Iwakura, a shy, 13-year-old schoolgirl, receives an email from a schoolmate after her suicide. Is it a prank? Lain doesn't feel horror, but curiosity.

Episodes.Title: Layer:01 – WEIRD
Episodes.Description: Lain Iwakura, a shy, 13-year-old schoolgirl, receives an email from a schoolmate after her suicide. Is it a prank? Lain doesn't feel horror, but curiosity.

Episodes.Title: Layer:02 – GIRLS
Episodes.Description: Classmates Alice, Julie, and Reika wonder if that was Lain they saw at the nightclub Cyberia. To find out, they invite Lain to go with them to the club.

Episodes.Title: Layer:03 – PSYCHE
Episodes.Description: Alice, Julie, and Reika are minor celebrities in their class after they witness a shooting at The Cyberia. Lain is given a black-market chip for her computer, but it seems she is also being followed.

Episodes.Title: Layer:04 – RELIGION
Episodes.Description: Some players of a Wired game called PHANTOMa are dying suspicious deaths. Lain investigates, but her growing interest in the Wired worries her father, as well as classmates Mika and Alice.

Episodes.Title: Layer:05 – DISTORTION
Episodes.Description: Lain receives cryptic messages about existence, God, and a coming prophecy. Meanwhile, Mika's world changes in ways both surreal and hyperreal.

Episodes.Title: Layer:06 – KIDS
Episodes.Description: Young children are acting strangely, arms outstretched and silently staring at the sky. A shocking vision suddenly appears in the skies; it looks like Lain! Determined to get to the bottom of this, Lain's investigations finally bring her to the creator of KIDS -- but what she discovers is not what she hoped for.

Episodes.Title: Layer:07 – SOCIETY
Episodes.Description: As the Knights activities make the evening news, a strange man named Nazumi wanders the city with machines strapped to his body. People on the WIRED are asking: ""Who is Lain"". Meanwhile, the two MIB agents take Lain to the Techibana offices where Lain's identity is challenged by a man; how well does she know her parents, her sister, herself? Can Lain answer him?

Episodes.Title: Layer:08 – RUMORS
Episodes.Description: Still shaken by the information she received from the Men In Black, Lain discovers that she is being blamed for spreading an ugly rumor in the WIRED. Is what the MIB said is true; is she another person in the WIRED? Or is she doing it herself? Lain must find out or risk losing the one true friend she has.

Episodes.Title: Layer:09 – PROTOCOL
Episodes.Description: A documentary about Roswell gives Lain some valuable information about the pioneers of the WIRED. Later, at the Cyberia, J.J. tells Lain that she left something the day before and hands her an envelop with the Knight's logo on it. The envelop contains a chip. Believing this was the other 'Lain's' doing again, she decides to call Taro's bluff and go on a 'date'. Taking him to her room, Lain demands that he tell her what he knows. Together, with Taro's information and the mysterious chip, Lain finds out more then she expected.

Episodes.Title: Layer:10 – LOVE
Episodes.Description: Lain struggles with her identity. Is she a human being, or just a hologram? And are the Knights responsible for the Evil Lain? Lain decides to deal with the Knights once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Layer:11 – INFORNOGRAPHY
Episodes.Description: Alone and frightened, Lain immerses herself in the WIRED, processing the events of the past few weeks and searching for the truth of who she is.

Episodes.Title: Layer:12 – LANDSCAPE
Episodes.Description: Troubled by what she saw, Alice decides to visit Lain at home and find out what is going on. Meanwhile, the two MIB agents receive a terrible shock and Eiri reveals his real motive for removing the barrier between the real world and the WIRED.

Episodes.Title: Layer:13 – EGO
Episodes.Description: The world is crumbling, people are dying and Alice's sanity is threatened. To save humanity, there is only one thing Lain can do; she must make the ultimate personal sacrifice.

Entries.Title: Unpredictable Family
Entries.Description: Jung Ae is living a perfect life with a successful husband and son, and all her friends are jealous of her. However, Jung Ae still wants to find her ex-husband, whom she has been out of touch with for 30 years. Meanwhile, Eun Sung picks up a photo of her father on the street.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 1
Episodes.Description: Jung Ae is living a perfect life with a successful husband and son, and all her friends are jealous of her. However, Jung Ae still wants to find her ex-husband, whom she has been out of touch with for 30 years. Meanwhile, Eun Sung picks up a photo of her father on the street.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 2
Episodes.Description: Jung Ae secretly asks her friend for help to find Dong Gu, and her children, Eun Hyuk and Eun A. Eun Sung finally gets a chance to perform on stage for the first time after joining the theater. While Eun Sung practices the role at the park, Sun Woo happens to see her acting.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 3
Episodes.Description: Following an unexpected response to her soft-spoken words from an invisible presence, Eun Sung hurriedly leaves the park. Meanwhile, Ha Young sets her sights on Sun Woo as a potential boyfriend. As fate would have it, they cross paths, and her scarf accidentally drops in Sun Woo's path. She regards this as an ideal, coincidental moment to initiate their relationship and excitedly anticipates his gesture of picking it up.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 4
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung crashes into Sun Woo dressed in a cat costume, and a mob of people start taking pictures of her because of her outfit. Sun Woo, who sees her hesitating about what to do, covers her up with his jacket. However, she runs away without saying a word. Later, Sun Woo reports her to the police, hoping to get back his jacket with his wallet and phone.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 5
Episodes.Description: After causing a huge scene at the theater, Eun Sung quits. However, she regrets it immediately as she is unemployed now. Meanwhile, Ha Young visits a crime scene for her next movie, and Eun Hyuk heads to the same place after getting a report.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 6
Episodes.Description: Sun Woo and Eun Sung run into each other at the police station. Even though Sun Woo is looking for the cat lady, he cannot recognize her when she's right in front of him. Meanwhile, Eun Sung is worried she might end up in prison as Si Heon is not willing to withdraw the complaint.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 7
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung talks to Si Heon to persuade him to withdraw his complaint. However, with Ju Ri by his side, Eun Sung has zero chance of getting out of this trouble. Ha Young finally meets Sun Woo in person at the office and already makes an unpleasant first impression.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 8
Episodes.Description: With Sun Woo's help, Sun Ju posts the truth behind Si Heon on the Internet for Eun Sung. As expected, Si Heon cannot handle the criticism and resentment toward him. Therefore, he calls Eun Sung first to meet up and talk it out. Meanwhile, Dal Yong is about to get a divorce from his wife, and his family is worried about him.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 9
Episodes.Description: Sun Woo recognizes Eun Sung right away with her phone case. Sun Woo and Eun Sung leave the theater together to find Sun Woo's jacket, which Eun Sung lost. However, they run into another problem, and Sun Woo makes a deal. Meanwhile, Ha Young is disappointed with Sun Woo as he did not show up for the movie.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 10
Episodes.Description: After finally getting in touch with Sun Woo, Eun Sung's only objective is to return his items. Unfortunately, things are not going smoothly for her. She plans to meet Sun Woo before Eun Hyuk learns more about the girl in the cat costume. Meanwhile, Ki Seok learns that Jung Ae is looking for Dong Gu without keeping him in the loop.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 11
Episodes.Description: Sun Woo meets up with Eun Sung to get back his jacket but sees her with a male mannequin and gets the wrong idea about her job. Meanwhile, Ha Young becomes furious at Dal Yong after she learns about another divorce he had, and Jung Ae happens to walk by Yoo Dong Gu on the street.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 12
Episodes.Description: On her way to a bakery to meet with Jung Sook to talk to her about her frustration over Ki Seok, Jung Ae walks right past Dong Gu. Meanwhile, Eun Sung stresses over not getting anywhere in her acting career, and Ha Young tries to blame Eun Hyuk for breaking the heel of her shoes.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 13
Episodes.Description: Sun Woo and Eun Sung both end up at the movies, watching a film together, though not exactly side by side. They hit it off over a little chat about the movie, bonding over shared interests, until Sun Woo unintentionally touches a nerve for Eun Sung. Meanwhile, Ha Young is laser-focused on getting closer to Sun Woo.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 14
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung might appreciate a bit of consolation as she anxiously awaits the audition results, feeling disappointed with her performance. Meanwhile, Sun Ju unintentionally overhears her mother and aunt, sparking curiosity about the mysterious guy in their conversation.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 15
Episodes.Description: Following a less-than-impressive audition, Eun Sung can't shake off thoughts about the stranger who offered encouragement in the park. Yet, upon revisiting the park, Eun Sung discovers her rescuer is nowhere to be found. Meanwhile, Ha Young's dedicated efforts to foster a deeper connection with Sun Woo go all wrong.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 16
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung coincidentally bumps into Sun Woo while applying for an audition at Cheong Film, and Chun Young learns from Dong Gu that Eun Sung failed her audition and heads over to the theater to see her. Meanwhile, an embarrassing video of Dal Yong exposes what a terrible dancer he is.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 17
Episodes.Description: Chun Young unleashes her wrath on Eun Sung after learning she got fired from the theater. Eun Sung tells Sun Ju about what happened, and Sun Ju takes it into her own hands to punish Si Heon for what he did. Meanwhile, Dal Yong gets caught sneaking into the house by Ha Young.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 18
Episodes.Description: Managing to fix Ha Young's shoes, Eun Hyuk returns them to her. While Eun Hyuk imbues each moment related to the shoes with meaning, Ha Young remains uninterested. Meanwhile, Sun Woo uncovers Eun Sung's falsehood about why she was present at the location of their encounter. At the dumpling place, Dong Gu reminisces about days gone by.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 19
Episodes.Description: Crossing his fingers that it wasn't too late to figure out who he collided with, Dong Gu promptly searches for Jung Ae. However, in the inevitable way desperate situations unfold, he comes up empty-handed. Meanwhile, Eun Sung's sole focus is on her audition at Cheong Film. Determined to make it happen, she whisks Sun Ju away, seeking a favor.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 20
Episodes.Description: Towed by Eun Sung, Sun Ju finds herself on the brink of a close encounter with Sun Woo at Cheong Film. Unaware of Sun Ju's odd demeanor, Eun Sung proceeds with her ritual involving a good luck charm. Meanwhile, Chun Young and Yoo Dong Gu face suspenseful moments as Eun Hyuk eagerly agrees to check security footage and identify the person who took the stolen dumplings.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 21
Episodes.Description: It's Eun Sung's big audition day, and she prepares to do her best. However, she runs into a little problem right before the audition. Meanwhile, Sun Ju struggles all on her own to show Eun Sung the extra support Eun Sung needs for the audition.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 22
Episodes.Description: The whole family consoles Eun Sung after they learn together that she didn't get picked for the role. Meanwhile, Dal Yong hears shocking news from his friend while he waits for the woman he met on a blind date to call. Later, Eun Sung sees a job posting from Cheong Film and contemplates applying. However, Jung Sook also wants to give it a shot.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 23
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung gets hired as an admin assistant at Cheong Film after a job interview with Ha Young, not knowing she will be working with Sun Woo. Dong Gu is against the idea of Eun Sung joining Cheong Film as an assistant, but she decides to swallow her pride and take the opportunity.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 24
Episodes.Description: The weight of stress on Eun Sung becomes evident as she struggles to catch her breath upon discovering that Sun Woo is the director at Cheong Film. Sun Woo, in turn, feels a sense of disappointment as he observes her altered behavior toward him in light of this revelation. Eun Sung is eager for the awkwardness to subside and takes the initiative to propose a solution.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 25
Episodes.Description: While Sun Woo engages in self-encouragement at the park, Eun Sung catches him off guard with an unexpected interruption. Struggling with embarrassment over his spontaneous monologue, Sun Woo hastily provides flimsy excuses. Despite his efforts, Eun Sung perceives his desperation and silently extends a heartfelt wish for good luck. Meanwhile, Ha Young considers approaching Eun Hyuk for crime-related consultations.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 26
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung happens to find out that Sun Woo is in a difficult situation as she reads a legal document on his desk. Furthermore, Ha Young gives a simple task to Eun Sung, but she ends up losing all the important files of Cheong Film. Meanwhile, Both Ki Seok and Jung Ae get a tip that Dong Gu is in the country.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 27
Episodes.Description: The moment Jung Ae hears the news about Dong Gu, she wants to start searching for Eun Hyuk and Eun A as soon as possible. However, Jung Sook is the only one who is not happy with the news. Meanwhile, Eun Sung runs around everywhere to restore all the files she lost, and Sun Woo is worried about her.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 28
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung is supposed to meet a video creator to restore all the lost files, but Sun Woo feels that there is something fishy about this guy. Meanwhile, Eun Hyuk obtains video footage of the dumpling thief, and Jung Sook is hiding something about Dong Gu from Jung Ae and Ki Seok.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 29
Episodes.Description: The CCTV footage reveals Dong Gu's determined pursuit of a woman, intriguing Eun Hyuk. Eun A's visit to the station with snacks prompts Eun Hyuk to share the story, sparking her curiosity. At the same time, Sun Ju surprises Jung Ae while she goes through baby clothes purchased for Eun A and Eun Hyuk thirty years ago. The intense verbal sparring between Chun Young and Jin Sil continues.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 30
Episodes.Description: After learning Eun Hyuk is the police officer who was supposed to be her movie advisor, Ha Young frets that he won't help her. Ki Seok shows Jung Ae the photo that Dong Gu's acquaintance had sent him, and Jung Sook, who now knows Dong Gu is in Korea, becomes anxious Jung Ae will find him.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 31
Episodes.Description: After seeing Eun Sung and Sun Woo talking on the rooftop, Ha Young asks them if they knew each other from before. Jung Ae visits the police station in hopes her children may have registered their DNA samples in case they were looking for her. Meanwhile, Eun Hyuk asks Dong Gu about the woman he chased after in some footage he was looking through.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 32
Episodes.Description: Ha Young becomes distressed over the Cat that keeps in contact with Sun Woo and starts to investigate who the Cat could be. Min Guk and Ga Ram hold a special event for Eun A. Meanwhile, Eun Hyuk drinks with Dal Yong, who feels deeply betrayed by his friend.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 33
Episodes.Description: Sun Woo hands over the cat heart to Eun Sung, but she gets upset as it reminds her of a bad memory. Therefore, Sun Woo feels awful for messing up her day. Meanwhile, Ha Young gets infuriated as she figures out who Cat was all along. She starts to interrogate Eun Sung and Sun Woo.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 34
Episodes.Description: After talking with Ha Young, Sun Woo is confused about his feelings towards Eun Sung. At the same time, Eun Hyuk happens to see Ha Young and Sun Woo together and gets a wrong idea about their relationship. Meanwhile, Ki Seok suggests Jung Ae take a cooking class at Royal Hotel, and Dong Gu finds out that his sworn enemy, who scammed him with his money, is staying at Royal Hotel.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 35
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung becomes upset at Sun Woo for mistakenly thinking something else about her job profession and storms off, leaving him behind. Jung Sook is shocked when she hears the news of Dong Gu's death from the private detective agency. Meanwhile, the whole family urges Chun Young to use the cooking class tickets they couldn't sell from the things they got from Mr. Park's items.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 36
Episodes.Description: Jung Ae and Chun Young see each other in the cooking class and are completely shocked. Ha Young asks Eun Sung what made Sun Woo misperceive her while pretending to have a special relationship with Sun Woo. Meanwhile, Eun Hyuk receives Dal Yong's advice over his thoughts regarding Ha Young.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 37
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung believes Sun Woo is interested in Ha Young and tries to keep her distance from him. Jung Ae can't get over seeing someone who looks exactly like Chun Young in the cooking class and digs deeper into her identity. Meanwhile, Ha Young offers Eun Sung a tempting opportunity to keep her away from Sun Woo.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 38
Episodes.Description: Sun Woo is disappointed as Eun Sung did not show up for their dinner date. At the moment, Ha Young joins him just as she planned, but he leaves the restaurant right away. Even though Ha Young feels humiliated, she tries to win him back. Meanwhile, Jung Ae and Chun Young meet again at the cooking class.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 39
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung finds out the message Sun Woo sent has disappeared, and Ha Young tries to come up with another plan to come between them. Meanwhile, Sun Ju gets extremely drunk and is about to pass out at Dong Gu's restaurant, while Sun Woo visits the park where he met Eun Sung for the first time.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 40
Episodes.Description: While making her way home, Ha Young's path is crossed by a menacing and intoxicated stranger, but she finds her savior in Eun Hyuk. Overflowing with gratitude, Ha Young earnestly thanks him, but her words inadvertently confuse Eun Hyuk. Meanwhile, at the office, Ha Young deliberately obstructs Sun Woo, preventing him from joining Eun Sung on their location-hunting expedition.

Episodes.Title: All I did was tell her to come have fruit! [EP.041]
Episodes.Description: Sun Woo rushes over to protect Eun Sung, who screams out in fear. However, they become trapped in the dilapidated factory in frigid conditions without warm clothing. Eun A hears about Min Guk and Ga Ram's story from Chun Young. Meanwhile, Ha Young calls Eun Hyuk after getting into a fight with Dal Yong.

Episodes.Title: Ms. Yu saved me [EP.042]
Episodes.Description: Jung Ae shows Eun Sung how grateful she is for saving Sun Woo. Ha Young also rushes to the hospital to see Sun Woo after hearing about what had happened. She runs into Eun Sung at the hospital but gives her a hard time for letting Sun Woo almost die. Meanwhile, Ga Ram waits for Eun A excitedly.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 43
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung and Sun Woo meet at the park and confess their feelings toward each other, while Ha Young visits Sun Woo's home to check in on him. Ga Ram waits for Eun A the whole day even though she cannot make it due to work. Min Guk gets upset at Eun A, and she feels terrible for canceling the plan.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 44
Episodes.Description: Chun Young barges into her restaurant while Eun Sung and Sun Woo are on their secret first date. Jung Ae and Chun Young have a huge fight and cause a scene after the cooking class. Meanwhile, Eun A apologizes to Ga Ram, and Eun Hyuk gets a gift for Ha Young.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 45
Episodes.Description: Eun Hyuk becomes flustered when Ha Young asks if he has feelings for her, and Jung Ae finds out that the police officer who kindly helped her was Chun Young's son. Meanwhile, Ha Young becomes extremely jealous when she sees how close Sun Woo and Eun Sung have become.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 46
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung tries her best to resolve the incorrectly ordered coffee and pastries, while Ha Young meets the CEO and insists that Eun Sung gets fired. Meanwhile, Sun Woo figures out that someone intentionally manipulated the order Eun Sung made.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 47
Episodes.Description: Ha Young becomes nervous that the security footage will reveal her misdeed, and Sun Ju asks Min Guk's coffee shop for part-time employment. Meanwhile, Sun Woo finds Ha Young's alibi suspicious while searching for the person responsible for sabotaging Eun Sung's order.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 48
Episodes.Description: Ha Young shares what happened at her office with Eun Hyuk, and he advises her to apologize to her colleague. Sun Ju starts working at Min Guk's cafe and gives him a hard time on her first day. Meanwhile, Ha Young musters up the courage and tell her boss the truth.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 49
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung has no choice but to introduce Sun Woo to her parents since they got caught by Chun Young. Eun Sung and Ha Young decide to let the coffee truck incident slide, but Ha Young is still upset about Sun Woo. Meanwhile, Jung Ae calls Ha Young to talk to her over dinner, and Eun Hyuk runs into Ha Young at Min Guk's cafe.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 50
Episodes.Description: After learning about Dong Gu's whereabouts, Ki Seok runs into Eun A while snooping around Haha Chicken. Eun Sung senses something wrong in Sun Woo's expression after he hears about Ed Williams, a famous Hollywood director, visiting Korea. Meanwhile, Ha Young has dinner with Jung Ae alone.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 51
Episodes.Description: Jung Sook heads to the private investigator's office after seeing Dong Gu and Chun Young at Haha Chicken. Dal Yong asks Jin Sil if she knows who the man Ha Young was head over heels for. Meanwhile, Jung Ae and Chun Young get into an accident in the cooking class.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 52
Episodes.Description: Sun Woo tells his family that he has a girlfriend after feeling uncomfortable when he hears that Jung Ae met with Ha Young without telling him. Ha Young sets up an interview with Ed Williams and Sun Woo without Sun Woo's consent. Meanwhile, Ki Seok puts a tail on Jung Sook to find out what she is hiding.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 53
Episodes.Description: Disclosing an error from thirty years ago to Ki Seok, Jung Sook prepares to tell Jung Ae the truth. Meanwhile, Sun Ju is astonished to discover that Ga Ram is Min Guk's son. During a press conference with Ed Williams and Sun Woo, Ed shocks the crowd of reporters by dropping a bomb, placing Sun Woo in a highly uncomfortable position.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 54
Episodes.Description: During Sun Woo's difficult moments, Eun Sung stands by him with unwavering support. Jin Sil is astonished by a picture found by Ga Ram. Meanwhile, the office team grapples with handling negative articles about Sun Woo. Eun Sung actively seeks solutions and learns about Jennifer, a former colleague of Sun Woo, being in Korea.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 55
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung meets with Jennifer, but she returns without any positive results. Jung Sook attempts to confess what she did 30 years ago to Jung Ae but falters. Meanwhile, an unexpected guest comes to see Eun Sung after getting an earful from Ha Young for not resolving the problem facing Sun Woo.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 56
Episodes.Description: Jung Ae isn't too pleased to hear that Eun Sung is Sun Woo's girlfriend, while Ha Young advises Eun Sung, who still looks like she wants to become an actress, to choose between working on the production team or in acting. Meanwhile, Haha Chicken gets picked to air on TV as a tasty neighborhood restaurant to eat at.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 57
Episodes.Description: Jung Ae finds out where Dong Gu is and rushes over to the chicken restaurant to meet Eun A and Eun Hyuk. Jung Sook also heads to the restaurant to meet Dong Gu before Jung Ae. Meanwhile, Eun Sung wants to audition for Sun Woo's new film, but she hesitates as she has to leave the team to participate.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 58
Episodes.Description: Dong Gu and Jung Ae clear up the misunderstandings and realize Jung Sook was the one who split them from each other. Dong Gu and Chun Young finally let Eun A and Eun Hyuk know about their birth mother, but Eun A is not fond of the news.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 59
Episodes.Description: Eun Hyuk and Eun A struggle to come to terms with the fact that Chun Young is not their biological mother. Before anything unfolds, Chun Young takes the initiative to confront Jung Ae, leading to a heated exchange between them. Meanwhile, Ha Young senses that something is amiss with Eun Hyuk and offers a listening ear if he needs to talk.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 60
Episodes.Description: Chun Young becomes sad when Eun Hyuk tells her he wants to meet his biological mother. Ha Young tells Eun Sung, who is contemplating whether or not to audition for Sun Woo's movie, to give up on the audition for Sun Woo's sake. Meanwhile, Eun A gets mad at Eun Hyuk for wanting to meet their biological mother.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 61
Episodes.Description: After meeting his biological mother, Jung Ae, Eun Hyuk asks Dong Gu why he divorced her. Eun Sung tells Sun Woo that she will pass on the audition this time and stick to her current role in the office. Meanwhile, Ha Young learns that Sun Woo is the eldest son of KS Foodville and calls Jung Ae.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 62
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung becomes flustered after experiencing how cold Jung Ae was to her compared to Ha Young. Sun Ju shows her interest in Min Guk and gets into a war of nerves with Eun A. Meanwhile, Jung Ae becomes impatient waiting for Eun A and heads to Haha Chicken to see her.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 63
Episodes.Description: Eun Hyuk gathers the courage to express his emotions to Ha Young, but the timing couldn't be worse, as Ha Young is a bit too inebriated to take it seriously. Eun A discovers that Chun Young played a role in Jung Ae and Dong Gu's divorce and decides to meet Jung Ae. Meanwhile, Eun Sung accidentally overhears a conversation between Ha Young and her colleague.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 64
Episodes.Description: Eun A discloses her desire to reunite with her biological mother, aiming to make up for the three decades they spent apart. Dong Gu and Chun Young, though taken aback, recognize their lack of influence over her choice. Meanwhile, Eun Hyuk anxiously awaits Ha Young's call following the previous night's incident. Eun Sung discovers she initially secured the role in Director Hwang's audition, only for it to be unexpectedly altered at the last minute.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 65
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung is utterly shocked when she learns Eun A and Eun Hyuk are from a different mother. Sun Woo and Sun Ju are also stunned that Jung Ae has another son and daughter they didn't know about. Meanwhile, Mr. Kim tells Eun Sung she should audition for Sun Woo's new movie.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 66
Episodes.Description: Jung Ae and Chun Young have a big argument over Eun A's future, and Jung Sook takes on the full wrath of someone's power trip as she cleans the stairs. Meanwhile, Ha Young becomes apprehensive over Eun Sung's decision to audition or not.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 67
Episodes.Description: Eun A wants to move into Jung Ae's house, but Eun Hyuk is against the idea as it will hurt Chun Young's feelings. At the same time, Sun Ju declares that she is uncomfortable with her older siblings from another father. Dong Gu tries to persuade Jung Ae, but she refuses to give in to Dong Gu and Chun Young.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 68
Episodes.Description: Eun Hyuk formally introduces himself to Sun Woo, but their interaction is cut short by an urgent matter that prompts Sun Woo's quick departure. Meanwhile, seizing the moment, Eun Hyuk asks Ha Young out on a date to watch a musical together. In a serious conversation, Eun A and Jung Ae discuss the complexities of their family relationships, with Jung Ae confiding in Eun A about Sun Ju's struggle to come to terms with her half-siblings.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 69
Episodes.Description: In the audition waiting room, Eun Sung discovers she's in direct competition with Ju Ri for the same actress role. As usual when Ju Ri is in the mix, Eun Sung faces unexpected challenges. Meanwhile, Sun Ju feels completely at ease with Eun A, even after her swift return the day after quitting. Ju Ri is aware of why Eun Sung isn't showing up for her audition turn but chooses to keep it a secret.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 70
Episodes.Description: Trapped in the washroom, Eun Sung somehow frees herself with assistance and makes it to the audition room promptly. Pouring all her past endeavors into the audition, she leaves no room for regrets. Meanwhile, Jung Ae calls Sun Woo, requesting that he bring his girlfriend home for a meal.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 71
Episodes.Description: After finding out that Eun Sung is an unknown actress, Jung Ae disapproves of her even more. Eun Sung can't forget what Jung Ae said to her during dinner, and her words weigh heavily in her mind. Meanwhile, Sun Woo argues with Jung Ae over why she doesn't think Eun Sung is the right match for him.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 72
Episodes.Description: Eun A and Eun Hyuk have a meal with Jung Ae, and Eun Sung's family feels gloomy, especially Chun Young. Sun Ju is shocked to find out who Eun Sung's boyfriend is, and she plans to come between them. Meanwhile, Eun Hyuk is excited to go on a musical date with Ha Young and decides to confess his feelings again.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 73
Episodes.Description: After Ha Young comes home from meeting Jung Ae and Sun Woo, she feels bad about canceling the plan she had with Eun Hyuk. At the same time, Eun Hyuk is heartbroken as he realizes that Ha Young lied to him to meet Sun Woo. Meanwhile, the result of Eun Sung's audition will be announced, so Eun Sung and her family gather to find out the result together.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 74
Episodes.Description: Jung Ae invites Eun A and Eun Hyuk over for dinner to introduce them to her family. Meanwhile, it's Eun Sung's first day joining the Hidden Memory team at Cheong Film as an actress, but she is terrified as she runs into Si Heon and Ju Ri.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 75
Episodes.Description: Eun A storms out of Jung Ae's house furiously because Sun Woo doesn't show up for their dinner arrangement. When Sun Woo finally returns home, Jung Ae asks him what happened in disbelief. Meanwhile, Jung Ae tells Dong Gu to say it to her face when he calls her about Eun A and Eun Hyuk getting stood up.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 76
Episodes.Description: Dong Gu, Chun Young, Jung Ae, and Ki Seok all gather and raise their voices about the issues revolving around Eun Hyuk and Eun A and what happened 30 years ago. Meanwhile, Sun Woo learns that Eun Sung got dropped from Director Hwang's final audition, and Ha Young tells Jung Ae about Sun Woo's accident while blaming everything on Eun Sung.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 77
Episodes.Description: Jung Ae invites Eun A and Eun Hyuk over again to celebrate her birthday and introduce Sun Woo and Sun Ju to them. Sun Woo asks Eun Sung to join them for the birthday dinner. Meanwhile, Sun Woo finds out that Si Heon is Eun Sung's ex-boyfriend during the welcome party.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 78
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung and Sun Woo's family finally meet and find out about the complicated relationship between the two families. Jung Ae tells them to break up right away as she discovers Eun Sung is Dong Gu and Chun Young's daughter. Meanwhile, Dong Gu lets Jung Sook move into the back room of his restaurant without letting Chun Young know about it.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 79
Episodes.Description: Despite the parents' disapproval, Sun Woo and Eun Sung are not willing to give up on each other and ask Eun A and Eun Hyuk for help. However, Eun A is also against their relationship, and Eun Sung feels hopeless. Meanwhile, Ha Young runs into Eun Hyuk.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 80
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung's parents find out that Sun Woo's parents called Eun Sung to their house to talk to her about breaking up with Sun Woo, and Sun Woo's parents find out that Eun Sung's parents called Sun Woo over to their chicken restaurant to talk to him about breaking up with Eun Sung. Meanwhile, Eun A witnesses Sun Ju and Min Guk stuck close together, and Jung Ae tells Ha Young to fire Eun Sung from Sun Woo's movie.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 81
Episodes.Description: Ha Young contemplates how Jung Ae wants her to help remove Eun Sung from Sun Woo's movie, and Sun Ju hears from Jung Sook about why Jung Ae cut ties with her. Meanwhile, Eun A and Eun Hyuk try to convince Eun Sung and Sun Woo that their relationship can't continue.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 82
Episodes.Description: Even though Sun Woo and Eun Sung promised to get through the challenges together, Eun Sung starts to waver as she sees both of their families suffer because of them. Meanwhile, Sun Ju confesses her feelings to Min Guk, and Si Heon and Ju Ri find out about Eun Sung and Sun Woo's secret relationship.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 83
Episodes.Description: Cheong Film turns upside down as the report about Sun Woo and Eun Sung's relationship goes public. Eun Sung thinks Ju Ri is the one who reported false information to the press on purpose, but there is no evidence. Meanwhile, Jung Ae wants Sun Woo to release a statement to quiet down the rumor.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 84
Episodes.Description: To split Sun Woo and Eun Sung up, Jung Ae reveals what happened with Dong Gu and Chun Young 30 years ago. Eun Sung is shocked, and Eun A gets furious at Jung Ae for telling Eun Sung about it. Meanwhile, Jung Ae waits for Eun Sung's answer, and Sun Woo gets ready for the press conference.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 85
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung tells in a live-broadcast interview that she is not in a relationship with Director Kang and removes herself from the movie, and Eun A reveals to Jin Sil that she has romantic feelings for Min Guk. Meanwhile, Eun Sung tells Sun Woo coldly that they should stop seeing each other.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 86
Episodes.Description: After learning Eun Sung dropped out of the movie, Ju Ri asks Sun Woo if she could take over Eun Sung's role. Eun A plucks up her courage and tells Min Guk she has feelings for him. Meanwhile, Sun Woo and Ha Young find Ju Ri suspicious of the tip-off to the press and learn why Eun Sung went missing on the day of her audition.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 87
Episodes.Description: Si Heon's openness dismissed suspicions surrounding Eun Sung's casting and any influence from personal connections. Nevertheless, a return to the previous state of affairs seems improbable. Min Guk uncovers Jin Sil holding on to Hye Yoon's photograph. Meanwhile, Jung Ae wonders about Eun A's lack of communication and decides to give her a call.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 88
Episodes.Description: Upon discovering that Jung Ae revealed sensitive information to Eun Sung, Chun Young reacts with intensity, delivering a slap to Jung Ae's face. Meanwhile, Sun Woo questions Eun Sung's vehement opposition to returning to the movie from which she was unjustly ousted. Ha Young runs into Eun Hyuk, who anxiously awaits an informant who has yet to appear.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 89
Episodes.Description: Ha Young is engulfed in a wave of remorse upon uncovering the connection between Eun Sung and Eun Hyuk. Jung Ae and Ki Seok's attempt to arrange a blind date leaves Sun Woo feeling let down. Meanwhile, Chun Young reaches out to Jung Sook for a conversation, catching Jung Sook off guard and prompting her to hastily retreat from the situation.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 90
Episodes.Description: Sun Woo becomes upset at Eun Sung's cold attitude as she draws a line between them. Chun Young, who already thought the new tenant was suspicious, believes something is going on between her and Dong Gu. Meanwhile, Ha Young worries about Eun Hyuk after hearing news of a murder suspect on the run and then receives a call about Eun Hyuk's injury.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 91
Episodes.Description: After learning about each other feelings, Ha Young and Eun Hyuk promise to keep their relationship a secret for the time being. Chun Young pressures Dong Gu to kick Jung Sook out of their vacant room. Meanwhile, Min Guk hears that someone from his family sent snacks to Ga Ram's kindergarten.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 92
Episodes.Description: Hye Yoon's unexpected return surprises Min Guk, while Ga Ram, unfamiliar with her, is puzzled to learn that she's here to see him. Jung Sook faces Eun A and Eun Hyuk directly, offering apologies for the years of time she has taken away from their mother. Meanwhile, Eun Hyuk and Ha Young are having a drink together, possibly indulging in a few too many glasses.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 93
Episodes.Description: Ha Young wakes up to a surprise as she discovers she's sharing a bed with Eun Hyuk. Shortly after, she receives a call from Jin Sil inquiring about her whereabouts and if she returned home the previous night. Ga Ram questions Hye Yoon about why she has never visited him, asking if it's because she doesn’t love him. Meanwhile, Ji Yeon joins Jung Ae for dinner and openly expresses her interest in Sun Woo.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 94
Episodes.Description: Dong Gu and Chun Young are shocked when they learn that Eun Hyuk's girlfriend, Ha Young, is Dal Yong's daughter. Hye Yoon explains to Min Guk and his family what kept her away for six years. Meanwhile, as soon as the public takes Eun Sung's side, Ha Young meets Eun Sung and asks her to return to Cheong Film's movie.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 95
Episodes.Description: Chun Young asks Eun Sung what she thinks about Ha Young. Sun Woo goes to Haha Chicken to persuade Eun Sung to rejoin the movie in front of her parents. Meanwhile, Eun Hyuk finds himself in a tricky situation when Ha Young comes early to meet him as he meets with Jung Ae.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 96
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung returns to the movie and gets reunited with an old friend. Min Guk is delighted to see Ga Ram and Hye Yoon eating tteokbokki together. Meanwhile, Jung Ae finds out Eun Sung rejoined the movie and heads to see her at Cheong Film, but she sees something shocking.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 97
Episodes.Description: After stumbling upon Eun Hyuk and Ha Young having a sweet moment, Jung Ae fires off a bunch of questions at them. Meanwhile, Min Guk, Hye Yoon, and Ga Ram roll back after a good time, making Eun A and Sun Ju think about throwing in the towel with Min Guk. Eun Sung and Je Ha bump into Sun Woo and Ji Yeon at a restaurant, and they all end up grabbing a meal together.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 98
Episodes.Description: Hye Yoon explains to Eun A and Sun Ju that the man with her is just her cousin. Yet, despite her clarification, Eun A and Sun Ju can't shake the suspicion that there might be more to their relationship. Meanwhile, Jung Ae and Chun Young share the same objective of separating Eun Hyuk from Ha Young.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 99
Episodes.Description: Je Ha reveals to Sun Woo that he has developed romantic feelings for Eun Sung, leaving Sun Woo deeply unsettled. Upon arriving at Hye Yoon’s residence, Min Guk unexpectedly encounters her along with Do Chul. Meanwhile, Eun Hyuk and Ha Young endeavor to convince Eun Hyuk's family about their relationship, but Chun Young appears resolute and unlikely to alter her stance.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 100
Episodes.Description: Hye Yoon is shocked when she sees Ga Ram listening to her conversation over the phone with Do Chul. Chun Young's plan to split Ha Young from Eun Hyuk with the two mothers-in-law approach hits Ha Young hard. However, Dal Yong hears what happened and calls Eun Hyuk over to speak his mind.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 101
Episodes.Description: Chun Young and Dal Yong get into a heated argument about their children, and Jin Sil invites Hye Yoon over for a home-cooked meal and treats her warmly. Meanwhile, Jung Ae heads to Haha Chicken to talk to them about matching Eun A with a possible husband.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 102
Episodes.Description: Upon receiving a substantial sum of money from Jin Sil, Hye Yoon finds herself caught in a whirlwind of conflicting emotions, feeling compelled to return the money. Meanwhile, Eun A surprises Eun Hyuk by taking Sun Ju to meet Ha Young and Eun Hyuk, without any prior warning. Meanwhile, Eun Sung attends an event with Je Ha, oblivious to the encounter she is soon to have with someone unexpected.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 103
Episodes.Description: Sun Woo struggles even more to let go of his feelings for Eun Sung when he sees her with Je Ha. When Je Ha criticizes Sun Woo for not being honest about his feelings, Sun Woo confronts him directly. Meanwhile, Eun A and Sun Ju encounter someone who bears a striking resemblance to Do Chul in the neighborhood. Sun Woo spends the night drinking with Eun Hyuk, finding solace in sharing his troubles with someone he can trust.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 104
Episodes.Description: Sun Woo wakes up at Eun Sung's place after a wild night of drinking. He ends up joining Eun Sung's family for breakfast, where he casually mentions being a year younger than Eun Hyuk, and Dong Gu finds this a bit awkward. Meanwhile, Min Guk calls Do Chul to discuss something about Hye Yoon's mother.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 105
Episodes.Description: After listening to Do Chul's lie about being in Vietnam, Min Guk visits Hye Yoon's place. Je Ha tells Eun Sung that he has feelings for her. Meanwhile, Sun Woo heads to see Eun Sung in the audition room after telling Jung Ae that he will get back together with Eun Sung.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 106
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung and Sun Woo start dating again, and Sun Woo straight away lets Jung Ae know about it. However, Eun Sung can't seem to find the right time to tell her parents the truth. Meanwhile, Hye Yoon confesses to Min Guk about why she came back after all these years.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 107
Episodes.Description: Dong Gu and Chun Young remain steadfastly against Eun Sung and Sun Woo's renewed relationship, despite Sun Woo's heartfelt plea. Meanwhile, Hye Yoon and Do Chul find themselves in a heated dispute over Hye Yoon's decision to return Min Guk's money. The revelation of Hye Yoon's departure for Vietnam comes as a shock to the entire family, disclosed by Min Guk himself.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 108
Episodes.Description: Ga Ram is moved to tears upon learning he won't see his mother again, prompting Min Guk to feel guilty for subjecting Ga Ram to the pain of losing his mother once more. Upon hearing the news, Jin Sil is consumed by rage toward Hye Yoon for departing without proper farewells. Meanwhile, Sun Woo stands outside Eun Sung’s house without notifying her beforehand.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 109
Episodes.Description: Aware that they haven't received official approval from Eun Sung's parents yet, Sun Woo conceals himself in a closet upon Dong Gu's unexpected arrival home. Meanwhile, Jin Sil reaches the cafe and unintentionally listens to a discussion between Sun Ju and Jung Sook concerning Hye Yoon's backstory. Ga Ram sets out to search for his mother without informing anyone.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 110
Episodes.Description: Min Guk searches for Ga Ram everywhere but can't find him. He runs into Eun A and tells her that Ga Ram went looking for his mom and is missing. Meanwhile, the house helper recognizes Jung Ae and tries to convince her that Dong Gu and Chun Young weren't having an affair 30 years ago, saying it was all a misunderstanding.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 111
Episodes.Description: Ha Young almost vomits in front of Eun Hyuk's parents and realizes she is ill. After visiting the hospital, she tells Eun Hyuk surprising news. Meanwhile, Jung Ae runs into Dal Yong on her way to meet with Ha Young's father and gets into a scuffle.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 112
Episodes.Description: Jung Ae and Dal Yong are shocked to find out they're Eun Hyuk and Ha Young's parents. Remembering their rocky start, they promise not to approve of their kids’ marriage. But everything changes when Ha Young announces she's pregnant. After the chaos, Jung Ae drunkenly calls Chun Young, blaming her for not keeping Eun Hyuk in line.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 113
Episodes.Description: The dispute over Dong Gu and Chun Young's affair escalates, prompting Jung Ae to take Sun Woo and Eun Sung to Haha Chicken to resolve it. While there, Chun Young reveals a shocking revelation about Sun Woo, leaving Jung Ae visibly unsettled by her knowledge. Simultaneously, another individual likely to be astonished by the news overhears it.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 114
Episodes.Description: Sun Woo hides that he knows Jung Ae isn't his biological mother, and he thanks her from the bottom of his heart. Eun Hyuk doesn't know what to do with Chun Young and Ha Young about where he and Ha Young will live after getting married. Meanwhile, Sun Woo gives Eun Sung a congratulatory event for her movie debut.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 115
Episodes.Description: Sun Woo suffers as he watches Eun Sung, who had tried to save him, in a coma. Eun Sung's family rushes to the hospital at the tragic news and falls to their knees in torment when they see her. Meanwhile, Jung Ae and Sun Ju, who had witnessed the accident, are also full of anxiety and concern.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 116
Episodes.Description: After reading Eun Sung's delayed text message, Sun Woo sobs by her side as her condition suddenly deteriorates. Meanwhile, Jung Ae and Ki Seok visit Eun Sung at the hospital after worrying about how she severely injured herself by saving Sun Woo, and Dong Gu and Chun Young decide to let Eun Sung be in love with Sun Woo.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 117
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung regains consciousness, bringing immense joy to Sun Woo. Having experienced the fear of almost losing each other, they express their love freely. Meanwhile, Jung Ae learns of Sun Woo's awareness of their non-biological relationship and wants to have a conversation with him.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 118
Episodes.Description: After careful thought, Jung Ae wholeheartedly gives her blessing to Sun Woo and Eun Sung's marriage. Simultaneously, Eun Sung's family, alongside Sun Woo and Ha Young, come together to celebrate Eun Sung's recuperation. Meanwhile, Dal Yong and Jin Sil express apprehension about the forthcoming arrangements concerning Ha Young's baby.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 119
Episodes.Description: Chun Young and Dal Yong's differing opinions on Eun Hyuk and Ha Young's post-marriage residence put Jung Ae in a difficult position. She also has her own ideas on the matter. Eventually, Eun Hyuk and Ha Young feel compelled to go along with Jung Ae's suggestion of living independently on their own.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 120
Episodes.Description: With Sun Woo's proposal, the two families meet together and agree on having a wonderful joint wedding, except for Jung Ae. However, the two couples, Sun Woo with Eun Sung and Eun Hyuk with Ha Young, get excited about their futures. Meanwhile, Sun Woo and Eun Hyuk formally propose marriage to Eun Sung and Ha Young.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 121
Episodes.Description: Eun Sung tells Sun Woo's parents that she will live with them after getting married, and Ha Young agrees to live in Eun Hyuk's room after the wedding until the apartment they want to move into becomes available. Meanwhile, Eun Sung and Ha Young try on wedding dresses in a battle of nerves that ricochets onto Sun Woo and Eun Hyuk, driving them mad.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 122
Episodes.Description: As the two couples walk down the aisle, solidifying their commitment to a lifetime of happiness together, tensions linger between the parents of the bride and groom, casting a shadow over the wedding hall. Meanwhile, Jung Ae experiences a strange sensation as she observes Eun Sung and Je Ha engrossed in conversation. Just before the bride's entrance, Eun Sung suddenly vanishes.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 123
Episodes.Description: As Hye Yoon watches Ga Ram play at a playground from a distance, she receives a disturbing call from Do Chul. He threatens to reveal all of her secrets to Min Guk in a menacing manner that deeply upsets her. Meanwhile, Sun Woo and Eun Sung have returned home from their honeymoon to Eun Sung's house, where everything now feels new and unfamiliar for her.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 124
Episodes.Description: Min Guk falls into deep shock after hearing that Ga Ram isn't his biological child. Hye Yoon tells him the truth from six years ago and that she will take care of Ga Ram if he can't accept Ga Ram. Meanwhile, Jung Ae rebukes Eun Sung as her daughter-in-law about the first family dinner for no apparent reason.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 125
Episodes.Description: After learning that Ga Ram isn't Min Guk's son, Jin Sil interrogates Min Guk for answers and then sobs in agony. Jung Ae sits Eun Sung and Sun Woo down, already disgruntled about them returning home late, and pressures them about having a baby. However, Sun Woo firmly resists Jung Ae's wishes, which irritates her even more.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 126
Episodes.Description: After seeing Je Ha dropping Eun Sung off in front of the house, Jung Ae warns Eun Sung to act accordingly. Meanwhile, Ga Ram senses something wrong with Jin Sil and makes a heart-rending plea to her. Later, Jin Sil meets Hye Yoon regarding Ga Ram.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 127
Episodes.Description: Regardless of its veracity, Jung Ae experiences a sense of shame due to the media's portrayal of an unfavorable incident involving Eun Sung, leading her to harbor minimal trust in Eun Sung. Matters escalate when Sun Woo supports Eun Sung, leaving Jung Ae disappointed. Feeling compelled to resolve Eun Sung's predicament, Sun Woo steps out of the house, taking Eun Sung with him.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 128
Episodes.Description: Sun Woo, in a fit of anger, vows to move out with Eun Sung if Jung Ae continues to show displeasure at her presence at home, especially after witnessing Dong Gu and Jung Ae argue about Eun Sung. Meanwhile, Sun Ju decides it's time to let go of her feelings for Min Guk, a decision that weighs heavily on her heart. Ha Young and Eun Hyuk visit Jung Ae's house, and Jung Ae scolds Eun Sung for not bringing the right tea for Ha Young.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 129
Episodes.Description: After receiving her diagnosis, Chun Young is taken aback to realize that her sole chance for treatment rests on a transplant. Dong Gu reassures Chun Young that things will work out, and they agree it's best to inform their children about the illness. Without hesitation, all three children and Dong Gu opt to undergo transplant screening tests.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 130
Episodes.Description: Everyone in Eun Sung's family becomes devastated when they all get a negative match to be Chun Young's liver donor. Sun Woo says he will also get tested to be the donor, but Jung Ae forbids it. Meanwhile, Jung Ae meets with Tto Soon's mom, the lady who had spread rumors of Dong Gu's affair 30 years ago.

Episodes.Title: Unpredictable Family 131
Episodes.Description: Jung Ae apologizes to Dong Gu and Chun Young after learning the truth from Tto Soon's mother about what she said to her 30 years ago regarding Dong Gu's affair with Chun Young. Eventually, Chun Young and Jung Ae clear up the past and reconcile before heading into the operation room.
