Entries.Title: Slam Dunk
Entries.Description: Hanamichi Sakuragi is depressed after being rejected by 50 girls during middle school. Once he enters high school, he meets a girl (Haruko Akagi) who introduces him to basketball.

Episodes.Title: The Genius Basketball Player Is Born?!
Episodes.Description: Hanamichi Sakuragi is depressed after being rejected by 50 girls during middle school. Once he enters high school, he meets a girl (Haruko Akagi) who introduces him to basketball.

Episodes.Title: Go to Hell, Basketball! Hanamichi vs. Rukawa
Episodes.Description: After school, Hanamichi has a run-in with Rukawa Kaede, who Haruko has a crush on. Hanamichi gets into a fight with him out of jealousy, causing Haruko to hate him. Later, Hanamichi gets into a competition with the Shohoku basketball captain after he calls the sport 'childish'.

Episodes.Title: Gorilla vs. Hanamichi! Big Showdown!!
Episodes.Description: Hanamichi pulls off an amazing defense and manages to steal the ball from Akagi. He also manages to successfully pull off a slam dunk against Akagi. After the challenge, he finds out that Akagi is actually Haruko's brother.

Episodes.Title: Basketball Player Hanamichi Joins the Team!
Episodes.Description: Hanamichi decides to join the basketball club, which Akagi is against. Sakuragi tries to find a way to get on Akagi's good side for Haruko's sake. After Hanamichi shows his determination, Akagi lets him join the team and entrusts his basic training to the manager, Ayako.

Episodes.Title: A Spiritless Afternoon
Episodes.Description: Hanamichi is tired of being made to do basic dribbling practice by himself. After Akagi refuses to let him practice with the rest of the team, Hanamichi gets into a fight with him and quits the club. He later regrets his actions and returns to the club.

Episodes.Title: Rukawa vs. Akagi: The Real Showdown
Episodes.Description: Kogure remarks that Hanamichi is improving at an astonishing rate. Coach Anzai stops by to announce that they will be having a practice match against Ryonan High School soon. Anzai sets up a match, freshmen vs. seniors, to measure the freshmen's skills, but Akagi doesn't let Hanamichi play. Rukawa pulls off some great moves, but isn't able to score against Akagi.

Episodes.Title: Hanamichi Debut! Dunk Explosion
Episodes.Description: After Rukawa is defeated by Akagi, he reveals his true potential and makes a spectacular dunk. Hanamichi is allowed to play for the last two minutes of the game, and he demonstrates his skill at dribbling that he learned from Ayako. He refuses to cooperate with his teammate Rukawa, however and tries to make a slam dunk, but end up smashing the ball into Akagi's head instead.

Episodes.Title: Hanamichi's Crisis! The Judo-man's Trap
Episodes.Description: Aota Tatsuhiko, captain of the Shohoku Judo Club and a childhood friend of Akagi and Haruko, decides that he wants Hanamichi in the Judo Club because of his innate talent. He tries to use pictures of Haruko as bait to lure Hanamichi into the Judo Club.

Episodes.Title: I'm Going to Play Basketball
Episodes.Description: Aota continues to try and bribe Hanamichi into joining the Judo Club using Haruko's photos. Hanamichi decides that he will take the pictures, but not join the Judo Club. The two get into a fight, and Hanamichi declares that he will not join the Judo Club as he is a basketball player.

Episodes.Title: The Commoner's Shoot is Difficult
Episodes.Description: Akagi decides that it's about time that Hanamichi learns how to shoot. He asks Rukawa to demonstrate a simple layup shot, but Hanamichi isn't interested in learning from Rukawa. Inevitably, they get in a fight, and are banned from practice for the day.

Episodes.Title: Our Love's Special Secret Training
Episodes.Description: After practicing the lay up shot with Haruko before school, Hanamichi finally makes it in. After a bit more practice late after school, he figures that he can make the shot roughly one in three times. A player from Ryonan named Hikouichi comes to investigate Shohoku while Hanamichi is attempting a dunk, mistaking him for Rukawa after admiring his jumping ability.

Episodes.Title: Defeat Ryonan! The Fierce Training the Night Before the Match
Episodes.Description: The team practices for the upcoming match. Akagi stays after with Hanamichi the day before the match to instruct him on rebounds.

Episodes.Title: Shohoku vs Ryonan. Burning Captain!
Episodes.Description: The faceoff between Shohoku and Ryonan begins. Hanamichi is crushed when it is revealed that he won't be in the starting lineup, but soon relaxes when Anzai reassures him that he will become their 'secret weapon'. Uozomi and Akagi begin their rivalry as captains.

Episodes.Title: Super Basketball Match With Ryonan
Episodes.Description: The match starts off with Ryonan leading 19-0. Life returns to Shohoku after Rukawa gets the rebound and faces off with Sendo, passing the ball to Akagi for the dunk. Shohoku manages to catch up, ending the first half with a score of 42 to 50.

Episodes.Title: Hanamichi Nervously Steps Into the Spotlight
Episodes.Description: Finally, Sakuragi gets a chance to play when Akagi injures himself while playing. Now, there is only about 9 minutes left on the clock.

Episodes.Title: Who is This Guy? Taoka's Miscalculation
Episodes.Description: With just 8 minutes left in the second half, Ryonan is still leading. Taoka tells the Ryonan to continue to attack. Sakuragi plays whole-heartedly and this impresses Sendoh.

Episodes.Title: The Rebound King Sakuragi Hanamichi's Distress
Episodes.Description: Ryonan is leading with 3 points ahead of Shohoku, and Taoka says that the game will depend on how Sakuragi plays. Meanwhile, Sakuragi begins to realize how important rebounds are.

Episodes.Title: Last 2 Minutes! I'll Be the One to Defeat Sendoh
Episodes.Description: Sendoh is amazed at how good Shohoku has become, thus he begins to take the game seriously. Anzai then calls both Rukawa and Sakuragi to approach, to tell them of his plan.

Episodes.Title: Time's Up! The Decisive Battle with Ryonan
Episodes.Description: Although Shohoku has lost the game, Sakuragi played very well for his first game. Sakuragi and Rukawa vow that in their next game with Ryonan, they will beat Sendoh.

Episodes.Title: Basketball Shoes
Episodes.Description: The next day, Haruko has to accompany Sakuragi to the sports shop to buy a new pair of shoes because his old shoes are in bad shape after the practice game with Ryonan.

Episodes.Title: Enormous Trouble Makers! Hanamichi vs Miyagi
Episodes.Description: Ryota Miyagi returns to basketball after being injured in a fight. Meanwhile, Ayako hears rumors of Miyagi's return, so she decides to investigate. She brings along Sakuragi, but Miyagi, who has a crush on Ayako, thinks that she and Sakuragi are together and immediately becomes jealous. Will Miyagi and Sakuragi be able to coexist?

Episodes.Title: History's Biggest Idiot Combination is Born
Episodes.Description: It almost seemed like Miyagi and Sakuragi were about to collide with each other, but it seems that things have turned out much better than expected.

Episodes.Title: Shohoku Basketball Club's Last Day
Episodes.Description: A former member of the Shohoku team returns with a major bone to pick. Does this spell doom for the team?

Episodes.Title: The Battle for Justice! Sakuragi's Goon Squad Joins!
Episodes.Description: After Ayako is slapped by one of the delinquents, Miyagi joins in the fight, and Rukawa follows suit. However, they are both easily taken down by Tetsuo. Sakuragi steps up, though he is outnumbered. Things change, however, when Sakuragi's friends appear in an unlikely fashion.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Aimed at National Championship
Episodes.Description: Mitsui and Tetsuo were defeated, but Mitsui still continues to fight. When Akagi arrives, the atmosphere becomes tense. Akagi slaps Mitsui around when the latter attacks him. Kogure then informs everyone that Mitsui was once an excellent basketball player, and was even on the team. Kogure then proceeds to tell the story of the rise and downfall of Mitsui's basketball career.

Episodes.Title: Mitsui, the Problems of the Past
Episodes.Description: It seems that Mitsui was once a great basketball player himself before high school. However, something happened during one practice session that changed everything.

Episodes.Title: I Want To Play Basketball!
Episodes.Description: After suffering through a severe injury, Mitsui quit basketball. Now two years later, in his attempt to sabotage Shohoku's chances of participating in the tournament, his feelings for the sport appear to be returning once again.

Episodes.Title: The Beginning of Interhigh Preliminaries
Episodes.Description: The day of the tournament is quickly approaching. Sakuragi is anxious to play against Sendo again, but Shohoku will have to deal with Miuradai first.

Episodes.Title: Hanamichi! Debut at an Official Game
Episodes.Description: The match starts, and Anzai refuses to put Sakuragi, Rukawa, Mitsui, and Miyagi in the starting line-up as punishment for fighting. Will Anzai keep it like this for the entire game?

Episodes.Title: The Introspective Army's Big Counterattack
Episodes.Description: With four of Shohoku's best players finally entering in the game, the tables turn quickly as they narrow the lead down to only 2. Sakuragi was hacked on a play, giving him two shots at the freethrow line, but things began to get tough for him, as nervousness broke his concentration, and his imagination started running wild.

Episodes.Title: Formidable Enemy Miuradai's Secret Weapon
Episodes.Description: Miuradai revealed a secret weapon of theirs that will help them try and overcome Shohoku, that secret weapon being the ox Nato.

Episodes.Title: Genius Hanamichi! Certain Death Dunk
Episodes.Description: Miuradai starts to gain control of the game, until Nato begins to block Rukawa instead of Sakuragi. Rukawa exploits his weakness, and this causes the game to go in Shohoku's favor.

Episodes.Title: Walkout King!? Hanamichi Sakuragi
Episodes.Description: Shohoku's next match is against Gohoku. While they have been exceeding almost everyone's expectations, Sakuragi continues to be laughed at for his nonsensical and pointless fouls. He starts to realize that he might not be so great after all.

Episodes.Title: Gorilla's Secret, Kill with Your Eyes!
Episodes.Description: Sakuragi and his fouling troubles continue. He unconsciously went to Akagi's house for help, and in order to help Sakuragi a little bit, Akagi gives him one piece of advice... instill his opponents with fear using his eyes. Sakuragi takes this too literally, with predictable results.

Episodes.Title: Hot Blooded Guys
Episodes.Description: Mitsui got himself caught up in a fight between Ryo and Tetsuo, and was eventually beaten himself. However, Sakuragi pops out of nowhere, and comes to aid his teammate when trying to get to the gym.

Episodes.Title: A Well Seeded School, Enter Shoyo
Episodes.Description: Sakuragi is still upset at Akagi for telling him a false technique in defense, and tries harder the next game against Tsukubu. While he gets fouled out, he's improving rather quickly, and he'll need it against a powerhouse team like Shoyo, who's the second ranking team in the tournament.

Episodes.Title: Hanamichi: First-time As Starter!
Episodes.Description: Anzai-sensei decides to start Sakuragi, much to everyone's shock. He figures that with his height and drive, he'll be the perfect weapon to use against Shoyo.

Episodes.Title: Rukawa's Counterattack!
Episodes.Description: With the Shohoku offense stalled by Shoyo's defense, Rukawa takes it upon himself to lead the offensive charge.

Episodes.Title: Lightning Flash Ryota!
Episodes.Description: With Rukawa taking the heat off of the rest of the team, Miyagi gets a chance to show off his skills as a point guard and his speed on the court.

Episodes.Title: Rebound King Hanamichi Sakuragi!
Episodes.Description: With Mitsui's 3 point shot, Shohoku finally catches up with Shoyo. It seems like Fujima has had enough, but Hanagata asks him to trust him for a little while longer. Fujima made a good decision in trusting his star center, for Shoyo pulled away from Shohoku again, creating another 10 point deficit.

Episodes.Title: Shoyo's Ace Fujima Enters the Court
Episodes.Description: Driven hard by Rukawa's offense and Sakuragi's rebounding, Fujima comes off the bench to lead his team to victory.

Episodes.Title: Shoyo Ace Fujima's Real Ability
Episodes.Description: Fujima is leading a strong charge for Shoyo against Shohoku, taking the lead once again. Though Shohoku has other problems besides Fujima; Mitsui is already very tired. Will Kogure be able to take his place?

Episodes.Title: Has Mitsui Reached His Limit!?
Episodes.Description: Shohoku's problems continue piling up. Mitsui can't get a 3 pointer to go in, forcing all the burden on Rukawa. Plus, Sakuragi is on the brink of fouling out, one more and he's gone. Is this the end for Shohoku?

Episodes.Title: Mitsui! Stormy 3 Points
Episodes.Description: Mitsui, reminiscing upon the past, gets the energy to play and lead his team. In just a matter of time, he scores 9 consecutive points thanks to his impressive shooting, but is it enough to overcome Shoyo?

Episodes.Title: Imminent Walkout!? Hanamichi's Pinch
Episodes.Description: While Mitsui has increased his efficiency during the game, Sakuragi still faces the risk of being dismissed. After a few destructive words from Rukawa, Sakuragi is fueled with fire.

Episodes.Title: Hanamichi, Hot Dunk
Episodes.Description: Thanks to a basket from Rukawa, Shohoku has finally taken the lead in a critical time. Sakuragi, wanting to feel important, jumps up at the same time as two opposing Shoyo players as he goes for the dunk. It seems like Sakuragi's long desire to perform a slam dunk will be fulfilled.

Episodes.Title: Challenge From a Rival
Episodes.Description: Shohoku has defeated Shoyo, and Sakuragi is quick to spread the word, especially after his ferocious slam dunk on Hanagata. It seems like Oda, a person that went to the same junior high as him, is going to be facing Kainan. They're also hoping to pull off an upset victory like Shohoku has.

Episodes.Title: The Guy Who Pledged to Defeat Kainan
Episodes.Description: Sakuragi skips practice in order to investigate on why Yohko was acting so strangely. When they get to Takezono, he is immediately met by hordes of girls who misjudge his delinquent looks as someone who came to beat up Oda in order to Sabotage Takezono's chances of beating Kainan.

Episodes.Title: Takezono, Last Fight
Episodes.Description: The match between Takezono and Kainan starts. Kainan only put in two starters the entire game, but it seemed like it was enough to take care of their opponents. That wasn't Takezono's only problem; Oda's injury remains ignorant to everyone but Yohko and Sakuragi, and it's clearly affecting his ability to play.

Episodes.Title: Outside Calculation!? Hanamichi at His Best!
Episodes.Description: The match between Shohoku and Kainan has been tight and intense all the way through, but it was Sakuragi who stood out the most with his cocky attitude and amazing athleticism. However, Kainan's coach is planning something to get Sakuragi off the court.

Episodes.Title: Secret Weapon Against Sakuragi!
Episodes.Description: Takato seemed to have devised the perfect plan to counter-attack against Sakuragi, which is sending in the extremely small and weak Miyamasu. In an unbelievable turn around, the plan worked in which Sakuragi ends up horribly embarrassed, allowing Kainan to widen the gap. Rukawa however, seems to be heating up.

Episodes.Title: The Gorilla's Injury! Desperate Situation!?
Episodes.Description: Coach Anzai asks for a time-out and substitutes Sakuragi. Rukawa is heated-up and starts scoring for Shohoku. Akagi assists with rebounds but takes a misstep and injures his foot. As he has to be taken out, Sakuragi goes back into the court with some words from Ansai for him and Rukawa. In the meantime, Ryonan is winning with an overwhelming difference against Takesato.

Episodes.Title: The Guy Who Dominates the Game
Shohoku on the Edge
Episodes.Description: Sakuragi blames himself deeply for Shohoku's loss against Kainan and becomes depressed. However, after a beating match against Rukawa, who tries to leviate the blame on himself, Sakuragi shaves his red head bald. This episode also introduces Kicchou Fukuda, a player on Ryonan's basketball team that was in disgrace.

Episodes.Title: Battle of the Aces! Kainan vs Ryonan
The Strongest Match! Sendoh vs Maki
The Final Battle! Shohoku vs Ryonan
The Greatest Shame of One's Life
Rukawa Kaede, Gambling on the 2nd Half
Vice-Captain Kogure's Determination
Episodes.Description: While shooting a three-pointer that will determine Shohoku's chances of winning, Kogure has a flashback from his early days of playing basketball up to the present, which also counts as a recap of the series from Kogure's point of view.

Episodes.Title: Win or Lose
Episodes.Description: It is a race against time between Shohoku and Ryonan to win the basketball match and earn the final qualifying position for the National Championship Games.

Episodes.Title: New Challenge: The National Championship!
Episodes.Description: The Shohoku Basketball Team's reputation has grown popular following their winning the final qualifying position for the National Championship Games, with Rukawa's popularity soaring high, much to Sakuragi's ire. However, it seems that Rukawa has some high ambitions of his own.

Episodes.Title: Rukawa's Ambition
Episodes.Description: In the aftermath of Ryonan losing the final qualifying position for the National Championship Games, Uozomi and Ikegami retire from the basketball team, passing the team's leadership to Sendoh, whom Yayoi Aida, Hikoichi's older sister and a basketball magazine reporter, wants to do a report on despite her editor's refusal on the grounds that Ryonan had lost.

Episodes.Title: Japan's Number One High School Player
Episodes.Description: Sakuragi chances upon Kainan players Maki and Kiyota and accompanies them to watch a basketball match between Sannoh Industry Affiliated High School and Aiwa Academy, which Maki acknowledges will be the new powerful rivals Shohoku will face in the National Championship Games. Meanwhile, Rukawa visits Coach Anzai to ask for his blessing for his wish to study abroad in the United States of America. To his surprise, Coach Anzai refuses, instead telling him to become the top-ranking player in Japan before he even thought of it.

Episodes.Title: The Basketball Kingdom - America
Episodes.Description: Coach Anzai's wife tells Rukawa the story of Ryuji Yazawa, a talented basketball player from Anzai's past 10 years ago who became dissatisfied with Anzai's tough training for him alone and left Japan to play in the United States, where he thought he would have better opportunities to show his talent, only to become depressed as a result of the unsupportive American college basketball culture and die in a high-speed head-on car collision five years later, reportedly under the influence of drugs. This revelation forces Rukawa to rethink his views on basketball playing.

Episodes.Title: Rukawa Kaede's Spirit
Episodes.Description: With a new viewpoint, Rukawa shows great improvement on his basketball skills, impressing his teammates and fans alike, much to the ire of Sakuragi. Haruko also comes to realize that her crush on Rukawa will never be requited.

Episodes.Title: Shohoku's Real Ace
Episodes.Description: Unwilling to accept Rukawa's improvement, Sakuragi challenges his rival to a one-on-one match to see who befits the role of Shohoku's Ace player. Meanwhile, Akagi is visited by the coach and captain of Shintai University's basketball team at his house with the invitation of joining their team upon graduating high school.

Episodes.Title: The Nationals' Crisis!
Episodes.Description: The Shohoku Basketball Team faces an unusual crisis when four of its best players - Sakuragi, Rukawa, Miyagi and Mitsui, are at risk of being disqualified from participating in the National Championship Games due to their poor academic grades, prompting Team Captain Akagi to beg the school authorities to give them a retry test and draft them into a study camp at his house.

Episodes.Title: Guys' Friendship? Sakuragi Gang
Episodes.Description: Sakuragi's gang take part-time jobs among two rivaling beachside stands to earn the money to pay for the travel expenses to watch the National Championship Games, and learn the hard lesson of hard-earned money when they unwittingly waste their first paycheck and then have to earn it back several times fold when asked by their employers to help defend their stands against a typhoon strike. Sakuragi steals their hard-earned money to pay for his travel expenses to attend Shohoku's friendship match with Jousei High but is dismayed to learn that he is being left behind at Coach Anzai's request, and the gang steal their money back from him.

Episodes.Title: Going Toward 20000 Shoots
Episodes.Description: Coach Anzai reveals that Sakuragi's weakness is long-distance shooting, so he puts him through a special training regime of 20,000 practice shots in a week to prepare for the National Championship Games. Haruko and Sakuragi's gang arrive to offer support.

Episodes.Title: Shizuoka's Fierce Fight! Shohoku vs. Jousei
Episodes.Description: While Sakuragi's training under Coach Anzai continues, the Shohoku Basketball Team faces off against the Jousei High Basketball Team in their friendship match.

Episodes.Title: Hanamichi's Hottest Day
Episodes.Description: Sakuragi's training is completed just as the Shohoku Basketball Team returns from their friendship match against Jousei High, and Haruko decides to reward Sakuragi for his hard practicing by taking him to the summer festival. Sakuragi sees this as an opportunity to try to get with her, but the process became harder than he had expected.

Episodes.Title: Basketball Shoes Part II
Episodes.Description: Sakuragi has been working hard for the past months to improve his basketball skills, but as a result, his shoes have torn. He visits none other than the man that gave him his first shoes.

Episodes.Title: Mixed Feelings, Uozumi Returns
Episodes.Description: When a couple of Shoyo players decided to give their goodlucks to Shohoku, Sakuragi comes up with a suggestion; a game against Shoyo and Ryonan!

Episodes.Title: Fierce Battle Begins! Shohoku vs. Shoyo/Ryonan
Episodes.Description: Rukawa garnered all the attention with his strong start to the game, but it was Sendoh who soon stole that spotlight when he entered the gym in his fishing clothes.

Episodes.Title: Facing the Strongest Team, Shohoku in Danger!
Episodes.Description: The combination team has become even more formidable by adding Sendoh and Fukuda to their lineup, and while Sakuragi is still struggling, Shohoku retains the lead.

Episodes.Title: The Man of Miracles, Hanamichi Sakuragi!
Episodes.Description: Fujima starts passing more and shooting less 3 pointers, giving hims teammates more open looks and easy opportunities to score. But is it enough to overcome Shohoku?

Episodes.Title: The Glorious Slam Dunk!
Episodes.Description: The game between Shoyo-Ryonan and Shohoku continues. At the last few minutes of the practice game, Sakuragi made two jump shots and everyone is amazed. The score is tied, when Fujima and Sendo attempts to do an alley-oop. Everyone is amazed when Sakuragi appeared at the back of Sendo, blocking the supposed alley-oop. Sakuragi then takes control of the ball and when he is about to dunk the ball, he remembered what Haruko taught him about slam dunk when he first met her. Shohoku wins with the score 76-74. The last episode ends showing the team of Shohoku and Kainan about to leave Kanagawa for the Inter High. When Shohoku is about to enter the shinkansen train, they promised to themselves that they're going to win the championship.

Episodes.Title: The Secret of the Ginga Braces
The Secret of the Demon King
To Fight Or Not To Fight
It Came From The Other Side
Now You See It, Now You Don't
Back To Nature, Back To Battle
The Night of the New Moon
A Lighthouse in the Sea of Time

Entries.Title: Boys Over Flowers
Entries.Description: Poor scholarship student Geum Jan-di enters the elite Shinhwa High School and immediately clashes with the powerful F4 group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Poor scholarship student Geum Jan-di enters the elite Shinhwa High School and immediately clashes with the powerful F4 group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Jan-di becomes the target of F4's bullying after standing up to Gu Jun-pyo. She receives the dreaded red card that marks her as an outcast.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo's interest in Jan-di grows as she continues to defy him. Jan-di gets a job at the school cafeteria to support her family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo arranges a trip to New Caledonia where tensions escalate between him and Jan-di. Ji-hoo comes to Jan-di's rescue during a crisis.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Back from the trip, Jan-di tries to avoid Jun-pyo but finds herself unexpectedly indebted to him. Jun-pyo's sister makes her first appearance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo's mother visits the school and takes an immediate dislike to Jan-di. Jan-di gets caught in a love triangle between Jun-pyo and Ji-hoo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo officially declares his feelings for Jan-di. Jan-di's family faces financial trouble, leading to unexpected help from Ji-hoo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo arranges a romantic birthday surprise for Jan-di. Jan-di begins to question her feelings as Jun-pyo's mother escalates her interference.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo takes Jan-di on a private date at his family's resort. The relationship faces its first major test when Jun-pyo's mother intervenes.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Jan-di's family faces eviction. Jun-pyo secretly helps them while dealing with his mother's schemes to separate him from Jan-di.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo's mother threatens Jan-di's family business. Jan-di considers breaking up with Jun-pyo to protect her family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: A heartbroken Jun-pyo leaves for Macau after Jan-di's rejection. Jan-di follows him, realizing the depth of her feelings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo and Jan-di reconcile in Macau. Upon returning to Korea, they face new challenges from Jun-pyo's mother and a mysterious new transfer student.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo's fiancée Seo-hyun arrives, creating tension. Jan-di struggles with jealousy while Jun-pyo tries to handle the arranged engagement.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Seo-hyun's true feelings for Ji-hoo surface. Jan-di and Jun-pyo's relationship deepens as they face external pressures together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo takes a stand against his mother for Jan-di. The F4 face family pressures as their friendships are tested.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo is disinherited after defying his mother. He and Jan-di attempt to build a life together outside the Shinhwa empire.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Struggling with poverty, Jun-pyo takes on menial jobs. Jan-di's family supports the couple while Jun-pyo's mother plots to break them up.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo is injured protecting Jan-di. While he recovers, his mother manipulates events to make Jan-di believe she's endangering him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Jan-di makes a painful decision to leave Jun-pyo for his own good. A devastated Jun-pyo returns to his family and his destined path.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Four years later: Jan-di is now a medical intern. Jun-pyo returns from America transformed and engaged, setting up a dramatic reunion.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo struggles with amnesia and his feelings for Jan-di. The F4 reunite as they help Jun-pyo recover his memories.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo's memories return, reigniting his love for Jan-di. His mother escalates her efforts to maintain control through his engagement.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Jun-pyo confronts his mother at his engagement party. The F4 unite to support their friend's pursuit of true love.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: In the series finale, Jun-pyo and Jan-di fight for their future. Relationships are resolved as the F4 graduates from Shinhwa High.

Live Your Own Life
Entries.Description: Even on the day of her promotion to team leader at TS Fitness, Hyo Sim can't find a moment of peace.

Episodes.Title: The Selfless Daughter
Episodes.Description: Even on the day of her promotion to team leader at TS Fitness, Hyo Sim can't find a moment of peace.

Episodes.Title: Family Burdens
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim is utterly surprised when she encounters a new member at TS Fitness at five in the morning.

Episodes.Title: Setting Boundaries
Episodes.Description: Myung Hee pulls off an escape from her captors, and Sook Hyang is alarmed when she gets the news.

Episodes.Title: Unexpected Support
Episodes.Description: Following an unintended collision with Myung Hee, Hyo Do finds himself taking her to Uicheon Villa.

Episodes.Title: Career Crossroads
Episodes.Description: At TS Fitness, an unexpected happenstance brings together Hyo Sim and the heirs of Taesan Group.

Episodes.Title: Breaking Free
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho eventually ends up injuring himself at the gym by resisting Hyo Sim's training regimen.

Episodes.Title: New Horizons
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho and Tae Min clash while Tae Ho persists in uncovering his grandmother's whereabouts.

Episodes.Title: Unexpected Connections
Episodes.Description: Caught between the fights of his parents, Tae Min feels like there's no one he can rely on.

Episodes.Title: Changing Dynamics
Episodes.Description: Seeing her mother a bit under the weather for reasons she's keeping to herself has Hyo Sim feeling uneasy.

Episodes.Title: Romantic Tensions
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho gets rid of Jun Bum's car, and Jin Soo wants to send Tae Ho to prison.

Episodes.Title: Family Crisis
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho quits going to the gym and looks for Myung Hee, and Tae Min asks Hyo Sim out again.

Episodes.Title: Professional Breakthrough
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim finds out her mother borrowed money from Woo Ju, and Tae Ho gets a call that his grandmother is dead.

Episodes.Title: Truth Revealed
Episodes.Description: The reality of Myung Hee's funeral overwhelms Tae Ho, leaving him lost in a sea of sorrow.

Episodes.Title: Personal Growth
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim has to cater to Tae Ho in the hospital while trying to be a good daughter to Sun Soon.

Episodes.Title: Unexpected Alliance
Episodes.Description: Seriousness escalates for Hyo Jun at the police station, which could possibly hinder his legal career.

Episodes.Title: Relationship Test
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim is astounded by the reality that she must secure a loan from Indangsu, yet she has no other option.

Episodes.Title: Newfound Independence
Episodes.Description: Sun Soon gathers her kids and does the thing she does when she feels her life is lonely and meaningless.

Episodes.Title: Family Reconciliation
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho asks Hyo Sim out on a date, but she cannot accept it due to her difficult situation.

Episodes.Title: Career Advancement
Episodes.Description: Since Tae Ho is not willing to give up on Hyo Sim, she hurts him with harsh words.

Episodes.Title: Crossroads
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sung asks Hyo Sim about her relationship with Tae Ho and tells her to quit immediately.

Episodes.Title: Unexpected Turns
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim and her crew go on a three-day workshop to Damyang, and she lets Tae Ho join them.

Episodes.Title: New Beginnings
Episodes.Description: Tae Min also heads over to Damyang where Hyo Sim and Tae Ho are, and Sun Soon calls Hee Ju over to her place.

Episodes.Title: Collaboration
Episodes.Description: Sook Hyang gets infuriated after she finds out about Hyo Sim. Tae Ho drives Hyo Sim home and meets Sun Soon.

Episodes.Title: Conflict Resolution
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho is eager for Hyo Sim to confirm officially that they are dating, yet Hyo Sim is hesitant.

Episodes.Title: Milestone Achievements
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim's sense of pride crumbles completely when she is presented with the cost of selling her soul.

Episodes.Title: Family Support
Episodes.Description: Enveloped by the enchanting snowfall, Hyo Sim and Tae Ho solidify their emotions through a poignant first kiss. Meanwhile, Tae Min acquires details about the car accident from the detective who handled the case. Despite Sook Hyang's insistence, Tae Hee is compelled to move back in, but she ingeniously finds ways to resist her mother's wishes. Tae Ho and Tae Min find themselves in a disagreement over rehiring Hyo Sim as the company model, while Hyo Sim gladly accepts Tae Ho's offer for a new phase in her life.

Episodes.Title: Personal Sacrifices
Episodes.Description: Expressing her desire for independence, Hyo Sim encounters strong resistance from her disapproving mother. Undeterred, she pushes forward with her plans to move out and actively looks for a new home. Despite reluctance, Tae Min proposes to Soo Kyung to ensure Jin Bum's safety, prompting Tae Ho to question his motives. Sun Soon makes a final effort to retain Hyo Sim by rallying neighbors.

Episodes.Title: Relationship Deepens
Episodes.Description: Released from the ties of family responsibilities, Hyo Sim relishes the moments in her new home with Tae Ho. Tae Min, reluctantly married to Soo Kyung, is away on a honeymoon. Tae Hee, forced back home by Mr. Yeom, is now in confinement. Changes are imminent at Uicheon Villa with Hyo Sim's move to a new residence.

Episodes.Title: Professional Recognition
Episodes.Description: In the midst of an inescapable situation with Mr. Yeom and his men, Myung Hee grapples with the challenge of finding an exit. Meanwhile, Tae Ho's trip to the supermarket with Hyo Sim unexpectedly brings him face-to-face with So Ra. With Tae Min and Soo Kyung back from their honeymoon, Tae Hee strategically plans her escape during a momentary diversion of attention. Hyo Jun's decision to give up his studies faces staunch opposition from Mi Rim, who refuses to let him throw in the towel. Hyo Sim takes decisive steps toward shaping her future.

Episodes.Title: Fairy Dancing
Episodes.Description: After seeing Tae Ho collapse, Hyo Sim consoles him. She asks him why he is so sad, but Tae Ho laughs it over. After spending a honeymoon practically separately, Tae Min and Soo Kyung begin their marriage, which is only for show. Hyo Do and Tae Hee register their marriage, and Hee Ju goes to Sun Soon's house but gets put to work. Meanwhile, Tae Ho plans to make Taesan Group the company it once was.

Episodes.Title: Business Challenges
Episodes.Description: After a delightful date, Hyo Sim and Tae Ho return to Hyo Sim's house. However, Sun Soon, who had grilled Hyo Sim's address out of Hyo Sung, barges in and creates a scene. Meanwhile, Soo Kyung offers to help Tae Min with his promotion by using the power of the press to disturb Tae Ho, while Tae Hee returns home with Hyo Do, and Tae Ho takes Hyo Sim by her hand to see her mother, Sun Soon.

Episodes.Title: Personal Growth
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim has had enough of how her mom treats Tae Ho, and she finally lets out her frustration. She even throws some harsh words at Sun Soon, who ends up showing a lot of disappointment. Tae Min learns about Tae Ho digging deeper into the Daegwallyeong Pass incident through Soo Kyung, who isn't happy with how Tae Min is treating her. Meanwhile, Tae Ho takes Hyo Sim to where his parents are laid to rest.

Episodes.Title: Future Planning
Episodes.Description: So, Tae Ho straight-up asks Tae Min if he's got the lowdown on what really went down with their old man's death. Things get heated, and they end up throwing punches. Later, Tae Ho crashes at Hyo Sim's pad, asking if he can crash there for the night. On the flip side, Tae Min is hustling hard to secure the top spot at Taesan Group, and he leaves Soo Kyung with scars while doing so. Meanwhile, Hyo Sim and Tae Ho are all lovey-dovey in a parking lot, clueless that they've got an audience.

Episodes.Title: Family Acceptance
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho and Myung Hee finally meet and shed tears of joy. Myung Hee tells Tae Ho to keep her a secret. With the money Hyo Sim gave her, Sun Soon takes over a cafe. Although Tae Min gets promoted to vice chairman, Tae Ho plans to stop him from becoming the chairman. Meanwhile, Tae Min and Soo Kyung's marriage shatters, and rumors at TS Fitness begin to spread.

Episodes.Title: Professional Milestone
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim tells her boss she is quitting TS Fitness after he interrogates her about her relationship with Tae Ho. Tae Ho senses something isn't right with Hyo Sim and rushes to her house. However, he runs into Hyo Sung as he is leaving her place. Meanwhile, Myung Hee offers the chairman of TV Live a proposal, and Sook Hyang sets Tae Ho in a trap when things look dire between Tae Min and Soo Kyung.

Episodes.Title: New Challenges
Episodes.Description: As Tae Ho falls into Sook Hyang's trap and gets taken away by the police, he asks Hyo Sung to look after Hyo Sim. Hyo Sim is shocked at the news, and she lets Tae Min know how horrible she feels when he comes to her about what happened with Soo Kyung. On the opening day of Sun Soon's cafe, Hyo Jun, who couldn't get over Mi Rim, shows up drunk and makes a mess. Meanwhile, Hyo Do meets with Tae Min, wanting to strike it rich, and tells him about Tae Hee.

Episodes.Title: Personal Reflection
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho's imprisonment exposes a distinct purpose, leading to Tae Min's interrogation visit. Despite Tae Min's inquiries, Tae Ho remains unwilling to provide any answers, causing frustration for Tae Min. Myung Hee starts disclosing Sook Hyang's heinous deeds on TV Live, leaving Sook Hyang uneasy. Hyo Sung, who dedicated his life to his job, faces termination. Thanks to Hyo Sung, Hyo Sim reconnects with Tae Ho and learns about Tae Ho's grandmother.

Episodes.Title: Relationship Milestone
Episodes.Description: Tae Min and Myung Hee sit face-to-face, where Myung Hee ensures Tae Min's steadfast commitment to safeguarding Taesan Group. Recently released from prison, Tae Ho declares a management war against Sook Hyang and Jin Bum. Hyo Sim, spotting Tae Ho waiting for her outside her house, joyfully runs into his arms and informs him that her mother wants to meet him. Meanwhile, Mi Rim desperately searches for Hyo Jun.

Episodes.Title: Family Unity
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim scolds Hyo Jun on behalf of Sun Soon, who has collapsed at the news of Mi Rim's pregnancy. Tae Ho grumbles sadly at Hyo Sim for having to leave Sun Soon's house. Myung Hee pressures Jin Bum to confess to the Daegwallyeong Pass incident, and later, Tae Min finds Jin Bum collapsed on the floor. Meanwhile, Sook Hyang frets about the prosecutor's investigation, and Mr. Yeom tells Tae Min that Myung Hee is behind it all.

Episodes.Title: Wedding Preparations
Episodes.Description: Mi Rim's unexpected remarks turn Hyo Sim's house upside down, and Sun Soon falls ill again. Sook Hyang gets taken in for questioning by the prosecution, and Tae Ho searches for evidence one last time. Hyo Sung resorts to a loan shark for his children's education but runs into Hyo Do. Meanwhile, Tae Ho tries to earn brownie points with Hyo Sim's family by helping at the cafe, and Tae Min sees his world crumble as he learns Myung Hee's secret.

Episodes.Title: Business Expansion
Episodes.Description: Myung Hee reveals the truth to Tae Ho, but Tae Ho can't hide his bewilderment. Sun Soon succumbs to Mi Rim's determination and approves her wish to find her husband. Tae Min leaves his resignation letter and keeps himself out of sight, but Tae Ho finds him. Meanwhile, Hyo Do takes a beating from Mr. Yeom and his men when he goes to help Hyo Sung, and Sook Hyang offers TV Live a proposition that could destroy Taesan.

Episodes.Title: Personal Fulfillment
Episodes.Description: While Tae Ho and Tae Min stay up all night looking for a way to stop TV Live's attack on Taesan Group, they seem to become closer. Hyo Sim fervently spreads flyers to find her father and later comforts Tae Ho after learning about his relationship with Tae Min. Meanwhile, Tae Hee returns home after signing divorce papers and finds Mr. Yeom's attitude towards her suspicious.

Episodes.Title: Family Legacy
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim races to a piano academy and finds traces of her father there after hearing new information about him. Tae Ho warns Sook Hyang to leave Tae Min alone, and Sook Hyang plans to dump all crimes on Mr. Yeom. Ru Bi takes Pil Lip to Indangsu and learns everything about Hyo Sung's painful circumstances. Meanwhile, Jin Bum, who cannot contain his remorse, tells Tae Min the truth behind the Daegwallyeong incident.

Episodes.Title: Final Preparations
Episodes.Description: Jin Bum apologizes to Tae Min and says he will go to prison. Hyo Sung accidentally finds a picture of a woman at the piano academy with Hyo Sim that they believe was where their father last stayed. Myung Hee gives Tae Min the dashcam footage of the Daegwallyeong Pass incident, and Tae Min and Tae Ho learn what happened. Meanwhile, Hee Ju tells Sun Soon that Tae Ho belongs to the family that runs Taesan Group, and Sun Soon calls Hyo Sim over right away.

Episodes.Title: The Wedding
Episodes.Description: Sook Hyang's longstanding deceitful behavior toward Mr. Yeom may soon have consequences. With Tae Min's help, Hyo Sung re-enters Taesan Group and persuades Hyo Sim to cease searching for their father. Tae Ho's visit to Uicheon Villa is an attempt to gain Sun Soon's approval for his marriage to Hyo Sim, but he is met with coldness from Sun Soon. Meanwhile, Tae Hee confides in Tae Min about a secret she has been keeping.

Episodes.Title: Newlywed Life
Episodes.Description: Tae Min tells Tae Ho that he will take care of everything and for him to get married and live a happy life. Hyo Sung finds Mr. Yeom's old phone and gives it to Tae Min, and Tae Ho gets in touch with Park Jin Myung. Tae Ho valiantly tries to win Sun Soon's heart, and Sun Soon is stunned at his behavior. Meanwhile, Kkeut Soon is shocked when she sees her grandson, who is supposed to be in the US, in the cafe. She and Hyo Sim track him down to find out more.

Episodes.Title: Business Synergy
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho and Tae Min reunite with Park Jin Myung when he returns to Korea to give them crucial documents that will put Sook Hyang away for good. Kkeut Soon locks herself in her room after her heart breaks over her family. While Myung Hee tries to console her, Taesan Group requests her return, and she has no choice but to leave Uicheon Villa. Meanwhile, Sun Soon sobs when she sees how beautiful Hyo Sim is on the runway of a fashion show, and Tae Ho takes Hyo Sim to where they first meet to propose to her.

Episodes.Title: Family Expansion
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim meets her father, Chu Ryeon, who doesn't recognize her, and she reveals who she is in his hospital room. Hyo Sung meets Mi Hee, his music instructor from when he was a child. And through her, he learns why his father had left his family. Tae Ho takes Sun Soon to meet Myung Hee about his marriage to Hyo Sim. Meanwhile, Tae Ho and Hyo Sung get promotions for their parts in revealing the truth, and Hyo Sim meets Mi Hee when she goes to see Chu Ryeon again.

Episodes.Title: Next Generation
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho becomes upset at Hyo Sim's words to postpone their wedding, and they fight over it. Sun Soon reunites with Chu Ryeon but collapses out of bitter anger. She warns Hyo Sung and Hyo Sim never to think about giving Chu Ryeon their liver. Tae Ho asks Tae Min to postpone his promotion, and Hyo Jun goes to take his lawyer's exam. Meanwhile, Hyo Sim's family takes matters into their own hands to protect their family.

Episodes.Title: Legacy Building
Episodes.Description: Knowing Hyo Sim went into the operating room to donate her liver, Sun Soon sobs in agony in front of the doors. While worrying about Hyo Sim for being out of touch, Tae Ho realizes something horrible has happened when he sees Hyo Sung missing from his desk. After the surgery, Hyo Sim questions her life while watching her family restabilize at her sacrifice. Meanwhile, Tae Hee and Tae Min visit Sook Hyang at the corrections facility, and Tae Ho rushes to the hospital when he finds out about Hyo Sim.

Episodes.Title: Living Fully
Episodes.Description: It's been one year since Hyo Sim left, but Tae Ho still waits for her. Carrot is born, and Hyo Jun becomes a lawyer. Besides that, all is the same at Hyo Sim's house. However, they all reflect on how inconsiderate they were to Hyo Sim as they live on. Tae Min picks up Jin Bum, who is getting released with a special pardon, at the prison. Meanwhile, Tae Ho sees Hyo Sim in an interview on TV and rushes out to find her. Will Tae Ho and Hyo Sim's reunion be beautiful?

Entries.Title: Helluva Boss

With the help of an ancient book obtained by one of the princes of Hell, they manage to make their work possible and together they attempt to survive each other while trying to keep their business afloat.

Episodes.Description: Follow the I.M.P. as they plan their very first assassination.

Episodes.Title: Murder Family
Episodes.Description: After her husband's mistress survives a violent outburst, a deceased teacher hires the I.M.P to finish the job, only to encounter a far more bizarre threat.

Episodes.Title: Loo Loo Land
Episodes.Description: In an attempt to get Blitzø's attention, Stolas unnecessarily hires the I.M.P to work as bodyguards for him and his daughter, Octavia, while they visit Loo Loo Land, an amusement park in the Greed Ring.

Episodes.Title: Spring Broken
Episodes.Description: Blitzø discovers that his reserved, sole parking spot has been stolen by his ex-girlfriend, succubus and famous pop star Verosika Mayday. He and the rest of the I.M.P attempt to get it back by challenging Verosika to a "demon duel."

Episodes.Title: C.H.E.R.U.B.
Episodes.Description: An eccentric inventor killed by an experiment gone wrong hires the I.M.P to assassinate his now elderly business partner, only to find that he's being talked out of suicide by a rival organization.

Episodes.Title: The Harvest Moon Festival
Episodes.Description: Stolas invites the I.M.P to attend the Harvest Moon Festival, an annual event taking place in the Wrath Ring that is overseen by him. However, unbeknownst to our protagonists, an insidious plot will be transpiring there.

Episodes.Title: Truth Seekers
Episodes.Description: While on Earth, Blitzø and Moxxie are captured by demon-hunting government agents. To escape, they must fight, and come to terms with their inner fears in the process.

Episodes.Title: Ozzie's
Episodes.Description: Moxxie and Millie celebrate their first anniversary at Ozzie's, a club in the Lust Ring. Blitzø wants in on the action, but since the club is couples only, he has no choice but to invite Stolas.

Episodes.Title: Queen Bee
Episodes.Description: Loona goes to a hellhound party in the Gluttony Ring, but after things don't go the way she planned, she asks Blitzø to join.

Episodes.Title: The Circus
Episodes.Description: In a flashback to 25 years in the past, Stolas meets Blitzø, who becomes his first friend. Flash forward to shortly before the present, and they meet again for the first time since on a night that kickstarts their monthly arrangement.

Episodes.Title: Seeing Stars
Episodes.Description: In an effort to watch Azathoth's tears descend onto Earth, an event that Stolas promised to take her to but forgot to, Octavia steals his grimoire from the I.M.P's office to do so but ends up getting lost in Hollywood.

Episodes.Title: Exes and Oohs
Episodes.Description: The I.M.P are invited to meet a mysterious figure offering them a vague job. Upon arrival, Moxxie realizes that he is far more familiar with the place and the figure than he'd like to be.

Episodes.Title: Western Energy
Episodes.Description: When Striker kidnaps Stolas, Millie and Moxxie must rescue him while Blitzø takes Loona to the vet.

Episodes.Title: Unhappy Campers
Episodes.Description: Due to Blitzø being preoccupied, Moxxie takes an opportunity to lead a mission for the first time, in which he and Millie travel to Earth to investigate the death of a camper and kill the culprit.

Episodes.Title: Oops
Episodes.Description: Upon being abducted by Crimson and Striker so that they may be used as ransom, Blitzø and Fizzarolli are forced to confront each other over their mutual hatred for each other following the explosive ending of their childhood friendship.

Episodes.Title: Mammon's Magnificent Musical Mid-Season Special
Episodes.Description: Fizzarolli participates in Mammon's annual clown pageant, which he has done every year since Mammon began hosting them and won in each of them. However, with the help of Asmodeus and Blitzø, he realizes that things need to change.

Episodes.Title: The Full Moon
Episodes.Description: On Earth, the Cherubs partner with the D.H.O.R.K.S. after being captured by them and discovering their mutual disdain for the I.M.P. Meanwhile, in Hell, Blitzø prepares for his monthly meeting with Stolas.

Episodes.Title: Apology Tour
Episodes.Description: After Blitzø and Stolas' transactional relationship finally comes to an apparent end, Blitzø attempts to make things right with those who he has wronged in the past.

Episodes.Title: Ghostf**kers
Episodes.Description: Millie helps Blitz deal with his NOT-breakup and things happen. WARNING: Happy Halloween.

Episodes.Title: Mastermind
Episodes.Description: When Andrealphus learns that Blitzø has been illegally accessing Stolas' Grimoire, I.M.P. is arrested and put on trial, where they must defend themselves against the court's harsh accusations.

Episodes.Title: Sinsmas
Episodes.Description: Stolas tries to contact Via. Sinsmas starts.

Episodes.Title: Herr Dr. Tenma
Episodes.Description: Dr. Kenzo Tenma, a leading neurosurgeon at the Dusseldorf Hospital has received massive acclaim for his successful surgery on a famous opera singer. However, he is burdened by guilt. Due to pressure from the director, he had operated on the opera singer on the night that he was supposed to operate on another man. As a result, when the director’s orders him to operate on the mayor, he decides to ignore the order and instead works on saving the life of a young boy, brought to the hospital from the scene of a serial homicide. However, the boy's twin sister, who was brought in with the boy, and who still suffers from shock, keeps repeating the words 'kill him'.

Episodes.Title: Downfall
Episodes.Description: The price for disobeying Dr. Heinemann's orders to operate on the mayor is costly for Dr. Tenma. His career begins to plummet. The boy whom he saved finally awakens, but a horrible incident occurs soon after.

Episodes.Title: A Murder
Episodes.Description: Things look brighter for Dr. Tenma, now that Dr. Heinemann is dead. His career takes off, and even Eva tries to win him back. But unfortunately, all that success has drawn the attention of Detective Lunge.

Episodes.Title: Night of the Execution
Episodes.Description: Adolf Junkers has information about the serial murders that is vital to the police, but he is afraid to reveal them. Dr. Tenma's care for Adolf Junkers however wins him over. His close relationship with Junkers however leads him to a night of shocking horror.

Episodes.Title: The Girl of Heidelberg
Episodes.Description: Nina Fortner, a talented young student in Heidelberg has been having nightmares. She also cannot remember anything about her life before she was 10 years old. She soon suffers from fainting spells in university and starts receiving anonymous emails.

Episodes.Title: The Missing
Episodes.Description: Nina finally receives an email informing her to meet the anonymous sender at a specified time and place. Dr. Tenma in his search for the Liebert girl, asks Mauler, an editor for a local publisher, for assistance in his investigations.

Episodes.Title: House of Tragedy
Episodes.Description: Tenma and Nina return to the Fortners’ residence to find Mauler and Nina’s parents dead. Two detectives arrive to take them to the station for questioning, but certain things don't look right.

Episodes.Title: Pursued
Episodes.Description: Eva tries to threaten Dr. Tenma, unless he gets back with her, she would reveal to the police that the tie that was found at the scene of the crime is his!

Episodes.Title: The Girl and the Seasoned Soldier
Episodes.Description: An old mercenary soldier named Hugo is interrogated by Lunge about a student of his, a doctor named Tenma.

Episodes.Title: A Past Erased
Episodes.Description: Tenma encounters a burglar named Heckel who claims to have seen the killer. It soon results in Heckel leading Tenma to a couple of murderers.

Episodes.Title: 511 Kinderheim
Episodes.Description: Tenma learns that Johan used to be in an orphanage known as Kinderheim 511. And he meets a former East German official named Hartmann who used to work there and an injured boy named Dieter.

Episodes.Title: A Little Experiment
Episodes.Description: Dieter is picked up by Hartmann before Tenma could return. And Tenma learns more about the experiments in Kinderheim 511.

Episodes.Title: Petra and Schumann
Episodes.Description: In a small village, Dr. Schumann worries over the health of his sick but stubborn old friend, Petra.

Episodes.Title: Left Behind
Episodes.Description: Inspector Lunge investigates the murder of a prostitute and suspects a senator named Dr. Boltzmann of involvement. His dedication to his work however takes a toll on his family life. Meanwhile, the vindictive Eva continues to press Lunge to catch Tenma. She also has a new lover, her gardener.

Episodes.Title: Be My Baby
Episodes.Description: Dr. Tenma and Nina Fortner's investigations lead them to a powerful man known as 'The Baby', who belongs in an extremist organisation. They soon learn that the organisation has special plans for the Turkish district tomorrow.

Episodes.Title: Wolf's Confession
Episodes.Description: Nina escapes the mansion. And Tenma meets with the unrecognizable General Wolf at the mansion later.

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: The extremists plans are put into action, and Tenma decides to postpone his search for Johan and instead heads to the Turkish district to warn the people there. Dieter and Heckel are captured by the skinheads and are left to burn in the fire. And Nina tries to get information about the 'main dish' from 'The Baby'.

Episodes.Title: Five Sugars
Episodes.Description: Nina meets with an old friend and boss, Mister Rosso. The delightful old boss however, has a very dark past.

Episodes.Title: Monster's Abyss
Episodes.Description: Tenma visits Rudy, a criminal psychologist, who is working on cases involving a murderer named Jurgens.

Episodes.Title: Journey to Freiham
Episodes.Description: Tenma and Dieter hitch a ride with an elderly couple on the way to Freiham. Tenma wonders if the couple plan to turn him in.

Episodes.Title: Happy Holidays
Episodes.Description: Nina confronts Muller, one of the two detectives responsible for the death of her foster parents, the Fortners. Muller discovers that his protege, Roberto, is actually working for Johan and is now tasked with killing Nina.

Episodes.Title: Lunge's Trap
Episodes.Description: Lunge determines that the murder of a wealthy, middle-aged, childless couple does not fit the usual modus operandi of the serial murders and decides to use this opportunity to lure Tenma to a trap. However, before he can arrest him, Lunge is critically wounded by the real criminal. Tenma is able to treat Lunge's injuries.

Episodes.Title: Eva's Confession
Episodes.Description: Eva Heinemann is arrested for public drunkenness and hooks up with Roberto, with whom she was with the night before her arrest. Roberto then reveals his link to Johan and Eva confesses that she was actually a witness the night Junkers was killed by Johan.

Episodes.Title: Of Men and Dining
Episodes.Description: In exchange for her life, Roberto tells Eva to confront Tenma, who is currently treating a mob boss at a country house. Eva is promptly wounded by Roberto when she is unable to complete her task but is saved by Tenma.

Episodes.Title: Thursday's Boy
Episodes.Description: Karl Neumann and Lotte Frank are both students who read latin to Hans Georg Schubert. Lotte attempts to assist Karl in finding out his past while trying to figure out the identity of a boy who reads to Schubert on Thursdays. When they both discover who he is, they find the boy, Edmund Farren, in his dormitory, dead.

Episodes.Title: The Secret Woods
Episodes.Description: A man who claims to be the son of a millionaire has committed suicide, and a detective is determined to solve the case.

Episodes.Title: Proof
Episodes.Description: Richard's past and present situation is revealed. Johan continues to bond with the Schuwald family and his intention is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Just One Case
Episodes.Description: Richard re-investigates his old homicide cases and makes a frightening discovery.

Episodes.Title: Execution
Episodes.Description: Robert delves into Johan's past and makes a shocking discovery. Dr. Gillen speaks to Peter Jurgens, a serial murderer about Johan's possible involvement and gets a tragic reply. Johan confronts Robert about Stephen Joos. And Dr. Reichwen receives tragic news from the police.

Episodes.Title: Decision
Episodes.Description: Suspecting foul play in Robert's 'accidental' death fall, Dr. Reichwen makes some discoveries in his investigations. But as he later realizes, his investigations may have put him in harms way.

Episodes.Title: In Broad Daylight
Episodes.Description: Dr. Tenma and Dr. Reichwen finally meet. Dr. Reichwen intends to proof Dr. Tenma's innocence in the homicides, but Dr. Tenma has other ideas.

Episodes.Title: Sanctuary
Episodes.Description: Lotte, Frank and Karl are drifting apart. Lotte meets Nina Fortner and they become friends. Dr. Tenma searches for a perfect spot to shoot Johan.

Episodes.Title: A Child's View
Episodes.Description: Dieter learns of a life threatening game that children are playing. Mr. Schuwald decides to donate his whole book collection to the Munich University Library under the suggestion of Karl and Johan.

Episodes.Title: At the Edge of Darkness
Episodes.Description: The 'Margot Langer' impostor tries to blackmail Johan. Dr. Tenma helps a young 'doctor' at an illegal clinic

Episodes.Title: My Nameless Hero
Episodes.Description: Lunge tries to get into Dr. Tenma's mind by pretending to be him. Dr. Gillen learns something about Johan during an interview with a psychotic killer. Dr. Reichwen tries to warn the Lieberts of Johan's true nature. Dr. Tenma scouts for a perfect sniping location.

Episodes.Title: The Monster of Chaos
Episodes.Description: Dr. Reichwein reveals the true nature of Johan to Mr. Schuwald. Dr. Tenma gets ready to assassinate Johan. Lunge concludes that Dr. Tenma will kill Schuwald next. Lotte confronts Nina about Johan.

Episodes.Title: A Nameless Monster
Episodes.Description: The episode begins with a fairy tale about a Monster without a name. Nina reads the story from the picture book and has a sense of deja vu. Johan's evil plans for the book donation ceremony is carried out. Dr. Tenma meets a big obstacle in his attempt to kill Johan.

Episodes.Title: The Demon in My Eyes
Episodes.Description: Dr. Tenma has a gun pointed at Roberto, but Roberto has the rifle pointed at him. Nina, Dr.Reichwen and Dieter arrive to find the whole library in flames. People are trapped inside and the doors are all locked. Karl reads the report on his mother's life and death. Dr. Tenma tries to rescue those trapped in the building. Johan reveals the monster inside of him to Schuwald.

Episodes.Title: The Hell in His Eyes
Episodes.Description: Lunge, from the BKA, learns that Johan may indeed exist. Nina goes into regressive hypnosis to learn more about the picture book and her past. Mr. Schuwald has a message for Dr. Tenma and sends Karl to Dresden to pass it to him.

Episodes.Title: Grimmer
Episodes.Description: The episode introduces Grimmer. Grimmer is a freelance journalist doing an in-depth research into the abuses in the orphanages in East Germany. Grimmer meets with Dr. Tenma during their trip to Prague, and they become more acquainted when Tenma is faced with an immigration problem.

Episodes.Title: Ghosts of 511
Episodes.Description: Grimmer stubbornly stalks Petrov for his experimental research papers chronicaling the abuses at Kinderheim 511, but he gets a surprise instead.

Episodes.Title: The Adventures of the Magnificent Steiner
Episodes.Description: Grimmer has the key that Petrov gave him, and a former Czechoslovakian secret police organization wants it. Caught and tortured, Grimmer tells his abductors about 'the Magnificent Steiner'.

Episodes.Title: Detective Suk
Episodes.Description: A new inspector, detective Suk is on the case of Zeman's homicide. During his investigation, he discovers that there is more to Zeman's murder than first assumed. Suk also meets a lady whom he falls head over hills for

Episodes.Title: Double Darkness
Episodes.Description: After the death of his seniors, Suk is left to re-investigate case from the very beginning. He gets information from the orphans about a meeting with Grimmer. His intention to arrest Grimmer takes a different turn however when he gets deeper into the investigation. The episode also reveals that there is more to the nameless lady at the bar than she lets on.

Episodes.Title: The Monster's Afterimage
Episodes.Description: Suk is put under surveillance by the new commissioner. Together with Grimmer, Suk retrieves the tape and research papers from the deposit box. But their movements is watched by various sides.

Episodes.Title: Contact
Episodes.Description: Dr. Tenma learns about Suk's fugitive status from a journalist. And sets out to find him. Meanwhile, Suk and Grimmer goes into hiding, but is quickly found, surrounded and attacked by the STB. The STB's assault comes to a bloody end.

Episodes.Title: The Door to Nightmares
Episodes.Description: Nina's experience in Prague is a nightmare for her. Tenma and Grimmer meets with a top man in the Czechoslovakian STB. They are offered a deal which Grimmer refuses to accept.

Episodes.Title: The Scariest Thing
Episodes.Description: Johan visits Suk's mother. Tenma and Grimmer learns of his visit. They, including Col. Ranke, listen to Johan's tape. Lunge arrives in Prague for a 'holiday'. His investigation leads him to the sketches of Franz Bonaparta.

Episodes.Title: The Cruelest Thing
Episodes.Description: Grimmer and Tenma tries to stop Johan from subjecting Milo, one of the orphans, to one of the most cruel fate.

Episodes.Title: The Rose Mansion
Episodes.Description: Lunge investigates the secret behind the Red Rose Mansion. Tenma and Grimmer separate, but Tenma finds himself in trouble.

Episodes.Title: The Monster's Love Letter
Episodes.Description: Schubert, with the help of Reichwein, re-explores his past with Karl Neumann's real mother and realizes his link to Johan. As news of Tenma's arrest spreads, various people react with shock and horror, with the exception of Eva Heinemann, who is insistent that Tenma pay dearly for rejecting her. Suk tries to leave the hospital he is in to try to help Tenma, but is stopped by the Prague Police who inform him that Grimmer has sent a note to them exonerating Suk from any involvement of the deaths of the police officers. Runge also gets news of the arrest as well, but he is more interested in the Mansion of Red Roses, where he obtains a letter possibly addressed to the twins' mother. Tenma is deported back to Dusseldorf.

Episodes.Title: The Lawyer
Episodes.Description: Former patients of Eisler Memorial Hospital enlist the aid of Alfred Baul, a lawyer, to represent Tenma. Baul in turn asks for the assistance of Fritz Vardemann. Vardemann visits Tenma in prison, and agrees to take on the defense, but is then called to the hospital when his wife goes into labor with their first child. When Baul visits Tenma in prison, Tenma is shocked to see that Baul is Roberto. Roberto then says that Eva Heinemann will be his next target.

Episodes.Title: Determination
Episodes.Description: After hearing Roberto's threat against Eva, Tenma decides to confess to all charges against him so he can be placed in the same van transporting a prisoner to a Federal Penetentary as the prisoner is arranging for a jailbreak.

Episodes.Title: The Escape
Episodes.Description: Tenma and Milch are on the run with the injured Gustav and Helene. Eva finds her life in danger when she discovers that the attorney she's supposed to meet, Mr.Baul, is none other than Roberto.

Episodes.Title: Room 402
Episodes.Description: Dr. Tenma takes Verderman hostage in a desperate search for Eva. And Verderman's dark past is revealed.

Episodes.Title: The Neverending Journey
Episodes.Description: Nina and Dieter enters the Red Rose Mansion, but Nina faints from her disturbing experience. And they end up in the care of a puppeteer name Lipsky.

Episodes.Title: That Night
Episodes.Description: A flashback to Johan’s and Nina’s past, to the time before the Liebert’s homicides reveals the reason behind Johan’s killing. Police makes a startling discovery at the burnt down mansion. Tenma finally learns where Eva is. And Lunge reveals Lipsky’s true identity.

Episodes.Title: I Hate This Job
Episodes.Description: Martin, a hired hand, is hired by General Wolf's ex-associates to ‘take care’ of Eva. But his emotions get in the way of his orders.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Saw the Devil
Episodes.Description: Tenma manages to find Martin. A drunken Eva spots Johan at a party. Martin receives his final orders from his boss but his feelings gets in the way. And Martin gets way over his head when he tries to investigate Johan and his disciple, and the truth about his past is revealed.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Knew Too Much
Episodes.Description: Martin’s attempt to save Eva costs him his life, his last minutes with Tenma reveals a terrible secrets about Martin’s boss, Peter Chapek and the about the experiments.

Episodes.Title: The Door to Memories
Episodes.Description: Nina returns to the apartment that she lived in with her mother and Johan and encounters another memory. She then returns to Munich and Dr. Reichwein where she volunteers for hypnosis to find the truth behind these memories. After she nearly kills Dr. Gillen in a hypnotic rage, she leaves Dr. Reichwein's house to try to stop Tenma from killing her brother. Meanwhile, Suk and Vardemann team up to interview former residents of the Mansion of Red Roses to gather information on Franz Bonaparta's reading sessions with his picture books, and for Vardemann to find out more about his father's true involvement.

Episodes.Title: A Pleasant Dinner Table
Episodes.Description: While trying to escape from police in Frankfurt, Tenma is hit by a van. He awakes in the Turkish Quarter of the city, the same one that he saved from The Baby's plot. The man who saved him plans to kill Petr Capek at a convention, but he fails at this task and is shot dead. Nina, in Frankfurt, sees the picture of Petr Capek and it triggers yet another memory.

Episodes.Title: Unrelated Murders
Episodes.Description: Egon Weisbach was one of the first investigators in the murder of the Liebert parents. On his last day on the job before retirement, he is escorting a convicted serial murderer but wants to know why he killed someone who did not fit his modus operandi. At the same time, Dr. Gillen is interviewing several murderers wondering why they killed someone who also did not fit their usual targets. Both realize that all these criminals committed murders outside their usual scope at the request of a young man, presumably Johan.

Episodes.Title: The Baby's Depression
Episodes.Description: The Baby is killed by a prostitute, and his death sends shockwaves in Petr Capek's organization. Capek becomes paranoid as to who is loyal or not and accidentally kills one of his guards. He makes it to his cottage where Johan is waiting for him.

Episodes.Title: Johan's Footprints
Episodes.Description: Capek tries to berate Johan for his actions and tells him that everything should be done according to Capek's plans but Johan simply disagrees and disappears. Capek realizes his hold on his organization is crumbling and has his men pick up Nina in Frankfurt. Eva accosts the young man who was introduced to Johan, Christof Sievernich, demanding answers.

Episodes.Title: Welcome Home
Episodes.Description: Capek reveals to Nina that her and her twin brother Johan are the products of a eugenics experiment designed to breed "the perfect children". Tenma has wounded Christof and is driving him and Eva to the hospital while demanding answers on Petr Capek. While Eva makes a phone call at a payphone, Tenma sneaks away.

Episodes.Title: I'm Back
Episodes.Description: Nina confronts Johan who presents her with a story on what happened when many people were poisoned at the Mansion of Red Roses. Nina realizes that she was the one who witnessed these deaths, the shock of this revelation nearly drives her to suicide, but she is saved by Tenma. Capek is gunned down by members of his organization when they find out about the guard that Capek killed.

Episodes.Title: Ruhenheim
Episodes.Description: With a postcard obtained by Lipsky, Lunge arrives in Ruhenheim. There he meets up with Grimmer, whose research has led him to this town as well. A working-class couple in this town realize they win the lottery and fearing that everyone else wants to kill them, the husband buys an arsenal of weapons.

Episodes.Title: The Peaceful House
Episodes.Description: Lunge and Grimmer conclude something terrible is happening in Ruhenheim when random gunshots ring out, people are either murdered or disappearing, and any links out of town is flooded by torrential rain. As Nina recovers in a nearby hospital, Tenma, using a lead from Capek, travels to Prague and meets with Lipsky and determines that Johan is in Ruhenheim.

Episodes.Title: The Town Massacre
Episodes.Description: As time passes, more people in Ruhenheim are being shot dead by mysterious people and each other. Both Grimmer and Lunge determine that the owner of a local hotel is Klaus Poppe, also known as Franz Bonaparta. After subduing a man who was giving weapons to everyone in the town, they obtain information that one of the ringleaders is in a second hotel.

Episodes.Title: The Wrath of the Magnificent Steiner
Episodes.Description: Tenma runs into Lunge, the latter apologizing for his previous accusations against Tenma. Nina and Dr. Gillen rush to Ruhenheim. After the winning lottery couple is wounded in an attack on Bonaparta's hotel, Grimmer rushes out to the streets to reason with the unknown assailants.

Episodes.Title: A Nameless Man
Episodes.Description: Lunge confronts Roberto, one of the ringleaders, in a hotel room. Both are subsequently wounded in the fight. Nina and Gillen arrive in Ruhenheim where they find a house containing drawings of the two twins by Bonaparta. This triggers a final memory and the secret to Johan's madness and motives, his quest for true solitude, as well as forgiveness for his actions. Bonaparta accompanies Tenma on his quest to find and kill Johan.

Episodes.Title: Scenery for a Doomsday
Episodes.Description: Bonaparta attempts to shoot Johan dead, but is gunned down by Roberto, who dies of his own injuries soon afterwards. With the massacre now over, authorities rush into the town and attempt to determine what happened. Just as an officer is about to arrest Dr. Tenma, an ambulance worker arrives asking for Tenma's assistance.

Episodes.Title: The Real Monster
Episodes.Description: It has been some time since the tragic blood battle, and everyone is working hard to put their lives back to normal. Tenma finally locates a woman he has been searching for, and she reveals some startling information.

Episodes.Title: It's my duty to protect and raise you until adult.
I wouldn't trade you for anything in the world.
Grandma, Dad must have found out.
You were the same when you were my age.
Did you go somewhere with President Dong?
I'm guessing you want to erase every trace of Mom.
Will you just stare at it?
That's right. Ok Mirae. I have you.
It's only natural to miss your birth parents.
It's late. I have to work tomorrow.
What will happen if they find out?
I'd like to rent my place.
Suji, these were made by Mirae, not you?
Please give me time to come up with a plan.
Why? Is there a problem, Gangsan?
Why are you flirting with my brother-in-law?
She will find some solace, Gangsan.
I will never give up Ok Mirae.
No, It's fine, I'll take it.
Could it be because I'm an adoptee?
Did you put a tail on me?!
Then did you lie to me..?
Your Dad will soon have a new girlfriend.
I should rip this up for Seonju's sake..
You said you wanted to dance your sorrows away.
Why would he remarry, Ms. Choi?
Is what Grandpa said really true..?
This is quite a clever move.
Who are you? Do you know Juhyeok..?
Horang, why are you beating about the bush?
She's picking a fight to extort money from us!
How shameless are you to ask for forgiveness?
Liar. You're out with your mother-in-law-to-be.
If you don't let up, I'll call the police.
I'll feel too bad and ashamed to face you.
You just said you had feelings for my dad.
You're trying to bribe me to seduce my dad.
I'm not interested in you either, so knock it off.
He is desperately waiting for my daughter!
Why were you waiting out here..?
Oh? You have a piece of styrofoam on your hair.
Come on! We must leave now.
What are you doing? Please stop..!
Please give a round of applause for Mr. Geum!
Mirae, Are you defending Mr. Geum?
Oh! Mr. Geum, I'll help you!
How did you know where I was?
Please help me find my wife...
Otherwise, I can make you disappear, Ms. Cha.
You know something about my wife?
I can't marry him. I don't love Juhyeok anymore.
I told you to stay away from my fiancée!
Jandi used to do this for me.
You are disrespectful to Ms. Ok.
I don't want him to ruin his life because of me.
Mirae, don't you know that he's an ex-con?
Why on earth did he show up?
Go to your ex-con birth father right away.
You know well what a great person your father is.
I do have feelings for you, Gangsan.
I won't let go of you either.
Who is that woman with him?
Who was it that you can't say?
Aren't you too little to be thieving?
Yes. It definitely won't be easy with Gangsan.
I don't think I can live without him.
I will never let you be with my daughter!
We'll see if you can defend that love.
How do you have my mom's exact looks and name?
Are you here to enroll your child?
I will stay by their side no matter what.
Mother, I want to move out.
I should go and introduce myself as your wife.
Please break up with my dad.
Ms. Ok, I'm going to quit the academy.
Sweetheart, did you miss me that much?
What do you mean mom returned for my bone marrow?
Jandi is my daughter. She is mine.
I don't want Mom to end up like that.
My dad is not my birth dad.
Thank you for being my daughter.
