Episodes.Description: Leo stows away aboard Terra Venture, joining a training mission where he meets Kendrix, Kai, and his brother Mike. After Maya arrives from planet Mirinoi seeking help against the villain Furio, the group travels through a portal to defend her world.

Episodes.Title: Quasar Quest (2)
Episodes.Description: Kai, Damon, and Alpha 6 revive the Astro Megaship to rescue the team on Mirinoi. Mike, Kendrix, Maya, Kai, and Damon claim the Quasar Sabers, becoming Power Rangers. Furio petrifies Mirinoi, and Mike sacrifices himself, passing his saber to Leo.

Episodes.Title: Race to the Rescue
Episodes.Description: Maya senses five captive Galactabeasts. The Rangers rescue them, gaining powerful allies to defend Terra Venture from Scorpius' monsters.

Episodes.Title: Rookie in Red
Episodes.Description: Leo joins Terra Venture's military but accidentally leaves a weapons vault unlocked, leading to a monster stealing the arsenal. He must reclaim the weapons to prove his worth.

Episodes.Title: Homesick
Episodes.Description: A stowaway boy tries to redirect Terra Venture back to Earth. Meanwhile, Furio launches an attack, forcing the Rangers to protect the colony.

Episodes.Title: The Lights of Orion
Episodes.Description: Furio sends a monster impersonating Mike to trick Leo into revealing the location of the Lights of Orion, a legendary power source.

Episodes.Title: Double Duty
Episodes.Description: Kendrix meets an actress who looks identical to her. When the actress feigns injury, Kendrix takes her place on a film set, only to battle a monster seeking the Lights of Orion.

Episodes.Title: The Blue Crush
Episodes.Description: Kai develops a crush on Commander Stanton's daughter while rollerblading, but romance takes a backseat when a monster attacks Terra Venture.

Episodes.Title: The Magna Defender
Episodes.Description: Leo battles Furio, who self-destructs after being defeated. Leo is saved by the mysterious Magna Defender, who emerges from a cave holding him.

Episodes.Title: The Sunflower Search
Episodes.Description: A monster believes the Lights of Orion are hidden in a sunflower statue. The Magna Defender reveals his tragic past and motive for vengeance against Scorpius.

Episodes.Title: Silent Sleep
Episodes.Description: A monster freezes Terra Venture's population to search for the Lights of Orion. Only Leo (protected by Mike's dog tags) and the Magna Defender remain unfrozen.

Episodes.Title: Orion Rising
Episodes.Description: Kendrix and Maya argue but must unite when a monster traps part of Terra Venture in a force field, seeking the Lights of Orion undisturbed.

Episodes.Title: Orion Returns
Episodes.Description: The Rangers, Scorpius, and Treacheron race to claim the Lights of Orion. The Scorpion Stinger damages the Astro Megaship, forcing the Rangers to pursue the Lights in Jet Jammers.

Episodes.Title: Shark Attack
Episodes.Description: Treacheron is framed as a traitor. Freed by the Shark brothers, he invades Terra Venture to capture Trakeena for revenge against Scorpius.

Episodes.Title: Redemption Day
Episodes.Description: The damaged Scorpion Stinger attempts to steal fuel from Terra Venture. The Magna Defender exploits this by destabilizing a volcano, endangering the colony for his vengeance.

Episodes.Title: Destined for Greatness
Episodes.Description: Skelecron captures four Rangers to power his warriors. Leo and Mike free them, with Mike embracing his destiny as the new Magna Defender to save the Galaxy Megazord.

Episodes.Title: Stolen Beauty
Episodes.Description: Trakeena sends a monster to steal beauty from Terra Venture's women. Disguised as a civilian, she tries to poison Mike, but he outwits her and reverses the theft.

Episodes.Title: The Rescue Mission
Episodes.Description: Mike leads a team to investigate a derelict ship, where a spider monster captures the crew. He and Leo free them, retrieving a mysterious book before the ship explodes.

Episodes.Title: The Lost Galactabeasts (1)
Episodes.Description: Deviot arrives with three powerful Zords (Stratoforce, Centaurus, Zenith) to attack Terra Venture. The Galactabeasts refuse to fight, forcing the Rangers to seek answers in the Galaxy Book.

Episodes.Title: The Lost Galactabeasts (2)
Episodes.Description: The Rangers decode the Galaxy Book to free the Galactabeasts from Deviot's control. They unite to defeat Deviot's Zords and protect Terra Venture.

Episodes.Title: Heir to the Throne
Episodes.Description: Trakeena escapes planet Onyx after Deviot orchestrates Scorpius' death. She assumes command of his army, preventing Deviot from using her transformation cocoon.

Episodes.Title: An Evil Game
Episodes.Description: Trakeena captures Leo to avenge her father. Their duel is interrupted when Deviot's assassins target Trakeena, allowing Leo to escape amid the chaos.

Episodes.Title: Memories of Mirinoi
Episodes.Description: Maya's friend Shondra appears on Terra Venture, but Kendrix suspects her. Maya discovers Shondra stealing the Galaxy Book, revealing her as one of Trakeena's monsters.

Episodes.Title: Green Courage
Episodes.Description: Trakeena takes High Commander Renier hostage, demanding a mechanic to fix the Scorpion Stinger. Damon volunteers, while Leo infiltrates the ship to rescue the Commander.

Episodes.Title: Blue to the Test
Episodes.Description: A monster mind-controls Commander Stanton into steering Terra Venture into a star. Kai disobeys orders to expose the plot and save the colony.

Episodes.Title: Mean Wheels Mantis
Episodes.Description: A motorcycle-riding monster kidnaps Maya and Kendrix. The Rangers race to rescue them, with Leo upgrading his bike to the Capsular Cycle to win.

Episodes.Title: Loyax's Last Battle
Episodes.Description: Trakeena sends the fallen hero Loyax to Terra Venture for a final battle. Maya convinces him to redeem himself, but Deviot destroys him.

Episodes.Title: A Red Romance
Episodes.Description: Leo pursues a romance with Hannah, whose overprotective brother complicates matters. When a monster abducts Hannah, Leo must save her and defeat the threat.

Episodes.Title: The Chameliac Warrior
Episodes.Description: Trakeena hires Chameliac, a warrior who copies opponents' fighting styles. The Rangers defeat him by unpredictably switching tactics.

Episodes.Title: To the Tenth Power
Episodes.Description: Deviot revives the Psycho Rangers. The Space Rangers arrive to help the Galaxy Rangers combat these deadly foes in a high-stakes battle.

Episodes.Title: The Power of Pink
Episodes.Description: Psycho Pink uses the Savage Sword against Cassie (Pink Space Ranger). Kendrix sacrifices herself to destroy the sword, dying in the process. Karone (Andros' sister) is chosen as the new Pink Ranger.

Episodes.Title: Protect the Quasar Saber
Episodes.Description: Karone, disguised as Astronema, steals the Pink Quasar Saber from an auction on Onyx. She delivers it to the Rangers, officially joining them as the new Pink Galaxy Ranger.

Episodes.Title: Facing the Past
Episodes.Description: Karone helps Leo regain his powers after the Magnetox monster drains them. Confronted by visions of her evil past as Astronema, she overcomes her guilt and obtains a key that restores Leo's abilities with enhanced armor.

Episodes.Title: Turn Up the Volume
Episodes.Description: Damon competes for chief mechanic against rival Baxter, who steals his plans. They must team up to defeat a monster attacking Terra Venture's systems.

Episodes.Title: Enter the Lost Galaxy
Episodes.Description: Deviot reads forbidden words from the Galaxy Book, transporting Terra Venture into the mysterious Lost Galaxy. The Rangers confront space pirates led by Captain Mutiny.

Episodes.Title: Beware the Mutiny
Episodes.Description: Captain Mutiny and Deviot enslave Terra Venture's citizens to mine for 'Earth.' The Rangers battle Mutiny's forces to free the colony.

Episodes.Title: Grunchor on the Loose
Episodes.Description: The colossal monster Grunchor burrows into Terra Venture. The Rangers must evacuate citizens and defeat it before it destroys the colony.

Episodes.Title: Until Sunset
Episodes.Description: Leo and Damon are captured by Deviot, reminiscing about past adventures. The other Rangers race to rescue them before Mutiny's deadline.

Episodes.Title: Dream Battle
Episodes.Description: Hexuba uses magic to trap the Rangers in nightmares. They must conquer their fears to wake up and save Terra Venture. (No stream link available)

Episodes.Title: Hexuba's Graveyard
Episodes.Description: Hexuba resurrects defeated monsters to attack the Rangers. The team fights their past foes in a climactic showdown.

Episodes.Title: Raise the Titanisaur
Episodes.Description: Captain Mutiny unleashes the Titanisaur, a gargantuan monster. The Rangers deploy all Zords in a desperate battle to protect Terra Venture.

Episodes.Title: Escape the Lost Galaxy
Episodes.Description: Mike sacrifices his Magna Defender powers to hold open a portal for Terra Venture's escape. Deviot betrays Mutiny and returns to Trakeena.

Episodes.Title: Journey's End (1)
Episodes.Description: Trakeena fuses with Deviot in Scorpius' cocoon, becoming a powerful insectoid monster. She cripples Terra Venture, forcing the evacuation to a nearby planet.

Episodes.Title: Journey's End (2)
Episodes.Description: Trakeena sets Terra Venture's wreckage on a collision course with a planet. The Rangers destroy her ship using the Astro Megaship's self-destruct, stranding Leo on a moon.

Episodes.Title: Journey's End (3)
Episodes.Description: Trakeena attacks Leo in Terra Venture's wreckage. Using his Battlizer armor, Leo defeats her but nearly dies. The Galactabeasts guide the colony to safety on Mirinoi, restoring its petrified people and reviving Kendrix.

Episodes.Title: Force from the Future (1)
Episodes.Description: In 3000 AD, mutant criminal Ransik escapes captivity, killing Red Ranger Alex Drake. Alex's team pursues him to 2001, where they recruit his ancestor Wes Collins to unlock their morphers.

Episodes.Title: Force from the Future (2)
Episodes.Description: Wes reluctantly uses Alex's morpher to help the Rangers battle Ransik. Though initially dismissed by Jen, he proves his worth during a mutant attack.

Episodes.Title: Something to Fight For
Episodes.Description: Wes questions his privileged life after Jen challenges his motivations. He earns the right to become the permanent Red Ranger by helping defeat a mutant attack.

Episodes.Title: Ransik Lives
Episodes.Description: Wes offers the Rangers shelter in his father's clock tower. During a painting job, Ransik takes Wes hostage and reveals the discrimination mutants face in the future.

Episodes.Title: A Blue Streak
Episodes.Description: Lucas must get a 2001 driver's license after being cited for speeding. A mutant challenges him to a high-speed chase during his driving test.

Episodes.Title: A Parting of Ways
Episodes.Description: Wes defies his father to rescue children held hostage by mutants. After publicly exposing his father's lack of charity, Wes moves into the clock tower.

Episodes.Title: Short-Circuited
Episodes.Description: Nadira kidnaps Circuit to prevent Megazord summoning. Trip must use his psychic powers against orders to locate their robotic ally during a mutant attack.

Episodes.Title: Jen's Revenge
Episodes.Description: Jen makes a dangerous deal with mutant Fat Catfish to locate Ransik, seeking personal vengeance for Alex's death.

Episodes.Title: The Time Shadow
Episodes.Description: When Bio-Lab's tank and the Megazord fail against a mutant, a mysterious ally from the future sends the Time Shadow zord.

Episodes.Title: Future Unknown
Episodes.Description: Ransik's actions alter the future, making Katie question their mission. Each Ranger must find personal motivation to stop Frax's new mutant.

Episodes.Title: Uniquely Trip
Episodes.Description: Trip loses confidence in his abilities and tries to imitate his teammates, learning to embrace his unique strengths instead.

Episodes.Title: Worlds Apart
Episodes.Description: Mr. Collins publicly shames Wes for working menial jobs. The Silver Guardians impress the Rangers during a Cyclobot attack, leading Eric to discover Wes is a Ranger.

Episodes.Title: The Quantum Quest
Episodes.Description: Ransik seeks the Quantum Controller uncovered by archaeologists. A rogue Silver Guardian activates it, becoming the Quantum Ranger.

Episodes.Title: Clash for Control (1)
Episodes.Description: Ransik sends Commandcom to steal the Quantum Rex zord. Eric refuses to surrender the Quantum Morpher and pursues the thief through time with Wes.

Episodes.Title: Clash for Control (2)
Episodes.Description: The Quantum Rex rampages through Silver Hills. Mr. Collins offers the Time Force Rangers positions in the Silver Guardians while Wes tries to reason with Eric.

Episodes.Title: Bodyguard in Blue
Episodes.Description: Dr. Zaskin is kidnapped by Nadira. His daughter Holly hires Lucas as a bodyguard, forcing him to reveal his Ranger identity while protecting her from mutants.

Episodes.Title: The Legend of the Clock Tower
Episodes.Description: Katie experiences a time-displaced adventure involving the clock tower's ghostly legend while the Rangers repair its mechanism.

Episodes.Title: Trust and Triumph
Episodes.Description: Jen's distrust of Wes allows Nadira to escape. Trapped in another dimension, they must learn teamwork to rescue their teammates.

Episodes.Title: Trip Takes a Stand
Episodes.Description: Trip befriends gentle mutant Notacon, who is forcibly weaponized by Frax. He must protect Notacon from Eric's destructive intentions.

Episodes.Title: Quantum Secrets
Episodes.Description: Eric is captured by mutant Conwing, who steals his morpher and controls the Q-Rex. Eric discovers the morpher's origin with help from the future.

Episodes.Title: Lovestruck Rangers
Episodes.Description: Male Rangers clash over attraction to Angelique. Jen discovers Angelique is a mutant controlling the team, forcing her and Katie to free them.

Episodes.Title: The Last Race
Episodes.Description: Nadira releases racer mutant Dash, who challenges Lucas to a high-stakes race. Dash plans to honor their agreement, but Nadira interferes.

Episodes.Title: Full Exposure
Episodes.Description: A tabloid photographer hires Katie to help photograph Rangers unmasked. She must warn the team while protecting their identities.

Episodes.Title: Movie Madness (1)
Episodes.Description: Ransik traps the Rangers in film genres. They battle movie-themed monsters while navigating classic cinema tropes.

Episodes.Title: Movie Madness (2)
Episodes.Description: The Rangers continue fighting through movie dimensions to escape Ransik's cinematic prison and return to reality.

Episodes.Title: Time Force Traitor
Episodes.Description: The Rangers suspect a traitor when Ransik anticipates their strategies. Internal distrust threatens to fracture the team.

Episodes.Title: Frax's Fury
Episodes.Description: Frax rebels against Ransik after constant humiliation. He creates powerful monsters to destroy both Ransik and the Rangers.

Episodes.Title: Dawn of Destiny
Episodes.Description: Ransik forces Dr. Zaskin to create a cure for his mutation. The Rangers confront Ransik during his transformation crisis.

Episodes.Title: Fight Against Fate
Episodes.Description: Ransik learns of his future defeat. He attempts to change destiny by eliminating the Rangers before they can fulfill their roles.

Episodes.Title: Destiny Defeated
Episodes.Description: The Rangers seemingly defeat Ransik, altering the future. They face consequences for changing history while returning to 3000 AD.

Episodes.Title: Undercover Rangers
Episodes.Description: The Rangers go undercover at Silver Guardians headquarters to investigate suspicious activities, testing Eric's loyalty.

Episodes.Title: Beware the Knight
Episodes.Description: A medieval-themed mutant creates chaos. The Rangers must combat ancient weaponry while protecting historical reenactors.

Episodes.Title: Time for Lightspeed
Episodes.Description: The Time Force Rangers team up with the Lightspeed Rescue Rangers to combat a joint threat from Ransik and demon queen Olympius.

Episodes.Title: Reflections of Evil
Episodes.Description: A mirror-themed mutant creates evil duplicates of the Rangers. The team must confront their darker selves to prevail.

Episodes.Title: Nadira's Dream Date
Episodes.Description: Nadira kidnaps a celebrity for a dream date. The Rangers must rescue him while navigating her unpredictable powers.

Episodes.Title: Circuit Unsure
Episodes.Description: Circuit malfunctions during a critical battle, forcing Trip to repair him mid-fight while the Rangers face Ransik's new monster.

Episodes.Title: A Calm Before the Storm
Episodes.Description: Ransik prepares his final assault as the Rangers strengthen alliances. Tensions rise before the climactic battle.

Episodes.Title: The End of Time (1)
Episodes.Description: Ransik launches an all-out attack on Silver Hills. The Rangers make their final stand as the city descends into chaos.

Episodes.Title: The End of Time (2)
Episodes.Description: Ransik critically injures Jen. Wes and Eric pursue him through time as the remaining Rangers protect Silver Hills.

Episodes.Title: The End of Time (3)
Episodes.Description: Wes confronts Ransik in 3000 AD. Nadira's redemption and Ransik's surrender conclude the battle, with the Rangers choosing their futures.

Episodes.Title: Lionheart
Episodes.Description: Cole Evans joins four Power Rangers on the Animarium to battle Orgs after discovering his red lion crystal. The team forms the Wild Force Megazord for the first time.

Episodes.Title: Darkness Awakening
Episodes.Description: Master Org resurfaces as the Rangers learn to combine their Wild Zords into the Megazord. Cole attempts to reason with the heartless Orgs.

Episodes.Title: Click, Click, Zoom
Episodes.Description: Camera Org turns citizens invisible. Cole defies Taylor's leadership rules to rescue the team, leading to a reconciliation.

Episodes.Title: Never Give Up!
Episodes.Description: Max is captured by Bell Org after Danny neglects teamwork. Danny overcomes his fear of heights to rescue Max.

Episodes.Title: Ancient Awakening
Episodes.Description: Alyssa discovers an ancient emblem in a cave, leading to the summoning of the Elephant Zord to defeat Tire Org.

Episodes.Title: Wishes on the Water
Episodes.Description: Max tosses a wish into Turtle Cove lake, but Ship Org emerges with the bottle. The Giraffe Zord helps defeat the Org.

Episodes.Title: The Bear Necessities
Episodes.Description: Taylor discovers twin boys who transform into Bear Zords to help defeat Cell Phone Org and restore morphing abilities.

Episodes.Title: Soul Searching
Episodes.Description: Cole searches for the Soul Bird to heal the injured Red Lion Zord, encountering Master Org who recognizes Cole's family photo.

Episodes.Title: Soul Bird Salvation
Episodes.Description: Retinax freezes the Zords, but a hatched Soul Bird restores their powers, enabling the Rangers to defeat the Duke Org.

Episodes.Title: Curse of the Wolf
Episodes.Description: Nayzor releases Zen-Aku, who defeats the Rangers and steals the Elephant power orb using dark magic.

Episodes.Title: Battle of the Zords
Episodes.Description: Zen-Aku summons Dark Wild Zords after saving Alyssa from Toxica and Jindrax, escalating the conflict.

Episodes.Title: Predazord, Awaken
Episodes.Description: Zen-Aku combines Dark Zords into the Predazord, stealing the Giraffe Power Animal from the Rangers.

Episodes.Title: Revenge of Zen-Aku
Episodes.Description: Zen-Aku kidnaps Princess Shayla and frees Motorcycle Org. Shayla's necklace triggers his suppressed memories.

Episodes.Title: Identity Crisis
Episodes.Description: Nayzor manipulates Zen-Aku into believing he is pure evil, intensifying his attacks on the Rangers.

Episodes.Title: The Ancient Warrior
Episodes.Description: Animus reveals Zen-Aku's true identity as Merrick, an ancient warrior cursed by the Org mask.

Episodes.Title: The Lone Wolf
Episodes.Description: Merrick battles Quadra Org alone to retrieve stolen Animal Crystals, regaining his Lunar Wolf Ranger powers.

Episodes.Title: Power Play
Episodes.Description: Toxica becomes General Org Necronomica. Merrick helps defeat her using his Wolf Savage Cycle.

Episodes.Title: Secrets and Lies
Episodes.Description: Signal Org erases Cole's memory. Alyssa discovers Cole's parents are presumed dead.

Episodes.Title: The Tornado Spin
Episodes.Description: Max learns a bowling technique called the Tornado Spin to defeat Bowling Org, reviving his mentor's spirit.

Episodes.Title: Three's a Crowd
Episodes.Description: Danny competes for Kendall's affection while battling Wedding Dress Org, revealing his identity as the Black Ranger.

Episodes.Title: A Father's Footsteps
Episodes.Description: Alyssa uses her father's martial arts training to defeat Samurai Org and protect Turtle Cove.

Episodes.Title: Sing Song
Episodes.Description: Shayla and Merrick sing to awaken the Deer Zord, helping the Rangers defeat Tombstone Org.

Episodes.Title: The Wings of Animaria
Episodes.Description: Cole uses the Falcon Summoner to defeat the resurrected Nayzor, forming the Isis Megazord.

Episodes.Title: Reinforcements from the Future, Part 1
Episodes.Description: Time Force Rangers Wes and Eric arrive in Turtle Cove, teaming with Wild Force to battle Mut-Orgs.

Episodes.Title: Reinforcements from the Future, Part 2
Episodes.Description: Ransik destroys the Mut-Orgs' mutant halves, allowing 12 Rangers to defeat the hybrids in a joint battle.

Episodes.Title: The Master's Last Stand
Episodes.Description: Master Org kidnaps four Rangers and reveals his origin to Cole. Toxica and Jindrax find new leadership in Mandilok.

Episodes.Title: Unfinished Business
Episodes.Description: Zen-Aku returns to merge with Merrick, who must accept his friends' help to defeat his past darkness.

Episodes.Title: Homecoming
Episodes.Description: Cole befriends a boy named Kite, who helps defeat Mandilok's Duke Orgs Artilla and Helicos.

Episodes.Title: The Flute
Episodes.Description: Flute Org forces citizens to dance uncontrollably. Animus intervenes to save the Rangers.

Episodes.Title: Team Carnival
Episodes.Description: Jindrax teams with his brother Juggelo to destroy the Rangers at an amusement park, leading to Juggelo's demise.

Episodes.Title: Taming of the Zords
Episodes.Description: Lion Tamer Org controls the Wild Zords. Kite frees them using mysterious powers.

Episodes.Title: Monitoring Earth
Episodes.Description: Mandilok turns Kite against humanity. Kite reveals himself as Animus and removes the Wild Zords.

Episodes.Title: The Soul of Humanity
Episodes.Description: The Rangers battle Toy Org without Zords. Animus restores their powers after witnessing human courage.

Episodes.Title: Forever Red
Episodes.Description: Cole teams with nine previous Red Rangers to stop the Machine Empire from reactivating Serpentera on the moon.

Episodes.Title: The Master's Herald, Part 1
Episodes.Description: Duke Org Onikage infiltrates the Animarium, kidnaps Princess Shayla, and creates Shadow Rangers.

Episodes.Title: The Master's Herald, Part 2
Episodes.Description: Onikage is destroyed by the Pegasus Megazord, but Master Org escapes with Princess Shayla.

Episodes.Title: Fishing for a Friend
Episodes.Description: Jindrax manipulates Rangers and Locomotive Org to re-energize Toxica's horn, reviving her from the spirit world.

Episodes.Title: Sealing the Nexus
Episodes.Description: Rangers battle resurrected Org Generals to disable the Nexus forcefield, enabling Toxica and Jindrax to rescue Shayla.

Episodes.Title: The End of the Power Rangers, Part 1
Episodes.Description: With villains seemingly defeated, the Rangers prepare to disband. Master Org returns as a new threat emerges.

Episodes.Title: The End of the Power Rangers, Part 2
Episodes.Description: Master Org's final assault forces the Rangers into a last battle for Earth and the Animarium.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the Jungle (1)
Episodes.Description: Casey Rhodes, Lily Chilman, and Theo Martin are chosen as guardians of the imprisoned Dai Shi. When the arrogant Jarrod accidentally releases Dai Shi, the trio seeks their new master, RJ, at Jungle Karma Pizza.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the Jungle (2)
Episodes.Description: The new Rangers adjust to their roles under RJ's guidance while battling Camille and Rinshi warriors flooding Ocean Bluff.

Episodes.Title: Sigh of the Tiger
Episodes.Description: Casey questions RJ's training methods while Buffalord attacks. Fran defends Jungle Karma Pizza from a chaotic birthday party.

Episodes.Title: A Taste of Poison
Episodes.Description: Dai Shi reveals himself in Jarrod's body and deploys the Five Fingers of Poison. Lily battles Rantipede after a nightmare about Jarrod.

Episodes.Title: Can't Win Them All
Episodes.Description: Theo's confidence shatters after losing to Gakko. RJ trains him to regain his skills while Casey and Lily protect the city alone.

Episodes.Title: Dance the Night Away
Episodes.Description: Tension between Theo and Casey escalates when Lily befriends Casey. Stingerella and Toady use dance rhythms to overpower the Rangers.

Episodes.Title: Pizza Slice of Life
Episodes.Description: RJ leaves Casey in charge of Jungle Karma Pizza, leading to chaos. Camille confronts Naja's plot to overthrow Dai Shi.

Episodes.Title: Way of the Master
Episodes.Description: Lily seeks the Jungle Mace from retired Master Phant to defeat Pangolin. Dai Shi prepares to resurrect the Sky Overlord.

Episodes.Title: Good Karma, Bad Karma
Episodes.Description: Casey's $5 tip is stolen by a boy named Josh. Carnisoar erases Jarrod's past good deeds to strengthen Dai Shi's control.

Episodes.Title: Blind Leading the Blind
Episodes.Description: Theo trains with blind Master Swoop to master Bat Spirit techniques. The Rangers battle Carnisoar's aerial warriors Bai Lai and Carden.

Episodes.Title: Pushed to the Edge
Episodes.Description: Camille seeks Lily's advice after Carnisoar's harsh training of Jarrod. She summons Sea Overlord Jellica, who trains Dai Shi instead.

Episodes.Title: One Master Too Many
Episodes.Description: RJ feels sidelined when Casey's second master, Shark technique expert Master Finn (RJ's father), arrives. Jellica unleashes Crustaceo.

Episodes.Title: Ghost of a Chance (1)
Episodes.Description: Overconfident Rangers are defeated by Dai Shi. RJ sacrifices himself to spare them, leaving them masterless.

Episodes.Title: Ghost of a Chance (2)
Episodes.Description: The Rangers enter the spirit world to rescue RJ and confront childhood fears. Fran discovers their secret identities.

Episodes.Title: Bad to the Bone
Episodes.Description: Lily's kindness backfires when Porcupongo's quill makes her rude. Fran helps her regain her true self.

Episodes.Title: Friends Don't Fade Away
Episodes.Description: RJ struggles with controlling his Wolf spirit after battling Dai Shi, becoming a threat to others. He learns to rely on friends.

Episodes.Title: No 'I' in Leader
Episodes.Description: RJ reassures Casey of his leadership role after joining as the Wolf Ranger. Grizzaka rebels against Dai Shi's command.

Episodes.Title: True Friends, True Spirits
Episodes.Description: RJ saves Flit from Grizzaka's curse, restoring harmony with his animal spirit. Flit becomes an ally.

Episodes.Title: Path of the Rhino
Episodes.Description: Dominic joins the Rangers as the Rhino Ranger after learning their identities, fulfilling his destiny from Master Mao.

Episodes.Title: Dash for the Dagger
Episodes.Description: Jarrod finds the Rhino Nexus and seeks the Control Dagger. Dominic races to protect it, but Camille delivers it to Dai Shi.

Episodes.Title: Race to the Nexus
Episodes.Description: Dai Shi, the Rangers, and the Overlords clash over the Rhino Nexus. Dominic unlocks its power with his friends' help.

Episodes.Title: Arise the Crystal Eyes
Episodes.Description: The Rangers protect the Crystal Eyes from Dai Shi and the Overlords, which can resurrect the Phantom Beasts.

Episodes.Title: Fear and the Phantoms
Episodes.Description: The Phantom Beasts return and capture three masters to create the Spirit Rangers—evil counterparts to the Jungle Fury team.

Episodes.Title: Blue Ranger, Twin Danger
Episodes.Description: RJ devises a plan to stop the Spirit Rangers. He risks everything to save his father and the other masters from evil control.

Episodes.Title: One Last Second Chance
Episodes.Description: Camille hosts a twisted game show testing the Rangers' knowledge of past events. Wrong answers risk 'cancellation'.

Episodes.Title: Don't Blow That Dough
Episodes.Description: Whiger steals Casey's Tiger Spirit, weakening him. Dai Shi becomes the Phantom Beast King and promotes Camille.

Episodes.Title: Tigers Fall, Lions Rise
Episodes.Description: Dai Shi strips Whiger of power for failing to kill Casey. Casey shows kindness, making Whiger reconsider his allegiance.

Episodes.Title: The Spirit of Kindness
Episodes.Description: Camille steals a cloning formula from Maryl to duplicate monkeys. Scorch and Snapper plot against her out of jealousy.

Episodes.Title: Maryl and the Monkeys
Episodes.Description: Camille's monkey cloning plan backfires. Scorch and Snapper sabotage her, exposing their jealousy of Dai Shi's favoritism.

Episodes.Title: To Earn Your Stripes
Episodes.Description: Casey trains to regain his Tiger Spirit. Jarrod's humanity resurfaces, weakening Dai Shi's control as the final battle looms.

Episodes.Title: Path of the Righteous
Episodes.Description: Jarrod breaks free from Dai Shi with Camille's help. They join the Rangers for the ultimate showdown against the Phantom Beasts.

Episodes.Title: Now the Final Fury
Episodes.Description: The Rangers and allies unleash their animal spirits to defeat Dai Shi. Jarrod and Camille redeem themselves in an epic conclusion.

Episodes.Title: The Road to Corinth
Episodes.Description: As humanity retreats into Corinth, mysterious drifter Dillon arrives with Ziggy. The Rangers defend the city against Venjix's Attack Bot.

Episodes.Title: Fade to Black
Episodes.Description: Dillon is discovered to have Venjix tech inside him. The Rangers recruit him for Series Black after he protects Ziggy.

Episodes.Title: Rain
Episodes.Description: Dillon accepts the Black Ranger role on one condition: Ziggy's release from prison.

Episodes.Title: Go for the Green
Episodes.Description: Ziggy bonds with the Green Morpher to prevent Tenaya 7 from stealing it.

Episodes.Title: Handshake

Entries.Title: Love Twist
Entries.Description: So Ri and Ha Ru start a business together. It is an online shop called Twist. Facing a big meeting with an investor, they feel rather lost and confused. Meanwhile, Ok Hee cooks up a storm as she waits for her husband, Kwang Nam, to return from a work trip. After Kwang Nam comes home, Ok Hee becomes worried that she can't reach her friend Hee Ok.

Episodes.Title: Fateful Encounters
Episodes.Description: So Ri and Ha Ru start a business together. It is an online shop called Twist. Facing a big meeting with an investor, they feel rather lost and confused. Meanwhile, Ok Hee cooks up a storm as she waits for her husband, Kwang Nam, to return from a work trip. After Kwang Nam comes home, Ok Hee becomes worried that she can't reach her friend Hee Ok.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Ok Hee meets with Hee Ok and hears about her difficult marriage and divorce. She feels terrible for her friend and tells Hee Ok that she wants to help her live a better life from now on. Meanwhile, So Ri becomes enraged when she discovers that Yun A ran off after causing a disaster at work. As Ha Ru keeps defending Yun A, So Ri feels upset.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: It wasn’t a part of the plan to run into Mi Ja after Kwang Nam and Hee Ok’s quality time together. Not long after, Mi Ja tells Ok Hee everything she saw. Meanwhile, Chul Gu offers Ha Ru a job at a company in Silicon Valley. At the same time, Ok Hee and So Ri enter into a deal, and So Ri now needs to go on a blind date.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Mi Ja witnesses Kwang Nam and Hee Ok playing footsy under the table at Ok Hee's house party. Out of anger, she calls Hee Ok to confront her about it. Meanwhile, So Ri rushes out to see Ha Ru after receiving a loan from Ok Hee in return for going on a blind date, but Ha Ru doesn't seem to be too thrilled.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: With Hee Ok and Yun A’s interference, Ha Ru eventually decides to shut down Twist. Although it is not what he truly wants, So Ri still agrees that shutting down the business is the wise choice. Meanwhile, Dong Man also finds out about Kwang Nam and Hee Ok’s secret relationship. Using this as leverage, he persuades Kwang Nam to hire Kyung Jun into Dongbang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Kyung Jun is overjoyed to hear that he has been hired by Dongbang. However, when he discovers that he is to work as Kwang Nam's driver, not his personal assistant, he feels disappointed. Meanwhile, Ok Hee goes to see Hee Ok at the hotel where she is staying. Then, Kwang Nam decides to surprise Hee Ok with a visit.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Since So Ri decides to shut down Twist, Yun A takes it upon herself to sell the remaining inventory in their office. When So Ri finds Yun A selling the clothes on the street, the two end up arguing. Hee Ok sends Ok Hee away and calls Kwang Nam back to her hotel room. However, Ok Hee also heads back to the hotel, curious about the weird man Hee Ok seems to be dating.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Kwang Nam finds out that So Ri and Ha Ru are in business together. Out of anger, Kwang Nam rushes over to see Ha Ru and slaps him in the face. Meanwhile, Kwang Nam and Hee Ok get right back to their affair at a safe place they created away from Ok Hee's eyes.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Ok Hee is confident that Hee Ok is living with the guy she thinks is trouble and becomes determined to figure out his identity. While Next guarantees their investment, So Ri and Ha Ru learn about one another's feelings and attempt to get Ok Hee to accept their love and cheer them on. Later, Ok Hee gets Ha Ru to ask his mom where she lives.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Hee Ok is angry that Kwang Nam is making her stay in a run-down apartment in Seoul as an adultress and tells him that she wants to head back to the US. Kwang Nam tries to appease her by giving her the old apartment. Meanwhile, Ok Hee goes to Ha Ru's place and talks to him about his relationship with So Ri. She promises to be on their side and to support the two of them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Ok Hee comes to visit Hee Ok and witnesses Kwang Nam and Hee Ok walking back home together. Ok Hee gets furious at them, but she goes to the bar where Kwang Nam used to drink and meets Madam Jung instead. Meanwhile, So Ri and Ha Ru decide to go on a trip together, but Kyung Jun tries to stop them by telling them about their parents' affair.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Despite the fact that Kyung Jun might get fired, Mi Ja makes up her mind to tell Ok Hee the truth about Kwang Nam and Hee Ok. However, Ok Hee already found it out herself, so she only throws a fit at Mi Ja. Furthermore, she barges into Hee Ok's apartment for confrontation. Meanwhile, Kyung Jun and Yun A team up to find So Ri and Ha Ru, who went on a trip together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Kwang Nam is speechless after Ok Hee furiously tells him to end his relationship with Hee Ok right that instant. Ha Ru and So Ri end up having to camp out in their car to avoid unwelcome guests, Kyung Jun and Yun A, who had come all the way to see them. The two of them end their first night together in the back of their car.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Although Ha Ru and So Ri ask Kwang Nam to allow their relationship, he coldly rejects, saying he can't accept anyone who doesn't even know their father. Mi Ja becomes angry while gathering things Ok Hee wants back, and out of anger, she rushes over to Hee Ok and tells her about Ha Ru and So Ri's relationship.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Kwang Nam brings Next's investment in Twist to a halt so he can split Ha Ru and So Ri up. Hee Ok tells Ha Ru to go to the US to get him away from So Ri. Meanwhile, Ok Hee, who keeps Kwang Nam and Hee Ok's affair to herself, suggests to So Ri that she should break up with Ha Ru.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: So Ri runs into Kwang Nam as he is leaving Hee Ok's apartment. She has no choice but to believe the news about his affair and is in shock. Meanwhile, Dong Man meets Ki Tae, an old high school buddy, on the streets. After a few drinks, Dong Man blurts out the fact that Kwang Nam and Hee Ok are having an affair.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: So Ri leaves home, and Ha Ru declares that he will cut ties with Hee Ok. Kwang Nam and Hee Ok realize that they can't go on like this any longer and decide to end their relationship. Hee Ok packs up her things to go back to the US when Ki Tae suddenly barges into her house. He demands to know who Ha Ru's father is.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Ki Tae wants to get DNA testing done with Ha Ru. To stop Ki Tae, Hee Ok tells him that Ha Ru's biological father is Kwang Nam. Meanwhile, Do Hee and Kyung Jun, who lied to one another, meet up again, and Yun A and Chul Gu get drunk and spend a hot night together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: So Ri says goodbye to Ok Hee, telling her that she and Ha Ru will marry and move to the US. Shortly after, Ki Tae suddenly shows up in front of Ok Hee, who is still heartbroken by So Ri's words. Meanwhile, Kyung Jun and Do Hee believe each other's family is affluent and fall into a blissful world.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Ok Hee asks Kwang Nam if Ha Ru is his son. He tries to explain he isn't, but Ok Hee won't listen. Kwang Nam realizes the decision he made was wrong and regrets it. Ha Ru and So Ri think about their future and spend a wonderful time together at Twist. Meanwhile, Kyung Jun gets caught stealing Mi Ja's ring he wanted to give Do Hee.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Ok Hee sees the DNA test results that say Kwang Nam is Ha Ru's father and becomes furious. Although Hee Ok tries to explain, Ok Hee refuses to listen. She declares to Kwang Nam later on that she wants a divorce. That night, Ok Hee receives a text message from So Ri saying that she is registering her marriage to Ha Ru the next day.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Ok Hee goes to see Ha Ru and tells him that Kwang Nam is his dad, making him and So Ri siblings. Then, she proceeds to have So Ri dragged home and locked up in her room. Meanwhile, Kyung Jun and Do Hee run into each other at Kwang Nam's house and are shocked to find out about each other's true identities.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Eventually, Ha Ru leaves So Ri without saying goodbye. Devastated by his sudden departure, So Ri does her best to find him. Meanwhile, Ok Hee and Kwang Nam try to persuade Kwang Nam’s parents to allow their divorce. But Ok Hee plans to leave Kwang Nam regardless of their approval. Ok Hee now has a lot to go through as her relationship with both her daughter and husband is unstable.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: So Ri finds out that Ha Ru is at Yun A’s place. When So Ri confronts the two, Ha Ru tells lies and says that he is with Yun A now to end things with So Ri for good. However, So Ri does not believe him and will not back down from taking him back. The news that Ha Ru and Yun A are together spread quickly. The parents of the three kids are concerned about what to do with this incident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Kyung Jun saves So Ri's life at the beach, and So Ri makes him a rather sudden offer of marriage. Although he is surprised, Kyung Jun doesn't want to miss this chance of a lifetime. Upon accepting So Ri's offer, Kyung Jun starts to talk badly about Do Hee to So Ri's grandparents in order to get rid of her for good.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Ha Ru hears that So Ri and Kyung Jun are getting married and goes to talk to So Ri. Although Ha Ru wants to tell her the truth about why they had to break up, So Ri doesn't want to hear anything from him at all. Meanwhile, Kwang Nam gets upset when he discovers what Ok Hee said about him to Hee Ok and confronts her about it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Chairman Oh gets shocked when Kyung Jun tells him about So Ri and Ha Ru's tragic truth. However, now that he knows Ha Ru is his grandson, he wants to add him to his family registry to leave him an inheritance. Meanwhile, Hee Ok boldly visits Ok Hee to ask for her help again because she is out of budget to support Ha Ru and Yun A.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: Kyung Jun is in utter disbelief after learning that the genetic testing that Chairman Oh ordered him to do isn't a match. To find out more, he goes to see Hee Ok. That night after giving it considerable thought, Chairman Oh tells So Ri she shouldn't have the baby.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Chairman Oh dies unable to overcome the trauma. Ok Hee finds his last will and testament where he had fallen and is shocked by his words. At Chairman Oh's funeral, So Ri and Ha Ru reunite. As So Ri watches Ha Ru get Yun A strawberries to overcome her pregnancy morning sickness, she is heartbroken.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: So Ri, who has made up her mind to marry Kyung Jun, announces to her family about her decision. With the news, one family rejoices, and the other gets thrown into chaos. Meanwhile, Yun A witnesses So Ri at the obstetrics and gynecology clinic while getting a checkup and figures out she is pregnant.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Five years go by, and So Ri struggles to keep Twist afloat on her own. As So Ri fails to get an investment from Next once again, Kwang Nam finds himself stuck in an unhappy marriage with Hee Ok. Then one day, he sees Ok Hee by chance. Meanwhile, Ki Tae realizes that Ha Ru might not be Kwang Nam's son and sends Ha Ru an email.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: Ha Ru returns to Korea and has a paternity test done with his and Kwang Nam's DNA. He finds out that Kwang Nam is not his biological father and that Kwang Nam is actively interfering with So Ri's business endeavors. Meanwhile, Yun A hears that Ha Ru plans to stay in Korea for a while and returns to Korea with her daughter Saet Byeol.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: Today is So Ri’s grandfather’s memorial day. On this big day, So Ri learns from her mother that she and Ha Ru are blood-related. So Ri also finds out that her grandfather wishes Ha Ru to be officially added to the family registry, but she will not make that happen for the sake of Han Byeol’s future. As the time for the memorial rite approaches, the Parks and the Ohs gather only to cause more trouble.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: So Ri shows up at her parents’ house and strongly claims that Ha Ru must not be a part of the Oh family. For now, she says it is because she does not want to share the family inheritance with him, but nobody is able to read her true intentions. To prevent Ha Ru from giving influence on the family, So Ri decides to go back to her parents’ house and live there with them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: Everyone in the Oh and Park family becomes busy after Ha Ru’s visit. While Kwang Nam wants to bring in So Ri instead of Ha Ru, Hee Ok wishes to do the opposite. Meanwhile, Ok Hee has been living in the slums despite all the money she got from the divorce. Although others think that she fell for a scam, her confidence shows that she has something hidden under her sleeve.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: So Ri, who had decided to sell Twist to stop Ha Ru's name from ending up on the family register and had moved back into Kwang Nam's house, finds out that the person who had been blocking all possible investments in Twist was Kwang Nam all along. Meanwhile, Ha Ru moves into the house across the street from Kwang Nam. He asks Ok Hee to live with him while telling her about his revenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 37
Episodes.Description: Ok Hee tells Soon Bun that Ha Ru is Chairman Oh's grandson and hands her his will. Shocked at the news, Soon Bun runs over to see Ha Ru. Meanwhile, Kwang Nam is heartbroken when he hears that Ok Hee has nowhere to live due to the redevelopment and is staying at Ha Ru's.

Episodes.Title: Episode 38
Episodes.Description: So Ri refuses to accept that Ha Ru is her brother until she sees some sort of proof with her own eyes. She agrees with her grandmother and asks for another paternity test. Kwang Nam and Hee Ok find themselves cornered and decide to tell the truth. However, Kyung Jun goes to Hee Ok with an unexpected offer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 39
Episodes.Description: At the district office, Kwang Nam ends up telling Ha Ru the truth and runs away from him. Meanwhile, Soon Bun asks Kwang Nam to show her the Family Relations Certificate as proof, but Hee Ok lies to her that Ha Ru has changed his mind. Ha Ru wants Hee Ok to apologize to Ok Hee and break up with Kwang Nam, but Hee Ok is not willing to do as he wants.

Episodes.Title: Episode 40
Episodes.Description: Yun A is shocked to find out that Ha Ru was aware he and So Ri weren't siblings. She demands to know whether Ha Ru decided to return to Korea because of So Ri, but Ha Ru insists that's not true. Meanwhile, Do Hee starts working again. When she pops into Kyung Jun's office, he begins to panic and worry.

Episodes.Title: Episode 41
Episodes.Description: Soon Bun tells Kwang Nam to end things with Hee Ok and get back together with Ok Hee. Meanwhile, Kyung Jun tries to persuade So Ri to work at Dongbang after telling her about Ha Ru. However, So Ri tells Kyung Jun to protect Dongbang in place of her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 42
Episodes.Description: Kwang Nam feels a sense of crisis as soon as he learns that Ha Ru, who is now a director at Dongbang, is going through their financial records. And to overcome any bad outcome, he appoints Kyung Jun as his successor. Meanwhile, Kyung Jun gets shaken up when he sees Do Hee and Won Byeol eating pizza at his parents' restaurant.

Episodes.Title: Episode 43
Episodes.Description: A new successor has been appointed to lead the future of Dongbang. The members of board are surprised and unhappy about the person that Kwang Nam chose. However, Ha Ru sees this as an opportunity and plans a scheme. Meanwhile, Yun A holds a birthday party for her daughter. So Ri and Do Hee will be attending with their children, but they also have an unexpected guest.

Episodes.Title: Episode 44
Episodes.Description: Kyung Jun runs into Do Hee and Won Byeol at Ha Ru's house with So Ri and Han Byeol. When he confronts her about getting too close to So Ri, Do Hee demands to be compensated for having to live a secret life. Meanwhile, Ok Hee sees how desperate Yun A is to have a second child and talks to Ha Ru about it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 45
Episodes.Description: Yun A is utterly devastated when her dreams of having a second child with Ha Ru are crushed. Hee Ok asks if Kwang Nam still loves Ok Hee, and Soon Bun, whose frustration regarding Hee Ok continues to grow, decides to invite Ok Hee over to the house. Meanwhile, Dong Man and Mi Ja go out to dinner when they witness something shocking.

Episodes.Title: Episode 46
Episodes.Description: After learning that Ha Ru was the one who invested in Twist, So Ri reminisces of the time they had dreams together and gets overcome with sorrow. Hee Ok feels threatened by Soon Bun's actions and tells Kwang Nam to either register their marriage or give her his shares of the nursing home. However, Kwang Nam tells her he is suffocating and declares war.

Episodes.Title: Zombie Detective 2
Episodes.Description: Moo Young is taken to the hospital after being hit by a helmet. However, he doesn’t want his identity to be revealed, so he runs away. Meanwhile, Bo Ra opens up a tripe restaurant. Seon Ji finds the witness and begs for an interview.

Episodes.Title: Zombie Detective 3
Episodes.Description: Moo Young is taken to the hospital after being hit by a helmet. However, he doesn’t want his identity to be revealed, so he runs away. Meanwhile, Bo Ra opens up a tripe restaurant. Seon Ji finds the witness and begs for an interview.

Episodes.Title: Zombie Detective 4
Episodes.Description: Zombie, Moo Young returns with a suspicious pill from the fast center. It’s called as a weight-loss supplement and given to all members at the center. But it clearly has something fishy about it, and Seon Ji takes it away to examine it.

Episodes.Title: Zombie Detective 5
Episodes.Description: With the help of Tae Kyun, Seon Ji realizes that Kim Moo Young is a zombie. Stunned and scared of getting eaten alive, she unwillingly goes to see him dressed in full combat gear to get desperately needed money owed to her. When she's about to leave his office, she faints due to her appendix bursting.

Episodes.Title: Zombie Detective 6
Episodes.Description: Seon Ji tries to help Moo Young remember his past life, but nothing seems to work. However, Moo Young begins to think of the possibility that he had a family in the past and feels a sense of emptiness in his life. Meanwhile, Seon Ji and Moo Young run into Hyeong Cheol while tracking down a lead on Moo Young’s past.

Episodes.Title: Zombie Detective 7
Episodes.Description: A man breaks into Moo Young’s office, and Seong Rok and Wei see it. As Moo Young finds out that the intruder has only stolen his lighter, he suspects that the intruder might be someone who knows his past. Meanwhile, Moo Young is invited to Joon Woo’s birthday party.

Episodes.Title: Zombie Detective 8
Episodes.Description: Hyeong Cheol tells Moo Young about his horrible past, and he gets devastated. As Moo Young tries to kill himself, Seon Ji tries to reach him to tell him about another version of his past. Meanwhile, Seon Ji runs into danger while investigating So Ri’s death.

Episodes.Title: Zombie Detective 9
Episodes.Description: After Hyeong Cheol’s death, Moo Young tries to erase all of his traces and leave. While Seon Ji tries to reach Moo Young, he passes out due to hunger and finds himself in his office. Meanwhile, Tae Kyun visits Moo Young and explains the story about his new zombie movie.

Episodes.Title: Zombie Detective 10
Episodes.Description: After Poong Shik is discharged from prison, he goes to Seong Rok and asks him to follow Moo Young. As Moo Young remembers what Poong Shik did before going to prison, he and Seon Ji start investigating his past. Meanwhile, Do Hyun happens to see Kang Min Ho’s picture and gets suspicious.

Episodes.Title: Zombie Detective 11
Episodes.Description: Moo Young and Seon Ji find out about Poong Shik’s illegal experiments on animals. And in order to find out more about Poong Shik, they ask Seong Rok about the Shadow Case where Poong Shik’s daughter went missing.

Episodes.Title: Zombie Detective 12
Episodes.Description: Poong Shik escapes from the police car while being transferred to the police station after being arrested. After hearing the news, Seong Rok, Wei, and Seon Ji tell the police that Poong Shik has created a zombie, but no one believes. Meanwhile, a man’s body is found in the mountains.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1 (Part 2)
Episodes.Description: Hae Il leaves Yeosu and head to Gudam. He stays at the Catholic church of Father Lee Young Jun who is like a real father to him. Dae Young is a detective at Gudam Police Station. He goes out to support a local event, and protestors appear at the scene. Meanwhile, Hae Il walks by the scene and witnesses protestors getting beaten up.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2 (Part 1)
Episodes.Description: Hae Il helps out the protestors at the ceremony and confronts Cheol Bum. Kyeong Seon gets a bribe from the accused of her case. New recruit Seung Ah joins Dae Young's team and becomes his partner. Meanwhile, Jang Ryong and his men make a scene at the church.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2 (Part 2)
Episodes.Description: Jan Ryong and his men are released without any penalty. Father Lee gets a call in the middle of the night. Next day, he is found dead at a mountain nearby. Hae Il requests an investigation, but the Gudam Police and the prosecutor refuse. Police announce that Father Lee was involved in various crimes, and Hae Il gets furious.

Episodes.Title: We're Back
Episodes.Description: Father Michael Kim Haeil returns, ready to take down a notorious and powerful drug cartel in Busan.

Episodes.Title: When in Busan
Episodes.Description: Haeil takes up teaching at a seminary in Busan, as drug lord Kim Hongsik arrives in the city.

Episodes.Title: Somewhere in Between Heaven and Hell
Episodes.Description: Haeil digs into the cartel, while Hongsik begins building his empire in Busan.

Episodes.Title: Within the Devil's Circle
Episodes.Description: Hae-il and Dae-young rescue Ja-young, while a suspect in interrogation suffers an accident amid the chaos, and the three decide to team up in their pursuit of the drug cartel; with his drug plant operational, Hong-sik begins expanding his reach.

Episodes.Title: Hard Measures for Insanity
Episodes.Description: Haeil and Hongsik sense the tension as strong rivals, while Kyungsun gains Duhun's favor.

Episodes.Title: The Devil is Not as Black as He is Painted
Episodes.Description: Haeil's pressure on Hongsik and the cartel grows, leading Hongsik to plot a fierce counterstrike.

Episodes.Title: A Priest's Duty Begins with Fury
Episodes.Description: When the Virgin Mary statue is set ablaze, Haeil is certain it is the work of the drug cartel.

Episodes.Title: A Worm Gets Crushed When Stepped on
Episodes.Description: Haeil discovers Hongsik's true identity, leading to an intense face-off between the two.

Episodes.Title: Stand Up Again
Episodes.Description: Haeil's fall signals a new resolve. His team unites, prepared to crush the forces of darkness.

Episodes.Title: Blessings Start Rough
Episodes.Description: Under flawless disguise, Haeil and Kyungsun infiltrate the ship, but Kyungsun faces danger.

Episodes.Title: Real Prayers are Made on the Move
Episodes.Description: Haeil and Kyungsun narrowly escape danger, while Duhun and Hongsik each plot their own survival

Episodes.Title: The Ship that Sails the Sky
Episodes.Description: Koharu, a young girl with the power to control fire, is chosen to board the Norn, a mysterious ship that travels to a place called "The World."

Episodes.Title: Ability
Episodes.Description: Koharu meets the other passengers on the Norn, all of whom have special abilities. They are attacked by a mysterious enemy.

Episodes.Title: Sprouting Spring
Episodes.Description: The passengers of the Norn learn more about each other and their abilities. They also learn that there is a traitor among them.

Episodes.Title: Serenade of the Dawn
Episodes.Description: The passengers of the Norn are attacked again. They must work together to defend the ship.

Episodes.Title: The Unsmiling Forest
Episodes.Description: The Norn makes a stop at a mysterious island. The passengers explore the island and learn more about its secrets.

Episodes.Title: The Beginning of the End
Episodes.Description: The passengers of the Norn learn the truth about "The World." They must make a choice that will determine the fate of humanity.

Episodes.Title: The Dream of Reality
Episodes.Description: The passengers of the Norn are forced to confront their pasts. They must come to terms with who they are and what they have done.

Episodes.Title: The World
Episodes.Description: The passengers of the Norn arrive at "The World." They must now face their final challenge.

Episodes.Title: The Truth
Episodes.Description: The passengers of the Norn learn the shocking truth about their mission. They must now make a choice that will change the world forever.

Episodes.Title: Aion
Episodes.Description: The passengers of the Norn must face Aion, the entity that controls "The World." They must defeat Aion to save humanity.

Episodes.Title: Reset
Episodes.Description: The passengers of the Norn defeat Aion and reset the world. They return to their old lives, but they are forever changed.

Episodes.Title: The New World
Episodes.Description: The passengers of the Norn wake up in a new world. They have a second chance at life and love.

Episodes.Title: Do Ra Meets Dae Chung
Episodes.Description: Thirteen-year-old Do Ra runs into Dae Chung and falls in love. Her mother forces her into acting to escape poverty.

Episodes.Title: Forced Breakup
Episodes.Description: Geum Ja reveals Dae Chung's birth secret. Mi Ja steals food from Dae Chung's family.

Episodes.Title: Jun Sub And A Woman
Episodes.Description: Geum Ja sees Jun Sub with another woman. Do Ra calls Dae Chung for help against bullies.

Episodes.Title: Pil Seung’s New Main Lead
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung (adult Dae Chung) becomes a drama director. Do Ra refuses a role in his drama.

Episodes.Title: Do Ra's Revenge Plan
Episodes.Description: Do Ra flirts with Bong Soo to spite Bi Bi, disappointing Pil Seung.

Episodes.Title: Birth Secret Revealed
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung discovers his adoption truth. Do Ra confronts her mother about past choices.

Episodes.Title: Family Confrontation
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung demands answers from his parents. Do Ra's mother schemes to control her career.

Episodes.Title: On-Set Sabotage
Episodes.Description: Bi Boo sabotages Do Ra's performance. Pil Seung protects Do Ra from a falling light.

Episodes.Title: Hospital Confession
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung confesses feelings to injured Do Ra. Jin Dan discovers their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Blackmail Scheme
Episodes.Description: Jin Dan blackmails Do Ra with stolen documents. Pil Seung's mother interferes with production.

Episodes.Title: Contract Termination
Episodes.Description: Do Ra faces contract termination. Pil Seung publicly defends her at a press conference.

Episodes.Title: Mother's Secret
Episodes.Description: Do Ra discovers her mother stole from Dae Chung's family. Jin Dan leaks their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Public Scandal
Episodes.Description: Do Ra's career collapses after scandal. Pil Seung confronts Jin Dan about the leak.

Episodes.Title: Disappearance
Episodes.Description: Do Ra disappears after scandal. Pil Seung searches desperately while Jin Dan celebrates.

Episodes.Title: Broken Engagement
Episodes.Description: Do Ra breaks up with Pil Seung and agrees to marry Jin Dan, but cancels the engagement last-minute.

Episodes.Title: Two Years Later
Episodes.Description: After Do Ra's presumed death, Pil Seung becomes a director. Jin Dan suffers nightmares. Pil Seung meets Ji Young (amnesiac Do Ra).

Episodes.Title: Memory Fragments
Episodes.Description: Ji Young experiences flashbacks. Pil Seung suspects her identity. Jin Dan tries to sabotage their interactions.

Episodes.Title: Identity Test
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung tests Ji Young with familiar places. Jin Dan plants false evidence about Ji Young's past.

Episodes.Title: Familiar Song
Episodes.Description: A childhood song triggers Ji Young's memories. Jin Dan hires someone to erase evidence of Do Ra's accident.

Episodes.Title: Photograph Evidence
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung finds a photo proving Ji Young is Do Ra. Jin Dan frames Ji Young for plagiarism.

Episodes.Title: Memory Return
Episodes.Description: Ji Young regains full memory as Do Ra. She confronts Jin Dan about the accident.

Episodes.Title: Revenge Plan
Episodes.Description: Do Ra plans revenge against Jin Dan. Pil Seung vows to protect her.

Episodes.Title: Business Takeover
Episodes.Description: Jin Dan's father attempts hostile takeover of GOGO Entertainment. Do Ra exposes financial irregularities.

Episodes.Title: Alliance Formed
Episodes.Description: Do Ra allies with Bi Boo against Jin Dan. Pil Seung discovers Jin Dan's embezzlement evidence.

Episodes.Title: Court Showdown
Episodes.Description: Do Ra testifies against Jin Dan's family. Key witness disappears before trial.

Episodes.Title: Witness Protection
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung hides crucial witness. Jin Dan hires thugs to eliminate evidence.

Episodes.Title: Media Leak
Episodes.Description: Do Ra leaks Jin Dan's illegal recordings to press. Jin Dan's reputation collapses.

Episodes.Title: Family Intervention
Episodes.Description: Jin Dan's mother begs Do Ra for mercy. Pil Seung's family accepts their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Blackmail Evidence
Episodes.Description: Do Ra finds proof of Jin Dan's blackmail. Jin Dan attempts to flee the country.

Episodes.Title: Arrest Warrant
Episodes.Description: Police issue warrant for Jin Dan. Do Ra and Pil Seung reunite publicly.

Episodes.Title: Trial Begins
Episodes.Description: Jin Dan's trial starts with media frenzy. Do Ra's mother testifies against Jin Dan's family.

Episodes.Title: Perjury Exposed
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung proves Jin Dan committed perjury. Key financial documents surface.

Episodes.Title: Verdict Fallout
Episodes.Description: Jin Dan found guilty. Do Ra faces public backlash for revenge tactics.

Episodes.Title: Career Crossroads
Episodes.Description: Do Ra considers quitting acting. Pil Seung starts new production company.

Episodes.Title: Fresh Start
Episodes.Description: Do Ra opens acting school. Jin Dan attempts prison escape.

Episodes.Title: Proposal
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung proposes to Do Ra. Jin Dan's family plots revenge from prison.

Episodes.Title: Wedding Sabotage
Episodes.Description: Jin Dan's allies try to disrupt wedding. Do Ra's mother reconciles with her.

Episodes.Title: Married Life
Episodes.Description: Do Ra and Pil Seung adjust to married life. Bi Boo becomes Do Ra's business partner.

Episodes.Title: New Project
Episodes.Description: Pil Seung directs Do Ra in new film. Jin Dan's release from prison causes tension.

Episodes.Title: On-Set Accident
Episodes.Description: Suspicious accident targets Do Ra. Pil Seung discovers Jin Dan's involvement.

Episodes.Title: Final Confrontation
Episodes.Description: Do Ra traps Jin Dan in legal showdown. Key evidence emerges from past accident.

Episodes.Title: Life Sentence
Episodes.Description: Jin Dan receives life sentence. Do Ra announces pregnancy.

Episodes.Title: New Beginnings
Episodes.Description: Do Ra wins acting award. Pil Seung's production company launches global project.

Episodes.Title: Legacy Project
Episodes.Description: Do Ra establishes foundation for struggling actors. Jin Dan attempts prison suicide.

Episodes.Title: Truth and Scandal
Episodes.Description: Ji Young's identity is exposed. Jin Dan frames her for sponsorships. Pil Seung resigns to protect her.

Episodes.Title: Public Backlash
Episodes.Description: Ji Young admits she is Do Ra and reveals her amnesia. Jin Dan's father hires a hitman to kill Ma Ri.

Episodes.Title: Jin Dan's Downfall
Episodes.Description: Jin Dan discovers Sang Gu is his father and orchestrated Ma Ri's accident. Do Ra opens a restaurant.

Episodes.Title: Car Crash and Consequences
Episodes.Description: Jin Dan crashes a car with Do Ra, leaving her paralyzed. Pil Seung becomes CEO of GOGO Entertainment.

Episodes.Title: Redemption Arc
Episodes.Description: Do Ra undergoes rehabilitation. Jin Dan faces murder charges for Ma Ri's death.

Episodes.Title: Finale
Episodes.Description: Jin Dan receives life sentence. Do Ra walks again and returns to acting. Pil Seung and Do Ra renew vows.
