Episodes.Title: Ryomen Sukuna
Episodes.Description: After visiting his beloved grandfather in the hospital, Yuji Itadori encounters an apprentice sorcerer who demands that Yuji hand over a cursed relic.

Episodes.Title: For Myself
Episodes.Description: Yuji manages to control the curse of Ryomen Sukuna. Later, he awakens in a room with Jujutsu High teacher Satoru Gojo, who offers him a deadly choice.

Episodes.Title: Girl of Steel
Episodes.Description: Nobara Kugisaki joins the class on a trip to Roppongi where Gojo gives her and Yuji their first test: dispel a curse from an abandoned building.

Episodes.Title: Curse Womb Must Die
Episodes.Description: When a curse womb attacks a juvenile detention center, Yuji's group is called upon to rescue any remaining survivors — but combat isn’t an option.

Episodes.Title: Curse Womb Must Die -II-
Episodes.Description: As Sukuna gruesomely holds Yuji's body hostage, Fushiguro struggles against the sheer strength of Sukuna's curse to buy time until Yuji can awaken.

Episodes.Title: After Rain
Episodes.Description: Sukuna tells Yuji that he will bring him back to life on two conditions. Meanwhile, Suguru Geto and a cursed spirit discuss their plans for Gojo.

Episodes.Title: Assault
Episodes.Description: The cursed spirit Jogo attacks Gojo, who has such little trouble fighting back that he leaves and brings back a student to observe the battle.

Episodes.Title: Boredom
Episodes.Description: As Kugisaki and Fushiguro train for the exchange event, two older students from the Kyoto Jujutsu school arrive in Tokyo and pick a fight with them.

Episodes.Title: Small Fry and Reverse Retribution
Episodes.Description: High schooler Junpei Yoshino finds his bullies horrifically killed in a movie theater. Sorcerer Kento Nanami and Yuji investigate the crime scene.

Episodes.Title: Idle Transfiguration
Episodes.Description: Junpei gets some startling advice from Mahito. Later, Ijichi and Yuji track down Junpei and formulate a plan to set up a chance encounter with him.

Episodes.Title: Narrow-minded
Episodes.Description: Annoyed at having to work off the clock, Nanami shows Mahito the true potential of his sorcery. Meanwhile, Yuji and Junpei bond over movies.

Episodes.Title: To You, Someday
Episodes.Description: Ignoring Nanami's warning, Yuji dashes into the school and tries to reason with Junpei, but Mahito soon interrupts. Yuji appeals to Sukuna for help.

Episodes.Title: Tomorrow
Episodes.Description: Yuji and Nanami coordinate their attacks on Mahito, wearing him down. But as the cursed spirit approaches death, he finds a new power within himself.

Episodes.Title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 0 -
Episodes.Description: With the exchange event between the Tokyo and Kyoto Jujutsu schools set to begin, Gojo arranges for Yuji to make a surprise appearance.

Episodes.Title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 1 -
Episodes.Description: Shortly after the exchange event team battle begins, Todo ambushes the Tokyo students. Yuji moves to stop him but soon finds himself surrounded.

Episodes.Title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 2 -
Episodes.Description: Todo gives Yuji advice on how to better tap into his curse powers. After Kugisaki taunts Nishimiya, Panda fights the remote-controlled Mechamaru.

Episodes.Title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 3 -
Episodes.Description: While Miwa struggles to stand her ground against Maki's attacks, Kugisaki chases down a flying Nishimiya, who lectures her about Mai's hardships.

Episodes.Title: Sage
Episodes.Description: Fushiguro dodges Kamo's barrage of arrows but his opponent proves just as formidable in close combat. Meanwhile, Inumaki senses a foreboding presence.

Episodes.Title: Black Flash
Episodes.Description: Inumaki, Fushiguro and Kamo struggle to hold their own against special grade cursed spirit Hanami, but Maki arrives to provide much-needed backup.

Episodes.Title: Nonstandard
Episodes.Description: After analyzing Hanami's assortment of skills with his self-proclaimed intellect, Todo uses his disorienting technique to attack in tandem with Yuji.

Episodes.Title: Jujutsu Koshien
Episodes.Description: After the event's interruption, the school tournament continues with a baseball match.

Episodes.Title: The Origin of Blind Obedience
Episodes.Description: An investigation into a string of curse-related killings leads Yuji, Fushiguro and Kugisaki to the victims' – and Fushiguro's – former middle school.

Episodes.Title: The Origin of Blind Obedience -II-
Episodes.Description: Fushiguro, Kugisaki and Itadori fight the cursed spirits on two fronts. When Fushiguro faces his enemy alone, he recalls his recent training with Gojo. He knows that he has to be able to surpass himself...

Episodes.Title: Accomplices
Episodes.Description: Yuji and Nobara's battle against the Death Painting Wombs Kechizu and Eso reaches its conclusion! However, even in victory there is a cost in killing, something the Jujutsu High students had never considered before. Meanwhile, Choso, Geto and Mahito gain wind of this event.

Episodes.Title: Hidden Inventory
Episodes.Description: The jujutsu sorcerers Iori Utahime and Mei Mei are dispatched to an ominous manor where several people have gone missing. They infiltrate the manor and attempt to destroy the cursed spirit's barrier, but suddenly the building starts to crumble.

Episodes.Title: Hidden Inventory 2
Episodes.Description: Gojo and Geto are assigned to the mission of escorting and erasing the young girl compatible with the Tengen - the Star Plasma Vessel. Amanai Riko is being targeted by the Curse User Group Q, and the religious cult the Star Religious Group.

Episodes.Title: Hidden Inventory 3
Episodes.Description: Gojo and Geto beat back the curse users after the bounty placed on Amanai's head when her cell phone rings. A captured Kuroi is displayed on her phone. Gojo tries to bring Amanai back to Jujutsu High, but she insists on going to the negotiations herself.

Episodes.Title: Hidden Inventory 4
Episodes.Description: "Let's go home, Riko-chan." The moment Geto extends a hand to Amanai, the worst that could possibly happen does. Geto is left dumbstruck as Toji Fushiguro makes his appearance. Toji then declares that he killed Satoru Gojo.

Episodes.Title: Premature Death
Episodes.Description: August 2007. Gojo starts to handle missions on his own, causing Geto to, as well. One day a certain individual appears before Geto. What's the conclusion that led to Gojo becoming the strongest jujutsu sorcerer, and Geto becoming the most evil curse user?

Episodes.Title: It's Like That
Episodes.Description: 2018. After finishing a mission one day, Itadori decides to go to the movies, Kugisaki decides to go shopping, and Fushiguro tells them he's going home. After parting ways Kugisaki is approached by a woman who suddenly asks if she was with Itadori-kun.

Episodes.Title: Evening Festival
Episodes.Description: The battle between Muta and Mahito continues and reaches its conclusion. Later, on October 31st, a veil is lowered over Shibuya and various jujutsu sorcerer teams assemble around the area.

Episodes.Title: Shibuya Incident
Episodes.Description: Team Mei Mei are reassigned to a veil that has been lowered over Meiji Shrine Station. The team splits up and Yuji encounters a grasshopper curse assigned to protecting the veil. Elsewhere Satoru Gojo encounters Jogo, Hanami, and Choso.

Episodes.Title: Shibuya Incident - Gate, Open
Episodes.Description: The battle between Satoru Gojo, Jogo, Hanami and Choso begins. Gojo informs Hanami that they will die first. Yuji encounters a woman who tells him that everyone was turned into monsters and boarded a train. As Gojo's battle continues, the train arrives.

Episodes.Title: Pandemonium
Episodes.Description: Now that Satoru Gojo has been sealed, Mechamaru works with Team Mei Mei to inform them about what is going on and has them work on enacting his plan on what to do now.

Episodes.Title: Seance
Episodes.Description: Nanami, Fushiguro, and Ino meet up with Itadori, then Nanami issues new orders for the others to work together to lift the veil keeping sorcerers out.

Episodes.Title: Dull Knife
Episodes.Description: Yuji and Megumi lift the veil that was keeping sorcerers from entering Shibuya. Nobara and Nitta encounter Shigemo and a battle ensues. Shigemo has the upperhand, but then Nanami arrives with the deaths of the assistant supervisors in mind.

Episodes.Title: Red Scale
Episodes.Description: Yuji makes his way to Shibuya Station where he's confronted by Choso. Choso unleashes his Convergence and the battle between him and Yuji commences.

Episodes.Title: Fluctuations
Episodes.Description: Mei Mei and Ui Ui fight the Special-Grade Disease Curse summoned by whatever is pretending to be Suguru Geto. Meanwhile, Nanami joins up with Maki and Naobito, but they encounter a cursed spirit with unknown powers.

Episodes.Title: Fluctuations (2)
Episodes.Description: Nanami, Maki, and Naobito are driven to the edge after the Special-Grade Cursed Spirit, Dagon, activates his Domain Expansion, Horizon of the Captivating Skandha. Fushiguro gives them a glimpse of a way to escape death, then Toji intrudes upon the fight.

Episodes.Title: Thunderclap
Episodes.Description: Sukuna refuses to heed Jogo's advice after waking up, instead displaying his overwhelming strength against the Special-Grade Cursed Spirit, Jogo. Meanwhile, Fushiguro faces off against the rampant Toji with neither being aware of the other's identity.

Episodes.Title: Thunderclap (2)
Episodes.Description: After being severely injured in his fight against Toji, Fushiguro suffers a surprise attack from Shigemo. On the verge of death, Fushiguro desperately heads toward Dougenzaka crossing and summons a certain Shikigami with his Ten Shadows Technique.

Episodes.Title: Right and Wrong
Episodes.Description: Itadori reawakens with grievous resolve as he bears witness to the aftermath Sukuna has wrought upon Shibuya. Meanwhile, Nanami continues to fight through packs of transfigured humans in an exhausted haze until Mahito appears before him.

Episodes.Title: Right and Wrong (2)
Episodes.Description: Itadori launches into a back-and-forth battle against Mahito, but he struggles against Mahito's ploy of using average people against him. Meanwhile, Kugisaki encounters one of Mahito's separated bodies as she returns to the battlefield.

Episodes.Title: Right and Wrong (3)
Episodes.Description: Itadori stands in a daze at the disaster before his eyes, his mind already well past its limit. As a curse, Mahito is elated at seeing his ideal sequence of events play out before him, and he prepares to further finish off Itadori.

Episodes.Title: Metamorphosis
Episodes.Description: After rescuing Itadori from his predicament, Todo bolsters his morale and encourages him to stand back up. As Mahito kicks things into higher gear, he begins using Soul Multiplicity and Body Repel to unleash omnidirectional attacks.

Episodes.Title: Metamorphosis (2)
Episodes.Description: The moment it appeared Itadori and Mahito's battle to the death was resolved, the being wearing Geto's body asked, "Shall I save you, Mahito?" Itadori immediately recognizes the man before him as the very same one who sealed away Gojo and leaps to attack.

Episodes.Title: Shibuya Incident - Gate, Close
Episodes.Description: Choso begins to realize the identity of the mastermind parasitizing Geto's corpse as sorcerers gather for the final moments of the Shibuya Incident. The special-grade sorcerer, Yuki Tsukumo, comes to the rescue when they're on the verge of death.

Entries.Title: D.N.Angel
Entries.Description: It's Daisuke Niwa's 14th birthday and he's not having a good day. He tries to confesses his feelings to Risa Harada but finds out she only likes him as a friend. A student Satoshi Hiwatari oversees Daisuke using skills he's not supposed to have in order to unlock an electronic lock at school. When he challenges the training traps at his house, Daisuke transforms into the phantom thief Dark a black angel that has reside within the male members of the Niwa family for generations with the purpose of stealing cursed artworks. Daisuke learns he can't transform back into himself until he steals the Saint Tears statue tonight, and that becoming Dark is his destiny. As Dark escapes, he flies by the Harada mansion, and kisses Risa's older twin sister Riku Harada.

Episodes.Title: Dark Revived
Episodes.Description: It's Daisuke Niwa's 14th birthday and he's not having a good day. He tries to confesses his feelings to Risa Harada but finds out she only likes him as a friend. A student Satoshi Hiwatari oversees Daisuke using skills he's not supposed to have in order to unlock an electronic lock at school. When he challenges the training traps at his house, Daisuke transforms into the phantom thief Dark a black angel that has reside within the male members of the Niwa family for generations with the purpose of stealing cursed artworks. Daisuke learns he can't transform back into himself until he steals the Saint Tears statue tonight, and that becoming Dark is his destiny. As Dark escapes, he flies by the Harada mansion, and kisses Risa's older twin sister Riku Harada.

Episodes.Title: Rekindled Feelings
Episodes.Description: Riku is confused about her encounter with Dark and why she thought of Daisuke. Daisuke's family explain he has to find his "sacred maiden" if he wants to be free of Dark. Later at school, Daisuke agrees to go Dark-spotting with Risa, but due to his 'love condition' finds himself unable to show; instead, going to steal a bird artwork from a city landmark. Dark makes a bet with Daisuke in which Dark wins.

Episodes.Title: Whisper of the Unicorn
Episodes.Description: The city's young girls are being kidnapped—but by who? Daisuke and Dark have to find out, so they can save the Harada twins and steal an enchanted painting artwork of a girl and her Unicorn.

Episodes.Title: Between Light and Darkness
Episodes.Description: After Satoshi sets up an ambush for Daisuke, Dark has a minor battle with his 'other half' Krad a white devil who resides within the Hiwatari family.

Episodes.Title: Double Cooking
Episodes.Description: It is Daisuke's first cooking class and an unexpected visitor comes with him: Wiz - the Niwa's family pet; Dark's familiar. Risa (Riku in disguise) and Daisuke get an exciting detention of cabbage shredding, but can Daisuke break out in time for his next phantom thief mission? In the meantime, Wiz (disguise as Daisuke) says "I like you" to Riku.

Episodes.Title: St. White Memories
Episodes.Description: Daisuke wants to buy a present for his mother's birthday… but his wallet is more than a little empty. Emiko Niwa shares the story of how she met Kosuke with Daisuke while Dark is out to "Steal The Heart Of The World's Number One Lady".

Episodes.Title: Adonis Of the Promise Garden
Episodes.Description: Dark discovers the cursed statue of Adonis has been revived. Daisuke's grandfather, Daiki, reveals that he and Dark once tried to seal away Adonis long ago, but couldn't because a tsunami had swept it away along with its castle into the sea. Dark must stop the Adonis from preying on a schoolgirl's soul.

Episodes.Title: Menou's Warning Letter
Episodes.Description: Takeshi Saehara falls in love with a girl who has been bound to the Agate Links necklace for 40 years, given by Daiki. Daiki wants Daisuke to break the spell that is keeping her in the world. Daisuke gets hesitant until the end, when the girl sees his true form and thinks it's Daiki.

Episodes.Title: A Little Romance
Episodes.Description: Wiz discovers strawberries… and girls. Wiz falls head over heels of a lop eared bunny and Daisuke is blind of that love. When Wiz takes a strawberry to her, the shop was already closed. The next morning, Wiz's girlfriend was gone and Wiz ran all around the city looking for her. Daisuke and Riku have to ease the pain of a lost love. A storm brews up and as Daisuke changes into Dark. Dark says how its amusing for Daisuke trying to save Wiz, cause no matter how long they are apart, Wiz always comes back to Dark. Daisuke also realizes his crush on Riku.

Episodes.Title: The Portrait of a Certain Musician
Episodes.Description: During a funeral of a violinist, Daisuke is transported back in time by a magical violin. Dark has to bring Daisuke back to the present after witnessing Daiki as a phantom thief.

Episodes.Title: The Temple of Neptune
Episodes.Description: Dark must steal the Horn of Neptune from under the sea which is a big task. At the same time, Satoshi sets up his own plan to capture Dark; but unfortunately, Risa accidentally takes a stroll in middle of it.

Episodes.Title: Together With Rutile…
Episodes.Description: Kosuke returns home from his travels to a welcoming Emiko. Daisuke is a little embarrassed at meeting his father for the first time. Daisuke has to steal a famed rutile ring, but Satoshi doesn't make it easy. Krad makes another appearance, and this time, he isn't going to be defeated so easily.

Episodes.Title: The Eternal Mark
Episodes.Description: When Dark goes to steal The Eternal Guide statue, a 'sealer' placed by Satoshi causes Dark, Risa and Takeshi's souls to be trapped inside a stone. To rescue them, Daisuke has to travel into what appears to be the future with Towa. While there, he stumbles upon someone special.

Episodes.Title: A New Rival
Episodes.Description: Towa moves in the Niwa household as a maid. A new student, Mio Hio, arrives in Daisuke's class. She turns out to be a little more than the class bargained for and on top of that, holds a deadly secret. Satoshi saves Daisuke in swimming class by performing CPR on him. Dark takes Risa on a date, which makes Daisuke depress in the end.

Episodes.Title: Barbecue Panic
Episodes.Description: It's school holidays. The Harada's limo breaks down on the way to activities—in front of Daisuke's house. Miss Hio also happens to be passing through the neighborhood. After a shopping spree, Emiko and Towa return and the lively Niwa household hosts a Barbecue.

Episodes.Title: I Found It
Episodes.Description: Riku revisits her childhood memories after finding an old teddy-bear in her closet that was given to her by her grandmother, Rika. Dark goes to steal an artwork from the "haunted" Old Clover Mansion… which is where Riku lost the teddy-bear when she was younger, that it was later rescued by a boy. Risa also discovers a secret close to Dark's heart after Dark says she won't see him anymore. Riku figured out later that it is Daisuke who retrieved her precious thing, the teddy bear.

Episodes.Title: A Summer Without Dark
Episodes.Description: Daisuke's class goes on an excursion to a tropical island to watch the Milky Way. Takeshi is rather into Mio. Both Risa and Riku are increasingly attracted to Daisuke and a nature hike will determine which twin will end up with Daisuke.

Episodes.Title: The Two Under The Shooting Stars
Episodes.Description: Riku sprains her ankle after a fall and Daisuke carries her. Mio is playing psychic. Risa suspects Daisuke of being Dark, but decides he's not when she realizes he doesn't act like Dark, becoming more mature. Daisuke finally realizes his true feelings for Riku after clearing a misunderstanding, and the two watch beautiful shooting stars falling near the beach.

Episodes.Title: Beautiful Heroine
Episodes.Description: Daisuke has to create an artwork for the cultural festival. Satoshi discovers his father's, Kei Hiwatari, scheme to capture Dark. Risa uncovers secrets of the love between Dark and her grandmother Rika, in a letter hidden at the Harada mansion. Meanwhile, the boys in Daisuke's class are to be performing the play "Ice and Snow", with Daisuke and Satoshi filling the lead roles.

Episodes.Title: Because I Wanted To See You
Episodes.Description: Kosuke enlightens Daisuke with the story of "Ice and Snow". Daisuke completes his piece for the festival - a painting of a snowscape, where the shadows on the purest snow are blue instead of gray. Mio must make a very important decision. As Riku gives Daisuke the pendant of friendship instead of love, Mio sacrifices herself in the end.

Episodes.Title: An Icy Voice Calling
Episodes.Description: Daisuke is feeling ill. Satoshi warns Daisuke that something is up, then Kosuke has a friendly chat with Satoshi. At nightfall, Daisuke enters the world of his painting, led by an entity known as "The Second Hand of Time". Dark has to steal the painting left at the Harada's household in order to bring Daisuke back.

Episodes.Title: Ice and Snow
Episodes.Description: Dark enters the snowscape world of the painting with both of the Harada twins in order to search and rescue Daisuke.

Episodes.Title: The Second Hand of Time
Episodes.Description: Kosuke discovers the original edition of the story, entitled "Ice and Dark". Meanwhile, Daisuke meets a girl named Freedert who is one with the Second Hand of Time, waiting for her long lost lover - Elliott. Long ago, the two lovers were cursed due to a childhood friend's jealous. Dark goes in search of "The Wedge of Time" sword, a Hiwatari's family artwork which is the key to rescuing Daisuke and bringing the story to an end.

Episodes.Title: Snow Falls in The Heart
Episodes.Description: Dark battles Krad to retrieve the Wedge of Time as the Harada twins witness it all. Satoshi repaints Daisuke's painting to retrieve him. Freedert and Elliott are finally reunited. The story of Ice and Dark is completed as snow comes falling down upon the city.

Episodes.Title: The Black Wings
Episodes.Description: Once Christmas is approaching, the signs of a 40-year repeated disaster—an extreme low tide and an earthquake—prompt the city authorities to issue an evacuation. Riku worries about Daisuke and she eventually finds out about his and Dark's identity.

Episodes.Title: Eternal Dark
Episodes.Description: Once upon a time the Hiwatari family created a living artwork, known as The Black Wings. The Niwa family, a family of phantom thieves tried to steal the artwork. The artwork must now be sealed forever. Krad and Dark fight, and at the end they both are sealed into the Black Wings, from which they came from. The Harada twins help Mio to stop Kei. After Daisuke saves Satoshi from sacrificing his life, Daisuke clearly realize Riku is his sacred maiden and the two kiss, and Dark and Krad disappear peacefully.

Episodes.Title: The Belly Bowl (Special)
Episodes.Description: The wild chase is on!  In this 6-part adventure across Penguia, three diverse kids called The CyberSquad must stop The Hacker and get their friend Mimi to her first Belly Bowl competition --a luge-like race where penguins slide on their bellies to win the coveted Vince Lombelly trophy.  When Mimi discovers a mysterious map containing a strange code incriminating Hacker, she leaves the competition and calls the CyberSquad for help. Can they stop Hacker before the clock runs out? And what will save the CyberSquad from the mayhem Hacker causes along the way? Sources of energy from nature to the rescue

Episodes.Title: Lost My Marbles
Episodes.Description: A day at the library turns into a cyberventure when Jackie, Matt, and Inez learn that Hacker has kidnapped Dr. Marbles, the only person who can save Motherboard from an evil virus. The rescuers learn to use a map as a mathematical tool as they navigate across a cyber island in search of Marbles—then try to escape before a huge earthquake turns the island inside out.

Episodes.Title: Castleblanca
Episodes.Description: Cybersquad must stop Hacker from activating his newest creation, Gigabyte, before the light of the midnight moon, or else Dr. Marbles mind will be transferred into the monster, and Hacker will learn about all of Motherboard's secrets. The kids and Digit know Hacker is in a castle on a spooky, Halloweenish site called Castleblanca. Unfortunately, Motherboard wasn't able to specify which castle he is in. The kids must survey the residents of Castleblanca to pinpoint the exact location where Dr. Marbles is being held captive.

Episodes.Title: R-Fair City
Episodes.Description: Digit is lured to R-Fair City, a cybersite full of carnival games, where he is kidnapped by a disguised Hacker. The kids must find the unfair/crooked game to find Digit. Meanwhile, they learn about chance and how to spot an unfair chance of winning and losing. Along the way they meet Lucky, a cab driver, who offers them a chance to gain a free cab ride while they search for Digit. Digit is locked in a bird cage with Buzz and Delete as his guards.

Episodes.Title: Snow Day to Be Exact
Episodes.Description: Hacker is looking for an eternal power source, so he steals Solaria's Sunisphere. The Cybersquad has to get it back before the whole site freezes over.

Episodes.Title: Sensible Flats
Episodes.Description: Hacker participates in a land rush in which participants cannot build property bigger than Judge Trudy's land. Hacker's land is accused of being bigger than Trudy's, but they turns out to be the exact same size.

Episodes.Title: Zeus on the Loose
Episodes.Description: The kids fail to stop Hacker from stealing Pandora's box in Mount Olympus, so they must solve a riddle and complete challenges to satisfy Zeus and earn a second chance.

Episodes.Title: The Poddleville Case
Episodes.Description: Hacker attempts to take power from the vault in Poddleville for himself by stealing the residents' power pods, much to the detriment of the community. Each power pod has a shape and a number from 1 to 12, and after Inez and Matt are imprisoned it becomes a race to solve the pattern and enter the vault.

Episodes.Title: And They Counted Happily Ever After
Episodes.Description: Wicked casts a spell that erases the memories of the citizens, so that they forget how to count.

Episodes.Title: Clock Like an Egyptian
Episodes.Description: Dr. Marbles finds the encryptor chip in an ancient pyramid, but the Mummy who guards the pyramid finds Marbles. When the Cybersquad arrives, they must work their way through the chambers of the pyramid, find Dr. Marbles, and escape before a trap set by the Mummy seals them inside forever.

Episodes.Title: The Secrets of Symmetria
Episodes.Description: Dr. Marbles builds Symmetria because of his passion of symmetry, but Hacker steals the symmetrizer and destroys Symmetria by splitting everything symmetrical in half. The Cybersquad has to figure out how to get the symmetrizer back from Hacker.

Episodes.Title: A Day at the Spa
Episodes.Description: The kids are assigned to steal a crystal that powers Hacker's gadgets, while distracting Hacker with a series of spa treatments.

Episodes.Title: Of All the Luck
Episodes.Description: Hacker decides he needs to change his luck from bad to good, so he hires Baskerville, a new henchman, to replace Buzz and Delete while the 10 good luck charms of Cyberspace ensure him good luck. The kids and Digit use logic to rescue the charms and stop Hacker.

Episodes.Title: Eureeka
Episodes.Description: Professor Archimedes has the encryptor chip, but has to activate the emergency defense system when Hacker arrives to steal it. He and his building shrink to 2D, and the kids and Digit have to put him back to 3D.

Episodes.Title: Cool It
Episodes.Description: Motherboard is suddenly sickened by the green liquid because of Buzz and Delete. So it's up to Digit and the kids to heal her using blue liquid.

Episodes.Title: Find Those Gleamers!
Episodes.Description: Hacker challenges the kids and Digit to a game show entitled "Find Those Gleamers!", Gleamers being lightning bugs that power ships such as the Grim Wreaker. The kids have to make their ship, the Grim Wreaker 2, take off before time expires.

Episodes.Title: Codename: Icky
Episodes.Description: Hacker steals the cyber slug Icky to destroy Aquari-yum, and the kids make a code to fool him.

Episodes.Title: Return to Sensible Flats
Episodes.Description: Hacker steals all the water from Sensible Flats to buy up their land, and the kids must determine when this started and how to fix it.

Episodes.Title: Problem Solving in Shangri-La
Episodes.Description: After Hacker kidnaps the kids, he crash-lands in Shangri-La, where Master Pi challenges both groups to a special contest. The winner is free to come and go at will, while the loser has to stay in Shangri-La until they learn to solve the problems.

Episodes.Title: Send in the Clones
Episodes.Description: Hacker's invention to clone himself accidentally clones Delete instead, leading him to produce 3 clones every time he sneezes. The kids and Digit enlist the help of clone catcher Cy Clone.

Episodes.Title: Trading Places
Episodes.Description: After crashing into each other's ships and crash-landing, the kids and Hacker must deal with bartering with one another to repair their ships. Also, Buzz and Delete suddenly become brilliant, and an evil genie named Warren disobeys his mother's orders to stay inside his bottle.

Episodes.Title: Less Than Zero
Episodes.Description: The kids chase Hacker around a building consisting of floors that have both positive and negative numbers.

Episodes.Title: Model Behavior
Episodes.Description: A Sky Wall is built to protect Happily Ever After from Hacker, but he plans to invade when Wicked's operatic voice will break it. One of the Three Little Pigs secretly aides Hacker after a promise of protection from the Big Bad Wolf, so the kids have to do double duty to expose him and stop Wicked from singing.

Episodes.Title: Fortress of Attitude
Episodes.Description: Hacker has a statue which broadcasts his voice 24/7. This leads Cybersites to surrender once they can no longer bear it.

Episodes.Title: Size Me Up
Episodes.Description: Digit and the Cybersquad are tricked into going to a land of giants, with Motherboard unaware of their presence. Hacker leaves them stranded, and threatens to send another deadlier virus to Motherboard. The Cybersquad must escape and stop Motherboard from receiving Hacker's virus.

Episodes.Title: A Battle of Equals
Episodes.Description: Hacker pollutes Cyberspace with dangerous cyber-static by tampering with four satellites designed to keep everything free from cyber-static cling.

Episodes.Title: Out of Sync
Episodes.Description: Hacker kidnaps the Beast, a member of a famous band on Mount Olympus. Without him, the band can't perform their music properly and in sync, which causes the Cybersite to begin self-destructing. Its all up to the Cybersquad to reunite the band and save Mount Olympus.

Episodes.Title: Hugs & Witches
Episodes.Description: Lady Lovelace comes up with a way to eliminate Hacker's virus, but Hacker traps her and Dr. Marbles in her time machine, and programs it to travel to the beginning of time.

Episodes.Title: Totally Rad
Episodes.Description: Hacker becomes the king of Radopolis, replacing King Dudicus. Then a competition begins and three players in Team Hacker compete against Matt, Jackie, and Inez in Team Motherboard. If Team Motherboard wins, King Dudicus reclaims his throne. If Team Hacker wins, Hacker becomes the king of Radopolis forever and the Cybersquad will never be able to return to Cyberspace. A later amendment to the bargain is that if Team Hacker wins, Inez will have to become one of Hacker's cheerleaders.

Episodes.Title: Harriet Hippo and the Mean Green
Episodes.Description: Thanks to one of Wicked's spells, Motherboard starts turning all cybersites mean and green. Digit gets the antidote but it breaks, and there isn't another one available to break the spell, so the kids must figure out how to make the antidote before all cybersites turn bad. Meanwhile, Hacker has a romantic encounter with Wicked.

Episodes.Title: True Colors
Episodes.Description: Hacker starts an election campaign to become the new ruler of Cyberspace, planning to replace Motherboard. He also appears to turn over a new leaf, doing good deeds all around Cyberspace to gain public favor for votes. The Cybersquad must prove that Hacker is lying about being good before the election is over.

Episodes.Title: All the Right Angles
Episodes.Description: Ivanca the Invincible has a treasure map that Dr. Marbles mails to Motherboard's "buddy list." However, the virus also causes her to mail it to her "baddy list," which gives Hacker the map. Meanwhile, Digit is on an undercover mission for Motherboard, going to Hacker pretending to have reverted to the dark side, into thinking he's turned evil again, to stall him long enough so the kids can find the treasure first.

Episodes.Title: Mother's Day
Episodes.Description: While Jackie freaks out over what to get her mother for Mother's Day, Hacker wrecks the Mother's Day festival in Cyberspace by interfering with a train shipment of special flowers. Jackie ultimately gets one such flower for her mother.

Episodes.Title: The Eye of Rom
Episodes.Description: Hacker steals Pyramida's Eye of Rom from its pyramid, which he plans to use against Motherboard. Because of this theft, when the pyramid's shadow hits the Nile River, the site will crash.

Episodes.Title: Whale of a Tale
Episodes.Description: Hacker reprograms trapeze artist Glowla's robotic whale partner, Spout, into going rogue to destroy R-Fair City.

Episodes.Title: Double Trouble
Episodes.Description: Hacker steals the Golden Droplet of Shangri-La, which doubles upon being removed from its pot, and doubles forever. He also kidnaps Master Pi for insurance.

Episodes.Title: Raising the Bar
Episodes.Description: The Cybrary, owned and operated by Ms. Fileshare, has a bug problem, so she hires an exterminator named the Vermin Vexor (Hacker in disguise) to help her with the problem. Hacker instead adds more bugs so all references of Motherboard get switched to himself, and he alters two bar graphs to hide the truth.

Episodes.Title: The Wedding Scammer
Episodes.Description: Wicked poses as a princess who had announced to get married, and her groom is Hacker. Sam Vander Rom and his co-host plan to air the wedding on cyberwide TV, while the kids look for the real prince and princess.

Episodes.Title: The Guilty Party
Episodes.Description: In Poddleville, Hacker gets robbed and frames magician Slythe O'Hand and his dog Presto for it.

Episodes.Title: A Time to Cook
Episodes.Description: Digit and the kids compete against Hacker on the popular cooking game show "Fearless Chef."

Episodes.Title: Trick or Treat
Episodes.Description: On Halloween, Hacker invades Motherboard Control Central with a toy frog.

Episodes.Title: EcoHaven CSE
Episodes.Description: Someone has stolen the legendary cyber beast Choocroca from cyberspace EcoHaven.

Episodes.Title: The Borg of the Ring
Episodes.Description: King Dudicus accidentally uncovers the long-lost "Totally Rad Ring of Radopolis," which grants whoever wears it on their head their hearts desires. The citizens suggest putting it in a safe place where nobody can use it for anything, but Hacker steals it and uses it to attack Motherboard.

Episodes.Title: A World Without Zero
Episodes.Description: Hacker's insulting letters to Mr. Zero cause him to leave Gollywood, leading all zeros on signs to disappear and further chaos to ensure. However, contrary to what the people think, their main central bank still has all nine million snelfus, which Hacker plans to use to finance all his conquering quests.

Episodes.Title: A Piece of the Action
Episodes.Description: Hacker doesn't know he is allergic to magnetite, which he uses to plan to erase Motherboard forever. Meanwhile, Hacker keeps a bunch of Scritter hostage, and he subsequently captures Digit.

Episodes.Title: The Creech Who Would Be Crowned
Episodes.Description: Tikiville crowns its new monarchs with a race, which Creech, once part of a royal family, plans to win. Hacker also enters the race, planning to use the crown to turn Tikiville's giant statues into an army if he wins.

Episodes.Title: The Grapes of Plath
Episodes.Description: After the prince of crabs takes a dare and becomes dishonest after falling in the Abyss, the kids and Digit must find the Grapes of Plath to restore his ability to tell the truth, located in the Fountain of Truth. Unfortunately, Hacker is pursuing the Grapes as well. Because he thought Motherboard said "Fountain of Youth", and assumes the grapes can and will fix his chin problem.

Episodes.Title: A Perfect Fit
Episodes.Description: Hacker tries to restore his giant robot, Gigabyte, by using the rays of Jimaya's sun. Delete is excited, but Buzz becomes jealous.

Episodes.Title: Be Reasonable
Episodes.Description: The Cybrary is under attack again, and the kids have to use logic and elimination processes to stop Hacker from entering Motherboard's vault.

Episodes.Title: The Snelfu Snafu (1)
Episodes.Description: The kids win the encryptor chip in an auction after saving enough money to buy it, but Hacker infected it and subsequently made himself the ruler of Cyberspace. After saving Dr. Marbles, the kids help him save Motherboard by having to reboot her, destroying the encryptor chip in the process. Meanwhile, Hacker breaks up with Wicked upon discovering she spent all 10 million snelfus on clothes and merchandise.

Episodes.Title: The Snelfu Snafu (2)
Episodes.Description: The kids win the encryptor chip in an auction after saving enough money to buy it, but Hacker infected it and subsequently made himself the ruler of Cyberspace. After saving Dr. Marbles, the kids help him save Motherboard by having to reboot her, destroying the encryptor chip in the process. Meanwhile, Hacker breaks up with Wicked upon discovering she spent all 10 million snelfus on clothes and merchandise.

Episodes.Title: Shari Spotter and the Cosmic Crumpets
Episodes.Description: Digit and the kids help Shari of Frogsnorts bake the Cosmic Crumpets. Hacker then attempts to use the magical Cosmic Crumpets to steal the powers of the scorcerers of Frogsnorts and become the most powerful magician in Cyberspace. When Hacker steals the sorcerers' powers, the Cybersquad helps Shari restore the magicians' powers.

Episodes.Title: Starlight Night
Episodes.Description: Hacker tries to destroy the festivities during Cyberspace's favorite holiday, Starlight Night (a mix of Christmas and New Year's Eve in the same day).

Episodes.Title: Balancing Act
Episodes.Description: The Cybersquad helps Sharri Spotter make a film about Frogsnorts while staying within a budget, but Hacker keeps trying to run the up budget by putting himself in the film.

Episodes.Title: Hackers Transformation: Part 1 (The Icky Factor)
Episodes.Description:
This is the first episode in the four-part mini-series "Hacker's Transformation".

Hacker kidnaps Icky to find a power source to power up his new invention so he can use it to rule over Cyberspace again.

Episodes.Title: Hackers Transformation: Part 2 (Penguin Tears)
Episodes.Description:
This is the second episode in the four-part mini-series "Hacker's Transformation".

Hacker's secret plan to take over Cyberworld by using the electric eel's energy continues. The missing piece of the puzzle is the Prism of Penguia. Since Emperor Penguia can't remember where he hid the prism, everybody in Penguia has to shed tears until it is found. The Cybersquad & Fluff must face several obstacles, including a booby trap, to "angle" their way out so that nobody no longer has to shed tears.

Episodes.Title: Hackers Transformation: Part 3 (Past Perfect Prediction)
Episodes.Description:
This is the third episode in the four-part mini-series "Hacker's Transformation".

Slider's father owes Hacker a debt, and if they don't pay up in time, Hacker will steal and take over his father's garage.

Episodes.Title: Hackers Transformation: Part 4 (Measure for Measure)
Episodes.Description:
On the final episode of the four-part mini-series "Hacker's Transformation".

Hacker's new invention is revealed, and is ready to create chaos.

Episodes.Title: A Change of Art
Episodes.Description: Hacker plans to use statues of himself to cause a power outage everywhere.

Episodes.Title: The Case of the Missing Memory
Episodes.Description: Motherboard's memory integrator has been stolen, so Digit and the Cybersquad need to find out what it looks like and who stole it.

Episodes.Title: A Crinkle in Time
Episodes.Description: Slider gets kidnapped by Hacker and gets brings him to Tick Tockia. The Cybersquad must save their friend from the Hacker.

Episodes.Title: A Broom of One's Own
Episodes.Description: Wicked builds some Broom and stated that it's a Cybersquad Seal of Approval, even though they didn't even test them. Jackie, Matt and Inez test out the brooms to see if they are faster.

Episodes.Title: A Tikiville Turkey Day
Episodes.Description: When Hacker steals the legendary Egg of Benedicta, the kids need to get the egg back from Hacker.

Episodes.Title: The Halloween Howl
Episodes.Description: The annual "Halloween Howl" bash in Castleblanca promises to be spooktacular… until Hacker takes over the Mayor's Castle and brings its seven stone gargoyles to life. Obeying Hacker's every command, the gargoyles capture the Mayor and imprison him in the dungeon. To gain control of the creepy creatures, the Cybersquad must figure out how to use division to evenly split up bunches of garlic and rock candy. But can they do it in time to rescue the Mayor and save The Halloween Howl? Meanwhile, Inez and Jackie are having a problem with their friendship after a misunderstanding.

Episodes.Title: A Clean Sweep
Episodes.Description: Buzz opens up a new doughnut shop in Radopolis. Hacker's magnetite confetti he collects is large enough to remove the memory of every single citizen of Radopolis and send them to sleep.The Cybersquad needs to design a confetti collector so they can spoil Hacker & save Radopolis before it's too late when he dominates Radopolis and renames it Hackerville.

Episodes.Title: Designing Mr. Perfect
Episodes.Description: The Wicked Witch of Happily-Ever-Afterville turns Digit into her husband. Wanda enlists the CyberSquad on a mission to Terra Swampa to rescue Digit. But first, they need to design an invention to help them get across the swamp.

Episodes.Title: EcoHaven Ooze
Episodes.Description: When Hacker takes all the Ooze from EcoHaven for himself, Inez, Jackie, Matt, Digit and Wigit must find a way to shoo Hacker away before the EcoHaven animals lose their energy.

Episodes.Title: The Fairy Borg Father
Episodes.Description: Delete is having a bad day. But things appear to brighten up when Zanko, a fairy borgfather, comes to grant Delete 9 wishes. Due to Delete's wish about bunnies, almost everybody in Cyberspace becomes bunnies. The only way to turn everyone back into themselves is for the Cybersquad to save Zanko's ladle and for delete to sacrifice his final wish.

Episodes.Title: The Flying Parallinis
Episodes.Description: Hacker kidnaps Jackie atop Mount Wayupthere and the rest of the Cybersquad must rescue her after meeting a Parallini named Teeny Weeny. In their search for the elusive Diamond Joe - the mysterious figure who holds the secret to Jackie's release.

Episodes.Title: Crystal Clear
Episodes.Description: Digit is malfunctioning, Motherboard sends the Cybersquad to get his Synchronium crystal and fix him.

Episodes.Title: Inside Hacker
Episodes.Description: Jackie, Inez and Digit shrink Matt so he can get inside Hacker so he can change back into his good guy form.

Episodes.Title: On the Line
Episodes.Description: When Hacker manages to get his NIC card back, the Cybersquad must get it back and dispose it before Hacker is able to use his Transformatron again.

Episodes.Title: A Fraction of a Chance
Episodes.Description: When the Cybersquad returns home from a meeting, Motherboard's portal glitches making them stuck in the vortex. Digit and Wicked work together to find the UVO (Universal Vortex Opener) before the Cybersquad permanently dematerializes!

Episodes.Title: Digit's B-Day Surprise
Episodes.Description: Hacker tries to ruin Digit's birthday party, though Digit thinks it's actually for Judge Trudy (since that was how the secret was kept from him).

Episodes.Title: When Penguins Fly
Episodes.Description: Penguins can't fly - or can they? In Cyberspace, on one special night each year, the penguins of Penguia take flight to deliver gifts to young borgs across the virtual universe.

Episodes.Title: Unhappily Ever After
Episodes.Description: Hacker destroys 3 boxes covering the Book of Unhappy Endings, and releases the Unhappy Endings. The CyberSquad must return the book by sundown.

Episodes.Title: Escape from Merlin's Maze
Episodes.Description: Hacker traps Shari in Merlin's Maze and the kids try to rescue her by using levers to move stone slabs that are surrounding her.

Episodes.Title: Step by Step
Episodes.Description: Hacker captures Dr. Marbles and puts him in a faraway volcano, so it's up to the kids to save him.

Episodes.Title: Team Spirit
Episodes.Description: The Cybersquad prepares to compete in Zeus' Mount Olympus games.

Episodes.Title: Jimaya Jam
Episodes.Description: The Cybersquad uses diagrams to get out of a basketball-like game called Jimaya Jam.

Episodes.Title: A Perfect Score
Episodes.Description: Jackie must be Hacker's partner in a dance competition

Episodes.Title: Chaos As Usual
Episodes.Description: The kids search for patterns in player performance to help defeat Hacker's team of titans.

Episodes.Title: Spheres of Fears
Episodes.Description: Digit and the kids are trapped in a Sphere of Fear by Hacker, so they rely on the relationship between circumference and diameter to locate the codebook they need to unlock the door.

Episodes.Title: Weather Watcher: Part 1 (Gone with the Fog)
Episodes.Description: This is the first episode in the four-part mini-series "Weather Watchers".  The Cybersquad must figure out dew point to make a rescue under fog.

Episodes.Title: Weather Watcher: Part 2 (The Emperor Has Snow Clothes)
Episodes.Description:
This is the second episode in the four-part mini-series "Weather Watchers".

The kids track a powerful storm to save the Emperor of Penguia.

Episodes.Title: Weather Watcher: Part 3 (The X Factor)
Episodes.Description: This is the third episode in the four-part mini-series "Weather Watchers".  A harmless act multiplied hundreds of times creates a huge problem.

Episodes.Title: Weather Watcher: Part 4 (Blowin' in the Wind)
Episodes.Description: This is the final episode in the four-part mini-series "Weather Watchers".  The Cybersquad must measure and compare wind speeds to find the cure to Motherboard's virus.

Episodes.Title: Fathers Day
Episodes.Description: Creech's dad Max is named "Cyberdad of the Year" for the annual Father's Day parade. However, a jealous Hacker---a one-time classmate of Max's who was always bested by him---sets out to sabotage the event.

Episodes.Title: The Deedle Beast
Episodes.Description: Digit pet-sits Dewey, a Deedle Beast who suddenly starts going berserk on his daily walk.

Episodes.Title: Spellbound
Episodes.Description: Wicked uses magic to make the Pompadorians adore her, and it's up to Jackie and Digit to break the spell. But to do so, they need to reproduce the symbol that possesses the power, but have no idea what it looks like. Matt and Inez, however, are able to use the Skwak to describe it to them.

Episodes.Title: The Hacker's Challenge
Episodes.Description: Hacker challenges the CyberSquad to solve a series of puzzles in three hours. If they fail, he vows to turn the cybersite Solaria into a digital garbage dump.

Episodes.Title: Face-Off
Episodes.Description: Fluff wants to wear his dad's lucky hockey skates in the prestigious Penguia Cup competition, but his teammates want everyone to wear cool skates they saw advertised on TV.

Episodes.Title: Peace, Love, and Hackerness
Episodes.Description: When Hacker blasts the pole of the Far-Out radio, it's up to the Cyber Squad to save Cyberspace before the radio dies.

Episodes.Title: Hackerized
Episodes.Description: Someone has hacked Sensible Flats so that everyone looks and acts like Hacker. The real Hacker tries to find out who did it while the CyberSquad seeks to save the town. To do so, though, they must scale a rocky cliff in less than three minutes.

Episodes.Title: The Bluebird of Zappiness
Episodes.Description: Hacker teams with the CyberSquad to stop his nemesis Ledge from finding the cure to Motherboard's virus.

Episodes.Title: An Urchin Matter
Episodes.Description:
The Cybersquad must figure out what is causing kelp from Mega Bay to rise to the top. Meanwhile, Hacker looks make some profit by putting on a show for Cyberspace to see, after watching a viral video on CyberTube.

Cybersites: Pefectomundo, Big Bay (on unknown Cybersite), Little Bay (on unknown Cybersite), The Northern Frontier

Episodes.Title: Going Solar
Episodes.Description:
Hacker has challenged Slider to a skate-off. But suddenly, the power to the brand new stadium goes out. The Cybersquad must find a way to harness solar energy, store it, and makes sure it lasts through the game. However, someone keeps sabotaging their plans. The show must go on!

Cybersites: Radopolis

Episodes.Title: Trash Creep
Episodes.Description:
The team battles a giant garbage heap in Perfectomundo, which threatens to break through the cybersite dome; Hacker seeks to grow an army of monster plants.

Cybersites: Perfectomundo

Episodes.Title: The Cyberchase Movie - Pt.1
Episodes.Description:
Hacker wishes to build Hackerspace by drilling on Ecotopia. He captured an aged Doctor Marbles and stole his journal to help him locate the Reformat Button. In searching for the button, Buzz and Delete capture Ollie's mom Abby, and accidentally drill into the inner slime core. Hacker locks Doctor Marbles and Abby away while he recalculates the location of the button. Motherboard sends the Cybersquad into Ecotopia to investigate where the slime came from, and what they can do to help. They soon realize that many of the animals of the Cybersite have lost their homes due to the slime destroying 2/3rds of the Preserve. In order to fix this, they must install a new preserve and format it in a way that the animals can live comfortably, plus they need to relocate the animals. Using an ark they are able to bring the animals to the new preserve, but by just narrowly escaping a whirlpool. Soon after, the Cybersquad and Ollie notice that the orangutans are in the wrong portion of the preserve. In order to figure out why, Inez and Ollie return to the old preserve and examine the wildlife. But in order to do so, Inez must overcome her fear of bats, and Ollie must overcome his fear of heights. If that wasn't enough, they overhear Hacker looking for the button and realize he has caused the inner slime core to erupt. Ollie spots his mother with Hacker, so he desperately wants to save her. The Cybersquad and Ollie formulate a plan that succeeds in rescuing Dr. Marbles and Abby, while installing a lock on the Reformat Button, thus ejecting Hacker into Cyberspace. The movie finishes with Inez and Ollie enjoying a sandwich high up in a tree.

Cybersites: Ecotopia, Control Central, and unknown frozen Cybersite.

Episodes.Title: The Cyberchase Movie - Pt.2
Episodes.Description: Auto-generated episode

Episodes.Title: Fit to Be Heroes
Episodes.Description: The CyberSquad and their new friend Scanner embark on a quest to build a new Encryptor Chip for Motherboard and cure her virus. With Hacker in hot pursuit, the kids must run, ski, canoe and climb their way to the end of the mission. In the process, they learn that a little activity over time adds up. But will they also cure Motherboard?

Episodes.Title: A Recipe for Chaos
Episodes.Description: A popular new restaurant in Castleblanca serves delicious meals, but all the residents have become cranky and tired. The CyberSquad quickly learns the restaurant's food is unhealthy...and Hacker is behind it all. To get Hacker to stop making his unhealthy food, Digit challenges him to a cook-off. But if Hacker wins, the kids must leave Cyberspace forever! Who will win the hearts--and stomachs!--of Castleblanca?

Episodes.Title: A Seedy Business
Episodes.Description: A popular new restaurant in Castleblanca serves delicious meals, but all the residents have become cranky and tired. The CyberSquad quickly learns the restaurant's food is unhealthy...and Hacker is behind it all. To get Hacker to stop making his unhealthy food, Digit challenges him to a cook-off. But if Hacker wins, the kids must leave Cyberspace forever! Who will win the hearts--and stomachs!--of Castleblanca?

Episodes.Title: Parks and Recreation
Episodes.Description: Kids in glamorous Gollywood have no safe place to play. When they discover an empty lot that can be converted to a park, they have only one opponent: Hacker. He wants the lot for his new Gollywood Tower, which he claims will broadcast entertainment to all of Cyberspace. (The tower is really meant to corrupt Motherboard's hard drive.) The CyberSquad goes up against Hacker at a city council hearing. Will they get their park, or will Hacker dazzle the council into approving his tower?

Episodes.Title: Bottled Up
Episodes.Description: Radopolis has a big problem: water bottles. Radsters are an active bunch, but their desire to stay hydrated has led to a huge bottle pile-up. Way Cool Arena has been turned into a bottle dump, and the beloved skate park is next! The kids and Slider must find a way to get rid of the heaps of empties and reduce future waste while making sure Radsters stay healthy. Can they prevent their rad cybersite from getting bottled up?

Episodes.Title: Watts of Halloween Trouble
Episodes.Description: It’s Halloween Haunt-O-Rama in R-Fair City, and Hacker has a wicked treat up his sleeve: to keep the kids out of Cyberspace forever by crashing Motherboard’s portal system. But when Buzz and Delete make a mistake, the portal system crashes too late, and the kids and Digit are trapped in R-Fair City! Now, the kids must find enough energy to power Digit’s portal rebooter and keep the amusement park going. But with the celebration in full swing, can they find big and small ways to save enough energy? And can they ever get back to Earth again?

Episodes.Title: Creech's Creature Quandary
Episodes.Description: A disagreement drives a wedge between friends when Inez tells Creech her bike path should be shut down.

Episodes.Title: A Murky Mystery in Mermaidos
Episodes.Description: On his annual trip to visit Eugene, Digit finds out that poor conditions in Mermaidos have forced many of the fish from their home.

Episodes.Title: Plantasaurus!
Episodes.Description: Motherboard invites the kids for a slumber party with Digit in Control Central.

Episodes.Title: A Reboot Eve to Remember
Episodes.Description: Delete joins forces with the CyberSquad to build a giant windmill for the little town of Bottawa after Hacker steals its power source.

Episodes.Title: Housewarming Party
Episodes.Description: As the Three Pigs celebrate their new cottage with a housewarming party, Hacker and Wicked accidentally zap away Mount Evermore -- which had been protecting the cottage from direct sunlight.

Episodes.Title: Invasion of the Funky Flower
Episodes.Description: Hacker plots a revenge when he loses to Inez at the annual flower-growing contest.

Episodes.Title: A Renewable Hope
Episodes.Description: Hacker enlists the help of CyberSquad to get back home.

Episodes.Title: The Migration Situation
Episodes.Description: Professor Bobson calls on citizen scientists to help when the trillers fail to show up for the Migration Celebration.

Episodes.Title: Back to Canalia’s Future
Episodes.Description: The kids promise to help Pearl spread the word about the water problem in Canalia, and they convince Canalians to change their water-wasting ways.

Episodes.Title: Space Waste Odyssey - Part 1
Episodes.Description: It is Motherboard's birthday, but not all is well. The CyberSquad must save Cyberspace on their own when a malfunction renders Motherboard powerless, while the Hacker attempts to crush Control Central between two giant Trash vortexes. They must reboot Motherboard, move the Control Central, and throw a birthday party for Motherboard

Episodes.Title: Space Waste Odyssey - Part 2
Episodes.Description: It is Motherboard's birthday, but not all is well. The CyberSquad must save Cyberspace on their own when a malfunction renders Motherboard powerless, while the Hacker attempts to crush Control Central between two giant Trash vortexes. They must reboot Motherboard, move the Control Central, and throw a birthday party for Motherboard.

Episodes.Title: Giving Thanks Day
Episodes.Description: The CyberSquad is excited to celebrate Giving Thanks Day with Jackie's pumpkin pie, but there's a big problem -- Hacker has taken all the pristine produce.

Episodes.Title: A Garden Grows in Botlyn
Episodes.Description: Ren and the CyberSquad use their math skills to plant a garden in an unlikely space. Meanwhile, Hacker receives an unexpected valentine.

Episodes.Title: Missing Bats in Sensible Flats
Episodes.Description: Digit's cousin, Brigit, thinks a lack of bats is the reason the flowering cactus plants are not bearing any apple cactus fruit.

Episodes.Title: Water Woes
Episodes.Description: Buzz and Delete enlist the CyberSquad to figure out why the water supply at Mount Bear Fresh Water Spa has stopped flowing. So the CyberSquad teams up with Buzz to figure out the problem.

Episodes.Title: Soil Turmoil
Episodes.Description: The team shrink to the size of tiny insects to try to help their earthworm friend Hapo figure out what is damaging his soil.

Episodes.Title: Hacker Hugs a Tree
Episodes.Description: In an unlikely pairing, the CyberSquad helps Hacker stop a new villain named Zusk who is zapping trees with his Tree X1. After Zusk leaves due to no longer having power, Hacker uses Zusk's Tree X to plant new trees in the Northern Frontier Forest.

Episodes.Title: Pursuit of the Prism of Power
Episodes.Description: The CyberSquad faces monsters, canyons, and cliffs as they pursue the Prism of Power, a vital piece of Motherboard's operating system that Hacker has stolen.

Episodes.Title: Composting in the Clutch
Episodes.Description: Hacker suctions up all the dirt in Dingerville Park just before The Dingerball Series -- a once-in-every-four-year championship -- leaving CyberSquad scrambling to refill the missing dirt before the big game starts.

Episodes.Title: A Camping Conundrum
Episodes.Description: Hacker suctions up all the dirt in Dingerville Park just before The Dingerball Series -- a once-in-every-four-year championship -- leaving CyberSquad scrambling to refill the missing dirt before the big game starts.

Episodes.Title: Journey of a Thousand Food Miles
Episodes.Description: Jackie and Inez search everywhere for cherries so Digit can make his famous cherry supreme dessert for food critic Bone Appetit. Unfortunately, Hacker stole the last batch of cherries of the season to make "Cherries a la Hacker". After traveling all over Castleblanca and Factoria, there are still zero cherries.

Episodes.Title: Duck Stop
Episodes.Description: The CyberSquad tags along as the Northern Frontier ducks migrate to Restoria, helping the flock avoid numerous hazards along the way.

Episodes.Title: The Great Outdoors
Episodes.Description: The CyberSquad investigates a mysterious creature that tramples over Crestwood Park, leaving visitors too scared to enter.

Episodes.Title: Coral Grief
Episodes.Description: The CyberSquad and Digit try to find the source that is heating up the ocean waters and bleaching the coral reef.

Episodes.Title: Sustainable by Design
Episodes.Description: Jackie wins a chance to apprentice with fashion designer Fabio DeZine and learns it takes more than a pretty drawing to design something that makes a sustaining impact.

Episodes.Title: Hacker's Bright Idea
Episodes.Description: The CyberSquad awaits the return of Kacy's Comet, but a glaring light in the sky blocks out all the stars.

Episodes.Title: Buzz and the Tree
Episodes.Description: It's Arbor Day in Cyberspace, but Buzz is more interested in his video game than planting a tree, so Delete calls on the CyberSquad for help.

Episodes.Title: The Lilting Loons
Episodes.Description: The CyberSquad investigates after the Lilting Loons of Botsberg go missing and their pond is replaced by trash.

Episodes.Title: Living in Disharmony
Episodes.Description: Hacker's niece Harmony returns to the Northern Frontier with a new pet, Sparkletoes, which quickly outstays his welcome.

Episodes.Title: Traffic Trouble
Episodes.Description: The Dingerville Dragons need to get around traffic so they can get to the field to practice.

Episodes.Title: A Garden is Born
Episodes.Description: Judge Trudy's prized Prickly Peach Cacti goes missing. Meanwhile, Buzz and Delete build their own garden.

Episodes.Title: Clean-Up on Isle 8
Episodes.Description: Auto-generated episode

Episodes.Title: Weather or Not - Part 1
Episodes.Description: The CyberSquad helps Bernice investigate when a green haze appears and heats up Stellandia. In his attempt to look extra green, Hacker unintentionally causes the weather in Stellandia to become too hot.

Episodes.Title: Weather or Not - Part 2
Episodes.Description: The CyberSquad helps Bernice investigate when a green haze appears and heats up Stellandia. In his attempt to look extra green, Hacker unintentionally causes the weather in Stellandia to become too hot.

Episodes.Title: Weather or Not - Part 3
Episodes.Description: The CyberSquad helps Bernice investigate when a green haze appears and heats up Stellandia. In his attempt to look extra green, Hacker unintentionally causes the weather in Stellandia to become too hot.

Episodes.Title: Trees, Please
Episodes.Description: Buzz, Delete and Digit take a wild ride on the wreaker; Inez and her sister have different ideas about how to fix up their building's courtyard -- Inez wants to plant trees but Camila wants a skatepark.

Episodes.Title: If You Can't Stand the Heat
Episodes.Description: The CyberSquad tries to keep cool as a heat wave sweeps through the cybersite during the annual Factoria Flower Show.

Episodes.Title: Cyberdillos in the Outfield
Episodes.Description: Something causes chaos at the Dingerville ballfield; Inez is forced to share her room with her younger sister.

Episodes.Title: A Berry Special Mother's Day
Episodes.Description: Matt gets his mom a special Mother's Day gift—two adopted alpacas for their family farm! In Cyberspace, the CyberSquad go on a wild adventure, helping Hannah find the ideal spot for growing Mother’s Day cyberberries.

Episodes.Title: Hacker's Birthday Bash
Episodes.Description: Buzz sets out to throw the best birthday ever for Hacker. Nothing but the finest food, decorations, and music will do! There’s just one problem—Buzz’s plans will cause way too much pollution! Delete brings in the CyberSquad to help.

Episodes.Title: The Domino Dilemma
Episodes.Description: A quiet day at Jackie's house is ruined by a noisy snowblower. Meanwhile, loud music in Botsberg is ruining two cyberkids' dream of setting a new domino record. The CyberSquad investigates what's causing all that racket.

Episodes.Title: A Fungus Among Us
Episodes.Description: Hacker has a new dastardly mission -- to glow in the dark! To do this, he steals all the mushrooms from the Southern Frontier. Except, this harms the cybersite's meeting tree! Can the CyberSquad get the fungi back and save the day?

Episodes.Title: The Kite Flying Showdown
Episodes.Description: It's high-flying action and problem-solving at Big Dune Beach! Digit competes in an annual kite-flying competition and Hacker is there ruining the beach's delicate sand dunes. Can the CyberSquad protect the dunes and help Digit win?

Episodes.Title: The Heat Beneath Your Feet
Episodes.Description: Buzz and Delete go on vacation to Dancing Water Springs to watch a super geyser erupt and bump into the CyberSquad. But, when Delete won't stop talking about the Earth kids, Buzz worries he may be losing his best bud.

Entries.Title: Prehistoric Park
Entries.Description: Nigel ventures to Late Cretaceous Montana (65 million years ago) to rescue a Tyrannosaurus rex. After encountering a Triceratops (named Theo) and witnessing a T. rex battle, he saves two juvenile T. rex (Terence and Matilda) moments before the asteroid impact that wiped out the dinosaurs [citation:5][citation:6][citation:9].

Episodes.Title: T-Rex Returns
Episodes.Description: Nigel ventures to Late Cretaceous Montana (65 million years ago) to rescue a Tyrannosaurus rex. After encountering a Triceratops (named Theo) and witnessing a T. rex battle, he saves two juvenile T. rex (Terence and Matilda) moments before the asteroid impact that wiped out the dinosaurs [citation:5][citation:6][citation:9].

Episodes.Title: A Mammoth Undertaking
Episodes.Description: Nigel travels to Siberia 10,000 years ago to rescue a woolly mammoth named Martha from extinction. He faces challenges including a cave bear and injured mammoths, while in the park, Martha is introduced to a herd of African elephants in the specialized 'Mammoth Mount' enclosure [citation:6][citation:9][citation:10].

Episodes.Title: DinoBirds
Episodes.Description: Nigel visits Cretaceous China (125 million years ago) to rescue Microraptors – feathered dinosaurs that support the theory that birds evolved from dinosaurs. This urgent mission occurs just before a volcanic eruption wipes out the local fauna [citation:2][citation:6][citation:10].

Episodes.Title: Saving the Sabre Tooth
Episodes.Description: Nigel and big cat specialist Saba Douglas-Hamilton travel to South America 1 million years ago to rescue the giant saber-toothed cat Smilodon. Nigel speculates that overspecialization contributed to their extinction. The rescued cats are housed in the 'Big Cat Climb' enclosure [citation:2][citation:6][citation:10].

Episodes.Title: The Bug House
Episodes.Description: Nigel travels to the Upper Carboniferous period (300 million years ago) to rescue giant arthropods including Meganeura (giant dragonfly), Arthropleura (giant millipede), and Pulmonoscorpius (giant scorpion). These creatures are housed in a specialized high-oxygen enclosure called 'The Bug House' [citation:6][citation:10].

Episodes.Title: Giant Croc
Episodes.Description: Nigel journeys to the Late Cretaceous (75 million years ago) to capture Deinosuchus, a 9-ton crocodilian relative of alligators. The mission is perilous, with concerns that Nigel 'may have bitten off more than he can chew.' The creature is housed in 'Deinosuchus Dip' [citation:2][citation:6][citation:10].

Episodes.Title: Making of Prehistoric Park
Episodes.Description: Behind-the-scenes featurette exploring the production and CGI techniques used to create the series.

Entries.Title: X-Men (Marvel Anime)
Entries.Description: Go behind-the-scenes of creating X-Men's mutant tales

Episodes.Title: The Marvel Anime Universe: Re-Examining the X-Men (Special)
Episodes.Description: Go behind-the-scenes of creating X-Men's mutant tales

Episodes.Title: X-Men: A Team of Outsiders (Special)
Episodes.Description: An in-depth exploration of Marvel's most heroic and infamous mutants.

Episodes.Title: The Return
Episodes.Description: When a young girl named Hisako Ichiki goes missing in northern Japan, her parents seek help in Professor Xavier, who calls on the X-Men to unite.

Episodes.Title: U-Men
Episodes.Description: The X-Men carry out an investigation that leads them to the U-Men, a group of mad scientists whose hideout contains a horrifying secret.

Episodes.Title: Armor
Episodes.Description: Hisako's mutant powers are weakened during a fierce battle between the X-Men and Todd, the U-Men's mad scientist.

Episodes.Title: Transformation
Episodes.Description: The X-Men are put at risk of secondary mutation when the Blackbird is attacked by a bat-like creature showing dangerous signs of Damon-Hall Syndrome.

Episodes.Title: Power
Episodes.Description: Emma allows Professor Xavier to read her mind and reveal her thoughts after Cyclops opposes her membership in the X-Men.

Episodes.Title: Conflict
Episodes.Description: An intense battle ensues when the X-Men are attacked by remnants of the U-Men after being forced to execute an emergency landing in the Blackbird.

Episodes.Title: Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Having defeated the U-Men, the X-Men come face to face with Yui Sasaki at her underground base, where she once ran a school for mutant children.

Episodes.Title: Lost
Episodes.Description: After falling ill with Damon-Hall Syndrome, Riko and Kaga attack the X-men's base, while Emma spies on a stranger in her diamond form.

Episodes.Title: Revelations
Episodes.Description: Revelations abound when it's discovered that Riko and Kaga were drugged by Yui and that Jun and Mastermind are one in the same.

Episodes.Title: Countdown
Episodes.Description: Mastermind's evil plans are frustrated as a fierce battle between the X-Men and the Four Pillars of the Inner Circle rages on.

Episodes.Title: Revenge
Episodes.Description: Despite Yui's attempts to suppress them, Takeo's powers continue to gain strength, causing reality itself to become more and more twisted.

Episodes.Title: Destiny
Episodes.Description: The X-Men mount an attack to bring down Professor Xavier's son, Takeo, before he destroys the world, putting an end to both mutants and humanity.

Episodes.Title: What a Vision Has to Do

Entries.Title: Iron Family
Entries.Description: Da Rim learns she'll go blind without an $800,000 treatment. She reunites with Gang Ju, her wealthy college classmate, who becomes unexpectedly involved in her life.

Episodes.Title: Fateful Reunion
Episodes.Description: Da Rim learns she'll go blind without an $800,000 treatment. She reunites with Gang Ju, her wealthy college classmate, who becomes unexpectedly involved in her life.

Episodes.Title: Burdened Secrets
Episodes.Description: Da Rim hides her diagnosis from family while hoping to win lottery money. Gang Ju reappears in her life as fate intertwines their paths again.

Episodes.Title: Accidental Connection
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju and Da Rim quarrel, leading to an accident that forces them together. Tae Ung grows suspicious of Gang Ju's intentions.

Episodes.Title: Mountain Discovery
Episodes.Description: Man Deuk and Gil Rye get lost on Mount Euak and witness Gil Soon burying a mysterious bag, potentially containing life-changing wealth.

Episodes.Title: Family Tensions
Episodes.Description: The family argues over Da Rim's treatment costs. Da Rim drinks alone, unable to pay, while Gang Ju unexpectedly comes to her aid.

Episodes.Title: Funeral Revelation
Episodes.Description: Man Deuk and Gil Rye attend Gil Sun's funeral, realizing the money-burying man has died. They plan to retrieve the hidden fortune.

Episodes.Title: Midnight Expedition
Episodes.Description: Man Deuk and Gil Rye secretly return to Mount Euak to retrieve the buried money, unaware they're being watched by Bong Hui.

Episodes.Title: Hope and Disaster
Episodes.Description: Da Rim schedules her surgery while Gang Ju causes a major accident at the laundry, creating new complications for everyone.

Episodes.Title: Missing Millions
Episodes.Description: Ji Yeon pressures Seung Don about missing money while Da Rim joyfully regains her sight, unaware of the stolen funds' origins.

Episodes.Title: Growing Attraction
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju can't stop thinking about Da Rim and visits the laundry's reopening. Da Rim struggles with job hunting while adjusting to regained vision.

Episodes.Title: Biological Truth
Episodes.Description: Seung Don confirms Tae Ung is his biological son but coldly states nothing will change, sparking fury in Tae Ung.

Episodes.Title: Drunken Confessions
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju gets drunk after learning Tae Ung is Seung Don's biological son, leading to a fistfight and emotional revelations about his feelings for Da Rim.

Episodes.Title: Money Trail
Episodes.Description: Ji Yeon tracks stolen money to Mu Rim's wedding venue while Tae Ung demands Gang Ju withdraw Da Rim's job offer.

Episodes.Title: Wedding Windfall
Episodes.Description: Mu Rim unknowingly uses stolen wedding cash to repay Da Rim's surgery debt while Ji Yeon investigates the money's origin.

Episodes.Title: Family Confrontation
Episodes.Description: Ji Yeon and Bong Hui slap Seung Don after learning about Tae Ung while Gang Ju faces trouble over a mysterious package.

Episodes.Title: Mother and Son
Episodes.Description: Tae Ung meets his birth mother Ae Ri in New York while Seung Don grows furious about Gang Ju attending film school.

Episodes.Title: Digital Discovery
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju traces an inflammatory post's IP address while Man Deuk searches for a ledger that could expose the stolen money.

Episodes.Title: CCTV Evidence
Episodes.Description: Seong Hun shows Gang Ju dry cleaner CCTV footage of the stolen money, unaware Seung Don sees them together.

Episodes.Title: Father's Favoritism
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju feels hurt as Seung Don favors Tae Ung. Da Rim confesses her feelings to Tae Ung again, complicating relationships.

Episodes.Title: Money Hunt
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju sneaks into Man Deuk and Gil Rye's room after overhearing the truth about the stolen money at the laundry.

Episodes.Title: Hidden Fortune
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju discovers the stolen money in Bong Hui's house while the family is distracted at Mi Ok's dinner party.

Episodes.Title: Confession Attempt
Episodes.Description: Da Rim tries confessing to Ji Yeon about the stolen money, but Gang Ju intervenes, protecting her from consequences.

Episodes.Title: Family Crisis
Episodes.Description: Man Deuk collapses and is hospitalized, leaving Da Rim distraught. Gang Ju comforts her as Ji Yeon arranges a secret meeting.

Episodes.Title: Business Clash
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju and Da Rim argue as business partners while suspicious messages appear from Gil Soon's supposedly dead phone.

Episodes.Title: Rooftop Showdown
Episodes.Description: Tae Ung tries evicting Gang Ju from the rooftop unit, but Da Rim defends him as Mi Ok investigates the stolen money.

Episodes.Title: Family Explosion
Episodes.Description: Ji Yeon storms into Seung Don and Tae Ung's shared home after learning they live together, demanding they separate immediately.

Episodes.Title: Mother's Arrest
Episodes.Description: Mu Rim handcuffs his mother Bong Hee and drives to the police station, making her confront the severity of her crimes.

Episodes.Title: Delirious Truths
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju and Da Rim desperately search for a designer while Gil Rye shows signs of delirium, accidentally confessing family secrets.

Episodes.Title: Disciplinary Action
Episodes.Description: Seung Don posts a disciplinary notice against Gang Ju on the company network, escalating their father-son conflict.

Episodes.Title: Stolen Glances
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju and Da Rim share meaningful looks as tensions rise over the stolen money and their complicated relationships.

Episodes.Title: Birthday Surprise
Episodes.Description: Da Rim plans a surprise birthday for Gang Ju while Tae Ung conspires with Ae Ri to remove Gang Ju from the company.

Episodes.Title: Company Coup
Episodes.Description: Tae Ung executes his plan to oust Gang Ju from Jiseung Group, forcing Da Rim to choose between family and love.

Episodes.Title: Secret Ledger
Episodes.Description: Man Deuk reveals a secret ledger documenting the stolen money's origins, threatening to expose everyone involved.

Episodes.Title: Truth Revealed
Episodes.Description: The full story behind the stolen money comes to light, forcing Da Rim's family and Gang Ju to face consequences.

Episodes.Title: Final Confrontation
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju confronts Seung Don about years of mistreatment while Da Rim's family prepares for potential legal fallout.

Episodes.Title: New Beginnings
Episodes.Description: In the series finale, Da Rim and Gang Ju start anew as both families reconcile and rebuild after the money scandal.
